Zeno has also been previously recognized by the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Zeno is a DJE Holdings Company.

Job Description:

SVP, Corporate Affairs


Do you thrive at the intersection of reputation, business strategy, media and stakeholder engagement? Are you energized by helping organizations navigate complexity, shape narratives and build trust with the audiences that matter most?


As an SVP, Corporate Affairs at Zeno, you will lead integrated communications programs for some of the world's most recognized brands and organizations. Working closely with senior clients, executive stakeholders and agency leadership, you will develop strategies spanning reputation management, executive visibility, internal communications, financial communications, media relations and stakeholder engagement.


This is an opportunity for a senior communications leader to shape high-impact programs, deepen client relationships, drive business growth and help organizations navigate an increasingly dynamic communications landscape.

About the Role:

  • Reputation Management & Corporate Strategy: Lead integrated communications strategies that connect business priorities to reputation, stakeholder engagement and measurable business outcomes.
  • Executive Visibility & Strategic Counsel: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and client stakeholders, helping shape narratives, guide communications strategies and navigate complex business challenges.
  • Media Relations & Earned Communications: Develop media relations strategies and oversee outreach efforts that drive meaningful coverage across business, financial, trade and industry media.
  • Internal & Financial Communications: Support executive, employee and financial communications initiatives that help organizations engage stakeholders and communicate effectively during key business moments.
  • Client Leadership & Business Growth: Build and strengthen client relationships, identify opportunities to expand engagements and lead new business efforts that contribute to agency growth.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Mentor and develop team members while fostering a collaborative environment where people can learn, grow and do their best work.
  • Operational & Financial Management: Oversee account performance, staffing, forecasting and profitability while ensuring high-quality work and strong client service.
  • Industry Leadership & Knowledge Sharing: Monitor emerging trends, share best practices and help advance the agency's corporate affairs capabilities through thought leadership and continuous learning.

About You:

  • 15+ years of experience in corporate affairs, corporate communications, public relations or related fields within an agency or other fast-paced environment.
  • Proven success developing communications strategies that drive business, stakeholder and reputational outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives and build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of reputation management, executive communications, internal communications and media relations.
  • Proven success building relationships with national business, financial and industry media.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, presentation and storytelling skills, with experience developing executive communications and leading client presentations.
  • Experience leading business development efforts, growing client relationships and contributing to agency growth.
  • Strong financial and operational management skills, including experience managing budgets, forecasting and account profitability.
  • Ability to think strategically and creatively about complex business and communications challenges.
  • Collaborative leadership style with experience mentoring, coaching and developing talent.
  • Curiosity about emerging communications trends, evolving stakeholder expectations and the future of corporate affairs.

Who We Are

At Lifestyle Communities (LC), we take deliberate action every day to nurture a culture grounded in our purpose — to Build a Connection™. Whether you’re behind the bar, in the kitchen, or on the floor, your work helps create spaces where people come together, connect, and belong.


We are guided by our core values — Performance, Quality, Communication, Teamwork, and Leadership — and fueled by our commitment to excellence. At LC, you’ll find your “why,” your place to belong, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact.


The Team You Will Join

The Goat is more than a restaurant — it’s a social experience built around community, connection, and bringing people together. Our food philosophy celebrates bright, flavorful, shareable dishes that encourage conversation and togetherness, with a focus on lighter, balanced flavors, fresh ingredients, and approachable execution.


Every member of our team plays a key role in bringing this experience to life — ensuring that each plate, every interaction, and all details reflect our commitment to great food, genuine hospitality, and memorable moments.


The Difference You Will Make

The Kitchen Lead oversees daily back‑of‑house operations to ensure efficient food preparation, high‑quality production, and a clean, safe work environment. This role provides hands‑on support in cooking and prep work, directs kitchen staff during service, upholds food safety standards, and assists with ordering, inventory, and workflow coordination. Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills are essential.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Lead and support kitchen staff during prep and service to maintain smooth operations.
  • Prepare, cook, and portion menu items following established recipes and quality standards.
  • Train new kitchen team members and provide ongoing guidance to existing staff.
  • Monitor food quality, presentation, portion control, and production efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate inventory levels and communicate ordering or restocking needs.
  • Uphold sanitation, cleanliness, and food‑safety regulations (including proper storage and labeling).
  • Coordinate with front‑of‑house management to ensure timely food delivery.
  • Assist with scheduling, task assignments, and problem‑solving during busy periods.

description: Information Security Officer Paytm Europe About Paytm Europe Merchants deserve better from their payments provider: fairer pricing, faster settlement, easier tools, and support from a partner that understands their business. Following launch in Luxembourg, the business will expand into other major European markets. Role Purpose The Information Security Officer (ISO) will establish and lead Paytm Europe's information and cyber security capability as we launch and scale our European payments business. This is a hands-on role: you will build the security framework as well as ensure it works in practice. Key Responsibilities Information & Cyber Security ● Develop and maintain Paytm Europe's information security strategy, policies, standards and controls. ● Identify, assess and manage cyber and information-security risks. ● Oversee security architecture, vulnerability management, access controls, monitoring and incident response. ● Establish effective security reporting, metrics and escalation. DORA & Regulatory Resilience ● Support compliance with DORA and applicable CSSF ICT and security requirements. ● Develop and maintain ICT security, incident management, testing and resilience capabilities. ● Support regulatory reporting, audits, inspections and security assessments. Technology & Product Security ● Embed security into product development and technology change. ● Review new products, architectures and material technology changes from a security perspective. ● Work with Technology teams to ensure secure-by-design development and deployment. Third-Party Security ● Assess and monitor the security of critical technology and ICT service providers. ● Support technology due diligence, contracting and ongoing third-party risk management. ● Work with Paytm group teams while ensuring Paytm Europe maintains appropriate local oversight and accountability. Security Operations & Incident Management ● Establish effective detection, response and escalation processes. ● Coordinate the response to material cyber and information-security incidents. ● Ensure lessons from incidents and testing translate into stronger controls. Build the Function ● Define the security capabilities, tools and resources required as Paytm Europe grows. ● Manage specialist external security providers where appropriate. ● Build security awareness across the organisation. Ideal Background You will ideally have held a senior information or cyber security role within payments, banking, fintech or another regulated technology environment, with experience operating in a complex technology and third-party ecosystem. You should combine deep security expertise with the ability to communicate risk clearly to executives and Boards. Essential Experience ● Significant information and cyber security experience in a regulated environment. ● Strong understanding of security architecture, cyber risk and operational resilience. ● Experience establishing and operating information-security frameworks and controls. ● Knowledge of DORA and the European financial-services regulatory environment. ● Experience managing security incidents and technology risk. ● Strong third-party and cloud security experience. ● Ability to communicate effectively with senior management, Boards, regulators and technical teams. ● Excellent English; additional European languages are desirable. title: PR&D – Advisor/Architect – Data & Agentic AI
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Product Research & Development (PR&D) owns the CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) data that underpins every regulatory submission, batch investigation, and process decision across Lilly's development portfolio, spanning structured systems (LIMS, MES, DMS, ELN) and unstructured scientific content (protocols, batch records, investigation reports). The function operates under strict GxP, data integrity, and audit-readiness requirements. The Advisor/Architect – Data & Agentic AI, PR&D, builds the engineering backbone that carries PR&D content from source to a governed, served agent: ingestion pipelines, ML and NLP components, retrieval services, APIs, and agent runtimes that sit on the Semantic Layer and Knowledge Graph. This role is hands-on, writing and shipping production code across data engineering, ML, and agentic delivery, and equally operates at design and guidance level: setting reference designs, reviewing team designs, and advising the teams that build on the platform. It works alongside the Systems Architect and knowledge graph engineers who own ontology and graph design. This role ensures PR&D's agents are built on shared, tested, reusable components rather than one-off pipelines, so each new agent and domain ships faster and stays governable as the footprint scales.

Path/Level: R4/R5 (Advisor/Architect), individual contributor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Data Ingestion — build and operate ingestion pipelines for multi-modal and multi-lingual PR&D content (documents, structured records, and beyond text-only formats where relevant), feeding the knowledge graph and vector store with ontology-based tagging.
  • ML & NLP Components — build entity and relationship extraction, classification, embedding, and LLM-assisted metadata enrichment components, and productionize them with testing, versioning, and monitoring.
  • Retrieval Services — implement and tune hybrid graph, vector, and keyword retrieval services for human exploration and agentic tool calls, optimizing precision, recall, latency, and groundedness against agreed evaluation sets.
  • Agent Runtimes & MCP Services — build agent runtimes and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that expose Semantic Layer capabilities (Q&A, summarization, context retrieval) with tool calling, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails — build evaluation harnesses, tracing, monitoring, and guardrails for agents, and contribute to a shared prompt library, so PR&D's agentic footprint stays measurable and governable beyond single-agent use cases.
  • Full-Stack & API Delivery — design and deliver APIs, services, and internal tooling (including front-end where needed) that make Semantic Layer and agent capabilities consumable by domain teams and scientists.
  • Platform Engineering & DevOps — own CI/CD, containerized deployment, environment management, and monitoring on Azure or AWS, with infrastructure and releases that meet GxP change-control expectations.
  • Data Quality, Lineage & Compliance Support — build data-quality checks, lineage, and access controls into pipelines and services, and produce the traceability and validation evidence needed to meet FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and enterprise security and privacy requirements.
  • Design Authority & Technical Guidance — act as design authority for ingestion, retrieval, and agent services: define reference designs, review team designs and code, advise domain teams on build-versus-reuse decisions and trade-offs, and give technical guidance to engineers building on the platform, while remaining a primary builder.
  • Reusable Engineering Patterns — establish reference implementations for ingestion, retrieval, and agent services that domain teams can reuse, reducing fragmentation and delivery time.
  • Technology Evaluation — evaluate vector database, orchestration, and agentic frameworks for CMC applicability through staged (Bronze/Silver/Gold) proofs of concept before wider adoption.
  • Collaboration & Peer Mentorship — work closely with the Systems Architect, knowledge graph engineers, and platform engineers; mentor peers on production data and agent engineering practice.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas

Python · Production Data Engineering (ETL/ELT, batch and streaming) · ML & NLP Engineering · Entity/Relationship Extraction · Embeddings & Vector Databases (Azure AI Search, AWS OpenSearch, Pinecone) · Hybrid & Graph-RAG Retrieval · Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems · Agent Orchestration (LangGraph or equivalent) · MCP (Model Context Protocol) · Agent Evaluation & Observability · Prompt & Context Engineering · API & Service Design (REST) · Full-Stack Development · Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS) · Containerisation & Kubernetes · CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code · Data Quality, Lineage & Access Control · Knowledge Graph Fundamentals (Neo4j, RDF/OWL) · Reference Architecture & Design Review · Security & Compliance Awareness · Stakeholder Communication

Basic Qualifications

  • Proven track record delivering production data, ML, and agentic systems end to end, building them rather than overseeing others who build them.
  • Hands-on production Python across data engineering and ML.
  • Experience operating agents in production with tool calling, orchestration, evaluation, and observability, beyond single-agent RAG or Q&A systems.
  • Experience building retrieval systems on vector stores and tuning them against measured quality.
  • Evidence of end-to-end ownership, from ingestion through to a served, monitored endpoint.
  • Experience operating at both levels: building hands-on, and defining reference designs, reviewing others' work, and advising teams on trade-offs.
  • Experience partnering with architects, engineers, and business or science stakeholders to turn requirements into delivered services.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies

  • Exposure to Neo4j or GraphDB, RDF/OWL, and Graph-RAG patterns.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other GxP-regulated environments, including traceability, validation, and access control.
  • Experience exposing knowledge or data services to LLM and agent consumption via MCP or equivalent tool-calling interfaces.
  • Experience with multi-modal or multi-lingual content pipelines.
  • Front-end or internal-tooling experience.
  • Comfortable explaining engineering trade-offs to senior, non-technical stakeholders.

Required Leadership Capabilities

  • Goes deep technically and communicates trade-offs in business-relevant terms.
  • Gives design guidance and advice to teams building on the platform, and reviews designs and code, while remaining a primary builder.
  • Takes ownership of a component or capability and sees it through to production and operation.
  • Raises design concerns early and unblocks peers without needing a formal people-manager structure.
  • Systems thinking that connects pipeline, retrieval, and agent design choices to downstream scientific workflows and business outcomes.

title: Director, Corporate Reputation, Real Estate | Strategic Communications
description:
Who We Are

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About the Role


We are a growing and dynamic market-leading team which advises a broad array of over 70 clients in the real estate and built environment sector, ranging from global leaders to start-ups.

These include:


  • Developers
  • Advisers
  • Property owners
  • Listed companies
  • Private equity and fund management businesses

Our clients span both residential and commercial property, as well as large, high-profile development projects.


We provide them with a comprehensive suite of integrated strategic communications services, including:

  • Corporate reputation
  • Digital and consumer campaigns
  • Financial communications and M&A
  • Crisis support
  • Public affairs

Our work spans all major markets around the world.


The Strategic Communications division of FTI Consulting (NYSE: FCN) is one of the world’s largest strategic business and financial communications consultancies, with over 800 people in more than 25 key markets.


FTI works with some of the world’s leading companies throughout the UK and around the world, providing expert advice to address their most pressing communications and business challenges.


Current clients include: Aviva Investors, Battersea Power Station, The Berkeley Group, Ballymore, British Land, Knight Frank, New West End Company Sirius Real Estate and SEGRO.


We are looking for a motivated and talented Director who can help us deliver best-in-class corporate and digital communications programmes, as well as provide consumer-focused campaigns to drive sales and lettings for our clients’ residential developments.


First-rate media relations skills are key, with an entrepreneurial approach at the heart of everything we do. Financial PR experience would be considered a bonus but is not essential.

The ability to work with best-in-class clients, help develop and mentor more junior team members, and integrate successfully into our 30-strong team, as well as FTI’s 280-strong wider London office, is crucial. For us, teamwork is everything.


What You'll Do


Deliver to Clients


  • Support and lead on a number of programmes, including both retained and project work, ensuring that client deliverables are agreed and project plans are seamlessly implemented.
  • Own client relationships and, with limited senior supervision, creatively prepare and coordinate client programmes.
  • Provide strategic advice to a portfolio of clients, manage accounts on a day-to-day basis and develop excellent relationships with your client group.
  • Focus on client retention through exemplary service delivery.
  • Leverage media relationships and intelligence to generate supportive coverage for clients.
  • Anticipate potentially difficult situations and evaluate alternatives with senior executives.

Build the Business


  • Support the team in seeking out new business leads and help convert them into profitable clients.
  • Drive and work alongside other senior members of the team on business development activities, such as pitch preparation and delivery.
  • Look to expand the Real Estate portfolio through growing business with existing clients and the broader FTI Group.
  • Proactively network with media contacts, industry analysts and influencers, as well as potential clients.

Team Involvement


  • Provide project line management for the team working on your clients.
  • Share knowledge, as well as develop and mentor junior team members.
  • Develop relationships with other teams within Strategic Communications.
  • Develop relationships with other teams across the wider FTI Consulting group.

How You'll Grow


We are committed to investing in and supporting your professional development. We have developed a range of programmes focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities.

We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through:


  • On-the-job learning.
  • Self-guided professional development courses and certifications.
  • A dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.
  • Tailored programmes for critical professional milestones as you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, ensuring you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You'll Need to Succeed


Basic Qualifications


  • Relevant communications or PR experience, either in-house or agency-side, ideally within Real Estate and the residential industry. However, good judgement and an understanding of the nuances of media messaging and reputation management are more critical.
  • Proven track record in delivering successful programmes for clients.
  • Strong understanding of the media and how it operates.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent contacts within the media and real estate industry.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Ideally, but not essentially, a track record of amplifying research, whether that is your own content or research from real estate agents.
  • Developing the ability to seek new business and being effective in new business pitching.
  • Ability to build strong rapport and relationships at all levels within FTI Consulting and client organisations.
  • Displays gravitas, confidence and maturity, with the ability to take the lead in team meetings.
  • Intellectually strong, demonstrating an ability to problem-solve and deal with highly complex issues.
  • Takes a pragmatic and 'can do' approach.
  • Demonstrates energy and a desire to provide exceptional client service.
  • Excellent team player with a positive and collegial focus.

title: Learning, Development & Employee Experience Manager
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

About The Role

As Learning, Development & Employee Experience Manager at The Park Gstaad, A Four Seasons Hotel, you will lead the hotel’s learning, development, and employee experience initiatives, helping build a strong culture of continuous learning, service excellence, engagement, and employee growth.

Reporting to the Director of People & Culture, you will play an important role in preparing our teams for the opening and supporting their development throughout the employee journey. From leading Four Seasons learning programmes and leadership development to driving employee engagement, recognition, wellbeing, and employee experience initiatives, you will help create an environment where employees have the knowledge, skills, and support required to thrive and deliver exceptional guest experiences.

The start date is February 2027, joining the pre-opening team of The Park Gstaad as we prepare for the reopening of one of Switzerland’s most anticipated luxury hospitality destinations.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and implement the annual Learning & Development strategy, Learning Needs Analysis, training plan, and employee experience plan.

  • Manage and facilitate Embark and other core Four Seasons learning programmes in collaboration with relevant presenters.

  • Maintain and develop the Certified Departmental Trainer (CDT) programme and coach Departmental Trainers.

  • Partner with hotel management teams to identify performance gaps and determine appropriate learning and development solutions.

  • Lead management and leadership development, coaching, development planning, and structured learning programmes.

  • Manage mandatory, ethics, safety, compliance, and service-related learning requirements.

  • Prepare training calendars reflecting performance gaps and learning needs and promote learning programmes and online learning.

  • Evaluate learning effectiveness through results, feedback, behavioural change, and relevant measures.

  • Drive employee engagement, recognition, appreciation, wellbeing, and employee experience initiatives across the employee journey.

  • Support employee services and accommodation-related initiatives in collaboration with People & Culture and operational teams.

  • Manage learning and employee experience budgets, resources, systems, records, and external providers.

  • Lead hotel-wide learning, culture, employee experience, change, and business transformation initiatives.

What You Bring

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a managerial learning, training, talent development, human resources, or related role.

  • Degree or Diploma in Learning & Development, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Education, Psychology, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience in adult education, workplace learning, training facilitation, instructional design, or organizational development.

  • Experience in hotel operations, preferably luxury hospitality or another customer-centric service environment.

  • Experience managing in diverse cultures.

  • Strong communication, facilitation, coaching, influencing, and organizational skills.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify when learning is the appropriate solution.

  • Knowledge of adult learning principles, Learning Needs Analysis, learning technologies, evaluation methods, project planning, and basic budgeting.

  • Fluent English and German and/or French required. Additional languages are advantageous.

  • A proactive, professional, and service-oriented approach.

  • In accordance with Swiss employment regulations, only candidates holding Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work authorization, can be considered for this position.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

  • Employee meals and uniform laundry service.

  • Monthly Employee Recognition Program.

  • Global career growth opportunities through Task Forces and Transfers.

  • Employee Travel Program after 6 months.

Schedule & Hours

  • Full-time position with flexibility for evenings, weekends, and holidays per seasonality.

  • Permanent position supporting the hotel’s pre-opening and ongoing operations.

  • Seasonal operation with primary opening periods from June to September and December to March.

description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact
As a Module Development Engineer, you will play a critical role in advancing Intel's manufacturing capabilities by driving technology development and enabling high-volume manufacturing for cutting-edge and future technologies. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing and developing sophisticated manufacturing processes, performing feasibility studies, optimizing production techniques, and collaborating with equipment and material suppliers to deliver innovative solutions. Your contributions will directly impact Intel's ability to produce high-performing, innovative products efficiently and at scale.

Business group
You will be part of Intel Corporation's manufacturing and operations organization, which is dedicated to driving innovation and delivering world-class silicon solutions. This team is responsible for supporting Intel's ongoing leadership in process technology through the development and optimization of advanced manufacturing techniques. Working within this group provides opportunities to contribute to Intel's legacy of technological excellence while shaping the future of the semiconductor industry.

- Design and develop technically advanced manufacturing processes, including material selection, parameter optimization, equipment metrology, and system design to enable new product development and functionality.
- Conduct pathfinding activities to support process and hardware development for manufacturing innovative device architectures and future product roadmaps.

- Recommend and implement modifications to enhance operating equipment and develop robust solutions for high-volume manufacturing.
- Collaborate closely with key equipment and material suppliers to integrate enabling technologies and develop cost-effective solutions that support future roadmaps.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

alesforce Professional Services partners with executive-level customers to turn business strategy into transformational outcomes on the Salesforce platform. We take an approach that considers people, process, and technology.
As a Senior Technical Architect, you will lead the technical delivery of complex, enterprise-grade solutions across Salesforce Core and emerging clouds. You will stay close to the build. You will architect, code, and prove ideas through proofs of concept (POCs), and you will use AI-assisted development to deliver faster without compromising quality.   • Expert knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and the Platform, and an understanding of Agentforce architecture.
  • Strength in data architecture, sharing and visibility, platform security, and design patterns, including Apex design patterns.
  • Knowledge of large data volume best practices, authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth), and platform security.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with other systems (ETL, middleware, CPQ, marketing automation, and legacy platforms).
  • Strong skills in Apex, Triggers, Flow, and LWC, with an understanding of environment management, release management, CI/CD, and deployment methods.

Qualified candidates should demonstrate verification judgment, planning, testbench architecture, assertions, coverage closure, structured debug, automation, evidence quality, and communication.


Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate:


  • Employment stability, reliability, and sustained accountability in prior roles.
  • Effective teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, formal verification, assertions, coverage, simulation, emulation, scripting, regression systems, performance verification, or silicon correlation.
  • Experience with technical analysis, automation, verification, root-cause investigation, quality improvement, or cross-functional delivery.
  • Experience creating decision-ready specifications, designs, plans, test evidence, reports, procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Materials Science, or a related field.

The team member regularly reaches by extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction while performing the essential functions of the job. The team member frequently stoops and crouches. The team member talks occasionally and frequently needs to hear sounds or voices. Many aromas and smells are present in the guest rooms and other hotel areas.

Lifting is regularly required to move, clean or prepare rooms. Exerts up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects such as carts, furniture and linens. The team member is subject to environmental conditions found working both inside and outside. The team member is regularly subject to extreme heat and humidity found in a laundry facility.

There is sufficient noise to cause the team member to shout in order to be heard above the ambient noise level. title: Senior Natural Resource Educator - East Meadow, NY
description:
This position will serve as the Senior Natural Resources Educator for Cornell Cooperative Extension Association of Nassau County under the leadership and oversight of the Executive Director. This position will provide development, evaluation, management, coordination and implementation for Natural Resources programming, resources, and activities related to climate adaptation and a focus on supporting municipal planning efforts. The Senior Natural Resources Educator will serve as a lead professional in the development and delivery of educational and technical assistance programs that support municipalities in planning for climate change adaptation and resilience. This role will focus on applying climate change modeling and scenario planning tools to inform practical, local decision-making and strengthen community preparedness. The Senior Natural Resources Educator will work collaboratively with local governments, regional partners, and cross-disciplinary teams to support the coordination, development, and implementation of Climate Change Adaptation and Resilience Plans (CCARPS). The position will serve as a resource in climate science, coastal ecosystems, clean energy transitions, land conservation, and nature based solutions and green infrastructure.

Key responsibilities include translating community demographic and climate data into accessible, actionable insights; facilitating scenario planning workshops; and supporting municipal leaders in identifying strategies to mitigate risk and enhance community resilience. The Educator will also lead public outreach and training efforts, develop educational materials, and maintain up-to-date knowledge on state and federal climate policies, tools, and resources.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, or closely related field in Natural Resources.
  • Experience relevant to the role of the position.
  • Valid NYS Driver’s License and the ability to meet travel requirements associated with this position.
  • Ability to work flexible hours which may include evenings and/or weekends, as appropriate.
  • Ability to work in outdoor conditions.
  • Four (4) years volunteer or work experience in climate change planning, climate adaptation and resilience, urban and community forestry, water quality, land-use planning, and/or community engagement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working on and/or familiarity with the NY-DEC Community Climate Adaptation and Resilience Planning processes.
  • Experience working directly with Long Island communities.
  • Experience with GIS software.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize program resources within the general community.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, teach and evaluate informal educational programs through a variety of delivery methods to reach individuals and groups.
  • Demonstrated ability to function as a team member working with volunteers and staff.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize reference materials for programming purposes.
  • Demonstrated ability to relate to diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively through oral, written and visual means.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize computer technologies for educational and communication purposes.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote office location if needed.
  • Ability to lift 20-50 pounds.

Responsibilities/Essential Functions:


Program Responsibilities:


Assessment and Development - 30%

  • Apply Natural Resources subject matter information and knowledge to identify gaps and trends in the community.
  • Develop and execute community needs assessment.
  • Analyze Natural Resources Program needs.
  • Make recommendations for Natural Resources programmatic offerings, enhancements and/or improvements as appropriate.
  • Maintain direct linkage with Cornell University faculty and staff for the purpose of program assessment guidance.
  • Ensure Natural Resources Program assessment is within the scope of the statewide Plan of Work and fulfillment of any funding or contractual obligations.
  • May assist in multi-Association team efforts to assess programs.
  • Apply Natural Resources subject matter knowledge to develop innovative educational programming and strategies.
  • Research, identify and select existing resources for program use.
  • Create program materials to address clients’ needs.
  • Structure Natural Resources Programs to meet the diverse needs of the community and program participants.
  • Interpret both Association and University program direction to create educational programs.
  • Develop Extension/Cornell University faculty connections for guidance with program development.
  • May be involved in assisting with multi-disciplinary and multi-Association team efforts in developing programs to address priority issues in Natural Resources.
  • Develop programming to meet changing local issues in the area of Natural Resources.
  • Use a system of on-going involvement of citizens in the program development process which expresses the demographics of the community.

Delivery, Evaluation and Applied Research - 40%

  • Occasionally teach existing Natural Resources educational programs as defined.
  • Evaluate and utilize a wide variety of proven educational methodologies in program delivery efforts.
  • Apply subject matter expertise to create innovative lesson plans necessary to deliver high-quality educational programming.
  • Serve as subject matter expert in the area of Natural Resources to staff and participants, community organizations and the general public.
  • Work to foster acceptance of the Natural Resources Program, methods and policies while addressing community and individual needs and considering diverse audiences.
  • Implement and facilitate a menu of educational programming, as needed, both virtually and in the community, to include, but not limited to: climate change adaptations and resiliency; urban and community forestry; coastal protection; & land conservation education programs.
  • Implement and facilitate Natural Resources program activities.
  • Interact with municipalities and communities in a positive manner, helping them meet their desired goals as a part of program delivery efforts.
  • Provide educational program efforts via mass media.
  • Deliver educational programs as a part of multi-association efforts when identified/appropriate.
  • Represent Cornell Cooperative Extension before the public, community leaders, government officials, Cornell or other Land Grand University faculty and staff as part of program delivery.
  • Serve as a team member and cooperate with the entire Association and Natural Resources staff to achieve Association program delivery goals.
  • Apply Natural Resources subject matter knowledge to evaluate educational program offerings.
  • Design/create program evaluation framework.
  • Implement program evaluation as designed.
  • Analyze collected program evaluation data.
  • Ensure programs meet the requirements of funding and/or contractual requirements.
  • Make recommendations for programming improvements.
  • May be involved in multidisciplinary and/or multi-Association team efforts for the purpose of program evaluation.
  • Maintain direct linkage with Cornell University faculty and staff for program evaluation guidance.
  • May have direct linkage with other Land Grant University faculty and staff for program evaluation guidance.
  • Communicate evaluation results and findings to constituents and program funders.
  • Collect and/or evaluate field samples related to the Natural Resources program and/or for applied research projects conducted in partnership with Cornell University faculty.
  • Communicate social and economic changes to Cornell University Specialists that may be studied and/or acted upon.
  • Ensure applied research is within the scope of the local and statewide Plan of Work.
  • Assist in conducted applied research in conjunction with Land Grant University Faculty as outline in Cornell Cooperative Extension program definition and standard.
  • Assist in the collaboration with Cornell Faculty to design and/or create applied research collection framework.

Administrative Responsibilities:


Direction and Management - 20%

  • Interpret Association and University program direction to plan educational programs in Natural Resources.
  • Work in cooperation with team members to help establish priorities and objectives for the Natural Resources Program Area.
  • Plan the delivery of established Natural Resources Program goals.
  • Assist in the design of a system of ongoing involvement of municipal staff, government officials, and community members which express the demographics of the community.
  • Plan educational programs and program delivery initiatives in the Natural Resources Program Area.
  • Plan fund development activities as appropriate.
  • Assist in planning major public events and programs, including, but not limited to: planning of mass media efforts related to upcoming events and programs.
  • Provide moderate-complexity administrative management of established educational program goals.
  • Assist in identifying and recommending program needs (i.e. program supplies and materials) to the Supervisor.
  • Solve problems and resolve conflicts that arise within the program utilizing appropriate policies and procedures.
  • Provide support and assist with problem solving when needed in accordance with established practices and procedures, involving the Executive Director when appropriate.
  • Manage fund development activities as appropriate.
  • Provide management (including recruitment and selection) and supervision (including guidance, performance feedback and annual performance reviews) to designated staff in accordance with established policies, procedures and protocol, and provide regular staffing updates to the Executive Director as required.

Coordination/Operation - 5%

  • Organize and coordinate program activities related to climate adaptations and resiliency.
  • Coordinate program activities that foster a robust participant base, including, but not limited to: recruiting initiatives and events, recognition events, and other programs and program activities as identified.
  • Provide administrative support for assigned Natural Resources Programs including, but not limited to: preparing correspondence, maintaining files, maintaining participant records, etc. ensuring confidentiality of all information.
  • Coordinate a menu of educational activities, as needed, virtually and in the community, to include, but not limited to: climate change adaptations and resiliency; coastal protection; & land conservation education programs.
  • Coordinate effective marketing strategies in the promotion of programming efforts to include, but not limited to: print media, news media, social media, and multi-media efforts.
  • Collect evaluation data and program needs assessments from program participants based on existing evaluation framework and guidelines.
  • Effectively maintain professional relationships with other agencies, organizations and businesses that promote effective communication and facilitate continued programming efforts.
  • This position may require the transport of program participants and/or program materials and resources in performing position responsibilities.

Professional Improvement and Other Duties as Assigned - 5%

  • In cooperation with Supervisor and/or Executive Director, jointly develop and pursue a professional development plan as a means to increase competencies relative to position accountabilities and to address changes in programming and association priorities.
  • Collaborate in activities that are in general support of Cornell Cooperative Extension including but not limited to attendance at staff meetings, timely reporting of expenses, working with other staff, general marketing of Extension programs and other duties as assigned.

Health and Safety - Applies to all duties and functions

  • Support the association to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Be familiar and strive to follow any applicable federal, state, local regulations, association health and safety policy/procedure/requirement and standard.
  • Act proactively to prevent accidents/injuries and communicate hazards to supervisors when identified.

POSITION DETAILS:


This position is a full-time, exempt position, 100% FTE. The annual salary for this position is $85,000.00 to $90,000.00 commensurate with experience. This position, based on eligibility, offers a comprehensive benefit package, to include: health and dental insurance, NYS retirement, vacation and sick leave.


Pay Rate Type: Salary


HOW TO APPLY:

Review of applications will begin immediately. Position will remain open until close of day on November 22, 2026 and until a qualified pool of candidates is identified.


Applicants need to attach/upload a resume to the online application in either Microsoft Word or PDF format. In the "Experience" section of your application, use the Paperclip icon to search for file(s) or use the "Drop Files Here" box to manually drag document(s) into your application. Once the application is submitted you will not be able to change your submission or add attachments.


External Applicants: (including current employees of other Cornell Cooperative Extension Associations) please refer to the Applying for a Job (External Candidate) document for additional guidance.


Internal Applicants: Current employees of the Cornell Cooperative Extension Association indicated in this job posting are considered internal applicants; please refer to the Applying for a Job (Internal Candidate) document for additional guidance. Contact Erika at eh482@cornell.edu with questions.


Sponsorship for employment VISA status is not available for this position.


The Association may make reasonable accommodations to enable applicants to participate in the hiring process and employees to perform the essential functions of their job. If you require an accommodation so that you may participate in the selection process you are encouraged to contact Erika at eh482@cornell.edu.

title: Associate Director, Enterprise Data Solutions Analyst
description:
The Associate Director, Enterprise Data Solution Analysis leads the business analysis that turns enterprise data and AI ambitions into well‑defined, deliverable solutions. Operating within Enterprise Data Programmes, this role translates business needs into clear requirements, quantifies value and supports AI solutions end to end, from discovery through to production and adoption, in partnership with the project leadership, platforms and business teams.

Scope of accountability:

You will lead the analysis for defined programme workstreams and AI initiatives:

  • Opportunity identification: Assess and prioritise high‑value data and AI opportunities, balancing value, feasibility, risk and strategic fit.
  • Requirements and solution definition: Elicit and document business, functional and non‑functional requirements; translate business problems into testable user stories and success metrics.
  • End‑to‑end AI solution analysis: problem framing, data readiness, technique evaluation, validation, deployment and post go‑live performance.
  • Business case and benefits: Develop lightweight business cases and track realised value against agreed measures.
  • Governance and responsible AI: Work with privacy, security, quality, risk and GxP (where applicable) to reflect policy and regulatory expectations in requirements.

Key accountabilities:

Business analysis and requirements:

  • Engage stakeholders to understand needs and desired outcomes; maintain traceable requirements and prioritised backlogs for assigned workstreams.
  • Translate programme strategy into scoped use cases and prepare directional proposals for governance forums.

Discovery, analysis and value quantification:

  • Perform process, data and landscape analysis to quantify value hypotheses (e.g., cycle‑time reduction, quality uplift, productivity gains).
  • Assess data availability, quality, lineage and access early, and flag dependencies affecting feasibility.

AI solution delivery:

  • Partner with engineers and data scientists to define evaluation criteria, thresholds and human‑in‑the‑loop checkpoints.
  • Support POCs, analyse results against cost, performance and risk criteria, and recommend whether to scale.

Governance, controls and risk:

  • Ensure privacy, security, quality and responsible AI requirements are captured, testable and evidenced.
  • Identify and escalate risks and issues; contribute to stage gates and assurance reviews.

Adoption, transition and benefits:

  • Define UAT approaches and readiness criteria; work with change management to embed solutions and gather post go‑live feedback.
  • Track and report benefits realisation and adoption, feeding lessons learned into future planning.

Stakeholder management and reporting:

  • Coordinate with leadership on dependencies, stage gates and reporting; provide clear status, risks and benefits tracking.
  • Engage with vendors and partners as needed; manage to agreed deliverables and quality.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Data Management, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in AI and Data is mandatory for this role.
  • Approximately 3 - 5 years of business analysis experience delivering requirements, process analysis and solution definition for data, analytics or technology programmes in a global, matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrable experience in the AI market, with solid understanding of AI/ML and generative AI capabilities, limitations, use cases and the vendor landscape.
  • Ideally a proven track record of delivering at least one AI solution end to end from use case definition through to production and adoption.
  • Strong skills in requirements elicitation, process and data analysis, and data quality criteria; able to translate business problems into designs and measurable success metrics using best practice frameworks, including BPMN and ER modelling.
  • Good communication in technical aspects, translate technical information depending on the audience, persuasive,
  • Working knowledge of the data lifecycle and of privacy, security and responsible AI considerations.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; effective collaborator with engineers, data scientists and assurance partners; experience working to agile principles.

Desirable:

  • Experience in life sciences or other highly regulated industries.
  • Knowledge data management, cataloguing/lineage, metadata standards and data quality frameworks.
  • Business analysis or agile certification (e.g., CBAP, PMI‑PBA, CSPO).

title: Head of Footwear Design
description:
Working at Stella McCartney is a truly rewarding experience. As a luxury fashion company with a strong ethical standpoint we are leaders and innovators in our industry.

Overview

Reporting into the Design Director and working in collaboration with the Creative Director, the Head of Footwear drives the creative vision for all Footwear collections (2 pre-collections and 2 runway collections per year, plus capsule collections and special projects). Contributing to and managing all stages of the design process while demonstrating a strong understanding of design principles and materials, the role will strategically translate creative concepts into innovative designs aligned with brand aesthetics and market needs. The Head of Footwear is responsible for leading and collaborating with designers, developers, and product managers, to create highly elevated and commercially successful footwear collections that align with the overall creative direction, brand aesthetic and ethical values.

Location: Olaf Street

Your Mission

  • Lead and inspire the Footwear team, providing clear direction, mentorship, and support.
  • Collaborate closely with the Creative Director and RTW Design Director, managing their creative vision and translate into qualitative product.
  • Create and develop Mood boards and original inspiration themes to present to Creative Director for the seasonal collection and colour card proposals then highlighting key combinations for each collection to provide to the Product Development team with clear information.
  • Lead design and research efforts to identify emerging trends, innovative materials, and new technologies, ensuring the brand remains at the forefront of the industry.
  • Oversee the fabric and prototype archive, ensuring organisation and accessibility for the design team.
  • Develop and execute the seasonal design strategy for all Footwear categories, creating 10-15 new styles per event.
  • Oversee fabric-to-sketch allocation following the product and merchandiser plan as the responsibility of managing budget and production is under them, ensuring effectively management of the design team workload.
  • Create high-quality renderings of Footwear for presentations and internal reviews.
  • Develop quick mock-ups to help the Creative Director to visualise designs and construction.
  • Record detailed notes during fittings and follow-up presentations, ensuring accurate documentation.
  • Prepare materials and presentations for design meetings and concept reviews.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, multitask and meet critical deadlines that impact the overall business
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, manufacturers, and industry partners.
  • Creatively input throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept to commercialization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design, sourcing, marketing, and merchandising, to ensure product success.
  • Manage the footwear product calendar and ensure timely delivery of collections.
  • Collaborate with Product Development to ensure that all footwear products meet or exceed quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and maintain quality control procedures throughout the supply chain in conjunction with Product Development.
  • undefined

Your Talent

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Demonstratable experience in the footwear industry, with progressive leadership responsibilities.
  • Trend awareness, keeping up with the latest fashion trends, materials and styles
  • Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Extensive experience in a leadership role within a luxury fashion house, with a focus on Footwear
  • Proven track record of developing and launching successful Footwear products.
  • Strong understanding of footwear design, materials, manufacturing processes, and quality control.

title: Business Continuity and Certification Manager
description:
If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.


Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software & information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

You’ll be supported by collaborative colleagues who share a purpose. We are 21,000 people unique in our dreams, life stories, abilities, and passions who come together every day with one ambition: to make a difference. We do our best work together, connecting to create new innovations with impact.


As a Business Continuity & Certification Manager, you will lead Business Continuity, Incident Management, and Certification activities across Poland and Romania.

Serving as the primary point of contact and subject-matter expert for resilience-related matters, you will collaborate with local and global stakeholders to strengthen organizational readiness, manage operational disruptions, and ensure compliance with Wolters Kluwer's governance and certification requirements.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the Business Continuity Management framework across Poland and Romania, ensuring alignment with Wolters Kluwer policies, standards and governance requirements.
  • Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), resilience testing and crisis simulation activities to ensure business readiness and recovery capabilities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Business Continuity and Incident Management matters, partnering with both local and global stakeholders.
  • Coordinate responses to significant operational incidents and crisis situations, ensuring effective communication, escalation and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead post-incident reviews, root cause analyses and remediation activities to strengthen organizational resilience and operational readiness.
  • Partner with business leaders, process owners and IT Disaster Recovery teams to identify critical dependencies, recovery priorities and resilience gaps.
  • Manage ISO certification and recertification programs, including the coordination of internal and external audits and the successful closure of audit findings.
  • Maintain policies, processes, documentation and evidence required to support certification, audit and governance requirements.
  • Support customer audits, due diligence reviews, tenders, RFPs and customer questionnaires related to business continuity, operational resilience and certification compliance.
  • Monitor resilience, certification and compliance risks, providing reporting, KPIs and actionable insights to senior leadership.
  • Build awareness of business continuity, crisis management and certification requirements through training, workshops and simulation exercises.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardization and stakeholder engagement initiatives across Poland and Romania to enhance organizational resilience and protect critical business operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Information Security, Business Administration, Finance, IT, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Business Continuity, Operational Risk, Disaster Recovery, Compliance, or a related area.
  • Hands-on experience with Business Continuity & Incident Management, including BIAs, BCPs, crisis response activities, and operational resilience programs.
  • Experience supporting ISO certifications, audits, compliance initiatives, and customer assurance activities such as audits, due diligence reviews, tenders, or RFPs.
  • Strong understanding of operational resilience, risk management principles, and the relationship between business recovery and IT Disaster Recovery capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively navigate a matrix organization.
  • Advanced English proficiency (C1+).
  • Professional certifications such as CBCP, MBCI, or equivalent Business Continuity credentials are considered a plus.

What We Offer

  • Stable, full-time employment in a growing organization.
  • The opportunity to make a real impact on how our teams work together.
  • A flexible hybrid working model.
  • Private medical care.
  • An employer-subsidized MultiSport card.
  • An additional day off on your birthday.
  • “10+ Leave” Program: 10 additional days of paid leave for employees with at least 10 years of total work experience.
  • Work-Life Balance Fridays: Finish work two hours earlier on the second Friday of each month.
  • Holiday allowance (“vacation benefit”).
  • Access to training and professional development.
  • A friendly working environment and support from an experienced team.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

title: Proposals Coordinator
description:
About The Role

The Proposals Coordinator is responsible for managing the end-to-end preparation and coordination of quotation, change orders, and ballparks for the respective business segment. This includes initial proposal development as well as updates driven by study design changes, amendments, and change orders. This role ensures that all scientific, operational, and financial inputs are accurately compiled, formatted, and delivered to support timely and competitive client deliverables. The Proposal Coordinator acts as a central point of coordination between Business Development, Client Management and Scientific Evaluators. Additional administrative tasks as assigned.


What You'll Do Here

Proposal & Quote Preparation

  • Coordinate the preparation of quotations based on inputs from Scientific Evaluators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
  • Compile and format quote documents using available templates.
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and completeness of all quotation materials (Excel costing files, PDFs, and supporting documents).

Opportunity Management

  • Create, update, and manage opportunities within internal systems (e.g., Salesforce or equivalent).
  • Maintain accurate records of quote status, documentation, and version control.
  • Move opportunities through defined stages (e.g., “Proposal Complete”) in alignment with process.

Quote Updates & Change Management

  • Manage updates to existing quotes resulting from study design changes, protocol amendments, or client-driven revisions.
  • Coordinate and implement change orders, ensuring all scientific and financial impacts are accurately reflected.
  • Collaborate with Scientific Evaluators to reassess scope, assumptions, and pricing as needed.
  • Maintain version control and ensure clear documentation of all revisions and change history requirements.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between Business Development (BD), Scientific Evaluators, and other Costing teams.
  • Ensure all required inputs (both for initial proposals and subsequent updates) are received, validated, and incorporated.
  • Proactively follow up with internal stakeholders to meet timelines, especially for urgent amendments or change orders.

Documentation & Communication

  • Distribute finalized and/or revised quotes (Excel and/or PDF) to BD and other Costing teams with all relevant details.
  • Ensure inclusion of key information such as internal/external assumptions and material cost breakdowns.
  • Maintain organized records of quote documentation for traceability purposes in required folders.

Process Compliance & Tracking

  • Follow established workflows and job aids for quotation generation and submission.
  • Track quotation progress using internal tools (e.g., SharePoint tracker or Salesforce) on a daily basis.
  • Ensure adherence to timelines, quality standards, and internal procedures.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve quotation templates, change order workflows, and coordination processes.
  • Support standardization of amendment and revision practices across the organization.
  • Contribute to improving turnaround times and operational efficiency.

Strategic Partnership

  • Following confirmation of strategic account BD assignments, Proposal Coordinators will be assigned to process new quotes and change orders for these accounts.
  • They will also attend regular meetings led by the Strategic Account BD or Partnership Manager to discuss and address feedback on proposals/CO process and format and will document the same in Ask Albert.

What You'll Need To Succeed

  • BA/BS specializing in business or sciences.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ related experience in proposal coordination, project coordination, or similar roles with training in the biotech, pharmaceutical or CRO industry.
  • Experience with assay development, validation, or sample analysis is an asset.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing multiple deliverables.
  • Microsoft Office’s suite of programs including: Word, Excel, and Internet Explorer.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and document management tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret study documents such protocol, study designs, method SOPs, etc.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation.
  • Ability to manage multiple conflicting priorities and meet tight deadlines
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Developed interpersonal skills are required.
  • Brings logical resolutions to conflicting interests and priorities.

What We Offer
Altasciences offers a wide variety of benefits to help our employees live healthy and fulfilling lives both at and outside of work.

  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance Plans
  • 401(k)/RRSP with Employer Match
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays
  • Paid Sick and Bereavement Leave
  • Employee Assistance & Telehealth Programs

Altasciences' Incentive Programs Include:

title: Site Quality Director
description:
Why Us?

At Par Health, we believe great healthcare is built on getting the essentials right. We’re looking for passionate, talented individuals who share our commitment to improving lives. With a global workforce, we lead with pride and purpose—prioritizing quality and safety while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and teamwork. Elevating the Essentials isn’t just our tagline, it’s the higher standard we live by every day.

Job Description Summary

The Site Quality Director is responsible for ensuring cGMP compliance and product quality at the Raleigh, NC facility while supporting broader site quality initiatives aligned with company objectives. This role provides strategic leadership in the development, implementation, and oversight of the site quality systems to ensure that all manufacturing, testing, packaging, storage, and distribution activities meet regulatory standards and deliver the highest product quality. The Site Quality Director leads and mentors quality teams, oversees daily quality operations, and serves as a key partner to site leadership by providing guidance on quality and compliance across the organization.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Manages all aspects of Site Quality System including but not limited to: CAPA, exceptions, document management, complaint investigation handling, change control, supplier quality, OOS investigations, stability programs, and regulatory inspection readiness.
  • Support a quality program which instils personal accountability for accuracy, consistency, and completeness for all operations
  • Provides direction and leadership for the successful execution of quality activities, such as:
  • Ensures health authority inspection (FDA, EU, Health Canada and others) readiness through development of compliance enhancement plans, internal audit program, and industry intelligence.
  • Customer complaint investigation, including interaction with customers and resolution of critical issues.
  • Manages the supplier quality program to fulfill regulatory and site needs.
  • Conducts and/or administers new employee, ongoing, and directed training on GMP topics to ensure compliance to regulations. Manages site training compliance program.
  • CAPA program to effectively identify and correct problems that impact product quality or compliance.
  • Validation activities for new, altered, or modified equipment, facilities, or manufacturing processes.
  • Customer audit process (approximately 50/yr.) to include preparation, hosting, and responding to issues noted – also, utilize input from customer audits and a continuous improvement tool.
  • Documents management and label control to fulfill regulatory and business needs
  • Stability program for both API products manufactured at the site.
  • Approves highly technical investigations involving product impact.
  • Sets direction and policies for cGMP compliance activities.
  • Schedules employees through subordinates, performance appraisals, and performance management of team members.
  • Budgets and adherence for areas of functional responsibility.
  • Directly interacting with key customers relating to technical issues, potential non-compliance activities, or service issues impacted by quality/compliance.
  • Resolution of critical quality issues that could impact production, customer service, quality, or compliance.
  • Interprets regulatory guidance to determine site course of action for compliance.
  • Technical expert in multiple quality functional areas, such as validation, product investigations, quality systems, and establishing compliance plans, etc.

DEPARTMENT SPECIFIC/NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Other duties as assigned with or without accommodation.
  • Participates in a certified 5S Workplace System to ensure good housekeeping and organization.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

BS Chemistry, Engineering, Life Science or related.

Experience:

7-10 years leadership experience in a chemical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, preferably specific to Quality and/or manufacturing related functions.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of chemical, pharmaceutical or bio-pharmaceutical manufacturing.
  • Must have knowledge and understanding of applicable global regulations, GMP and compendial requirements.
  • Must have thorough knowledge and understanding of QA regulations as they apply to this type of facility.
  • Experience in driving improvements in quality systems and quality performance is preferred.
  • Certification as a Six Sigma Black or Green Belt and/or as a Certified Quality Engineer is considered a plus.
  • Must have high technical ability and excellent interpersonal/communication skills. Requires excellent oral and written skills and good negotiation skills to effectively communicate and influence the outcome of quality related plans, programs, and activities throughout the business unit.
  • Must have the ability and experience to drive cost reduction while continuously improving performance, as well as the ability to lead employees in making these changes.

RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHERS/ SCOPE:

  • This position reports to the Interim Head of Quality, Generics.
  • This position will have frequent communication and working relationships with departments and plant managers.
  • Interacts with internal Staff (Department and Plant Managers) on all Site management issues. Advises Staff on compliance issues. Report on overall performance and critical quality issues to Corporate Quality. Interacts with Corporate Quality personnel, R&D, and quality and managers within the organization. Works with Commercial team on customer issues. External contacts include regulatory authorities, state, federal and international (FDA, OSHA, EPA, NCDENR), suppliers, customers and community contacts.
  • Financial responsibilities include managing multi-million payroll and operating budgets. Also recommends major purchases and capital expenditures that are necessary to maintain operations of QC laboratory and to maintain or improve the site’s GMP compliance and performance.

title: Supply Chain NPD Project Manager
description:
If you are a current Ruger employee, please click here to apply internally.


Job Description:

Job: Supply Chain NPD Project Manager

Location: Mayodan, NC; Prescott, AZ; Hebron, KY; or Newport, NH

Reports to: Sr. Director, Enterprise Planning & Procurement

Ruger is seeking a Supply Chain NPD Project Manager to lead supply chain readiness for new product development (NPD), engineering changes and product discontinuations. The Project Manager owns the integrated part phase-in / phase-out process and Plan for Every Part (PFEP) readiness, combining time-phased demand, usable inventory, open supply, supplier capacity and qualification milestones to determine feasible launch and cutover dates. The role coordinates cross-functional decisions, exposes inventory and service trade-offs, and recommends launch dates through the approved program governance process. Planning retains daily MRP and scheduling ownership; Procurement retains commercial sourcing and contracting authority.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the integrated NPD part phase-in / phase-out plan, with accountable owners, dependencies, readiness gates, cutover milestones and contingency actions across sites.
  • Ensure SC PFEP development and readiness for every affected part: revision, BOM usage, source, lead time, MOQ / order multiple, replenishment method, safety stock, packaging, logistics and storage location.
  • Maintain a reconciled inventory position covering usable on-hand, allocated stock, WIP, in-transit material, open purchase orders, supplier-held inventory and quality holds by part, revision and site.
  • Build time-phased new-part ramp and legacy-part depletion scenarios using approved demand, BOM quantities, yield, service / aftermarket needs, inventory and committed receipts; prevent double-counting.
  • Determine feasible launch dates from the latest critical-part availability, supplier qualification, tooling, production capacity and logistics readiness dates; test inventory coverage through ramp-up.
  • Recommend product launch and cutover dates with documented assumptions, risks and cost / service trade-offs; secure cross-functional go / no-go decisions and communicate approved dates.
