title: Application Security Engineer(s), Canadian Segment Technology
location: CAN, Ontario, Waterloo, 500 King Street North
description:
Join our Canadian Segment Technology Application Security team!


Manulife Bank’s Application Security team shapes how security is built into the applications and APIs that support our banking business.


In this hands-on technical role, you’ll partner with engineering teams, security specialists, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful security risks, influence secure design and delivery, and help teams make informed, risk-based decisions. You’ll work across a diverse application portfolio and contribute to evolving capabilities in application and API security, threat modeling, secure software delivery, automation, post-quantum readiness, and AI-assisted security analysis.


Application teams remain accountable for implementing changes to their applications and managing incidents. Your role is to provide application-security expertise by identifying and assessing risk, recommending practical mitigations, and validating security improvements.


We are open to candidates with different levels of application-security experience. The scope, level of independence, and complexity of work will be aligned with the successful candidate’s experience and demonstrated capabilities.


Position Responsibilities:

  • Lead application and API security assessments, bringing together evidence from manual and automated testing, code security reviews, penetration tests, static and open-source analysis, vulnerability disclosures, and other sources to assess and prioritize risk.
  • Own complex application-security findings from investigation through clear recommendations, stakeholder alignment, remediation tracking, and validation. Help teams distinguish urgent exposure from lower-risk issues and identify practical approaches to reducing risk.
  • Lead threat modeling, architecture, and secure-design reviews for complex or cross-team initiatives, identifying security requirements and control gaps early and guiding teams toward effective mitigations.
  • Advance secure software delivery practices by helping incorporate appropriate application-security guidance and controls earlier in development and CI/CD workflows.
  • Assess systemic security exposure across the Bank’s application and technology footprint, including technology and cryptographic inventories. Identify cross-cutting gaps, develop prioritized recommendations, and contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness.
  • Evaluate external dependencies and security controls, including vendors, third-party services, WAF and DDoS-related capabilities, working with business, engineering, risk, and control owners to understand exposure and evaluate improvements.
  • Apply Manulife’s enterprise security standards within the Bank, assessing application alignment, identifying material gaps, and recommending appropriate local controls while partnering with the global teams that own enterprise standards.
  • Improve application-security tooling, automation, and reporting, including exploring responsible uses of AI and helping build or enhance AI-assisted security analysis with appropriate human oversight.
  • Communicate application and portfolio-level risk clearly to engineering teams, security partners, business stakeholders, and leaders, helping them understand trade-offs and make informed decisions.
  • Build security capability across the organization by coaching developers and colleagues on secure design and coding practices, sharing reusable guidance, and contributing to the Bank Security Guild.
  • Provide technical security support during incidents when requested, contribute to post-implementation reviews, and help maintain resilient coverage of critical team responsibilities through knowledge-sharing and cross-training.

Required Qualifications:

  • Relevant experience in application security, software engineering, cloud engineering, security architecture, or a related technical security discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of web and API security, common application vulnerabilities, secure design, threat modeling, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience performing or guiding application and API security testing, secure code reviews, or comparable technical security assessments.
  • Ability to analyze security findings and technical evidence and translate them into practical, risk-based recommendations that engineering teams can implement.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-hosted application environments, with the ability to identify security exposure and clearly communicate technical risks and trade-offs to both technical and business audiences.
  • Sound judgment and collaborative leadership, with the ability to work independently while building alignment and influencing teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple assessments and priorities.
  • A collaborative approach to knowledge-sharing, mentoring, continuous improvement, and team resilience.

Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in one or more of the following would be an asset, but you do not need to bring everything listed below to be successful in this role:


  • Application-security testing and review techniques and tools, including SAST, SCA, DAST, penetration-test analysis, or secure code review.
  • Cloud security, DevSecOps, CI/CD security controls, security tooling, or vulnerability-management workflows.
  • Security frameworks and guidance such as OWASP, NIST, or CIS, particularly experience applying enterprise security requirements in a regulated environment.
  • Third-party or vendor security assessments, WAF/DDoS controls, cryptographic inventories, or post-quantum cryptography readiness.
  • Ability to review application code in languages such as Java or JavaScript/TypeScript, including Node.js applications, or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software-development workflows.
  • Experience applying AI within security workflows, or developing and evaluating AI-assisted security-analysis capabilities.
  • Relevant security education, professional training, or certifications, or a demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters
Every executive team is asking the same question: how do we move AI from pilot to production, safely and at scale? As a Salesforce Chief Technology Optimisation Architect, you’re the person they call.

You’ll be the senior technology advisor to CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers and enterprise architects in government, health, education and financial services. These are organisations where AI has to be trusted, governed and built to last. You’ll design the architecture that connects their data, their platforms and their AI strategy. You’ll do it on the products they’re betting on: Agentforce and Data Cloud, with direct access to the latest Salesforce AI innovations.

  • Build on the AI products, not around them. You’ll work with Agentforce and Data Cloud as they evolve, with early access to new releases and a direct line to Product and Engineering.
  • Work the AI-native way. Our delivery model uses AI agents and tooling in the work itself. That clears the routine tasks so your time goes to judgement, customer relationships and decisions that can’t be automated.
  • Advise at the top, with the team behind you. You’ll lead at the executive level, backed by Salesforce Professional Services: 150K+ engagements, 77K certifications, 25+ years of experience and 10K consultants.
  • Embedded AI tooling in delivery: Using Claude to draft Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), generate data schemas, conduct threat modeling, and evaluate multi-cloud topologies.
  • AI-assisted engineering leadership: Championing prompt-driven architecture and modeling AI-assisted development patterns for client teams.


Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Design architectures that get customers to production value they can measure, shortening time to value and supporting the customer’s ROI case.
  • Help customers grow their use of the platform by moving Agentforce and Data Cloud solutions from pilot to production at scale.
  • Curiosity to keep learning as AI evolves. We’ll support you with certifications and real scenarios.
  • First 3 months: Targeting AI certifications (e.g. Claude Certified Architect , Claude Certified Professional) credentials during onboarding.
  • By 6 months: Own the architecture direction and Data + AI roadmap for a strategic customer. Lead executive design authority sessions where the big decisions get made.
  • By 12 months: Be the recognised Data & AI authority for your customers. Contribute reference architectures, governance frameworks and accelerators that other CTOs and delivery teams reuse.
  • Architecture problem-solving with Claude: leverage Claude for stress-testing designs, simulating integration edge cases, comparing architectural trade-offs, and generating technical specifications.
  • AI-assisted coding approaches: Coach customers on modern coding workflows using Claude—including prompt-driven scaffolding, Apex/LWC generation, automated test suite creation, and AI-assisted code reviews.
  • COE expansion: Extended the Salesforce COE focus area to include developer velocity and AI-native development workflows.
  • Link architecture decisions to business outcomes and cost. Explain the trade-offs in terms of value, TCO and consumption.
  • Work with the Business Transformation Architect and account team to set success metrics up front, such as value realised, adoption and consumption, and report against them after launch.


Minimum Requirements

  • Deep enterprise architecture experience across cloud, integration, data architecture and modelling, and master data management, as an enterprise, solution or data architect or in a CTO or Head of Architecture role.
  • Credibility with C-level decision makers. You can go from a boardroom discussion to a design workshop in the same day.
  • Understanding of data and AI: data platforms, governance, and ML, generative or agentic AI. Data Cloud and Agentforce experience is highly regarded, and we’ll help you build the rest.
  • Strong facilitation, communication and presentation skills, and ownership of problems.
  • Applied AI Literacy & Tooling: Practical command of frontier AI tools like Claude—spanning context-window engineering, prompt-driven technical synthesis (ADRs, threat models, data schemas) and for system design, technical synthesis, and problem decomposition. Translating data sovereignty, privacy, and regulatory assurance requirements in public sector into trusted, auditable architectures.
  • AI-Assisted Coding Acumen: Practical knowledge of AI-augmented software engineering using Claude (context-window management, prompt engineering for code generation, unit test creation, and secure code review practices) and and designing human-in-the-loop agentic workflows that accelerate scaffolding, testing, and secure code review across the SDLC.

  • Nice to have : AI Unit Economics & Architectural Trade-offs: Fluency in balancing model capability, latency, and consumption-based economics (across Agentforce, Data Cloud, and frontier LLMs) to design scalable, cost-predictable enterprise solutions.

title: DSP/Systems Architect
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About the Role

We are seeking a talented DSP and Systems Engineer to design, develop, and architect digital signal processing algorithms for next generation high speed SerDes PHYs. This role focuses on developing advanced adaptation, calibration, and equalization algorithms to optimize link performance, improve signal integrity, and enable robust high speed data transmission.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in digital signal processing, communication systems, and algorithm development, with hands on experience in MATLAB, Simulink, Python programming, and IBIS AMI model development. Familiarity with advanced detection and equalization techniques, including JPP, MLSE, and MLSD, is highly desirable. Knowledge of high speed interface protocols such as Ethernet and PCIe is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and architect DSP algorithms for next generation SerDes PHYs, focusing on high speed data transmission, channel compensation, and receiver performance optimization
  • Develop adaptive algorithms for receiver adaptation, automatic calibration, and optimization of PHY parameters across varying channel conditions and process, voltage, and temperature variations
  • Develop and evaluate equalization techniques, including feed forward equalization, decision feedback equalization, and other DSP based channel compensation methods
  • Evaluate and implement advanced signal detection and sequence estimation algorithms, including JPP, maximum likelihood sequence estimation, and maximum likelihood sequence detection
  • Build behavioral and system level models using MATLAB and Simulink to analyze channel characteristics, algorithm performance, link margins, and end to end SerDes system behavior
  • Develop Python based tools and simulation frameworks to automate analysis, evaluate algorithm performance, and validate DSP architectures across a range of channel and operating conditions
  • Develop, integrate, and validate IBIS AMI models to characterize SerDes transmitter and receiver behavior and assess end to end link performance
  • Collaborate with analog, mixed signal, digital design, verification, and systems teams to translate system requirements into implementable DSP architectures and support silicon development and productization
  • Analyze simulation and characterization results to identify performance bottlenecks and optimize power, performance, complexity, and robustness

To Be Successful in This Role, You Should Demonstrate

  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to break down complex technical problems into structured, implementable solutions
  • Effective cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across multidisciplinary engineering teams
  • A detail-oriented approach to algorithm development, simulation, and validation to ensure accuracy and performance across varying conditions




Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a related field
  • At least 5 years of relevant industry experience in DSP, communication systems, signal processing, or high speed interface design

The experience must include:

  • Fundamentals in digital signal processing, communication theory, and equalization techniques
  • Hands on experience developing algorithmic models using MATLAB and/or Simulink
  • Proficiency in Python programming for simulation, data analysis, and algorithm validation
  • Understanding of adaptive algorithms, receiver calibration, and high speed serial link fundamentals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree with 3 or more years of relevant industry experience, or Ph.D. with 2 or more years of relevant industry experience, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience designing and architecting DSP algorithms for high speed SerDes PHYs
  • Familiarity with advanced detection and equalization techniques, including JPP, MLSE, and MLSD
  • Experience developing, debugging, and validating IBIS-AMI models for high speed serial links
  • Knowledge of high speed interface protocols, particularly Ethernet and PCI Express (PCIe)
  • Experience with high speed channel modeling, signal integrity analysis, link budget evaluation, and performance optimization
  • Familiarity with SerDes receiver architectures, including CTLE, FFE, DFE, clock and data recovery (CDR), and adaptive control loops
  • Experience collaborating with analog and mixed signal design teams to transition algorithms from system level models to silicon implementation

title: Materials Planner
description:
If you are a current Ruger employee, please click here to apply internally.


Job Description:

Job: Materials Planner

Location: Newport, NH (onsite)

Reports to: Sr. Director, Enterprise Planning & Procurement

Ruger is seeking a Materials Planner to own demand translation, material requirements planning, inventory parameters, supply balancing, and exception management for assigned materials and sites. The role connects ERP demand and inventory data to procurement and production workflows, creates timely supplier requirements, and drives shortage recovery. The Planner provides Buyers with accurate demand, timing, and capacity signals; the Buyer retains ownership of sourcing events, commercial negotiations, supplier awards, and contracts.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate forecasts, customer demand, production plans, bills of material, inventory, open orders, and lead times into time-phased material requirements.
  • Run and govern MRP planning cycles; review exception messages and release, reschedule expedite, defer, or cancel planned supply within approved rules.
  • Create and maintain purchase requisitions, delivery schedules, forecast releases, and planning signals with complete quantity, need date, site, and specification data.
  • Own day-to-day material availability, shortage identification, shortage prioritization, expedite/de-expedite activity, and recovery tracking with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Maintain planning parameters including lead time, order policy, lot size, safety stock, recorder points, calendars, yield, and planning fences; document and approve changes.
  • Balance service and working capital by monitoring inventory turns, excess and obsolete exposure, slow-moving stock, stockouts, and purchase commitments.
  • Develop constrained supply plans using supplier capacity, confirmed dates, transit times, quality holds, alternate materials, and production priorities.
  • Lead recurring shortage, material readiness, and supply-demand reviews; communicate risks, recovery dates, decisions, and owners.
  • Measure supplier delivery performance, confirmation accuracy, lead-time reliability, and schedule adherence; provide objective performance data to Buyers and QBRs.
  • Support SIOP / integrated business planning by reconciling demand, capacity, materials, inventory, and supply risks across planning horizons.
  • Improve demand, inventory, supplier, and purchase-order master data; investigate root causes of recurring planning exceptions and implement controls.
  • Develop business-continuity scenarios for constrained and single-source materials in partnership with Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Operations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business, analytics, engineering, operations, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years in production planning, material planning, inventory control, supply planning, or related manufacturing experience.
  • Hands-on understanding of MRP, bills of material, lead times, safety stock, lot sizing, capacity constraints, inventory accounting, and supplier schedules.
  • Working knowledge of ERP planning and purchasing modules (Oracle preferred), Excel analysis, and business-intelligence or planning dashboards.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage shortages, prioritize competing requirements, analyze root causes, and communicate credible recovery plans.
  • Strong cross-functional facilitation, quantitative analysis, attention to master data, urgency, and disciplined follow-through.
  • Ability to work across sites, time zones, and supplier operating calendars.

Preferred Qualifications:

CSCP, CIPM, APICS/ASCM, or similar certification preferred.


Other Requirements:

  • Be willing and legally able to handle firearms.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship now or in the future (i.e. must be a US person as defined in applicable export control laws).
  • Successfully complete a pre-employment background check and drug screening.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package including competitive salary, profit sharing and bonus
  • Health benefits including medical, dental, and vision
  • Life and Retirement benefits including 401k match, company 401k contribution, basic and supplemental life options, as well as short- and long-term disability plans
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Relocation Assistance is available for the right candidate
  • Casual work environment

Our motto, "Arms Makers for Responsible Citizens®," echoes our commitment to these principles as we work hard to deliver quality and innovative firearms. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.


What's the role?

The Seller Growth team designs the tools that help Etsy sellers grow their businesses, whatever their size, tenure or stage. That covers insights into how a shop is doing and what a specific type of seller needs to grow, listing-level support, ads and promotions, and new ways of thinking about and promoting a business. It is a broad scope, and much of it is problem space where no company has found a great answer yet.


As Senior Manager, Product Design for Seller you will set the design direction for this space and lead a team of four designers. You will also stay in the work: designing alongside your team in Figma, and leading through design as much as through coaching. We want a strong product designer, who can tell a clear story about what makes a seller experience distinctly Etsy, in its point of view, its tone of voice and its craft.

This is a full-time position reporting to Sr. Director of Product Design- Seller. Your work will help independent sellers build businesses around what they love. You’ll join a team that cares deeply about craft, collaboration, and creating opportunities for creative entrepreneurs.


What's this team like at Etsy?

Seller Design is a team of 14 designers who own the seller side of Etsy's business. You will manage four of them, and you will work with all of them. Designers at Etsy work in squads alongside product, engineering, research and analytics partners. Together they take on problems, test solutions and get feedback directly from customers.


What does the day-to-day look like?


Lead with Strategy

  • Set a clear design vision and strategy for Seller Growth, grounded in what different sellers need to grow.
  • Share your team’s work regularly with peers and leadership, and tell the story behind it.

Bring Clarity to Complexity

  • Take big, ambiguous problems from zero-to-one, concepts to end-to-end experiences.
  • Pivot across several independent squads, each with its own problem, and keep the work cohesive.

Grow and Support Your Team

  • Coach, develop, and support four designers.
  • Lead through design. Work in Figma with your team, and take on projects directly as needed.

Champion Craft & Systems Thinking

  • Shape a point of view, tone of voice and level of craft that is distinctly Etsy, so the tools feel thoughtful and not just functional.

Drive Measurable Impact

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, research and analytics to turn ideas into measurable impact for sellers.

Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy’s discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.


Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

  • 10+ years of professional experience in product design.
  • 4+ years of direct people management experience. You have managed, developed and guided designers, not only led projects.
  • A track record of taking large ambiguous projects from zero to one
  • Strong craft and storytelling. Your portfolio shows how your work reflects a brand's voice and purpose, and answers the user's question thoughtfully
  • Strategic thinking, plus the ability to pivot and context switch across several different problems at once.
  • A hands-on approach. You are comfortable in Figma, designing alongside your team, and taking on projects yourself.
  • Experience on two-sided marketplaces or complex tooling
  • A knack for taking something complex and making it simple and digestible for the audience that uses it.
  • Positively add to team culture, bringing motivation, optimism, quality and integrity to everything you do.
  • Nice to have: prior work on growth products and agency experience


Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.


Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.


Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.


Salary Range:

• Geo-1: 211,000.00 - 285,000.00 USD Annual
• Geo-2: 190,000.00 - 256,000.00 USD Annual



What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.


Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. title: Senior Commercial Revenue Lead
description:
ABOUT TEMENOS


Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market-leading core banking suite and best-in-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. Our mission is to create a world where people can live their best financial lives.


VALUES


Care about transforming the Banking landscape.

Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.

Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.

Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.


The Senior Commercial Revenue Lead (APAC) – Asia Pacific role reports into the Global Revenue Operations Lead and is responsible for leading revenue operations in Asia Pacific. The role is a business partner to the Managing Director of Asia Pacific and critical in the planning & execution of regional revenue strategies & operations.


RESPONSIBILITES

• Be the trusted partner of the Asia Pacific Managing Director, using business acumen and data insights to recommend, implement, and execute opportunities & strategies for revenue growth.

• Support sales commercially by managing deal governance and pricing support on new business and renewal opportunities, and identifying, generating, and executing commercial initiatives.

• Partner with regional reporting analysts to effectively communicate actionable and insightful information & recommendations to regional stakeholders and business partners (“tell a story” with the data).

• Design, lead, and enforce the execution of short-term, mid-term, and long-term regional revenue cadences with the partnership of regional revenue leaders and revenue analysts.

• Drive large deal, territory/business, and end-of-quarter deal reviews.


SKILLS

• Drive weekly forecast cadence with regional revenue leadership, using analytics and methodologies to surface forecast risk & opportunity.

• Champion a standard of excellence and influence the adoption of ideas related to sales methodologies, value selling, pipeline management, sales tool utilization, account management practices, and territory development to all levels of regional sales.

• Help design and implement account & country territory and coverage models.

• Represent regional revenue operations on global initiatives and projects.

• Support the onboarding of new sales hires by teaching on sales best practice and processes.

• Be a consultative, proactive business partner with cross-functional leaders outside of sales.

• Provide leadership & mentorship to the revenue analytics analyst in the region.

• Excellent leadership capabilities, with experience in influencing cross-functional teams and mentoring junior analysts. Information in this document is subject to change without notice.

• Strong prioritization and project management skills leveraged to effectively utilize limited time and resources from business partners.

• Ability to “tell a story” by communicating complex data insights clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with demonstrated experience presenting & recommending to executive leadership.

• Experience in executing transformational projects that require change management best practices & communication.

• Demonstrated ability to assess regional business trends and identify actionable insights for sales and operations leadership to improve or implement process excellence.

• Strong understanding of SaaS & Subscription business models and go-to-market strategies. Experience in the B2B software industry and reporting on software industry standard license and SaaS metrics.

• Clear communication and excellent interpersonal skills (both written and verbal) with a willingness to serve stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Excellent knowledge Microsoft Office and advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required.

• Proficiency in Salesforce.com, Microsoft Excel & PowerPoint, and experience with revenue intelligence platforms, such as Clari.

• 10+ years of experience in a combination of revenue operations and finance related fields.


SOME OF OUR BENEFITS include:

title: Process Excellence Manager
description:
Join Us!

At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

As a Process Excellence Manager, you will serve as an Executive Strategic Transformation Partner and Global Practice Leader. In this role, you are accountable for defining, architecting, and orchestrating enterprise-wide transformation agendas across global workflows and multi-regional business verticals, moving beyond traditional Process Excellence methodologies to rethink, reinvent, and redesign service models at massive scale.


You will bridge the gap between long-term global executive strategies and ground-level operational execution by fusing Lean Six Sigma discipline with AI-driven insights, cognitive automation, and digital innovation. Partnering directly with VP, and Director-level leadership across Google and GOC, you will lead multi-million dollar global charters to eliminate systemic vulnerabilities, elevate the end-to-end user experience, develop high-performing teams, and secure a lasting competitive advantage.

  • Enterprise Transformation Strategy & NorthStar Governance: Define, govern, and drive the multi-year "future-state" NorthStar operating model across global verticals and sites. Lead systemic change anchored on Operational Agility, Digital Transformation, and Industry Excellence.
  • Next-Gen Service Excellence & CX Architecture: Champion the global Service Excellence framework, architecting friction-free agent and customer journeys to maximize user delight, eliminate customer friction, and maintain service delivery standards globally.
  • Predictive Operations & Advanced Data Modeling: Drive the shift from reactive troubleshooting to predictive, proactive operations by integrating advanced quantitative telemetry, machine learning models, and Lean Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate process variation.
  • Enterprise Resilience & Risk Safeguards: Architect global resilience and business continuity frameworks that proactively identify and eliminate systemic technical and process vulnerabilities, ensuring operational adaptability during high-stakes organizational pivots.
  • Value Engineering & Strategic Industry Benchmarking: Act as an enterprise consultant, benchmarking internal workflows against global industry standards to align product synergies and unlock non-linear Value Engineering opportunities.
  • Scalable AI & Intelligent Automation Roadmaps: Own the global portfolio strategy, business-case validation, and architecture for AI, GenAI, and cognitive automation integrations, accelerating the transition to self-healing operational ecosystems.
  • Rapid Prototyping & MVP Incubation Leadership: Foster a "prototype-first" culture by guiding teams in incubating functional Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) using GenAI tools, low-code/no-code platforms, and prompt engineering to accelerate time-to-value.
  • Executive Orchestration & Global Alignment: Lead cross-functional alignment and governance across VP/Director-level stakeholders in Operations, Product, Engineering, Quality, and Account Management across multiple geographies.
  • Executive Storytelling & Value Realization: Craft compelling narrative strategies and executive dashboards for Google and GOC senior leadership, translating complex operational metrics into measurable business value and ROI.
  • People Leadership, Coaching & Capability Building: Directly manage, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of Transformation Managers and Specialists. Build robust succession plans and champion enterprise-wide upskilling in AI-enabled process redesign and modern innovation frameworks.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 12-14+ years of overall experience in Service Sector / KPO / Global In-house Center operations, with a verified track record of leading large-scale Strategic, Digital, and Process Transformation programs.
  • People Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management and experience leading large, matrixed, multi-regional transformation teams.
  • Process Mastery: Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB) with demonstrated success embedding continuous improvement into AI-first operating models.
  • Digital & AI Fluency: Proven track record of architecting and deploying digital solutions (GenAI workflow integrations, cognitive automation, RPA, Low-Code/No-Code architectures) at enterprise scale.
  • Portfolio & Program Governance: Demonstrated success owning multi-million-dollar global transformation portfolios that deliver measurable ROI, operational resilience, and efficiency.
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional executive presence with demonstrated success acting as a trusted advisor to VP/Director-level stakeholders.
  • Industry / process knowledge: Experience in delivering transformational initiatives for Technical workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or MBA.
  • Certified Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt (LSS MBB) and advanced certifications in Agile, Scrum, or Design Thinking.
  • Deep domain expertise in aligned business verticals (<Replace & Ads, Customer Finance, Legal, Marketing, Safety, Support Trust vertical: with> ).
  • Experience overseeing hands-on incubation of functional AI MVPs and data architectures (e.g., Looker, BigQuery, Python/R, AppSheet).
  • Exceptional ability to navigate organizational ambiguity, resolve cross-functional friction, and steer large ecosystems toward strategic transformation.

title: DC Ops Technician III - UK
description:
The Data Center Operations Technician owns the responsibility of all IT Infrastructure, including customer configurations, within the data centre environment ensuring all customer server environments are secure, operational and maintain 99.999% uptime.


Responsibilities:
• Utilize custom monitoring software and internal ticketing system to provide customer support
• Identify and troubleshoot simple hardware failures on x86-based servers to include the replacement of failed hardware components
• Troubleshoot simple operating system storage issues including file system, disk management and RAID technologies
• Support servers running Microsoft Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Server, Ubuntu Linux or VMWare ESX Server
• Simple operating systems administration to include troubleshooting of login, password and connectivity issues
• Troubleshoot simple local area network (LAN) connectivity issues and re-establish remote access to customer configurations utilizing SSH, Terminal Services/Remote Desktop Services or Remote Access Controllers
• Complete the troubleshooting, configuration and replacement of network device hardware including access and aggregation switches, firewalls, load-balancers and security appliances
• Complete the troubleshooting, configuration and replacement of storage devices including DAS and NAS arrays
• Complete customer configuration maintenances including hardware modification, operating system installation, mounting of the devices within cabinets and completion of all cabling needs required
• Troubleshoot copper and fibre cabling including initial installation testing as well as connectivity issues with previously deployed copper or fibre cabling
• Provide technical communication relating to customer configurations in a concise, professional manner
• Adhere to company security policies and procedures, including health and safety and local governing requirements as directed
• Execute and maintain meticulous 5S and housekeeping practices
• Demonstrate no less than full performance in a continuous, consistent, measurable manner
• Demonstrate high levels of passion and enthusiasm when providing Fanatical Support to all customers and co-workers
• Communicate in an honest, transparent manner focused on building trust amongst customers and co-workers
• Demonstrate a clear understanding of Rackspace software toolsets required for the monitoring and support of customer configurations
• Demonstrate the ability to successfully complete customer configuration maintenances and hardware troubleshooting
• Attention to detail and adherence to maintenance instructions ensure customer configuration rework is not required
• Customer configuration maintenances are quality controlled and adhere to published policy and process to ensure Global alignment
• Troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities lead to accurate and timely resolution of technical events
• All customer incidents or potential risks to our customers must be investigated utilizing the root cause analysis method
• All customer interactions, both internal and external, are conducted in a manner that delights customers
• Process and policy sign off is conducted in a timely manner, with clear understanding of the subject matter, by the specified due date
• All areas of responsibility are clean and organized with specific areas designated for all moveable items


Knowledge:


• Experience with Dell PowerEdge and HP ProLiant rack server hardware preferred
• Experience with Cisco ASA and ASA-X series firewalls, F5 BigIP and Brocade ADX series load-balancers and Alert Logic IDS preferred
• Experience with Cisco Catalyst 2900, 4900, 6500 and Nexus series switches preferred
• Experience with Dell PowerVault DAS, NetApp and EMC Isilon NAS systems preferred
• Must be able to work a flexible schedule, 24x7x365 coverage, including holidays and weekends
• Must be able to prioritize work in a fast paced, high-pressure environment
• Must possess strong written and verbal skills, type with proficiency and exhibit professional phone etiquette
• Must be proficient with productivity software including, but not limited to, Microsoft Office and Open Office as well as email client software
• Must be able to lift 50 lbs over head
• Must have reliable transportation and be willing to occasionally travel (2-4 wks/yr)
• Success in the role requires the following personal qualities: Effective Communicator, Self-Starter, Team Player, Welcomes Feedback, Ability to Identify Problems, solicits input from others when making decisions


Education:


• Educated to GCSE level or equivalent; further education in a technical vocation advantageous


Certifications
• Industry recognized certifications in operating systems, networking, security and/or storage technologies preferred


Other Skills
• Previous experience or ability to show familiarity with building, repairing or upgrading hardware components required
• Previous experience in a customer service-oriented position preferred


** This role is for Third Shift (Night Shift). Normal working hours are 21:00h-07:00h, 4 nights a week with Sun-Wed and Wed-Sat shift pattern.

title: Teknisk Produktleder
company: MESTERGRUPPEN REGNSKAP OG IT AS AVD OSLO
description:
Mestergruppen søker nå en teknisk produktleder til Headless Commerce plattformen vår, et av våre strategiske satsingsområder innen digitalisering. Omnium er en Headless Commerce plattform som er en sentral del av netthandelsplattformen vår, der vi forvalter og bygger netthandelstjenester til alle kjedekonseptene i Mestergruppen.

Vi styrker nå vårt Headless Commerce team som er sentralt på alle virksomhetskritiske områder for digitale kanaler. Vi har mange initiativer på gang, blant annet forvaltning og utvikling av skybaserte løsninger; som dataplattform, masterdataplattform, identitetsplattform og netthandelsplattform (inkl. Headless Commerce).

Vi har en mikrotjeneste basert systemarkitektur av distribuerte systemer i sky og med DevOps som prinsipp. Vi bruker Google Cloud Platform, og jobber med Infrastruktur as code og automatisert deployment med Pipelines. Vi benytter komponenter som Elasticsearch og Kafka i dataplattformen vår, Auth0 i identitetsplattformen og Omnium og Sanity i netthandelsplattformen; på backend koder vi i Kotlin og Python, og på frontend koder vi i React. Claude Code har også blitt en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen vår det siste året.

Hos oss vil du få

  • Være med å videreutvikle det sterkeste fagmiljøet innen systemutvikling i byggebransjen
  • Være med å påvirke produktvisjon, veikart og prioriteringer for Omnium og netthandelsplattformen
  • Jobbe tett med utviklerne på domenedrevet design og arkitekturvalg
  • Bruke data og brukerinnsikt til å prioritere backlog og måle effekten av det vi leverer
  • Jobbe i team basert på smidig metodikk
  • Utvikle deg innen ny teknologi og mulighet til å jobbe med noe som angår oss alle – hjemmene våre

Vi søker

  • Du har erfaring som produktleder, produkteier eller tilsvarende rolle for tekniske plattformer eller systemer innen Headless Commerce / eCommerce
  • Har god forståelse for systemarkitektur og kan kommunisere godt med utviklingsteam, uten nødvendigvis å kode selv
  • Vi ser etter deg som brenner for det du holder på med, er ambisiøse og liker høyt tempo.
  • Du tenker helhetlig og er opptatt av å forstå og levere på behovene til brukerne av produktene vi utvikler.
  • Har god kjennskap til Order Management-systemer for digital handel, gjerne fra byggebransjen.
  • Erfaring med Omnium er en fordel

Vi kan tilby

  • Interessante faglige utfordringer og utviklingsmuligheter
  • Et svært godt tverrfaglig og sosialt miljø
  • Du blir del av boligbransjens fremste og største kompetansemiljø
  • Gode muligheter for kurs og årlige midler til egenutvikling
  • Fleksibel arbeidstidsordning, konkurransedyktige betingelser og personalordninger

Synes du dette høres spennende ut og har lyst til å være med på å forme fremtiden til en av Norges viktigste bransjer og arbeidsplasser? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg! Ta kontakt for en uformell prat.

I Mestergruppen mener vi at mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi verdsetter medarbeidere med ulike perspektiver, erfaringer og bakgrunner, og jobber aktivt for å skape et inkluderende miljø der alle føler seg velkomne og respektert. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke. Bli en del av vårt team - og bidra til å forme en fremtid hvor mangfold er vår styrke og inkludering er vår standard.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mestergruppen er et av Skandinavias største konsern innen byggevarehandel, overflatebehandling, VVS, huskjededrift for boligentreprenører og eiendomsutvikling. Sammen med våre 1500 medlemsbedrifter skal vi bli best i bransjen. Mestergruppen er eid av Ferd og medlemmene våre. I Mestergruppen finner du mange av Norges mest kjente kjedekonsepter i byggebransjen - se oversikten på mestergruppen.no.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our 50,000+ employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.


The Customer Insights and Analytics (CIA) organization is Lilly's business-facing insight and analytics capability, uniting Market Research and Analytics into a single, integrated partnership model that helps our business partners make faster, better, more customer-centered decisions.



Position Overview



The Market Research Associate Director is a senior researcher who owns the end-to-end research agenda for a brand, indication, or global platform within a Strategic Intelligence team. Reporting to the platform's Primary Market Research Lead (Senior Director, Global Market Research), the role defines the critical business questions, designs the learning plans, frames and runs the research, and translates findings into strategy.


In the operating model, judgment, framing, and interpretation live here, in the team; scale, methods, vendor and panel management, and cross-TA execution are drawn from centralized Research Science — so this role holds the craft and the interpretation while central capabilities field and scale the work behind it. The role works under a global platform Primary Market Research Lead and, alongside analytics, contributes to a single integrated point of view rather than a standalone deliverable, pulling analytics in per decision so research and analytics reach the business as one connected narrative.


The role works AI-first by default: routine and standard research is delivered through AI and synthetic methods, human-in-the-loop validation governs AI-assisted output, and scarce human judgment is reserved for framing the question, catching a flawed sample, and interpreting in context.



Responsibilities



● Act as the objective voice of the customer and market to guide brand strategy, positioning, and launch decisions for the platform, framing work decision-first across the brand lifecycle (from early aspiration through in-market optimization).
● Own the platform's learning plan — define the critical business questions and knowledge gaps and determine methodology, scope, approach, and budget — defaulting to AI-enabled and synthetic methods, and reserving human-led primary research for the highest-stakes decisions.
● Frame and lead primary (qualitative and quantitative) and secondary research; design instruments and interpret results, working directly with external research vendors and drawing on centralized Research Science for methods, quality standards, vendor governance, panels, and specialized techniques.
● Synthesize and triangulate findings across studies, geographies, and sources — including first-party, patient-journey, and market-sizing data — into a clear, decision-ready narrative with minimal bias.
● Feed research into the platform's integrated point of view and partner with the team's analytics associates and the US Marketing Analytics lead, pulling analytics in per decision to deliver one connected answer rather than disconnected outputs.
● Contribute to always-on signal detection and continuous in-market reading rather than episodic, one-off projects.
● Interpret and apply the centrally-run brand-health and continuous trackers — owned by Research Science's Qual, Quant & Brand Health Tracking team — reading brand performance, brand health, and competitive dynamics into the platform's decisions and integrated point of view, rather than running the trackers.
● Apply the right work mode to each activity — agentify routine and standard work, keep a human in the loop for validation, and personally lead the high-stakes research.
● Manage research projects, budgets, and timelines and ensure compliance and privacy with zero defects, partnering with Research Science on vendor, panel, and contract management.
● Coach business partners on how to frame the strategic questions market research is best positioned to answer, and connect delivered insight back to the decisions and outcomes it shaped.
● Where the role is a specialty variant (e.g., competitive intelligence and external-trend monitoring, market access, or LillyDirect / CX), own that distinct craft while sharing the same level architecture, seam, and AI-first default.



Basic Requirements


● Bachelor's degree.
● 3+ years of experience in market research or marketing


Additional Skills / Preferences



● MBA or Master of Marketing Research.
● Therapeutic-area (Dermatology, Allergy, Respiratory, Aesthetics, GI and/or Rheumatology) and product-launch experience.
● Proven ability to partner across market research and analytics and to influence without authority.
● Strong framing, synthesis, written, and verbal communication skills.
● Proficiency with data-visualization, synthetic-research, and AI-enabled research tools.



Additional Information



● Travel: Up to 20% depending on business needs.
● Lilly may provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role for internal applicants only

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer I, Search Ranking
description:
Company Description
Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.


We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.


What’s the role?


Etsy is hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer I to join the Search Ranking team. We are looking for individuals who are product and delivery-driven, and are passionate about making ML innovations in search ranking to help improve the Etsy buyer experience.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone interested in building user-centric ML systems for a two-sided marketplace with 90+ million buyers, 6+ million sellers, and hundreds of millions of unique, handmade, vintage listings.

The work on the team involves building machine learning systems to define and deliver Etsy’s search experience — helping buyers find items they’ll love by combining relevance, personalization, and marketplace value in every search result. The work directly contributes to Etsy’s growth by driving better buyer engagement, higher conversion, and a healthier marketplace


This is a full-time position reporting to the Engineering Manager.


What does the day-to-day look like?


  • Work closely with software engineers, machine learning engineers, product managers, and designers to set the future technical direction of Etsy’s search ranking system
  • Push the state of the art and apply the latest advances in ML to improve the relevance and personalization and increase buyer engagement
  • Develop models that target Etsy-specific problems, including but not limited to personalized ranking, multi-objective optimization, etc.
  • Prototype, optimize, and productionize large-scale ML models that help deliver key results Conduct experiments (A/B testing etc.) to validate the effectiveness of ML models and pipelines
  • Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:


  • You have a successful track record of applying machine learning techniques in addressing real-world problems.
  • You can successfully create requirements and lead your team from design through to delivery.
  • You have experience with / working in one of the following fields: deep learning, user sequence modeling, multi-modal learning, etc.
  • You have hands-on experience in training, deploying, monitoring, debugging and iterating on large-scale production machine learning systems in search, ads, and/or recommendation systems.
  • You write understandable and testable code. You have the ability to write and manipulate data at a large scale and you have an eye towards maintainability.
  • An M.S. or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science or related engineering fields with at least two years of practical machine learning experience


Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.


Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.


Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.


Salary Range:

• Geo-1: 182,000.00 - 246,000.00 USD Annual
• Geo-2: 164,000.00 - 222,000.00 USD Annual



What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.


Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. title: Tech Lead .NET Developer
description:
Je bent een senior .NET developer. Je denkt in domeinen en architectuur en je hebt al een team aangestuurd. Je hoeft niet de luidste in de kamer te zijn om gehoord te worden. Mijn klant, een software consultancy bedrijf, zoekt precies dat profiel. Je werkt in langdurige opdrachten langdurige opdrachten van 2 à 3 jaar. Eén dag per week werk je intern, waar je andere developers coacht en aan eigen projecten bouwt.

Bij de klant (4/5de)Je bent de technische spil in het project. Je werkt bij klanten in de regio Antwerpen, Mechelen en Brussel, van gevestigde bedrijven tot snelgroeiende scale-ups. Ze zitten in sectoren zoals supply chain, publieke sector, automotive en utilities.

  • Je bepaalt mee de technische koers en de architectuur.
  • Je maakt een technische keuze en legt uit waarom.
  • Je begeleidt het team van developers in het dagelijkse werk.
  • Je bewaakt kwaliteit, performantie en duurzaamheid van de code.
  • Je helpt de klant keuzes maken die over vijf jaar nog kloppen.

Een voorbeeld: een bestaand .NET platform moet mee evolueren naar een cloud-native architectuur. Jij tekent mee de route uit, neemt het team mee in die overgang en zorgt dat de klant er op lange termijn beter van wordt.

Omdat opdrachten gemiddeld 2 à 3 jaar lopen, leer je het domein van de klant echt kennen. Je ziet de gevolgen van je eigen keuzes en je bouwt een band op met het team.

Intern (1/5de)Eén dag per week werk je voor het bedrijf zelf. Je coacht andere developers, deelt kennis en werkt mee aan interne projecten. Het bedrijf werkt aan de technische en menselijke kant van software ontwikkeling. Jij brengt daar je ervaring in als lead.

Wat je moet hebben:

  • Minstens 7 à 8 jaar ervaring als .NET developer of architect. Met 10 jaar of meer ben je helemaal op je plaats.
  • Ervaring met domain driven design.
  • Inzicht in architectuur, zoals microservices en clean architecture, en ervaring met het maken van technische keuzes.
  • Ervaring als team lead.
  • Vlot Nederlands en Engels.

Je technische bagage:

  • Senior niveau in .NET, Azure, Entity Framework en SQL Server.
  • Automated testing: unit- en integratietests.
  • Messaging-systemen zoals RabbitMQ of NServiceBus.
  • Git, CI/CD en Azure DevOps.
  • Een fullstack blik en voeling met React, Angular of Blazor.
  • Een agile werkwijze, met Scrum of Kanban.
  • Actieve interesse in AI binnen softwareontwikkeling.

Wie jij bent: Je bent een rustige kracht. Je werkt geconcentreerd, luistert eerst en spreekt wanneer je iets te zeggen hebt. Dan zeg je het ook, ook als het tegen de stroom in gaat. Een tafelspringer past hier niet. Iemand die bij een slechte architectuurkeuze zijn mond houdt, evenmin.

Je neemt ownership zonder er een show van te maken. Als iets misloopt, kijk je eerst naar je eigen aandeel. Je blijft nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologie en probeert graag iets uit voordat je erover oordeelt.

title: Senior Corrosion Protection Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

At APA, our purpose is to secure Australia’s energy future. We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it with our customers and communities as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.

We now have an exciting opportunity available for a Senior Corrosion Protection Engineer to join us in our Gas Operations West team in Perth, WA on a Full-time permanent basis.


Reporting to the Team Leader Asset Engineering WA, you will provide corrosion and cathodic protection (CP) engineering expertise to help keep APA's WA pipeline assets, including compressor and delivery stations, operating safely, reliably and compliantly. You will support the effective management of corrosion in accordance with AS/NZS 2885 and AS/NZS2832, the Pipeline Licence, the Safety Case and the PIMP. You will also support project delivery, integrity management and continuous improvement, while leading the identification, management and optimisation of corrosion threat controls across the WA asset base.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor CP system performance and identify areas of under- or over-protection.
  • Analyse CP survey data and investigate CP system and coating issues, recommending remedial actions where required.
  • Assess corrosion anomalies identified through ILI, pipeline dig-ups and inspections, and recommend appropriate remediation actions.
  • Prioritise dig-ups and provide engineering justification for deferrals based on risk and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide corrosion and CP engineering support to pipeline projects, including materials selection, coatings and system design.
  • Support safety studies, audits and regulatory compliance activities, while driving improvements to corrosion monitoring and CP systems.

Your background

  • Degree in Mechanical, Materials, Metallurgical, Chemical or Corrosion Engineering, or NACE/ACA certification with proven corrosion engineering expertise.
  • Significant engineering experience in oil and gas pipelines, energy infrastructure, or comparable buried metallic assets.
  • Strong knowledge of cathodic protection, external corrosion management, and pipeline integrity principles.
  • Working knowledge of AS/NZS 2885 and AS 2832.1.
  • Experience assessing inspection, integrity and corrosion data to support technical decision-making.

About the Team

You will join Gas West's Asset Engineering Team, a multidisciplinary group based in Perth that supports the integrity, reliability and continued development of critical gas infrastructure throughout Western Australia. Working with both Operations and Maintenance and Project Delivery, you will help shape the integrity of existing assets and new capital projects, applying specialist corrosion and pipeline protection expertise to engineering decisions at every stage of the asset lifecycle. The role requires occasional travel and the ability to coach, influence and motivate people across teams to improve pipeline safety and equipment maintenance.

Working at APA

At APA, we’re committed to fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where you can achieve your best.

We offer targeted career development programs designed to accelerate your career, competitive remuneration, employee benefits, flexible working arrangements, and wellbeing initiatives are all part of what we’ll offer you. Our inclusive parental leave policy offers 18 weeks of leave, including superannuation, to support parents at work and in life.

We employ around 2,000 people across Australia and are committed to building a high-performing, customer-focused organisation where everyone feels safe, valued, and trusted to perform at their best.

We are APA

At APA, we’re taking on one of Australia’s greatest challenges:​ the energy transition.​ We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.​

​

We proudly own, operate and manage a diverse $20 billion portfolio of assets which deliver essential services to communities and customers across Australia. And we own more than 15,000 kilometres of gas pipelines which deliver energy to households and businesses across every corner of Australia.

As the partner of choice in delivering infrastructure solutions for the energy transition, we’re focused on bundled remote grid energy solutions, electricity and gas transmission, and future energy, including hydrogen and carbon capture and storage.

Our customer focused approach means we understand our customers and offer them reliable, innovative, and cost-effective energy solutions that support their decarbonisation ambitions.

We are committed to securing Australia’s energy future by delivering infrastructure solutions for Australia’s energy transition and supporting the decarbonisation ambitions of our customers and communities.

Join our team and be part of securing Australia’s energy future. We’d love to hear from you.

APA is an equal opportunity employer. The safety, health and wellbeing our people, community and environment a priority. We embrace diversity in our people to ensure our workforce is representative of the communities that we operate in.


Applicants must be eligible to work in Australia to be considered.

This vacancy works with critical APA data, systems or infrastructure and candidates are subject to background vetting (including Police checks) before & during employment.

title: Lending Transaction Specialist (Syndicated - Commercial Lending)
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Lending Transaction Specialist within PNC's Agency Closer organization, you will be based in Cleveland, OH; Cincinnati, OH; Dallas, TX; Kalamazoo, MI; Denver, CO; Pittsburgh, PA; or East Brunswick, NJ.

The Lending Transaction Specialist typically operates during standard business hours between 8:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, with onboarding and training generally occurring between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. As proficiency develops and business needs dictate, employees may be asked to adjust start and end times at manager discretion and may occasionally be required to work outside standard business hours, sometimes with limited notice, to support transaction volume, system testing, or other business-critical activities.

Strong commercial lending and syndicated lending experience is highly preferred.

The Lending Transaction Specialist (Senior Closer) is responsible for managing complex commercial, syndicated, and other lending transactions from initial closing assignment through funding, booking, and post-close activities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and an exceptional client experience throughout the transaction lifecycle. Closings are assigned based on transaction complexity, individual skill set, and capacity. The Senior Closer serves as a central coordinator for transactions, partnering with business lines, operational teams, risk partners, service providers, and external legal counsel to drive transactions toward a successful and timely close.

A significant portion of this role occurs well in advance of the anticipated closing date and requires proactive coordination, planning, and execution to ensure transaction readiness. The Senior Closer is responsible for reviewing loan documentation, authority documents, approvals, funding instructions, conditions precedent, due diligence requirements, and other transaction-related materials to validate closing readiness. This individual identifies outstanding requirements, facilitates issue resolution with internal and external partners, ensures all required approvals and conditions have been satisfied, and confirms that transactions are prepared for funding, booking, and operational execution.

Responsibilities include coordinating and tracking transaction milestones, maintaining communication among stakeholders, validating funding and booking readiness, processing and understanding monetary transactions, completing end-of-day balancing activities, maintaining and updating closing checklists, accurately booking loans within the system of record, and identifying, mitigating, or escalating issues requiring immediate attention. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of loan documentation, transaction workflows, operational controls, and banking risk frameworks to ensure transactions are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established policies and procedures.

This position requires the ability to work independently, make informed decisions based on available evidence, navigate competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with significant transaction volume and tight deadlines. Strong commercial lending and syndicated lending experience is highly preferred. The ideal candidate demonstrates sound judgment, attention to detail, risk awareness, and the ability to effectively manage multiple concurrent transactions with limited supervision.

The role provides broad exposure across multiple business lines and requires extensive collaboration with diverse stakeholders throughout the organization. Candidates should possess strong relationship management, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and coordinate activities across functions to support successful transaction execution.

This position requires the ability to work independently, make informed decisions based on available evidence, navigate competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with significant transaction volume and tight deadlines.

The role provides broad exposure across multiple business lines and requires extensive collaboration with diverse stakeholders throughout the organization. We seek motivated, driven and creative individuals that enjoy working as part of a team in a high energy environment which thrives on innovation and ingenuity. You will work together to create new solutions which will provide our clients with an exceptional customer experience. Valued opinions, supported by collaborative teams, impact the success of the Commercial Lending Operations organization.This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Performs functions in the documentation, funding, and due diligence requirements of complex transactions being financed by PNC, or bought from/sold to other institutions. Provides client-facing service. May provide on-the-job training or coaching.
  • Determines, reviews and issues required legal documents for complex transactions while ensuring all terms are met.
  • Negotiates documentation revisions and drafts changes independently, or in collaboration with client's counsel if necessary. Identifies deficiencies in documents for complex transactions being sold to or bought from institutions.
  • Interacts with internal and external clients to coordinate a closing schedule for complex transactions. Directs work flow as needed to ensure client expectations are met. Builds relationships with clients, legal counsel, vendors and internal partners.
  • Gathers, reviews and analyzes all information from internal and external parties specific to complex transactions.
  • Resolves inquiries/issues as necessary. Complies with necessary regulations, internal procedures, and may assist in response to audit exceptions.
  • Validates that transaction structures match pricing models. Assures perfection of security interest for complex transactions and/or requests approval for exceptions.

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with strong attention to detail while maintaining a broader project perspective.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with Operations SMEs, project teams, and senior stakeholders.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio and Project; experience with other project tracking or collaboration tools is a plus.

description:

YOUR ROLE

The Controls & Process Excellence Manager is responsible for establishing and maintaining an effective company-wide control environment while driving process standardization, governance, and continuous improvement across the organization.

The role partners with functional leaders across all functions within the Company to strengthen internal controls, enhance process maturity, mitigate operational risks, and ensure company policies are embedded into day-to-day operations. The position also leads the development of data-driven and AI-enabled monitoring capabilities to improve risk visibility, compliance effectiveness, and process performance.


The team structure,

  • Direct report to: CFO

Key responsibilities

Governance & Internal Controls

  • Design, implement, and maintain the company's internal control framework.
  • Establish and oversee key controls across critical business processes.
  • Perform periodic control effectiveness assessments and identify remediation actions.
  • Maintain process documentation, control matrices, and governance standards.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Support internal and external audit activities and coordinate management responses.

Risk Management

  • Facilitate company-wise risk identification, assessment, and monitoring.
  • Maintain corporate risk registers and risk mitigation plans.
  • Monitor emerging operational and process risks.
  • Develop risk reporting and escalation mechanisms for senior management.
  • Promote risk awareness and accountability across business functions.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead process standardization initiatives across functions and geographies.
  • Establish process governance structures and process ownership models.
  • Drive continuous improvement programs to improve efficiency, control effectiveness, and user experience.
  • Conduct process maturity assessments and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to harmonize processes and eliminate inefficiencies.

Data Analytics & Continuous Monitoring

  • Develop control and risk monitoring dashboards using tools such as Power BI.
  • Implement continuous control monitoring and exception reporting capabilities.
  • Leverage automation, analytics, and AI technologies to strengthen governance processes.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and control gaps through data analysis.
  • Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to management.

Policy Management

  • Maintain company policy governance framework.
  • Ensure policies remain aligned with business operations and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate periodic policy reviews and updates.
  • Monitor policy adherence and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related disciplines.
  • CPA Professional Certification (Preferred)

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Internal Controls
    • Risk Management
    • Process Excellence
    • Governance
    • Internal Audit
    • Finance Controllership
    • Business Process Management
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a multinational environment.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, etc.).
  • Experience with AI, data analytics and dashboarding tools such as Power BI.

Key Competencies

Governance & Control Mindset

  • Strong understanding of internal controls and risk management principles.
  • Ability to balance control requirements with operational practicality.

Process Excellence

  • Strong process mapping and process redesign capabilities.
  • Ability to identify inefficiencies and drive sustainable improvements.

Analytical Thinking

  • Ability to analyze large datasets and identify trends, anomalies, and root causes.
  • Experience translating data into actionable business insights.
