description:
Job Description


The Growth Strategy Director helps turn market insight into growth. This leader defines where the business should play and how it can win, then works with Product, Sales, and other partners to convert the strategy into focused investments and measurable commercial action. The role combines rigorous strategy work with practical growth enablement, including market and customer analysis, financial performance insights, strategic pricing, business cases, new growth opportunities and innovation. The Director also enables the increased adoption of AI across the organization.


Responsibilities

· Lead high-impact growth strategy initiatives from framing through recommendation and implementation support, ensuring alignment with business priorities and financial objectives.

· Guide market segmentation, sub-segmentation, market sizing, customer research and competitive analysis to identify attractive markets, priority customer needs and new adjacencies.

· Translate strategic insight into clear growth choices, partnering with Product, Sales and Marketing to enable execution through focused investments, prioritized initiatives and well-designed tests.

· Develop and monitor financial KPIs, such as new sales, churn, formations and profitability, ongoing pricing performance, surface implications, including adjustments to existing prices and rules, and coordinate actions to address opportunities and risks.

· Develop pricing and discount rules, approval thresholds and exception criteria for Product / GM approval,

· Lead strategic pricing recommendations for new products, partnering with Finance to validate economics and Product / GM for final approval.

· Build decision-ready growth investment cases, incorporating market evidence, customer value, financial impact, risks and implementation requirements.

· Evaluate major new revenue opportunities, partnerships and selected M&A or tuck-in acquisition opportunities; contribute to due diligence, integration planning and post-investment learning where relevant.

· Lead or support innovation efforts by prioritizing high-potential ideas, designing proof-of-concept tests and helping product and development teams move validated opportunities into execution.

· Apply AI tools and methods in the development of strategic insights, while helping the organization expand AI adoption in both internal operations and products.

· Create executive-ready strategy materials, including annual strategy plans, business reviews and Board-level presentations; communicate recommendations clearly and build alignment among senior stakeholders.


Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent practical experience. MBA, or similar advanced degree is preferred.

· Minimum 8 years of experience in strategy, corporate development, growth, commercial planning or related roles, including experience in a strategy consulting firm or similarly rigorous strategy environment.

· Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, conduct market and competitive analysis, build financial models and present fact-based recommendations to senior leaders.

· Experience taking strategy beyond the recommendation: partnering with commercial, product or marketing teams to shape investments, launch initiatives, test ideas or improve growth performance.

· Experience developing pricing, packaging or monetization recommendations and using customer value, willingness-to-pay and financial analysis to inform commercial decisions preferred

· Practical experience using AI-enabled tools and enabling the adoption of AI within an organization.

· Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect market opportunities, customer needs and operating realities to revenue, retention and profitability outcomes.

· Experience evaluating new business opportunities, partnerships, acquisitions or innovation portfolios is preferred.

· Excellent written, verbal and executive communication skills, including the ability to create concise, compelling presentations and facilitate decisions across diverse stakeholders.

· Strong project leadership and influence skills; able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and build trust across functions without relying on direct authority.

· High intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a bias toward translating insight into measurable business action.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


DESIGN@LILLY | PRODUCT DESIGN


Staff Product Designer | 5-7 years


Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes.


As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build.


Path/Level

R4

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Staff Product Designer at Lilly, you will work across the full arc of design delivery, from making sense of research and shaping the problem, to crafting the interactions, nailing the visual execution, and getting it across the finish line with engineering and product. At Lilly, that means your work has real stakes: the people on the other end of your screens are patients, caregivers, and the scientists trying to help them.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we will expect from you:

  • Elevate and maintain design standards through direct contribution across a wide range of outputs and mediums, from digital products to patient-facing experiences.
  • Bring attention to detail and a passion for all aspects of design including typography, motion, copy, composition and art direction.
  • Understand component-based design systems and know when to follow existing patterns and when to break constraints.
  • Present and persuasively communicate design rationale at all levels, incorporate feedback constructively, and build trust with collaborators across the organization.
  • Demonstrate accountability, flexibility, and initiative, with the ability to prioritize and deliver results efficiently.
  • Embrace a learning and growth mindset, stay current on industry trends and tools, and contribute positively to a culture of critique, collaboration, and honest reflection at Design@Lilly.
  • Set the craft standard for the team, producing sophisticated work others reference and build from.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment on design direction across a product area.
  • Shape team culture through critique leadership, mentorship, and active contribution to Design@Lilly practices.
  • Deliver high-quality UI and UX work across features, flows, and system-driven experiences.
  • Contribute to design system adoption and collaborate closely with product and engineering to bring work across the finish line.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in product, UX, or visual design for digital products and experiences.
  • An exceptional portfolio of design work spanning multiple projects and mediums, with a focus on interface or screen-based experiences.
  • A degree in Design (Digital Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with a high level of intellectual curiosity and a passion for innovation in digital health.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable for a broad range of collaborators.
  • A collaborative spirit and the ability to build strong working relationships and navigate conflict constructively with peers and partners.
  • Demonstrable experience identifying and addressing user pain points, synthesizing research, and advocating for user-centered design.
  • For Visual Designers: Deep understanding of foundational design principles with excellent command of type, grid, composition, and color.

At Manulife John Hancock, we believe in investing in the future – starting with you. Our Standards Assurance and Risk Monitoring co-op is your launchpad to success, offering the support, structure, and exciting opportunities you need to thrive and make your mark.


Are you an enthusiastic undergraduate student looking to gain hands-on experience in information risk management? Reporting to the Director, Standards Assurance and Risk Monitoring (SARM), you’ll support the SARM execution team in providing assurance to the second line of defense by assessing the design and effectiveness of Information Risk Management (IRM) controls. Through control assessments, walkthroughs, evidence reviews, and data analysis, you’ll help identify gaps and develop actionable insights that contribute to strengthening Manulife’s risk and control environment.


Position Responsibilities:

  • Assess Information Risk Management (IRM) controls to determine whether they are designed effectively and operating as intended.
  • Participate in walkthrough sessions with process owners to understand processes and evaluate control design and execution.
  • Review and analyze evidence and data to identify gaps in risk management processes across business segments.
  • Collaborate with the SARM execution team and other stakeholders to validate findings and support effective risk management practices.
  • Prepare work papers and document testing steps, results, and detailed findings for assigned controls.
  • Identify actionable insights and opportunities to strengthen controls and improve risk management processes.

  • Basic understanding of information security principles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to analyze IT-related risks and clearly document findings.

title: Audio System Software Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Role Overview As Intel accelerates its company-wide focus to define and execute to our Physical AI strategy, team is seeking an Audio System Software Engineer to spearhead advanced audio architecture, driver enablement, and voice-edge processing on Intel-based robotics platforms under Linux. In this role, you will collaborate with leading robotics IHVs (Independent Hardware Vendors), Tier-1 OEMs, and internal architecture teams to enable low-latency, highly accurate audio perception stacks, smart amplification, and embedded AI-driven noise suppression systems. Key responsibilities, not limited to • Linux Audio Stack Development an Enablement: Design, implement, and maintain Linux ALSA (Advanced Linux Sound Architecture), ASoC (ALSA System on Chip), Sound Open Firmware (SOF), and PulseAudio/PipeWire drivers tailored for Intel compute platforms. • Audio Codec and Smart Amplifier Integration: Bring up, validate, and optimize external high-performance audio codecs and smart amplifiers (e.g., I2S, SoundWire, TDM interfaces), ensuring acoustic protection, thermal safety, and power efficiency. • Pre- and Post-Processing Pipeline: Integrate and tune low-latency audio pre-processing and post-processing pipelines, including acoustic echo cancellation (AEC), beamforming, dereverberation, and multi-microphone array localization for mobile robotics. • AI-Driven Noise Suppression and Voice UI: Deploy edge-AI audio algorithms (e.g., deep-learning noise suppression, keyword spotting, wake-on-voice, spatial audio filtering) leveraging Intel CPU/GPU/NPU inference frameworks (OpenVINO). • Ecosystem and Customer Collaboration: Partner directly with global robotics innovators and IHV ecosystem partners to triage audio hardware-software co-design issues, accelerate customer design-ins through production, and deliver developer documentation (application notes, tuning guides, reference specs).

Technical Proficiencies: • In-depth understanding of Linux audio drivers (ALSA, ASoC, SoundWire, I2S, I2C, SPI). • Direct experience bringing up and tuning audio codecs and smart amplifiers (Realtek, TI, Cirrus Logic, etc.). • Solid grasp of digital signal processing (DSP) fundamentals, filter design, and acoustic tuning (digital mic array calibration, AEC, noise suppression). • Familiarity with edge AI audio pipelines (inference runtime integration, voice activity detection, ML-based speech enhancement). • Soft Skills and Language: Strong problem-solving aptitude, technical ownership, proactive communication, and fluency in written and spoken English for global cross-functional collaboration.

title: Technical Project Manager - Digital Engineering
description:
About the role

You’ll run a portfolio of defense R&D programs that use digital engineering (DE) to improve how physical systems perform. That means simulation, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), digital twins, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. The technical work happens at Integer and in university labs. Your job is to turn defense requirements into development plans with measurable milestones, then keep the work on track.

You’ll report to the Digital Engineering Director and coordinate several research teams led by principal investigators (PIs) at partner universities, along with Integer engineers and prime contractor counterparts. You’ll get results through planning, clear communication, and the trust you build with each team.

Several of these efforts are new, so the schedules, governance, and documentation standards don’t exist yet. You’ll build them. You’ll do well here if getting academia, industry, and government to agree on a schedule sounds like a problem worth solving.

What you'll do

  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent defense R&D programs from initiation through delivery, maintaining technical roadmaps, work breakdown structures, and integrated master schedules
    • Coordinate with PIs, Integer development teams, and university research teams to align scope, deliverables, and schedule without direct authority over academic staff
    • Serve as the primary interface between Integer Technologies, DoW program offices, prime contractors, academic partners, and equipment manufacturers
    • Translate operational requirements and government direction into clear engineering tasks and deliverables for distributed research teams
    • Run regular risk assessments, issue tracking, and status reporting (e.g., technical briefings, performance dashboards) for the DE Director and program stakeholders
  • Set and enforce documentation standards so design decisions, test plans, results, lessons learned, and configuration records live in a structured, accessible repository
  • Write concise status reports, technical briefings, meeting minutes, risk registers, and communication plans for executive, senior military, academic, and government audiences
  • Adapt project management methods (e.g., design reviews, RACI matrices, issue logs, project charters, milestone tracking) to the pace and culture of R&D
  • Identify and resolve execution problems (e.g., scope creep, schedule slip, resource conflicts between programs), and escalate when the fix needs more authority
  • Improve project governance and workflow practices across the DE portfolio

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Science, or a related technical field
  • 4+ years of professional experience managing complex technical projects in research, prototype development, or test and evaluation
  • PMP certification, Defense Acquisition University (DAU) program management coursework, or equivalent experience with structured project management practice
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across organizations without formal authority
  • Enough technical depth in DE (e.g., simulation, MBSE, digital twins, HIL, high-performance computing (HPC)) to engage credibly with the teams doing the work, without doing it yourself
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical reports and concise briefings for senior military and government stakeholders
  • Proficiency with project scheduling and collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence)

Desired Qualifications

  • Active DoW clearance, Secret or higher
  • Experience managing programs that apply simulation, digital twins, or model-based engineering to defense hardware or system performance
  • Experience coordinating with DoW program offices or other DoW customers, including regular work with government technical representatives and contracting officers
  • Experience working within prime contractor and subcontractor structures
  • Familiarity with university research environments (e.g., sponsored research agreements, IP considerations, academic calendars, PI-led team dynamics)
  • Experience supporting system test and evaluation, including empirical or lab-based testing in a defense or research setting
  • Experience leading multiple concurrent technology streams (e.g., simulation, HIL, software integration) and owning cross-program dependencies and technology insertion decisions
  • Working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink, RTDS, Speedgoat, or HPC environments, enough to judge technical status and risk (deep expertise not required)
  • Familiarity with FAR/DFARS, government contract types (e.g., cost-plus, firm-fixed-price, other transaction agreements), and compliance requirements for DoW R&D programs

title: Associate - Quality Assurance
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Patients are at the center of everything we do at Lilly. We are currently hiring a Associate Quality Assurance.

This role supports critical work that helps bring medicines and solutions to patients responsibly and efficiently. #WeAreLilly

Eli Lilly and Company is seeking an Associate - Quality Assurance to join our PR01 manufacturing site. In this role you will provide quality oversight and technical guidance to manufacturing processes, ensure compliance with applicable regulations, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and Global Quality Standards (GQS), and serve as a mentor and key quality resource for Associates and cross-functional partners. This QA Manufacturing Support role applies Data Integrity and Digital Quality standards to everyday manufacturing processes, ensuring product and process quality through deviations, change control, and proactive data review. Working across functions, you’ll embed quality compliance into operations, collaborate to resolve issues, and monitor metrics to identify improvements. You’ll operate under defined methods, solving routine problems with established procedures, while building relationships and seeking input to broaden impact. Your contributions will support consistent quality, safer processes, and reliable manufacturing outputs. This role delivers foundational quality systems support that enables faster, more confident decisions across the manufacturing team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed Data Integrity and Digital Quality standards into manufacturing support processes.
  • Support deviation and change control processes impacting manufacturing to maintain product and process quality.
  • Review manufacturing data and metrics to analyze quality trends and recommend improvements proactively.
  • Ensure adherence to GxP regulations including Data Integrity and Digital Quality standards within manufacturing support activities.
  • Develop and maintain quality-related technical documentation such as SOPs, reports, Annual Quality Reviews and regulatory inspection materials.
  • Perform routine inspections and audits of manufacturing operations to verify QA standards compliance and detect deviations.
  • Review and approve events and batch documentation, making lot disposition decisions that protect product quality and ensure compliance with cGMP, Global Quality Standards and regulatory commitments.
  • Lead or co-lead investigations of complex or multi-area events, facilitating root cause analysis, evaluating CAPA effectiveness and serving as the escalation point for investigators.
  • Review and approve qualification and validation protocols and reports, master batch records and procedures, and define risk-based validation strategies for assigned processes.
  • Anticipate quality and compliance risks through trend analysis, self-inspection and oversight of microbiology sampling, cleaning, facilities, utilities and equipment, and act as subject matter expert during regulatory inspections and audits.
  • Lead small to medium quality improvement projects, partner with Production, Technical Services, Maintenance, Engineering, Utilities, Laboratory and Regulatory Affairs, and coach operators in GMP fundamentals, problem solving and risk management.

Core Capabilities

  • Adheres to established change and quality controls within manufacturing support tasks, documenting deviations per procedure.
  • Demonstrates QA-focused collaboration with the process team to embed quality into processes and feedback loops.
  • Executes defined processes for operations, tracking progress and maintaining quality standards in daily tasks.
  • Engages with learning management systems resources to complete required trainings and integrate new learning into daily practice.
  • Familiarity with analytical thinking to evaluate quality issues and trends.
  • Exposure to root cause analysis techniques to identify fundamental quality drivers.
  • Experience with documenting issues and results clearly in reports.
  • Ability to explain procedures and findings to peers with clarity.
  • Understanding of corrective action workflows to support timely follow-ups.
  • Proven ability to anticipate and resolve complex quality and compliance problems across multiple teams, and to influence decisions through sound technical and quality rationale.
  • Proven ability to lead small to medium projects with minimal to moderate risk and resource requirements, and to produce clear technical documentation.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Natural Science, Chemistry, Engineering, (Chemical or Industrial).
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in the pharmaceutical or another regulated industry, (medical device) including GMP experience in Quality Assurance and/or Regulatory.
  • Experience in Drug Product or Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated experience in event investigations, change control evaluation and batch record review.
  • Experience leading complex event investigations using risk management and root cause analysis tools.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) with written, verbal and oral communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Veeva and/or an equivalent quality management system.
  • Proficiency in applying U.S. FDA regulations and GMPs, statistical sampling systems and computerized systems in a pharmaceutical quality environment.
  • Experience participating in regulatory agency audits.

Additional Information:

  • Travel: Availability to travel within and outside of Puerto Rico when necessary.
  • Schedule: Availability to work irregular hours, night, weekends or holidays when necessary, in support of 24/7 operation.

title: Managing Director, Corporate Positioning & Insights, Digital | Strategic Communications
description:
Who We Are


FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

Our Corporate Positioning and Insights (CPI&I) practice seeks a talented, versatile Managing Director of Digital Public Affairs with 18-25 years of experience to join the team. As a senior leadership team member, you will oversee the digital strategies that protect our organizational reputation, influence public policy, and engage key stakeholders—including government bodies, grassroots coalitions, and the media. You will directly managing accounts and their respective teams and budgets, and serve as a senior strategic advisor on rapid-response and crisis communication scenarios.


Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-channel digital public affairs strategies aligned with macro-level policy and business goals.

  • Digital Advocacy & Campaigns: Oversee the lifecycle of paid, earned, shared, and owned digital campaigns designed to influence legislative, regulatory, and public opinion landscapes.

  • Crisis & Rapid Response: Lead digital crisis response frameworks to mitigate negative publicity and safeguard brand integrity in real-time.

  • Stakeholder & Coalition Building: Deploy digital tools to mobilize grassroots supporters, cultivate online allies, and build digital advocacy coalitions.

  • Team & Agency Management: Direct and mentor an internal team of digital specialists, while managing external vendor and agency relationships.

  • Data & Analytics Oversight: Implement advanced social listening, data analytics, and performance measurement systems to track campaign ROI and report actionable insights to executive leadership.

  • Budgetary Accountability: Oversee the digital public affairs budget, ensuring optimal resource allocation across paid media, technology tools, and staff.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Public Affairs, Political Science, Communications, Journalism, or a related field (Master's preferred).

  • Experience: 15+ years of experience working in public affairs, political campaigns, government communications, or PR agencies, with at least 6 years dedicated specifically to digital strategy in Washington. Knowledge of AI as it relates to digital public affairs strongly encouraged.

  • Leadership: Minimum of 15+ years in a senior management role directing high-performing digital or advocacy teams.

  • Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of paid digital advertising ecosystems (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, programmatic), social listening platforms (e.g., Brandwatch, Meltwater), and digital advocacy software (e.g., Phone2Action, Quorum).

  • Communication: Exceptional written communication skills, with a proven track record of distilling complex regulatory or policy jargon into compelling digital narratives.

title: Case Manager- Case Management Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


The Case Manager is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) within the safety system for all Lilly compounds and products in accordance with global pharmacovigilance regulations and company standards ensuring data integrity, quality, consistency, and compliant safety reporting. This individual contributor role performs specialized tasks within the case management workflow, which may include intake and triage activities, case processing (data entry, coding, narrative writing), or reporting and submissions, depending on team assignment. This role reports through a Group Leader, Case Management Operations.

Primary Responsibilities: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any role/position can change over time and can include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervisor regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that might be required for the role/position.

Core Responsibilities (All Team Assignments)

  • Process ICSRs accurately and efficiently within established timeframes and quality standards (e.g., peer review of individual cases, aggregate review of cases in queries)
  • Follow all applicable SOPs, work instructions, and regulatory requirements
  • Utilize safety database systems (e.g., Argus, Veeva) effectively for assigned tasks
  • Maintain high quality standards with attention to detail and accuracy
  • Escalate complex cases, questions, or issues to management appropriately
  • Participate in training programs and maintain competency in assigned functional areas
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and provide feedback on process optimization
  • Support audit and inspection activities by maintaining proper documentation
  • Collaborate effectively with team members and cross-functional partners
  • Mentor junior case managers
  • Adhere to data privacy and confidentiality requirements
  • May participate in special projects as needed
  • undefined


Specialized Responsibilities by Team Assignment:

A. Intake and Triage Team:

  • Receive and acknowledge adverse event reports from all sources (spontaneous, clinical trials, literature, digital media, etc.)
  • Perform initial case assessment to determine if minimum criteria for a valid ICSR are met
  • Triage cases based on seriousness, expectedness, regulatory timelines, and medical urgency
  • Route cases to appropriate processing queues or medical review pathways
  • Initiate follow-up for invalid or incomplete case information
  • Document receipt of information and complete intake forms/checklists
  • Perform literature screening and case identification from monitored publications
  • Process duplicate case assessments and case linking activities
  • Coordinate with Medical Information, affiliates, and other case sources for information clarification

B. Case Processing Team:

  • Enter complete case information from source documents into the safety database
  • Apply MedDRA coding to adverse events using appropriate Lower Level Terms (LLTs) and Preferred Terms (PTs)
  • Apply WHO-DD coding to medications/products with accurate formulation and indication
  • Assess case seriousness, expectedness, and causality (where applicable) according to defined criteria
  • Write clear, concise, and scientifically accurate case narratives
  • Perform case assessments including clinical relevance and data consistency checks
  • Generate and track follow-up queries for additional information
  • Link cases appropriately (duplicate, parent-child, case series)
  • Process special case types including pregnancies, medication errors, off-label use, lack of efficacy, legal
  • Perform in-line quality control checks prior to case finalization
  • Prepare cases for medical review ensuring all required elements are complete

C. Reporting and Submissions Team:


  • Generate expedited reports (ICSRs) for health authorities per regulatory timelines (15-day, 7-day)
  • Create initial and follow-up submissions in required formats (E2B, CIOMS, local formats)
  • Prepare and submit reports to business partners per pharmacovigilance agreements
  • Generate investigator and ethics committee safety notifications for clinical trial cases
  • Perform pre-submission quality checks ensuring accuracy and completeness
  • Submit reports through regulatory gateways and track transmission confirmations
  • Process acknowledgments from health authorities and document successful submissions
  • Generate nullifications and amendments for previously submitted reports when required
  • Maintain reporting logs and ensure accurate documentation of all submissions
  • Troubleshoot gateway transmission failures and coordinate resolution.
  • undefined
  • Understand and Support of the EU QPPV role
  • Understanding the roles and responsibilities of the EU Qualified Person.
  • Ensure support is provided to enable the Qualified Person to fulfill all the Qualified Person legal responsibilities.

Minimum Qualification Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Healthcare degree, or study in the area of pharmaceutical/biological science.
  • 3 years of Pharmacovigilance or related healthcare experience

Other Information/Additional Preferences:

  • Highly conscientious with strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to make decisions autonomously and as part of a team.
  • Adaptability when using new or changing electronic systems.
  • Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills.
  • Basic computer skills (i.e., word processing, tables and graphics, spreadsheets, presentations, templates, databases, and search engines).
  • Ability to work effectively in a global capacity and apply understanding of diversity and inclusion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with fluency in writing, reading, and speaking English.
  • Basic understanding of drug development and clinical research
  • Familiarity with medical terminology
  • Clinical background (RN, RPh, MLT, or equivalent) preferred for case processing roles
  • Previous experience with safety databases (Argus, ARISg, Veeva, or similar)
  • Knowledge of MedDRA and WHO-DD coding conventions
  • Understanding of ICH guidelines and global PV regulations
  • Experience in pharmaceutical industry, CRO, or healthcare setting
  • Additional language capabilities beneficial for global case management

The Group Leader develops the Group strategy and oversees its implementation, driving high performance and organic growth to ensure the VBU objectives are met across the Education Group. The role supports M&A, participates in due diligence, oversees the integration of acquisitions, ensures Portfolio financial objectives and Volaris metrics are embedded throughout the Group, and ensures business risk management is undertaken consistently.
The Group Leader also drives key initiatives and sets and drives the culture across the Group, ensuring alignment to the broader Education & Cultural Industries Portfolio.

Job Description:

Key duties and responsibilities

1. Strategy and performance

  • Ensure a strategic plan is developed with each VBU and executed so that the key strategic and financial objectives are met across the Group.
  • Meet agreed growth and profitability targets for the Group.
  • Set and then manage the delivery of agreed annual objectives for the Group of companies.
  • Drive the quarterly review process for business and talent performance, ensuring businesses take timely action to address any issues identified.
  • Ensure Group and VBU plans respond to changes in the education market, including curriculum, funding and policy changes.

2. Organic growth, sales and customers

  • Actively engage with VBU Leaders to ensure sales strategy is well aligned to organic growth objectives and that sales channels are focused to generate the expected results.
  • Ensure sales and renewal activity is aligned to academic-year and public-sector budget and procurement cycles.
  • Act as the escalation point for key customer issues within the Group.

3. M&A and integration

  • Participate in M&A activities as required by the Education Portfolio Leader, including participating in meetings with potential targets and undertaking due diligence.
  • Oversee the integration of allocated acquisitions within the Group, ensuring achievement of the integration plan objectives and alignment of IRR for the acquired businesses.
  • Ensure Portfolio financial objectives and Volaris metrics are embedded throughout the Group, including in acquired businesses.
  • Note at this stage the Group Leader role does not have capital deployment targets or responsibilities.

4. People, talent and culture

  • Manage and develop direct reports, including the attraction, retention, development and building of capability and engagement.
  • Ensure adequate talent pipelining, succession planning and talent management to support the growth objectives of the Group, including building capability and engagement within each business in the Group.
  • Ensure structure and resourcing levels enable the Group objectives to be met.
  • Set and drive the culture across the Group, ensuring alignment to the broader Education & Cultural Industries Portfolio.

5. Risk, compliance and governance

  • Oversee business risk management across the Group, including:
    • ensuring compliance and regulatory requirements are met across the Group;
    • ensuring student data privacy and child safeguarding obligations are met (for example GDPR, FERPA, COPPA and the Australian Privacy Act, as relevant);
    • ensuring education products meet accessibility standards (for example WCAG);
    • ensuring risk management strategies are in place to support growth and profitability; and
    • ensuring compliance with all Volaris policies, including cybersecurity policies.

6. Stakeholders

  • Manage strategic internal and external key stakeholder relationships, including education customers, authorities and partners.

7. AI and innovation

  • Drive AI tools adoption and culture evolution across the Group to adopt and exploit AI positively impacting growth, revenue, efficiency and customer retention.
  • Ensure AI is used responsibly in education products, including with regard to academic integrity and student data.

For more than 100 years, ZEISS medical technology has been driving progress in ophthalmology and microsurgery. In ophthalmology, our solutions help to maintain and improve people's vision at every stage of their lives. description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Position Description:

  • The purpose of the Content Operations role is to partner with brands, external and internal partners to ensure the brand’s content strategy is implemented with quality, speed, value and compliance across the content supply chain. The Manager, Content Operations is expected to be a creative problem solver who supports achievement of the brand’s goals while always seeking ways to apply the process in a more effective manner. This individual supervises a portfolio of assigned projects for their respective brands, and defines, oversees, and maintains a complete timeline for brand content and projects. They use system tools to improve important metrics (including, but limited to, throughput, velocity, speed, rework, and deviations) across the content supply chain to ensure on-time delivery of quality projects in accordance with the brand strategy. They review timelines and capacity constraints for their given brands. They supervise errors, and work solution fixes, and technology to ensure accurate measurement of work to be done, capacity, resources required, forecasting, and content operations. They are responsible for checking work thoroughly between content supply chain systems and handoffs. They ensure data accuracy and track progress across content supply chain systems. In addition, this role is responsible for training and upskilling cross functional teammates on content supply chain systems, workflows, tasks, and results.
  • This role reports to the Senior Director, Content Operations.

  • Know Lilly, our customers, internal and external business partners, and our purpose

title: Senior/Principal Project Manager
description:
Welcome to Holly Springs, North Carolina— home to Roche/Genentech's largest-ever investment: a $2B greenfield start-up where next-generation technology, high-performing teams and Operational Excellence converge to create the global standard for high-volume, highly-efficient Drug Product manufacturing.


The facility's core is defined by Innovation - leveraging advanced automation, robotics, digital tools, real-time data analytics, and simple, streamlined processes to produce the highest quality medicines. This plant meets today’s demand for CVRM (Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism) medicines and is scalable to grow with the portfolio, which focuses on next-generation metabolic medicines specifically targeting the global obesity epidemic and Type 2 diabetes. This is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a high-level of accountability, with planned launch in 2028.


Are you a problem-solver and change-agent who thrives in a Team environment, eager to tackle the most complex manufacturing challenges? If so, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to launch a state-of-the-art facility from the ground-up and shape the culture of our organization for the next generation.


Join us in Holly Springs, where you won't just build a plant—you will build the future of medicine.


THE OPPORTUNITY


At our Holly Springs site, we are building a state-of-the-art biopharmaceutical campus, and we need visionary leaders to help bring it to life. As a Senior or Principal Project Manager, you won’t just track schedules—you will orchestrate the transformation of a greenfield site into a high-performing, fully operational manufacturing powerhouse.

In this high-visibility role within the Site PMO, you will own the delivery of mission-critical projects and workstreams to support our path to operational readiness. You will serve as the strategic bridge between construction, commissioning, qualification, validation (CQV), digital systems, quality and manufacturing operations. If you thrive in fast-paced industrial environments, love solving complex cross-functional puzzles, and want to establish the PM standards for a site that will impact patients worldwide, this is your launchpad.


Drive Operational Readiness & Greenfield Startup

  • Orchestrate Day-One Readiness: You will spearhead cross-functional Operational Readiness (OR) workstreams across Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and MSAT to ensure seamless transition from mechanical completion through commercial operations.
  • Accelerate Product Introductions: You will partner with technical teams to PM complex Tech Transfers and New Product Introductions (NPI) to establish robust drug product supply chains on aggressive timelines.
  • Integrate Cross-Functional Milestones: You will align engineering handover, CQV phases, regulatory filing requirements, and commercial launch targets into integrated, actionable master schedules.

Strategic Program Leadership & Portfolio Governance

  • Manage Critical Dependencies: You will act as the strategic integrator across complex portfolios, proactively identifying risks, untangling schedule constraints, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Shape PMO Best Practices: You will co-create and scale the tools, frameworks, and visual project controls that define the Holly Springs PMO culture of operational excellence.

Stakeholder Alignment & Influence

  • Bridge Global and Local Networks: You will partner closely with site leadership, technical functions, and global enterprise teams to ensure strategic and operational goals are met.
  • Lead Matrixed Excellence: You will motivate and align multi-disciplinary project teams without direct-line authority, fostering an environment of accountability, agility, and psychological safety.

WHO YOU ARE:

description:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

title: Triparty Operations Associate/AVP
description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

The Triparty Allocation Associate/AVP is responsible for managing and optimizing the allocation of collateral in triparty repo shells. This role ensures that collateral is accurately and efficiently allocated, monitored, and reported in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of the triparty collateral allocation processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Triparty Allocation and Management:
    • Monitor and actively process the daily matching and allocation process on BONY Tri-party platforms (BONY Domestic Accessedge & Global Accessedge).
    • Ability to communicate issues and escalations succinctly and accurately to front office business partners, counterparties, and vendors.
    • A firm understanding of the cash management process and using eCPO tool on AccessEdge when optimizing tri-party allocations.
    • Execute daily allocation of collateral in triparty agreements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with contractual terms, including hard-to-allocate equities and corporate bonds.
    • Monitor triparty allocation levels and optimize allocations to meet margin requirements and mitigate risk.
    • Reconcile allocated triparty positions and resolve discrepancies promptly.
    • The ideal candidate would be knowledgeable in processing Tri-party loans and allocation uploads in the Broadridge Impact (ICI) system.

  • Data Analysis and Reporting:
    • Generate and analyze reports on collateral allocation, usage, and sufficiency.
    • Identify trends and areas for improvement in collateral allocation processes.
    • Provide front office with morning collateral reporting for start of the trading day.
    • Ability to learn and navigate systems specific to MUFG only.

  • Compliance and Risk Management:
    • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to triparty allocations.
    • Collaborate with risk management teams to assess and mitigate risks associated with collateral allocation.
    • Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and procedural explanations.

  • Process Improvement:
    • Identify opportunities for automation and process enhancements to improve efficiency and accuracy.
    • Collaborate with internal and external teams to implement and test system enhancements.
    • Maintain operating procedures and task controls for triparty allocation processing tasks.

  • Client and Counterparty Interaction:
    • Liaise with clients, counterparties, and custodians to resolve issues related to triparty allocations.
    • Provide exceptional customer service and support to internal and external stakeholders.
    • Communicate effectively to ensure all parties are informed about triparty allocation statuses and requirements.

Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of experience in triparty allocations with a broker-dealer.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Proficiency BONY Accessedge, BONY BDC, and intermediate to advanced MS Excel is required.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work under high pressure and multi-task

Key Competencies:

  • Highly motivated individual who is driven, enthusiastic, and eager to accomplish individual and team focused goals.
  • Ability to analyze complex data and make informed decisions.
  • Meticulous in ensuring accuracy and completeness in all tasks.
  • Clear and effective communication with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proactively identifies issues and develops effective solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Ability to meet strict time deadlines throughout the trading day.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: Remote Operation Center Technician
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About APCC

  • Be a part of Intel's Advanced Packaging Command Center (APCC), the global command center for Advanced Packaging that provides remote capabilities, follow-on engineering, and operational support across Wafer Packaging Manufacturing (WPM).
  • Through APCC, engineering expertise is focused to improve coordination across regions, drive standardization, and improve responsiveness, while strengthening end-to-end operational execution across regions and delivering consistent, high-quality execution at scale.

Job Details/Job Description:

  • Monitors and supports real-time wafer-level manufacturing operations from a centralized remote operations environment to maintain safe, stable, and predictable factory execution.
  • Plans, monitors, and coordinates production material movement across manufacturing processes using established manufacturing and automation systems.
  • Monitors equipment health, availability, operational status, and manufacturing conditions, and coordinates with production and technical support teams to maintain operational readiness.
  • Responds to equipment, manufacturing, automation, and material-flow alarms according to established procedures, performs authorized recovery actions, and escalates unresolved or abnormal conditions to the appropriate support teams.
  • Executes approved real-time disposition actions for production lots and equipment conditions within authorized scope and established manufacturing rules.
  • Monitors and manages material flow across manufacturing operations to support production priorities, cycle time, equipment utilization, and manufacturing output requirements.
  • Identifies material-flow constraints, abnormal conditions, equipment interruptions, or automation issues and coordinates with Manufacturing, Engineering, Equipment, and other support functions for resolution.
  • Interprets and executes production instructions using information from documented specs, manufacturing systems and multiple stakeholders while ensuring compliance with established safety, quality, and operational requirements.
  • Uses manufacturing and automation systems to monitor factory conditions, equipment status, lot movement, alarms, and production execution.
  • Supports troubleshooting of workstation, manufacturing system, and automation-related issues within authorized scope and escalates system or equipment issues when additional technical support is required.
  • Monitors manufacturing indicators and operational data to identify deviations, recurring issues, or opportunities to improve factory execution.
  • Maintains accurate shift documentation, manufacturing records, issue status, and operational handover information to ensure continuity between shifts and support teams.
  • Communicates manufacturing status, equipment issues, material-flow constraints, recovery progress, and outstanding actions clearly and promptly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Supports continuous improvement initiatives to improve remote operations effectiveness, standard work, manufacturing consistency, and workstation performance.
  • Supports training and knowledge sharing with peers to strengthen team capability and consistent execution of manufacturing procedures.
  • Performs assigned activities in accordance with applicable EHS, quality, manufacturing control, and work procedures.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Microelectronics, Chemical/Process Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related technical field.

Experience:

  • To have at least 2 years of working experience.
  • Relevant experience in semiconductor manufacturing, wafer-level manufacturing, manufacturing operations, equipment operations, automation, or other high-volume manufacturing environments is an advantage.
  • Experience using computer-based manufacturing, production, or automation systems is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in semiconductor or high-volume manufacturing operations.
  • Familiarity with remote manufacturing operations, equipment monitoring, production control, material-flow management, or factory automation systems.
  • Experience monitoring and responding to production, equipment, automation, or material-flow alarms.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing workflows and the interaction between material movement, equipment availability, production priorities, and manufacturing output.
  • Experience interpreting production instructions and manufacturing data from multiple systems and information sources.
  • Familiarity with systematic troubleshooting, problem solving, and manufacturing excursion or abnormal-condition management.
  • Basic data analysis skills with the ability to identify trends, abnormalities, and recurring manufacturing issues.
  • Experience supporting continuous improvement activities in a manufacturing environment is an added advantage.
  • Experience training, coaching, or providing technical guidance to peers is an added advantage.

Other Requirements:

  • Strong technical aptitude and systematic problem-solving skills.
    Sound judgment and initiative when responding to complex or non-standard manufacturing conditions within authorized scope.
  • Ability to monitor and manage multiple manufacturing activities and priorities from computer-based workstations.
  • Strong computer literacy and ability to effectively navigate manufacturing, monitoring, and automation systems.
  • Basic understanding of semiconductor manufacturing operations, equipment availability, material flow, automation, and manufacturing process control.
  • Ability to interpret and follow production instructions, standard operating procedures, escalation requirements, and manufacturing controls.
  • Ability to recognize abnormal equipment, material-flow, automation, or production conditions and escalate according to established procedures.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities, including the ability to coordinate effectively with Manufacturing, Engineering, Equipment, Automation, and other support teams.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to adjust to changing manufacturing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new manufacturing systems, automation technologies, processes, and operating methods.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to safety, quality, manufacturing discipline, and operational excellence.
  • This role requires regular onsite presence to fulfill essential job responsibilities.
  • Willing and able to work rotating shift schedules, including day and night shifts, as required.

title: 4-H Afterschool Program Educator Floater - Watertown, NY
description:
This position will serve as an Afterschool Program Educator for Cornell Cooperative Extension Association of Jefferson County in support of the 4-H Afterschool Program and will provide comprehensive 4-H youth development opportunities for youth in grades K-12. This position will be a floater, providing coverage for staffing shortages at 4-H Afterschool program sites depending on need. This position may be assigned to work in one of the following school districts on a daily basis: Beaver River Central School District, Belleville Henderson Central School District, Carthage Central School District, Copenhagen Central School District, Indian River Central School District, LaFargeville Central School District, Watertown City School District, South Jefferson Central School District and General Brown Central School District. This position will provide coverage for the districts listed above, as assigned. This position will assist the 4-H Afterschool program in other tasks assigned on days when program coverage is not needed such as but not limited to ordering and organizing program materials and supplies and developing daily lesson plans. This position will provide established guidance and direction for program participants during after-school activities, including daily academic support and enrichment activities. This position will provide instruction utilizing established 4-H curricula in the areas of environmental science and natural resources, science, technology engineering, art and math (STEAM). This position will utilize existing program resources and materials in program work, assist in the creation of program lesson plans, utilize a variety of delivery methods and assist in delivering established innovative educational programs as assigned. This position will also provide staffing and/or programming coverage, as needed, for other Cornell Cooperative Extension Association of Jefferson County Afterschool Programs.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR APPLICANTS:

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING


All applicants must apply online by close of day on December 31, 2026. All applicants must submit a complete application online, which includes: cover letter, resume and three (3) references.


All External Applicants (including applicants currently employed by Cornell Cooperative Extension in Associations other than the Association advertising this career opportunity) must submit his/her application materials via the "APPLY" button located within this job posting.


All Internal Applicants (current employees working for the Association advertising this career opportunity) must apply online via his/her Workday account, which may be accessed here: .


Please contact Diana Young, Assistant Manager for Human Resources in Afterschool at 315-788-8450 with questions.


POSITION DETAILS:


This position is a part-time non-exempt position, 20 hours per week. The hourly rate for this position is $20.00. This position, based on eligibility, offers a comprehensive benefit package, to include: health and dental insurance, NYS retirement, vacation, sick and personal leave.


POSITION INFORMATION:


Required Qualifications:

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent education (GED/High School Diploma and 1 year transferrable/program experience).
  • Experience relevant to the role of the position.
  • Valid NYS Driver’s License and the ability to meet travel requirements associated with this position.
  • Ability to meet all School Age Child Care (SACC) and Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS) licensing requirements (i.e. Tuberculosis Test, physical exam, training requirements).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity of subject matter appropriate to area of programming (4-H Youth Development).
  • Demonstrated initiative, reliability and dependability.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, implement, and teach informal educational programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively through oral, written and visual means.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize computer technologies for educational and communication purposes.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate in professional team efforts.

Responsibilities/Essential Functions:


Program Responsibilities:


Program Delivery, Evaluation and Applied Research - 90%

  • Utilize established program resources and materials in providing information and resources to program participants in established 4-H programming.
  • Teach a menu of existing educational programs and activities as defined in support of 4-H afterschool programming efforts including, but not limited to: science, technology, engineering, art and math (STEAM).
  • Assist the 4-H Afterschool program in the creation of lesson plans and assist in teaching innovative educational programs as assigned.
  • Assist Afterschool Program Coordinator and other Program Educators in providing established 4-H afterschool educational programs via multi-media, as assigned.
  • Assist teachers, as needed, during the academic study portion of the program.
  • Via established program parameters, communicate and cooperate with school personnel to foster intentional instruction and to address the needs and interests of participating youth.
  • Serve as a team member and cooperate with the entire Association and Youth and Family Development Program staff to achieve Association program delivery goals.
  • Implement program evaluation as designed by the Outside Evaluator and New York State Education Department (NYSED).
  • Interact with program participants to obtain evaluation data, to include: evaluating effectiveness of classes within program areas for all Afterschool Programs offered.

Administrative Responsibilities:

Coordination/Operation - 5%

  • Under the direction of the Program Operations Coordinator, coordinate and assist with program projects and program outreach efforts as instructed per already established program parameters.
  • Coordinate, compile and organize existing program resources and program materials.
  • Effectively communicate with parents of school districts as needed to achieve program goals.
  • Effectively maintain existing professional relationships with other agencies, organizations and businesses that promote effective communication and facilitate continued programming efforts.
  • Transport program materials and resources as needed in performing position responsibilities.

Professional Improvement and Other Duties as Assigned - 5%

  • Participate in required trainings to meet School Age Child Care (SACC) and Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS) licensing regulations.
  • In cooperation with Supervisor and/or Executive Director, jointly develop and pursue a professional development plan as a means to increase competencies relative to position accountabilities and to address changes in programming and association priorities.
  • Collaborate in activities that are in general support of Cornell Cooperative Extension including but not limited to attendance at staff meetings, timely reporting of expenses, working with other staff, general marketing of Extension programs and other duties as assigned.

Health and Safety - Applied to all duties and functions.

  • Support the association to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Be familiar and strive to follow any applicable federal, state, local regulations, association health and safety policy/procedure/requirement and standard.
  • Act proactively to prevent accidents/injuries and communicate hazards to supervisors when identified.

title: Global Tax Provision Manager
description:
We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.

We’re looking for people who:

  • Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose

  • Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride

  • Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them

  • Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

Job Description:

You Are

A tax accounting professional with deep technical expertise in ASC 740 and experience supporting global income tax provisions within public accounting or a US public multinational corporation. You understand quarterly and annual SEC reporting, international tax reporting, SOX internal controls, and the tax accounting implications of complex cross-border transactions and evolving global tax regulations.


You also bring an interest in process automation and using data and tax technology to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of tax accounting processes.


You Will

ASC 740 Financial Reporting & SEC Disclosures

  • Manage the end-to-end preparation, review, and consolidation of quarterly and annual global income tax provisions under ASC 740 for Forms 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Calculate and analyze the consolidated effective tax rate, current and deferred tax expense, and return-to-provision true-ups.
  • Prepare and review income tax footnote disclosures, including ETR reconciliations, deferred tax rollforward tables, and narrative disclosures.
  • Direct the calculation, maintenance, and documentation of uncertain tax positions under ASC 740-10, formerly FIN 48.
  • Conduct quarterly valuation allowance assessments across domestic and international jurisdictions, including positive and negative evidence memoranda supporting management’s conclusions.

Global Coordination & Operations

  • Manage the reconciliation and validation of global deferred tax assets, liabilities, and income tax payable general ledger accounts.
  • Partner with international finance teams to ensure Corporate Tax receives GAAP-to-statutory bridge reports.
  • Lead global ETR and cash tax forecasting in partnership with FP&A.
  • Monitor and account for tax provision impacts from global legislative developments, including OECD Pillar Two, foreign currency movements, and GAAP-to-statutory differences.

Controls, Audits & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain and execute internal controls over income tax financial reporting in compliance with SOX requirements.
  • Serve as a key tax liaison for external auditors, coordinating audit requests and resolving technical accounting inquiries.
  • Collaborate with the VP of Global Tax and VP of EMEA Tax to model and document the provision and accounting impacts of business initiatives and M&A activity.

title: Software Engineer - Power Systems Modeling & Integration
description:
About the role

You’ll build the software frameworks that tie electrical power system models together and put them to work controlling real power systems. Our engineers model Naval power systems in MATLAB/Simulink. Your job is to make those models plug into a common framework, run in real time, and drive supervisory control (i.e., the layer that decides how sources, loads, and breakers are configured across the whole plant).

Keeping the lights on is the easy part. We’re maturing mission-context control methods, where the controller shifts power priorities based on what the platform is doing at that moment. That takes digital twins (i.e., models kept in sync with the physical system) and optimization running alongside the controller, plus software that holds it all together.

This is a software role that requires deep electrical engineering knowledge. You’ll develop and extend electrical dynamics models yourself, and you’ll need to know when a model is wrong before the hardware tells you. The role is onsite in Columbia, SC.

What you'll do

  • Design and build software frameworks that integrate electrical power system models from different tools and teams into system-level simulations
  • Develop supervisory control software that uses digital twins and optimization to recommend or command power system configurations
  • Mature mission-context power and energy control methods, taking them from concept through real-time simulation and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing
  • Develop and validate electrical dynamics models (e.g., generators, power converters, energy storage, distribution) in MATLAB/Simulink
  • Integrate digital twins with real-time simulation and HIL environments (e.g., Speedgoat, OPAL-RT)
  • Write automated tests and maintain version control and continuous integration for models and software
  • Process simulation and lab test data to validate model and controller performance
  • Document software and deliver clear technical reports and briefings to customers

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience
  • Proficiency in Python, Rust, C++, or similar
  • Strong electrical engineering fundamentals, including power system dynamics, power conversion, and electric machines and drives
  • Experience developing electrical dynamics models in MATLAB/Simulink
  • Experience designing software that integrates models or simulations from multiple sources
  • Experience with Git and automated software testing
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

Desired Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience developing supervisory control or energy management software for power systems, especially maritime (e.g., machinery control systems, electric plant control systems)
  • Experience building or integrating digital twins of physical systems
  • Experience applying optimization methods (e.g., model predictive control, mixed-integer programming) to power system operation
  • Experience with real-time simulation and HIL testing on Speedgoat, OPAL-RT, or an equivalent platform
  • Experience with co-simulation standards such as the Functional Mock-up Interface (FMI)
  • Experience generating code from Simulink models (e.g., Simulink Coder, Embedded Coder)
  • Experience with CI pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker) for simulation software
  • Experience with shipboard HM&E (hull, mechanical, and electrical) systems or Navy customers

Client Set-Up and Implementation Ownership

  • Assist with the end-to-end set-up of new captive, cell and ART clients from mandate acceptance through to operational handover.
  • Support regulatory applications, incorporation or cell establishment, governance documentation, banking, accounting, service-provider appointments and internal onboarding requirements.
  • Support the implementation plan for each new client, including milestones, owners, dependencies, risks and completion status.

Risk Finance Advisory and Solutions

Other Responsibilities

  • Support strategic Howden Captive Services initiatives which might include obtaining insurance management licenses in new domiciles
  • Preparing New Business reports and pipeline updates for the CASL

  • Maintaining a professional and productive working environment

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

  • Cross-sell and expansion revenue generated within the existing client base.
  • Number and value (value being the core objective) of feasibility studies and consulting engagements led, and conversion rate to incorporated structures.

  • Support the validation team in qualifying silicon and debugging issues.
  • Help develop and optimize low-power design techniques and power estimation methodologies.

  • Work effectively in a team, with strong problem-solving and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Collaborate with international design and implementation teams.

Requirements/Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience writing microarchitecture specifications and generating RTL with AI/ML tools.
  • Experience with the ASIC design flow, including lint, formal, CDC/RDC, power estimation, MBIST/DFT concepts, and low-power techniques.
  • Strong understanding of SoC architecture (ARM, RISC), bus protocols (AMBA, AXI, etc.), and peripheral IPs (USB, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, etc.).
  • Experience designing bus matrix designs.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as TCL, Perl, and Python.
  • Excellent English reading, writing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, energetic team players.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth/UWB communication theory and standard specifications.
  • Knowledge of security features and functional-safety-compliant design principles.
  • Experience with verification methodologies (UVM/OVM).
  • Experience with validation methodologies, including debugging on FPGA and silicon IC boards.

Travel Time:

0% - 25%

title: Leading Hand Grodan
description:
Ben jij een mensgerichte leider die grip houdt op de operatie én bouw mee aan een duurzame toekomst.
Bij ROCKWOOL maken we niet alleen hoogwaardige steenwolproducten. We bouwen aan een cultuur waarin veiligheid, verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerking centraal staan. Wil jij het verschil maken op de werkvloer en jouw team naar een hoger niveau brengen? Dan zoeken wij jou als Leading Hand voor onze Grodan afdeling

Jouw rol

Als Leading Hand ben jij hét aanspreekpunt op de productievloer en de rechterhand van de Teamleader. Jij neemt eigenaarschap over jouw ploeg en zorgt voor een veilige, gestructureerde en efficiënte werkomgeving. Je weet precies wat er speelt, begeleidt collega’s in hun ontwikkeling en grijpt in waar nodig. Jij bent degene die overzicht houdt, keuzes maakt en samen met je team zorgt dat onze substraten op tijd en volgens de hoogste kwaliteitsstandaarden geproduceerd worden.

Belangrijke verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Voorbereiden en leiden van het dagelijkse werkoverleg (Oobeya-ronde);
  • Zorgen dat de juiste mensen op de juiste plek staan en vakmanschap borgen;
  • Analyseren van afwijkingen en KPI’s en verbeteracties uitzetten;
  • Dagelijks opvolgen van operationele problemen en bewaken van de voortgang;
  • ROCKsafe-issues volledig en zorgvuldig afhandelen.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent een leider die verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het verschil maakt door mensen en processen verder te brengen. Jij combineert overzicht met oog voor details en weet op de juiste momenten te coachen, corrigeren en motiveren. Met jouw communicatieve kracht en eerlijkheid creëer je vertrouwen, duidelijkheid en resultaten.

  • Een afgeronde mbo 3 opleiding (pré technisch);
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels;
  • Je bent sterk in administratie en begrijpt het belang hiervan;
  • Bereidheid tot het werk in 5 ploegen;
  • Eigenaarschap en leiderschap: jij staat voor jouw ploeg;
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om mensen te coachen;
  • Analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een goed basissalaris met een ploegentoeslag van 28,5%;
  • Diverse doorgroei- en opleidingsmogelijkheden onder andere met onze interne bedrijfsschool en externe opleidingen;
  • Direct een Rockwool contract, waarbij zowel een jaarcontract als een vast contract tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
  • Werken in een 5 ploegenrooster;
  • Een solide pensioenregeling, een 13e maand, 25 vakantiedagen, vakantiegeld, reiskostenvergoeding, een sociaal fonds en onder andere korting op je sportschoolabonnement.


Over Grodan

Bij onze Grodan afdeling maken wij pluggen, blokken en matten die gebruikt worden in de kastuinbouw. Een innovatief product dat wereldwijd gebruikt wordt om verschillende gewassen op te telen. Kwaliteit staat zoals overal binnen ROCKWOOL hoog in het vaandel omdat onze producten toonaangevend zijn binnen deze branche. Op de afdeling zijn er een aantal lijnen die door meerdere operators volledig bediend worden.

Geïnteresseerd?
Reageer via de sollicitatiebutton en wij gaan graag het gesprek met je aan! Bij vragen schakel direct met onze recruiter Joey Bokhorst via joey.bokhorst@rockwool.com of 06-15036795

title: Emergency Department Tech (ERT),  FT, evenings, 3p-3a
description:
BASIC PURPOSE OF THE JOB

An employee who performs tasks which involve specific nursing care for patients delegated by and performed under the direction of a Registered Professional Nurse.

  • Nurse Manager

Supervisory Responsibilities: YES

Minimum Education: High School Diploma/GED

  • Demonstrates effective communication and service excellence skills.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Safely and efficiently transfers patients to and/or from other patient care areas as directed, including patients on oxygen and/or IV therapy.
  • Consistently adheres to safe Infection Control practices.
  • Collects specimens (throat, NP, urine, stool and sputum), labels them accurately and ensures they are sent to lab.

Keyboard/computer use and/or repetitive motions may be required.

description:
