An Inventory Specialist works with and reports to the General Manager and is responsible for HUB operation while performing the following duties. Other duties may be assigned.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Pull and ship HUB orders on time.
  • If HUB order can’t be filled, call servicing store before next HUB run explaining how to reorder.
  • Working with store management team, complete all parts department cycle counts including OUTS.
  • Work with store management team to complete all parts department plan-o-grams.
  • Work with store management team to stock all parts department parts.
  • Work with store management team to complete all parts department callbacks.
  • Work with store management team to complete MAXI changes in parts department.

  • Comply with all company policies and procedures.

  • At General Manager’s direction, train and develop Team Members to help assure the HUB is operated according to company policies and procedures.

  • Help to ensure compliance of established security, customer service and record keeping policies and procedures.

  • Task assignment and completion, safety, open/close duties.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Should have prior retail experience, including basic merchandising and inventory management skills.
  • Able to drive forklift, if certified and applicable, and use a hand truck and pallet jack.
  • Should be well mannered, neat in appearance and possess the ability to meet and deal with the public in an unbiased manner.
  • Previous work records should demonstrate stability and performance results.
  • Scheduling factors necessitate that the individual should be able to come to work on short notice, and/or work flexible hours including nights and weekends.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Almost constant standing or walking.

Inside approximately 95 % of the time; depending upon the time of year, the store is air conditioned or heated accordingly. Job Posting Title:

Job Description:

Overview:

The incumbent in this position will perform experimental and applied research and testing on transient multiphase flow and heat transfer across several concurrently funded projects. Areas include geothermal engineering, geothermal thermal-hydraulics, geothermal well control, and geothermal system engineering; CO2-related thermal hydraulics, CO2 well control, and CO2 and hydrocarbon transport and injection, including CO2 injection and CO2 atmospheric dispersion for safety and risk studies; well control and managed pressure drilling (MPD); and well integrity and decommissioning. The work is hands-on: building, commissioning and operating high-pressure flow loops and live pressure-control equipment, instrumentation and data acquisition, and executing test campaigns on the PERTT Laboratory facilities. Responsibilities include running experiments according to designs and procedures approved by the principal investigator, reducing and analyzing data, and contributing data, analysis and written sections to reports and publications prepared under the direction of the principal investigator. The incumbent does not independently design research programs or serve as primary author on publications.


Job duties for Research Associate 3:

Build, commission and operate high-pressure flow loops, test facilities and live pressure-control equipment; install and maintain instrumentation and data acquisition; execute experimental campaigns at the PERTT Laboratory according to designs and procedures approved by the principal investigator, covering geothermal engineering and thermal-hydraulics, CO2-related thermal hydraulics and CO2 well control, CO2 and hydrocarbon transport and injection, well control and MPD, and well integrity and decommissioning; reduce and analyze data and validate models against measurements.


Contribute data, analysis and written sections to papers, reports and presentations prepared under the direction of the principal investigator; support research planning and external engagement; maintain data and records.


Minimum Qualifications for Research Associate 3:

Master's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engr, Chemical Engr or related degree and 0 years of experience. Also, we will accept as a minimum qualification, a Bachelor's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engr, or Chemical Engr and 2 years of related experience. Specific experience: Hands-on experimental experience is required: building and operating flow loops or comparable high-pressure test facilities, instrumentation and data acquisition, and execution of test campaigns. Working knowledge of thermal hydraulics, thermodynamics, and multiphase flow heat transfer. Good written and verbal communication skills are required.


Preferred Qualifications for Research Associate 3:

Master's in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engr, Chemical Engr or closely related degree with 0 years of experience. Specific experience: Expertise in experimental multiphase flow is a strong advantage, as is a strong background in heat and mass transfer and in thermodynamics. A petroleum engineering background and prior field or industry experience - particularly in well control and plug-and-abandonment operations - are advantageous. Preference will be given to candidates comfortable working at a live pressure-control facility. Experience with machine learning and data assimilation applied to flow and thermal systems is advantageous; surrogate modeling and digital twin workflows are also relevant. None of these is required.


Preferred Certifications/Licenses:

International Well Control Forum (IWCF) certification; OSHA/University lab safety training

title: Discovery Analytical Chemistry Advisor/Senior Advisor
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Position Summary:

This role is an independent scientific contributor position within the Discovery Analytical Chemistry team, part of Discovery Chemistry Technologies in Advanced Molecule Design. The scientist will apply advanced analytical expertise across characterization, separation science, and method development — operating with full ownership of their work and a high standard of quality and scientific rigor to generate insights that directly shape compound progression decisions. A high-performing individual in this role will bring deep technical knowledge, strong scientific judgment, and the ability to influence analytical strategy at the project and team level, actively engaging with the analytical science literature and partnering across discovery chemistry teams and geographies to accelerate molecule progression toward the clinic.


Responsibilities:

Analytical Characterization & Separation Science — Own the Science, Shape the Decisions

  • Apply advanced analytical expertise across characterization, separation science, physicochemical profiling, and material quality assessment to independently solve complex analytical challenges and generate insights that shape compound progression decisions.
  • Design and optimize analytical and purification methods across multiple modes and techniques — including chiral and achiral separations, crude sample analysis, and preparative-scale isolation — applying deep scientific judgment to balance quality, rigor, and scientific impact.
  • Anticipate and resolve non-routine analytical problems through mechanistic reasoning, creative method development, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Influence analytical strategy at the project, team, and departmental level — defining analytical approaches that enable discovery chemistry teams to rapidly iterate through design-make-test-analyze cycles.
  • Evaluate and implement new analytical technologies and methodologies to strengthen the team's capabilities and expand capacity for high-throughput chemistry experimentation and library synthesis.
  • Actively engaged with the analytical science literature and external innovation landscape to identify, assess, and introduce impactful innovative approaches across the Lilly portfolio.

Instrument Operations & Maintenance — Set the Standard for Performance and Reliability

  • Ensure optimal performance and reliability across the team's analytical instrumentation portfolio; define and maintain SOPs, testing plans, and maintenance protocols.
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex instrument issues and partner with vendors and support teams to resolve them efficiently.

Safety & Compliance — Model Safety Leadership Through Personal Practice

  • Maintain safety as the top priority in all laboratory work and in the identification of procedures that pose potential risks to health, safety, or the environment. Actively reinforce a safety-first team culture.
  • Maintain a detailed, timely, and compliant laboratory notebook. Uphold rigorous documentation and data integrity standards as a model for the team

AI/ML & Technology Adoption — Drive Digital Integration into Analytical Workflows

  • Actively integrate AI/ML tools, data-driven approaches, and automation into analytical workflows to improve efficiency, throughput, and decision quality.
  • Champion data generation practices that enable training of predictive models and support the team's broader digital and automation strategy.
  • Build and apply working proficiency in scientific informatics, data visualization, and analytical workflow tools to extract deeper insights from experimental data.

Collaboration & Communication — Elevate the Team Through Partnership and Influence

  • Partner with discovery chemistry teams and cross-functional colleagues as a trusted analytical authority, proactively identifying how analytical insights can accelerate portfolio decisions and connecting findings to both technical and business implications.
  • Shape analytical strategy in partnership with project teams — aligning approaches to the scientific questions that matter most and ensuring insights are contextualized for rapid, confident decision-making.
  • Proactively track progress against milestones and timelines; anticipate challenges and propose solutions before they become bottlenecks.
  • Mentor and develop team members, sharing technical expertise and fostering scientific growth, good laboratory practices, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Supervise and coordinate the work of scientists and external partners, managing workload balance while ensuring quality outcomes.

Basic Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, or a related field; or M.S. with 5 + years of experience and a BS with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Proven hands-on experience in analysis and purification of small molecules across multiple chromatographic modes and mass spectrometry techniques, with demonstrated ability to independently develop and optimize analytical methods.
  • Proven track record of contributing to peer-reviewed scientific publications, presentations, and/or patents.
  • Effective English-language written and verbal communication skills.

Additional Preferences:

  • Extensive theoretical and practical knowledge of (U)HPLC, SFC, and NP chromatography and method development.
  • Hands-on experience with Waters, Agilent, and/or Shimadzu (U)HPLC and SFC platforms.
  • Experience with instrument maintenance, troubleshooting, and vendor coordination for analytical and preparative chromatography systems.
  • Experience with NMR acquisition and interpretation, including 1D and 2D techniques for structure elucidation.
  • Familiarity with a variety of analytical assays such as stability, racemization, or forced degradation studies.
  • Experience with sample processing equipment such as evaporators and lyophilizers.
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory automation platforms and workflows, with demonstrated ability to enhance analytical throughput and efficiency.
  • Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python) to support data analysis, automation, or workflow development.
  • Proficiency with scientific informatics, data visualization, or data management tools that support analytical decision-making and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong foundational knowledge of organic or medicinal chemistry principles and their application to analytical problem-solving.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising scientists in a laboratory environment.
  • Learning agility — demonstrated ability to rapidly acquire new technical skills and apply them to evolving analytical challenges.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; able to balance multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and handle ambiguity.
  • Research experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or drug discovery environment.
  • Views personal success in the context of team success.

This position works across several departments and requires someone who can manage competing priorities, adapt as needs change, and has an acute eye for details.


What you'll be a part of

  • Manage incoming requests, responding to inquiries (basic to complex), researching questions, and directing requests to the appropriate departments
  • Set up and maintain business partners in Harris ERP systems with accuracy
  • Communicate with vendors and customers to verify billing, payment remittance, and W9 information
  • Process credit applications in partnership with the purchasing team
  • Monitor subcontract compliance holds, communicate with Accounts Payable, project teams, and subcontractors to obtain missing documentation, and update compliance information in Harris ERP systems
  • Prepare basic subcontracts and change orders, research ERP reports to identify compliance issues, and maintain complete subcontract files
  • Provide general administrative backup to Construction, Estimating, and Service + Building Automation teams and contribute to special projects as needed

You'll work with a variety of people and departments, making organization, communication, and

  • Identify and resolve issues related to clinical trial conduct and data integrity, including troubleshooting problems with data collection and addressing discrepancies in study records

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Industry Software
description:
About the team

The Industry Software organization builds the B2B SaaS platforms that power Zillow's software and services for real estate professionals, including:
- Home listing, lead delivery, and home shopper lifecycle workflows
- Identity and access: account hierarchies, user identity, team roster/permissions management
- Enterprise integrations: broker rosters, listing feeds, partner data pipelines
- Monetization: purchasing, pricing, billing, entitlements, and internal tooling for sales, support, and operations

We work in tight partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and Finance to build an integrated, reliable, and scalable B2B ecosystem for our industry customers - and we aim to do it smart, humble, hardworking, and highly collaborative.

About the role

We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own some of the most complex, strategically important initiatives in Industry Software - multi-team, cross-organizational programs that span multiple product areas, from strategy and scope through execution, launch, and post-launch learning. You'll act as a thought partner to senior and executive leaders, bridge Product, Engineering, and Design to create clarity from ambiguity, and build deep expertise across our domains (monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, real estate SaaS and lead delivery) while operating as a strong generalist who ramps up quickly elsewhere.


You'll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: energized by building structure where little exists, balancing technical depth with strong stakeholder management, and setting direction while rolling up your sleeves to get high-quality work done on time.


What You'll Do

  • Strategy and planning: Define cross-org initiatives that align with Industry Software and broader Zillow B2B priorities; translate strategy into program charters, success metrics, and multi-release execution plans; shape scope and sequencing with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders.
  • Execution and delivery: Own the program lifecycle end to end - planning, dependency mapping, execution, launch, and post-launch follow-through - and drive the operating rhythms (status reviews, dependency checkpoints, release readiness) that keep teams delivering reliably, without subsuming team-level agile ceremonies owned by EMs and PMs.
  • Risk and metrics: Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early; drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions with leadership; use data to measure program health and guide iterative improvement.
  • Stakeholder communication: Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations; communicate status, risks, and decisions in a crisp, executive-ready narrative up to VP/SVP level.
  • Technical leadership: Build working knowledge of the systems, APIs, and data flows within your program scope; partner with Principal Engineers and architects to shape technical approach; ramp up quickly across domains like monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, and real estate SaaS/lead delivery.
  • TPM craft: Define and refine planning, risk, and reporting best practices for Industry Software; mentor other TPMs as a force multiplier for program management excellence; use AI-native tools to increase program efficiency and decision speed.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $182,100.00 - $290,900.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $173,000.00 - $276,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 8+ years in Technical Program Management (or equivalent), leading large-scale, multi-team, cross-org programs - including portfolio-level and multi-quarter planning - at mid-size or large companies.
  • Significant experience with B2B SaaS products or platforms, ideally serving business customers with complex account, identity, integration, or monetization needs.
  • Proven track record owning end-to-end delivery of complex, distributed systems or platforms, with strong technical fluency in modern architectures (microservices, event-driven patterns, data pipelines) and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to build program structure from the ground up: operating rhythms, governance, and metrics for complex initiatives.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive-ready narratives, and proven ability to influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Design, and other partners up to senior and executive leadership.
  • Comfortable applying data-driven prioritization to trade off scope, quality, cost, and schedule across multiple simultaneous programs in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience in one or more Industry Software domains - identity and access, monetization and billing, enterprise integrations, or real estate SaaS and lead delivery - or in adjacent complex B2B platforms (ecommerce, fintech, ad tech), ideally within a platform or internal tools organization where reliability and partner integration are critical.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring TPMs or shaping TPM best practices within an organization.
  • Familiarity with AI and modern collaboration tooling (program dashboards, automation, document generation) to streamline program management.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to have you help lead the next chapter of Industry Software at Zillow.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

title: Sr. Staff Software Technical Product Manager - AI
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Location

Remote.


Position Summary

Illumina BioInsight AI Lab is investing in deep-learning AI models to better understand genomic variant effects and prioritization. As Staff Software Technical Product Manager — AI, you own model productization and positioning inside our products: turning models into shipped, operable, customer-valued product surfaces. BioInsight AI Lab has a proven track record developing key models such as SpliceAI2, PromoterAI, and PrimateAI-3D.


You report into the Multiomics + Data + AI product group and keep AI product work moving at full pace. You partner tightly with engineering, design, PMO, Platform, Marketing, and other Software Technical Product Managers so BioInsight AI capabilities land cleanly in customer workflows.


Responsibilities


AI Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the product roadmap for AI model productization and in-product AI positioning across assigned BioInsight surfaces
  • Translate model capability into clear product problems, requirements, and success metrics (adoption, quality, trust, time-to-value)
  • Prioritize across research prototypes, production hardening, and portfolio asks so the highest-leverage AI product bets ship
  • Represent AI product work in group and BioInsight forums; escalate tradeoffs with clear recommendations

Model Productization

  • Drive the path from model to product: packaging, UX placement, evaluation criteria, failure modes, telemetry, and operational readiness
  • Partner with engineering and science stakeholders on what “production excellence” means for each model
  • Ensure AI features have durable ownership — documentation, supportability, and iteration loops

Positioning and Adoption

  • Own how AI capabilities are positioned inside products — when they appear, what they claim, and how customers learn to trust them
  • Partner with Marketing and field teams on enablement for AI features without overselling model limits
  • Close the loop on friction that blocks adoption or creates support burden

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Align with Multiomics, Data, Platform, DRAGEN, and other application TPMs so AI work compounds portfolio value
  • Collaborate with Legal, Privacy, and Security partners where AI features touch customer data, claims, or regulated workflows

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.


Qualifications


Required


  • Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years of experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Degree in biology, life sciencies, computer science, bioinformatics, or related field; master's degree preferred
  • Typically 10+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning shipped software products at scale
  • Track record of taking products from concept to commercial launch, including ownership of pricing and packaging, go-to-market planning with sales and marketing, customer adoption, and revenue and retention outcomes
  • Technical and biological fluency to evaluate AI models with scientists and engineers, from API and operational tradeoffs to what a prediction means biologically
  • Strong written and verbal communication; ability to create clarity under ambiguity

Preferred

  • Experience in genomics AI or other life-sciences AI product contexts including shipping AI inside complex B2B / enterprise software workflows (not only consumer chat)
  • Familiarity with cloud ML platforms and production
  • Advanced degree
  • Exposure to regulated or quality-conscious software environments

Position Title

Software Engineer - .NET and Azure Developer


Job Summary

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience with the .NET stack, a strong background in SQL, and proficiency with the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. This role is critical to the development and enhancement of our enterprise applications, with a particular focus on research systems. Experience with financial instruments is highly desirable.


Key Responsibilities

· Agile Scrum Participation: Engage as a full-fledged member of an Agile Scrum team, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

· Software Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy robust and scalable software solutions using C#, .NET, and the Angular framework.

· Azure Development: Implement and manage integrations and workflows using Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Logic Apps, with development facilitated via VS Code.

· Database Management: Write and optimize complex queries and stored procedures within Azure SQL databases.

· API Management: Create and consume APIs to facilitate seamless communication between our applications and external systems.

· Version Control: Utilize Git for source code management, ensuring efficient collaboration and code integrity.

· Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD): Manage the application lifecycle and automate deployments by migrating changes between environments using Azure DevOps.

· Standards and Quality: Adhere strictly to development standards and best practices, participating in code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

· Troubleshooting: Provide technical support for production environments and conduct root cause analysis to resolve complex technical issues and defects.


Qualifications and Skills

title: Senior Principal Engineer - Kubernetes
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.


About the Technology Organization

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.


About the Business Function

The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialised engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency.


Role Summary

As a Senior Principal Engineer, you will design, build, and operate Lilly's Kubernetes-based hosting platform across multiple clouds. You will own platform capabilities end to end: writing Kubernetes controllers in Go and platform automation in Go or Python, defining infrastructure as code, evolving CI/CD and GitOps delivery, and raising the reliability and security of the platform. You will also lead a small team of engineers, guiding them technically and driving delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Build, deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters end to end, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, networking, scaling and decommissioning, on a managed offering such as EKS or ROSA, or an equivalent platform.
  • Design, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes networking, including CNI plugins (Cilium, AWS VPC CNI), Services and kube-proxy replacement, CoreDNS, Ingress and Gateway API, network policies, pod-to-pod and cross-cluster connectivity, and egress control.
  • Develop and maintain custom Kubernetes controllers and operators in Go (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or Operator SDK), including CRD design, reconciliation logic, finalizers, and admission webhooks.
  • Operate and extend controller-based platform tooling such as AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), Crossplane, kro, Argo CD, and cert-manager.
  • Deploy and operate the Istio service mesh (sidecar and ambient modes), including mTLS, traffic management (Gateway, VirtualService, DestinationRule, ServiceEntry), authorization policies, mesh observability, and version upgrades.
  • Author and maintain automation, tooling, and services in Go or Python that streamline platform operations, onboarding, and review processes.
  • Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize, with strong module design, state management, and policy-as-code practices.
  • Own and evolve CI/CD and GitOps pipelines using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Artifactory, and Checkmarx, with a security-first approach to software supply chain.
  • Implement node and workload autoscaling with Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, HPA/VPA, and KEDA, including node image and upgrade strategies.
  • Review and approve pull requests for platform hosting, deployment configurations, and infrastructure changes, ensuring they are secure, reliable, and aligned with platform standards.
  • Lead a small team of platform engineers, providing technical direction, architecture and design guidance, and mentoring to grow engineers’ skills and independence.
  • Own team delivery: break down roadmap items into sprint-sized work, plan and track sprints, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate status to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Partner with application teams during onboarding, migration, and go-live, providing hands-on technical guidance and clear documentation.
  • Participate in on-call and incident response for platform issues, including root cause analysis (RCA).

How You Will Succeed

  • Demonstrate deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, API machinery, and troubleshooting production issues.
  • Write production-quality Go (and Python where needed), including tests, and apply good software engineering practices to platform code.
  • Apply strong knowledge of AWS/Azure, including compute, networking (VPC/VNet, routing, private endpoints), IAM (IRSA, Pod Identity, workload identity), and managed Kubernetes services.
  • Lead and mentor the team, setting engineering standards and technical direction while keeping delivery predictable, with clear priorities, estimates, and outcomes.
  • Use Istio to secure and manage service-to-service traffic, and set clear guidance on where mesh, CNI, and network policy responsibilities begin and end.
  • Operate CI/CD and GitOps toolchains effectively, with sound judgment on release strategies such as progressive delivery, canary, and rollback.
  • Use observability tooling to diagnose platform and application issues quickly, and drive improvements from the findings.

Required Skills


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 9+ years of experience in Platform or DevOps engineering, including running Kubernetes in production.
  • Experience technically leading or mentoring a small team of engineers, with a track record of guiding design decisions and delivering platform work on schedule.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with at least one managed Kubernetes offering (EKS, AKS, ROSA, or ARO); exposure to multiple is strongly preferred.
  • Strong programming experience in Go, including hands-on experience building Kubernetes controllers and operators; Python for tooling and automation is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes manifests, rollouts and Helm charts (deployments, rollbacks, upgrades), along with a solid understanding of core Kubernetes concepts such as storage (PV/PVC, StorageClasses, CSI), networking (Services, Ingress, DNS, network policies) and scheduling.
  • Strong Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI plugins, Service and kube-proxy modes, CoreDNS, Ingress and Gateway API, network policies, and troubleshooting pod, node, and VPC connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience operating the Istio service mesh in production, including mTLS, traffic management, authorization policies, ingress and egress gateways, and upgrades.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management (Artifactory or equivalent).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure core services, networking, and IAM.
  • Practical experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, or equivalents) and log analysis in Splunk or similar.
  • Experience with Linux, containers, and container runtimes, and strong troubleshooting skills across the network and OS layers.

Preferred

  • Experience with ACK, Crossplane, kro, or similar infrastructure-from-Kubernetes approaches.
  • Experience with security scanning and policy tools such as Checkmarx, Trivy, Kyverno, or OPA.
  • Experience supporting platforms in regulated industries (Life Sciences, Healthcare).
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS) or cloud certifications (AWS or Azure professional level).
  • Experience with multi-cluster management, disaster recovery, and cost optimization (FinOps).
  • Exposure to Agile methodologies and SDLC.

Additional Information

This is a full-time employee position. Availability for flexible hours may be needed to support platform operations, and some on-call or non-standard-hours support may be required depending on platform incident volume.

  • Supporting Group Leaders with employee relations issues around attendance, performance or conduct; working alongside senior management and Human Resources as required
  • Ensuring that animals and samples shipped to clients are in accordance with client specifications and to Company standards
  • Ensuring that operational areas and equipment are routinely monitored and that repairs are arranged and completed in conjunction with the Facilities team
  • Driving training plans for colleagues to ensure that training needs are identified, addressed and verified, offering development opportunities to support retention and employee engagement
  • Providing a working environment that is in accordance with the Company's health and safety policies
  • Having an overview of resource levels throughout the year, carefully managing annual leave and time off and ensuring that staffing levels are appropriate
  • Recruiting new team members from business case to onboarding including interview and selection
  • Being actively involved in customer audits
  • Supporting and implementing procedures necessary for compliance with Inotiv's various initiatives
  • Ensuring the maintenance of Vet Health records
  • Ensuring that those adequate accurate records of breeding history and performance are maintained on the Colony Management Program and that the correct replacement breeding systems are implemented
  • Deputizing for senior management as requested
  • To undertake other reasonable duties as requested by management
  • Adhere to all regulations, policies, guidelines, and procedure principles for utilization
  • Perform miscellaneous duties, as assigned

  • 1-3 years of leadership experience

  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent attention to detail

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint) with willingness and ability to learn company-specific systems and software

title: Analytical Engineer 3
description:
Job Description:

Employer: Techtronic Cordless GP

Title: Analytical Engineer 3

Job Description:

  • Perform and develop techniques for complex multi-physics simulations, including, but not limited to, conjugate heat transfer, creep, fatigue, and electromagnetics.
  • Design and evaluate new gear box assemblies through simulation and gear design software, such as Kissoft.
  • Serve as subject matter expert in Structures related engineering topics including Statics, Dynamics, Topology Optimization, Modal, Random Vibration, Magnetics, and Thermal Analyses.
  • Support new product development (NPD) engineering projects through simulation to meet market driven design guidelines and fulfill cost, timing, reliability, and high volume manufacturing requirements.
  • Support the Advanced Engineering team in the research and development of new to market products and technology.
  • Develop reduced order plant models (ROM) to predict mechanical and thermal system performance using MATLAB, Simscape, Python, or similar languages.
  • Perform measurements, including, but not limited to, sound, vibration, and modal studies.
  • Support NPD, new to market technology, and simulation advancement through structural analysis (FEA).
  • Maintain current knowledge of developments in the field to recommend innovations to improve quality and effectiveness of company products.
  • Partial work from home allowed on a regular basis.

Job requirements:

Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering field, or the foreign degree equivalent, and 2 years of relevant experience as an Engineer or alternate related acceptable occupation; OR Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering field, or the foreign degree equivalent, and 4 years of relevant experience as an Engineer or alternate related acceptable occupation.


Work or academic experience must have included:

  • CAD modeling (NX, SolidWorks, or other commercial code).
  • Computational language (MatLab, Simscape, Simulink, Python, Fortran, C, C++, or VB).
  • Finite Element Analysis (FEA) or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulation.
  • Multiphysics simulations including CHT, electromagnetics, and FSI.
  • Working with complex material behavior, including Creep, Fatigue, and Strain Rate Sensitivity.
  • System modeling in Matlab, Simscape, Simulink, Python, or other computational language.
  • Laboratory testing and data acquisition, including vibration, temperature, pressure, flow rate, torque, and power.

High school diploma or general education degree (GED), Bachelor’s degree in business or a related area preferred.

Must have a valid driver's license

title: Vizir søker: Løsningsarkitekt
description:
På vegne av, meget spennende selskap søker vi etter en løsningsarkitekt, som ønsker å være en del av et sterkt fagmiljø.

Er du en løsningsarkitekt som ser helheten og brenner for å skape forretningsverdi?

Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring, helst innen Dynamics 365 Finance og Supply Chain Management, og som også har god oversikt over Power Platform, øvrige apper og Azure. Du ønsker en rolle der du får bruke både strategisk blikk og teknologiforståelse til å skape verdi for kundene våre.

Hos oss får du jobbe tett med kunden -- fra tidlig dialog og løsningsdesign til ferdig leveranse og kontinuerlig forbedring -- med fokus på å bygge løsninger som faktisk gjør en forskjell i virksomheten.

Som løsningsarkitekt vil du:

  • Designe helhetlig løsningsarkitektur basert på Dynamics 365-plattformen, inkludert integrasjoner og tredjepartsløsninger

  • Delta aktivt i presales og være en faglig sparringspartner både for kunder og kolleger

  • Jobbe etter etablerte prosessmodeller tilpasset ulike bransjer

  • Dele erfaringer og utvikle metodikk i samarbeid med andre løsningsarkitekter

  • Holde deg oppdatert på nye trender, særlig innen Power Platform og Microsoft-teknologi generelt

Hvem er du?

Du har trolig mellom 5 og 10 års erfaring med Dynamics 365 Finance og Supply Chain Management, eller tilsvarende ERP-løsninger. Du jobber strukturert, forstår kundens behov og tenker langsiktig. Du trives med å presentere løsninger og samarbeider godt i team.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har erfaring med løsningsdesign og arkitektur på tvers av systemlandskap

  • Har fokus på leveransemetodikk og brenner for standardiserte og strukturerte prosesser

  • Har deltatt i presales og trives med dialogen i tidlig fase

  • Er analytisk, forretningsorientert og god til å kommunisere

  • Er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi og motiveres av å lære og dele kunnskap

Hos oss får du:

  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag med hybridmodell og mulighet for hjemmekontor

  • Tilhørighet til et sterkt fagmiljø med fokus på kunnskapsdeling og utvikling

  • Prosjekter hos mellomstore og store virksomheter, ofte med kompleksitet og påvirkningskraft

  • Mulighet til å forme rollen og bidra til både kunde- og teamutvikling

Vi er i vekst og ser etter flere dyktige folk som vil være med og løfte både kundene og hverandre. Du vil få tilhørighet til ett av våre kontorer i Norge, og vi ser gjerne at du er innom kontoret én til to ganger i uken.

Syntes du at noen av de ovenfor beskrevne områdene er interessante vil vår kunde kunne tilby konkurransedyktige betingelser et godt miljø og gode fremtidige karrièremuligheter med meget kompetent kolleger. Noe reising må påregnes.

Søkere vurderes løpende.

Alle henvendelser og søknader blir behandlet konfidensielt.

Søk på stillingen ved å sende CV og søknad til e-mail: soknad@vizir.no eller registrer din CV hos vizir.no.

For spørsmål vedrørende stillingen kontakt Finn J. Sævil, tlf. 905 32 358 for en uforpliktende prat.

Hvis du kjenner noen som du tror passer til jobben, og som vurderer spennende utfordringer, så tips dem gjerne.

For andre stillinger se vizir.no

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vizir AS er et rekrutterings- og rådgivningsselskap som er spesialisert innen fagspesialister og ledere. Selskapet arbeider i Bergen, Oslo og Stavanger. Vi har som målsetting å være ledende og våre kunder er blant Norges mest attraktive arbeidsgivere.

title: Financial Systems Analyst
description:
Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

Summary

The Financial Systems Analyst provides hands-on functional support for production finance systems and supports implementation activities for Oracle Fusion ERP and related finance applications. This role focuses on business process support, system testing, user documentation, training coordination, and issue resolution while partnering with the Finance Systems team to improve operational effectiveness and end-user adoption.


Position Responsibilities


Finance Systems Support & Implementation Execution

  • Support assigned Oracle Fusion workstreams (Procure to Pay, Record to Report, Quote to Cash, Project to Close) by executing functional tasks based on business and project requirements
  • Document business processes, system workflows, and functional requirements for current-state and future-state operations
  • Maintain and validate functional setup data including chart of accounts, calendars, ledgers, business units, payment terms, tax rules, and approval hierarchies under established design standards
  • Partner with IT Infrastructure and business teams on integration testing for Salesforce CRM, Workday HRIS, and third-party applications
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, research support documentation, and escalate complex problems to senior team members or Oracle support as needed

Testing Coordination & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and execute test scripts for unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across Oracle Fusion workstreams and business scenarios
  • Support UAT execution including tester coordination, sandbox readiness, test data preparation, and daily issue tracking during testing windows
  • Track defects using project management tools such as Jira and Smartsheet, maintain clear issue documentation, and support timely resolution and test result sign-off
  • Execute regression testing after Oracle quarterly updates to validate existing functionality and identify impacts from new features

Training Development & Delivery

  • Support development of role-based training content aligned with job responsibilities (AP Processor, AR Specialist, GL Accountant, Financial Analyst, Manager Approver, etc.)
  • Create and maintain training materials including user guides, quick reference cards, sandbox exercises, and FAQs
  • Facilitate or co-facilitate end-user training sessions and provide follow-up support during adoption and stabilization periods

Production Support, Hypercare & Ongoing Operations

  • Support production finance systems (Oracle Fusion and other applications) through daily troubleshooting, user support, system maintenance, and implementation-related activities
  • Serve as a first-line functional resource for end users, resolving routine Oracle Fusion issues, escalating when needed, and monitoring support trends to identify documentation or training gaps
  • Build effective working relationships with business stakeholders while providing practical guidance on system processes, support options, and standard ways of working

Business Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document end-to-end business processes using process flows, RACI matrices, and written procedures; maintain functional knowledge articles, business rules, and troubleshooting guides
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and adoption of new Oracle Fusion capabilities introduced in quarterly updates
  • Partner with Accounting SMEs and project team members to gather feedback on pain points, bottlenecks, and enhancement requests

AI/LLM Usage & Productivity

  • Use LLM tools such as GPT, Claude, and Gemini to improve productivity in creating test scripts, training materials, user documentation, and process guides
  • Support AI-enabled workflow adoption by providing user feedback, participating in validation activities, and helping prepare end-user materials

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field
  • 2-4 years of experience in finance systems, ERP support, or business process analysis
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Financial Management or another major ERP platform such as Oracle EBS, PeopleSoft, SAP, or NetSuite
  • Experience supporting UAT, developing test scripts, and tracking defect resolution for system implementations or enhancements
  • Experience creating user documentation or supporting end-user training for finance systems or business applications

Functional & Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of financial accounting processes including Procure to Pay, Quote to Cash, Record to Report, and Project to Close
  • Foundational knowledge of Oracle Fusion functional configuration (setup tables, value sets, approval rules, reporting trees)
  • Experience using Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as OTBI, BIP, or FBDI for data extraction and analysis
  • Working knowledge of testing tools and methodologies including test case design, defect management, and regression testing
  • Strong Excel skills for data analysis, validation, and reporting; familiarity with SQL is a plus

Communication & Training Skills

  • Strong written communication skills with ability to create clear, user-friendly documentation and translate system terminology into business language
  • Effective presentation and facilitation skills for supporting training sessions with users of varying technical abilities
  • Supportive coaching style with ability to explain system functionality in simple, practical terms
  • Active listening skills and empathy for user challenges during system transitions and go-live events

AI & Emerging Technology Skills

  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and experience using AI tools for productivity and content creation; curiosity about emerging finance technology trends
  • Basic understanding of AI agent concepts and ability to participate in user validation and feedback activities

Personal Attributes

  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused with commitment to accuracy in all deliverables
  • Self-starter who takes initiative to identify and solve problems proactively
  • Flexible and adaptable in fast-paced, changing environments with competing priorities; team player with collaborative mindset
  • Customer-service orientation with focus on end-user experience and satisfaction

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in an office environment (Constant)
  • Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)


Clearance Level

No Clearance

$89,000 - $151,500

title: Financial Clearance Specialist III - PreArrival - Full Time 8 Hour Days (Non-Exempt) (Non-Union)
location: Los Angeles, CA - Health Sciences Campus
description:
The Financial Clearance Specialist III is responsible for ensuring insurance eligibility, benefit verification, and the authorization processes are complete in the time allowed by the insurance companies to prevent denials or penalties. Documenting accurate insurance information and authorization details to optimize reimbursement from both the payer and patient. Maintain strong working knowledge of insurance plans, contract requirements, and resources to facilitate appropriate insurance verification and authorization. Must be able to run eligibility and secure full benefit coverage information (including COBRA when applicable) with insurance companies and employers, confirm all demographic information is correct, and ensure coordination of benefit (COB) and insurance plan codes are accurate. Verify insurance coverage immediately for inpatient and outpatient accounts that are same day and next day add-ons. Determine if pre-certification, pre-authorization or a referral is required for insurance companies and obtain if applicable. Communicate with providers and team regarding out-of-network issues, assess contracted and non-contracted payer issues, and document outcomes and next steps. Determine, communicate, and collect patient liability prior to service and attempt to collect prior balances. Conduct all transactions appropriately and consistently, and complete Medicare Secondary Questionnaire accurately with the patient or patient's representative. Maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations as it pertains to the insurance processes. Maintain professional development by attending workshops, in-services, and webinars to remain up-to-date on insurance rules and regulations in addition to changes within the industry. Responsible in submitting authorizations for surgery, GI , Imaging chemotherapy, Infusions, invasive and non-invasive procedures, transplants, and all other services as required.


Essential Duties

  • Responsible for obtaining insurance information/verification/authorization to ensure financial clearance of patient accounts. Updates both professional and / or hospital registration systems. Ensure all insurance plans are properly selected in all registration and scheduling information systems. Responsible for calling insurance or use Internet portals to obtain and document: a) Insurance eligibility and benefits, b) Financial responsibility, c) Authorization and / or Pre-Certification as required. (20%)
  • Responsible for understanding and articulating patient’s liability by performing mathematical calculations in understanding out of pocket, co-insurance and deductible calculations. Responsible for full calculations on all Surgery, GI, Chemo/Infusions, Imaging on non and invasive procedures by following the appropriate documentation standard guidelines. (20%)
  • Responsible for contacting Physician office when a patient’s services are denied, re-directed and or when a Peer to Peer is required. Communicate with physician offices regarding proposed admissions, special procedures, outpatient referrals and same day surgeries. (20%)
  • Responsible for submitting authorizations for Surgery, GI, Chemo/Infusions, Imaging on non and invasive procedures. Submits authorizations via the Valor software tool and or websites and follows the appropriate protocol when submitting authorizations. Responsible for clearing assigned worklists in any of the information systems (15%)
  • Responsible for completing Documentation of all authorization information is entered in all appropriate registration fields and follows the approved documentation standard guidelines. Submit pre-certification documentation to third party payers for authorization with correct CPT and ICD coding. Research payer medical policy requirements for treatment authorizations and understand process for submitting pre-certification requests. Follow up for routine requests from the message center are followed up on 3-5 business days consistently. Scan all authorizations into appropriate system under the respective patient accounts and document authorization outcomes in the registration system. (15%)
  • Perform all other duties as assigned. (10%)


Qualifications

  • Req High school or equivalent Or GED required.
  • Req 2 years Admitting/ insurance verification experience in a hospital, health plan or Physician office environment.
  • Req Broad experience in financial counseling and co-pay collections.
  • Req Ability to submit authorization and articulate full insurance benefits for Surgery, GI, Imaging, Chemo Therapy, Infusions, and invasive and non- invasive procedures is highly desirable.
  • Req The extended ability to perform mathematical calculations, extensive experience in hospital and medical business office setting.
  • Req Ability to interrupt patient’s insurance coverage, identify services that are not covered benefit and provide clear explanation to patients and providers.
  • Req Strong problem solving customer skills.
  • Req Knowledge of business office procedures.
  • Req Knowledge of medical terminology and coding.
  • Req Knowledge of grammar, spelling, and punctuation to type patient information.
  • Req Must be able to verify insurance and advanced knowledge of both CPT codes and medical terminology.
  • Req Must also be able to understand and interpret patient liability and benefits for HMOs and all payer types.
  • Req Ability to read, understand, and follow oral, and written instructions and establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, employees, and the public.
  • Req Excellent time management, organizational skills, research/analytical skills, negotiation, communication (written and verbal), and interpersonal skills.
  • Req Capable of reading the policy and procedure manual and understanding information pertaining to specific job duties and the general information for all hospital employees.
  • Req Fire Life Safety Training (LA City) If no card upon hire, one must be obtained within 30 days of hire and maintained by renewal before expiration date. (Required within LA City only)

This role involves working closely with operations and maintenance teams to ensure the automation equipment perform reliably and efficiently, minimizing downtime and supporting our operational goals at Kenco Fleet Services.

title: Programme Manager
description:
Job Description

Programme manager

Derby

Onsite

Management level C

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

As a Programme Manager in our defence Future Programmes, you’ll play a critical role shaping the future of combat air capabilities for the next generation – helping deliver pioneering technologies, processes, and platforms that secure the UK’s operational freedom and Rolls-Royce’s leadership in the market.

Stepping into this role, you’ll integrate multidisciplinary teams across our sub-system, focussing to deliver work packages, collaborating across technical, governance, and capability groups.

You’ll champion delivery excellence, business partnering, team development, and continuous improvement—cultivating an environment where bold ideas and diverse perspectives drive results.

What you will be doing:


  • Lead and empower the delivery of work packages across varying levels of complexity, collaborating directly with sub-system teams to achieve seamless execution.
  • Act as a strategic business partner for the programme, engaging proactively with colleagues in engineering, procurement, and programme management to drive integrated solutions.
  • Work closely with sub-system teams to develop, maintain, and manage a holistic, integrated plan—ensuring alignment with programme priorities, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Monitor risks, actions, and emerging challenges, taking ownership for clear mitigation strategies and driving benefits and successful delivery throughout the lifecycle of each work package.
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with all stakeholders, facilitating transparent communications and collaborative problem solving to ensure shared understanding and commitment.
  • Champion robust stakeholder management—providing clear, timely information to sponsors, team members, customers, and business partners.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement, ensuring that learnings are captured and applied across the programme.
  • This role would also include additional accountabilities to represent the Defence Future Programmes within our Derby office, as well as becoming a security and safety representative for the Derby based teams.

Position qualifications:

  • APM PMQ or equivalent

Preferred requirements:

  • Robust Project management domain knowledge to lead complex work packages with variation of stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of delivering technical programmes/projects to scope, schedule, and budget
  • Demonstrable experience managing projects in diverse or unfamiliar contexts
  • Strong understanding of product change control and NPI/ industrialisation. Knowledge and application of APQP would be desirable.
  • As a minimum, must be a UK National and hold SC clearance without restrictions
  • undefined

Regional Benefits:

  • Work in a safety-first environment were doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
  • Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
  • Develop your career as a mid-career professional blending technical expertise with strong personal qualities.
  • Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.
  • Collaborate and build relationships in a team-focused environment while also working independently.
  • Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
  • Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.

To work for the Rolls-Royce Defence business, an individual has to hold a Security Check clearance. Rolls-Royce will support the application for Security Clearance if you do not currently already have this in place. Due to the nature of work the business conducts and the protection of certain assets we can only progress applications from individuals who are a UK national or, in MOD and Government body approved cases, a dual national.

Please be aware that the priority will be given to employees identified as being at high risk.

The professional level and the salary of the position will be dependent on the skills and experience of the successful candidate.

It is advised that you inform your current manager of your application for this role.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

title: Fulfillment Team Leader
description:
Manulife Bank & Trust’s Mortgage Underwriting department is looking for a Mortgage Fulfillment Team Lead. In this role, you will directly contribute to growth within our Residential Mortgage business by supporting a frictionless and competitive mortgage origination experience for both our customers and independent advice partners.


Position Responsibilities:


  • Provide ongoing coaching to team members, including formal bi-weekly coaching, progress documentation and SMART goals focused on productivity, quality and turnaround times.
  • Review files and conduct quality checks to ensure productivity and quality standards are achieved prior to funding.
  • Develop strong knowledge of regional residential mortgage markets and relevant market and cultural differences to effectively support the assigned geographic area.
  • Manage escalations, appeals and complaints with a strong sense of urgency, including same-day acknowledgement.
  • Effectively manage scheduling, resources and workflows to consistently deliver against service-level expectations.
  • Collaborate and act as a liaison with internal business partners and vendors to support a strong risk partnership.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen transaction structures and the company’s position in the event of default.
  • Identify individual and team training gaps and provide ongoing coaching and development.
  • Prioritize the Review Queue and provide support to other Team Leads as required.
  • Provide hands-on support during periods of higher volume, including new files and the Review Queue, to help the team achieve targets.
  • Plan and implement training programs for new hires and support training for other departments as required.
  • Track employee progress and provide updates to leadership.
  • Advocate for continuous improvement, change management and evolving business needs and initiatives.
  • Develop training quizzes and feedback surveys to support learning and development.
  • Represent the team in working groups as a subject matter expert and resource.
  • Support management with audit requirements.
  • Identify knowledge gaps and process-efficiency opportunities.
  • Facilitate and support process improvements and projects as a subject matter expert.
  • Identify, report and mitigate risk.
  • Proactively alert Directors and Managers to emerging trends related to risk or service.

Required Qualifications:


  • Strong knowledge of residential lending practices, products and mortgage underwriting.
  • Expert knowledge of credit with strong analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to build consensus.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Effective change-management skills and the ability to manage fluctuating workloads and priorities.
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across business partners.
  • Ability to coach and empower Fulfillment Analysts while promoting proactive problem-solving and accountability.
  • Ability to build alignment between team members and business partners.
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills, including experience leading training and case-study sessions.

When you join our team:

  • We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
  • We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

title: T24 Senior Technical Consultant
description:
ABOUT TEMENOS


Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market-leading core banking suite and best-in-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. Our mission is to create a world where people can live their best financial lives.


VALUES


Care about transforming the Banking landscape.

Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.

Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.

Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced SeniorTechnical Consultant to spearhead the design and development of robust and scalable software solutions at Temenos Headquarters S.A. This role will be pivotal in translating business requirements into technical specifications and guiding our development teams through the entire software development lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities

* Lead the architectural design and development of complex software applications, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards.
* Conduct thorough assessments of existing systems and proposed solutions, identifying areas for improvement and innovation.
* Oversee and actively participate in application development, including compiling and decompiling code as needed for analysis and optimization.
* Configure and maintain computer systems, including portal servers, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Champion best practices in IT testing, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable software.
* Document and model user requirements, translating them into clear and actionable technical specifications.
* Design and implement intuitive Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) and user experiences (UX), focusing on usability and accessibility.
* Manage program installation, versioning, and deployment processes across various environments.
* Provide expert guidance on WAN switching and firmware configuration, optimizing network performance for applications.
* Drive continuous improvement within the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) through effective action planning and strategic initiatives.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, applying digital literacy to inform architectural decisions.

Job Qualifications

* Proven experience as a Senior Technical Consultant or similar senior-level role in software development.
* Expertise in Action Planning and driving strategic technical initiatives.
* Strong background in Application Development, including proficiency in compiling and decompiling code.
* Demonstrated ability in Assessment and evaluation of technical solutions.
* Proficient in Computer System Configuration and maintenance.
* High level of Digital Literacy and adaptability to new technologies.
* Experience in documenting and modeling user requirements effectively.
* Extensive knowledge of Graphical User Interface (GUI) design principles and implementation.
* Solid understanding of Information Technology (IT) Support principles and practices.
* Expertise in IT Testing methodologies and execution.
* Hands-on experience with Portal Server Configuration and management.
* Proficient in Program Installation and Versioning control systems.
* In-depth knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and its various phases.
* Proven ability in User Experience (UX) Design, creating intuitive and engaging interfaces.
* Experience with WAN Switching and Firmware Configuration.

description:
Senior Financial Associate

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

1. Supports Business Unit Controller in:

· Records revenue each month for Unit, Fee for Service and Fixed Price contracts;

· Loads project budgets into Oracle/Revenue Wizard and maintaining key member lists (project set up) and other project data in Oracle and associated systems and schedules;

· Prepares project level actual versus budget/forecast variance analysis monthly as well as monthly reports for distribution in analyzing monthly results;

· Coordinates monthly forecasting of financial results (backlog);

· Meets established deadlines for Revenue and Backlog submittals;

· Timely preparation of project close out reconciliations including issue identification and escalation, if necessary;

· Serves as a key contact point for interpretation and investigation of financial results in assigned area for the assigned Project Manager(s)/Project Lead(s); and

· Reviews executed Work Orders and Change Orders for bonus other anomalies.

2. Works closely with Business Unit Controller to:

· Captures, assesses and consolidates results; and

· Prepares key reports such as annual cost and expense budgets, cost rates, cost and expense forecasting, monthly utilization, headcount, revenue backlog analysis, and/or gross profit for assigned area.

· Assists in running P&L’s (Profit and Loss), G/L (General Ledger) account detail, and Project level reports for Business Unit Controller(BUC) review; and

· Produces ad hoc reports as required with assistance.

3. Attends project meetings as applicable to support assigned areas. Attends project kick-off meetings to capture and process relevant data for set up of newly awarded projects onto financial systems and schedules. Attends monthly project review (MPRs) meetings to ensure understanding/concurrence of project status, potential issues and the accuracy of the forecast.

4. Monitors the overall health of assigned projects including but not limited to revenues, gross profit, receivables, and unbilled amounts as well as project close outs and reconciliations.

5. Acts as back up for BUC in supporting and responding to requests received from project managers and others as needed.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
