title: Field Reimbursement Manager
description:
Job Title

Field Reimbursement Manager

Requisition

JR000016127 Field Reimbursement Manager (Open)

Location

Minneapolis, MN

Additional Locations

Des Moines, IA, Milwaukee, WI

Job Description Summary

This position is a critical front-line member of the Keenova Access and Reimbursement team. The Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) represents Keenova's interest with HCP accounts, as well as all internal Keenova stakeholders and field sales personnel. The FRM will be an expert and provide education, training and hands-on assistance related to access to the above products.

Job Description

Provider Account Support

  • Critical point person for all reimbursement and acquisition logistical aspects of a high touch biologic medication for an orphan disease, and testosterone products with multiple acquisition options within a changing payer landscape.
  • Assists HCP offices with questions related to Buy/Bill BI management. Educate/Assist with Specialty Pharmacy understanding, expectations and logistics. Continually educate office staff on appropriate steps, educate on the importance of chart documentation, keep offices up to date on payer policies for Keenova products and triage issues to the appropriate HUB and Specialty Pharmacy
  • Primary responsibilities include:
    • Managing patient assistance and reimbursement support services offered to providers and related to patient access to buy/bill products.
    • Coordinating with Keenova’s patient support services program representatives.
    • Educating office staff on the use of Buy/Bill products patient assistance and reimbursement support services.
    • Participating in sales training related to product reimbursement.
  • Utilizing data to critically think through acquisition challenges from a variety of outlets including Specialty Pharmacies, Specialty Distributors and Title sales.
  • Assist new offices from a reimbursement perspective to inform them about reimbursement issues as well as education on various MARC approved resources pertaining to reimbursement, acquisition and coding.

SP Support

  • FRMs work closely with the external and internal customers to trouble shoot any SP related issues. FRMs to work closely with their NAE partner to manage any customer related issues directly with the SP’s.
  • Specialty Pharmacy experience is critical. Each FRM should be an expert in Specialty Pharmacy logistics and operations.
  • FRMs must be able to analyze data and know how to make that data into actionable steps to facilitate patient access to Keenova products.
  • Work closely with Specialty Pharmacies to understand logistical issues that arise and provide MARC approved resources and programs to facilitate patient access as well as communicate with SP’s to find resolutions to issues that arise at the SP.
  • Identify gaps in knowledge of accounts from a Specialty Pharmacy process and help provide education for the account and physician.

Internal Partnerships

  • Consistent, reliable, timely and high-quality support of the field, as well as all other internal commercial functions.
  • Strong leadership role to the field teams by establishing a solutions oriented approach, working with your Sales Representatives/DM to build and execute on local plans to overcome barriers to Buy/Bill products access. Specific examples include:
    • Identify in conjunction with the field, specific targeted accounts where the FRM will assist with product acquisition or SP dispense.
    • Partner with the DM’s to build local business plans; participate in district business reviews as the expert resource on the reimbursement landscape from regional, district, state and local perspective.
    • Provide the teams with actionable feedback (across the organization) on support programs such as the Helpline, copay card, SPP performance, so as to guide changes to improve access.
    • Help educate the internal customers on managed market dynamics specific to SP’s/SD’s as well as local payor issues-needs. Track customer trends in order to help inform internal business decisions. (E.g. Health care policy changes…).
    • Proactively use business analytics to understand common logistical issues in top accounts and proactively develop plans for education and to find solutions for better patient access. Ensure alignment with DM and District Strategy.
    • Provide support to sales representatives and District Managers/Internal Stakeholders on rules of engagement to educate and further clarify what is appropriate.

Advocacy

  • The FRM works with the field to identify potential payer advocates and supports the National Account Management team on issues relating to medical policy development and execution at the HCP level.
  • Ensure all Keenova approved promotional speakers have an in-depth understanding of billing/coding, logistics and payer coverage.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • BS or equivalent, MBA or advanced degree ideal.
  • 5-7 years of relevant experience.
  • Previous experience working with vendor relationships desirable.
  • Previous experience managing customer interactions.
  • Previous sales management and/or account management experience highly desirable.

Knowledge

  • Systemic understanding of the global payer and distribution environment, in particular, biologic In-Office Injectables (IOI) in the U.S.
  • Understanding of coverage, coding (diagnostic, procedural and product), payment and reimbursement requirements and policies.
  • Knowledge / expertise in Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) per each regional MAC for all Keenova products.
  • Knowledgeable on Medicare billing/coding and appeal process. ASP, WAC as well as Sequestration; interpret and understand Medicare EOBs and CMS 1500 forms.
  • Understands the legislative, legal and regulatory environments and anticipates potential impact to Keenova.
  • Solid understanding of coverage policy creation, interpretation and management.

Skills & Abilities

  • Significant sales experience in the biologic (injectable) market.
  • Ability to synthesize clinical literature and target product profile in order to understand implications for value to payers, patients and health care providers and Keenova.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to condense complex information into concise outputs and direction.
  • Ability to work with health care providers and insurers to explain and help manage all issues related to product access.
  • Ability to balance external stakeholders’ wants with Keenova needs.
  • Hands–on operational reimbursement experience – in-house and outsourced experience desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with multiple stakeholders in a collaborative and constructive manner. Establishes relationships with appropriate field personnel, accounts, payers and vendors.
  • Comfortable working in a transparent environment (fair balance, full disclosure, Safe Harbors, etc.)

Physical Requirements

  • Significant travel involved.

Keenova offers employees a Total Rewards package which includes competitive pay and benefits. To learn more about our Total Rewards benefits please visit: Keenova Careers | Serve and Grow with Purpose | Keenova


The expected base pay range for this position is $111K - $178K. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.


This position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable program. Bonuses are awarded at the Company’s discretion.


Disclaimer: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications. Management reserves the right to change or modify such duties as required.


#LI-REMOTE

#LI-GN1

At Keenova, we believe that no one should be alone in their pursuit of better health. This purpose drives us as we pair quality therapeutics with human support—showing up in big moments and small to help patients find comfort and confidence.

We bring deep expertise and resolve to every therapeutic area we serve, including immunology, urology, men’s health, orthopedics, critical care, and pediatric endocrinology. We work with patients, care partners, and physicians to help them navigate healthcare system complexity and access therapies that make a meaningful difference.

We are Keenova—keen to solve, keen to serve. Learn more at www.keenova.com.

Job Summary

McKee Foods is seeking a Dispatch Clerk join our Central Region Transportation team. In this fast-paced role, you are responsible for assisting in real-time coordination of driver movements, load assignments, and shift documentation. You will serve as the primary point of contact for our McKee drivers and outside carriers, ensuring that all trip information is accurate, all instructions are monitored, and all documentation meets our high standards for compliance and efficiency.

  • Data & Documentation: Update trip information in internal systems as it becomes available; coordinate and print all driver trip information, delivery receipts, and backhaul documentation.
  • Carrier Management: Assist in properly dispatching and sealing outside carriers, ensuring load security and documentation integrity.
  • Administrative Support: Maintain accurate documentation, record daily call-ins, and update driver attendance and PTO records.
  • Shift Integrity: Document all shift activity to ensure a seamless handoff between teams; prepare necessary documents and reports for supervisors.
  • System Management: Maintain and update databases and modern Transportation Management Systems (TMS) with high accuracy.

Required Qualifications

  • Documentation Excellence: Exceptional attention to detail and high-level documentation skills.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical skills with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Professionalism: Ability to deal professionally and calmly with customers, drivers, and suppliers in high-stress situations.
  • Multi-tasking: Proven ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, 24/6 operational environment.
  • Communication: Excellent telephone etiquette and verbal/written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with TMS computer systems and relational databases.
  • Previous experience in transportation dispatch or logistics data entry.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, SharePoint).
  • Experience analyzing logistical information to optimize driver routes.
  • Experience with Google suite software

Benefits

title: Vendor Management Manager
description:

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Manager / Team Lead to oversee end-to-end Purchase Order (PO) Management, Invoice Processing, Vendor Reconciliation, and GST Compliance activities. The role will be responsible for leading a team of finance and operations professionals, ensuring service excellence, compliance with financial controls, and effective stakeholder engagement. The incumbent will drive process efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring accurate and timely execution of procure-to-pay operations.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Lead and manage the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, including PO creation, amendments, invoice processing, vendor reconciliations, and payment support activities.
  • Supervise and mentor a team, establish performance metrics, and drive a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Review and validate complex PO requests, ensuring compliance with organizational policies, delegation of authority (DOA), and budgetary guidelines.
  • Partner with business leaders, procurement teams, finance controllers, and vendors to ensure timely approvals, issue resolution, and seamless transaction processing.
  • Oversee vendor account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure timely closure of outstanding issues.
  • Ensure compliance with GST regulations, tax documentation requirements, and applicable statutory and regulatory standards.
  • Develop and implement process controls to strengthen governance, mitigate risks, and ensure audit readiness.
  • Monitor operational KPIs, SLA adherence, aging reports, backlog management, and financial accuracy through regular dashboards and reviews.
  • Drive automation and process transformation initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce cycle times, and enhance stakeholder experience.
  • Support internal and external audits by ensuring complete and accurate documentation and compliance with financial policies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process gaps and implement scalable solutions across geographies and business units.
  • Provide leadership on escalations, critical vendor issues, and complex procurement and invoicing scenarios requiring managerial intervention.

Bachelor's or master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, or Business Administration. Or

Professional degree like CA/ICWA/MBA with relatively less experience

8-12+ years of experience in Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable, Vendor Management, or Shared Services operations for master’s degree and relatively less for professional course/degree

Strong understanding of GST regulations, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance frameworks.

Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, or equivalent procurement systems.

Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence, process automation, and cost optimization initiatives.

title: Behörighets- och säkerhetsadministratör
description: Vattenfall Vattenkraft ansvarar för Vattenfalls 90 vattenkraftverk och ca 300 dammar i Norden. Vi är ca 580 medarbetare i Sverige och Finland med huvudkontor i Luleå. Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor och en variation av frågor där du bidrar med både service och struktur.Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:    Behörighetsadministration för IT-system och fysiska tillträden till våra vattenkraftsanläggningar    Administration kopplad till säkerhetsprövningar, exempelvis initiera och löpande följa upp säkerhetsprövningsärenden    Framtagning och utveckling av instruktioner, utbildningsmaterial, rutiner och processbeskrivningar    Genomföra systemtester och vara nyckelanvändare    Hålla utbildningar för verksamheten inom området    Stöd och rådgivning inom behörighets-, IT- och säkerhetsfrågor.Säkerhetsområdet utvecklas kontinuerligt i takt med förändringar i omvärlden och ökade krav på skydd av säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. Du kommer därför även att kunna delta i utvecklingsarbete och bidra till att våra arbetssätt och processer är tydliga, aktuella och ändamålsenliga.KravspecifikationVi söker dig som har:    Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT och/eller säkerhet, alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet    Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete inom IT och/eller säkerhet    God IT-vana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system och programvaror    Erfarenhet av att ta fram instruktioner, rutiner och processbeskrivningar    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift    B-körkort, resor i tjänsten förekommer.Det är meriterande om du har kunskap om svensk säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning samt erfarenhet av säkerhetsprövningar och arbete i större organisationer. Vi ser gärna att du har arbetat med behörighetsadministration och processutveckling samt haft en roll som nyckelanvändare där du har stöttat och utbildat kollegor.Du trivs med administrativa arbetsuppgifter och arbetar strukturerat och noggrant. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, vilket ställer krav på god kommunikativ förmåga och ett serviceinriktat arbetssätt. Du tycker om att hjälpa andra och samarbetar väl med olika delar av organisationen.Eftersom du hanterar säkerhetsrelaterad information och behörigheter är det viktigt att du har hög integritet och ett ansvarsfullt förhållningssätt. Du bidrar till en öppen och hjälpsam arbetsmiljö där vi tillsammans utvecklar våra arbetssätt.Placeringsort: LuleåKontaktpersoner För frågor om tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Veronica Holmström. Fackliga representanter är Anneli Jönsson Ledarna, Samuel Jernlif Unionen, Magnus Nilsson Akademikerna och Fredrik Lidholm SEKO. Alla nås via Vattenfalls växel, 08-739 50 00. Du svarar på några inledande frågor och bifogar ditt CV, du behöver inte inkludera ett personligt brev. På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här Att arbeta inom Vattenfall innebär att arbeta med samhällsviktig infrastruktur. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.

title: Sr Director, IT Architecture
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Sr. Director Enterprise Architecture


Company Overview

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled some of the world’s most significant health challenges, developing therapies that improve lives and expanding access to them around the globe.

Every member of Gilead’s team contributes to the discovery and delivery of life-changing scientific innovation. We are seeking passionate, ambitious people who are ready to collaborate, lead change, and make a direct impact.


Job Description

The Head of Enterprise Architecture (EA) is the senior enterprise leader and primary owner of Gilead's overall IT architecture landscape, accountable for defining, evolving and governing the enterprise architecture strategy, operating model, standards and decision framework. The role connects business strategy, capabilities, data, applications, platforms, infrastructure and technology roadmaps to shape enterprise investment, modernization and transformation decisions across Gilead.

This leader positions Enterprise Architecture as a strategic, business-facing capability that engages early, from strategy formulation and capability planning through portfolio shaping and delivery. The role has direct people leadership responsibility for a high-performing team of Enterprise and Domain Architects and provides indirect leadership across Gilead's federated architecture community. As the enterprise governance point person for IT architecture, the role establishes clear decision rights, chairs architecture governance forums, resolves cross-domain issues and drives adoption of enterprise principles, standards, target states and roadmaps through trusted partnership and influence.


This is a site based role in Foster City, CA at our global headquarters. We offer a hybrid environment with 3 days onsite and 2 days optional work from home.


Job Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture Leadership and Strategy

  • Own and maintain the enterprise architecture vision, strategy, principles, target-state architecture and multi-year roadmap for Gilead's overall IT architecture landscape, aligned with business, digital, data, AI and technology priorities.
  • Translate enterprise strategy into actionable capability, domain and technology direction, balancing long-term sustainability with near-term business and delivery needs.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders on enterprise technology strategy, architecture options, investment choices and trade-offs across speed, value, cost, risk, reuse and sustainability.
  • Act as the primary enterprise owner and governance point person for architecture, establishing decision rights, governance forums, escalation paths, metrics, repositories and an integrated architecture toolchain that increase transparency, adoption and measurable value.
  • Continuously evolve the EA operating model, methods, decision rights, metrics, repositories and integrated architecture toolchain to increase adoption, transparency and measurable value.

People Leadership and Architecture Community

  • Directly lead, manage, mentor and retain a diverse, high-performing team of Enterprise and Domain Architects; establish organizational accountabilities, set performance and development expectations, and hold leaders and team members accountable for enterprise outcomes.
  • Create an inclusive, outcome-focused culture that values enterprise thinking, pragmatic decision-making, collaboration, technical depth and continuous learning.
  • Own workforce strategy for Enterprise Architecture, including organization design, capacity and succession planning, talent reviews, role clarity and deployment of architecture talent across enterprise priorities and business domains.
  • Provide indirect leadership to the federated architecture community through the Architecture Guild and governance network; align architects across disciplines and business areas around shared methods, reusable assets, standards, guardrails, mentoring and enterprise priorities.

Establish and lead enterprise architecture governance, including architecture review and decision forums, exception management, escalation and transparent decision records. Make or sponsor enterprise architecture decisions and resolve cross-domain trade-offs to balance business value, delivery speed, cost, risk, reuse, resilience and sustainability.

Set expectations for conformance to enterprise target states, principles, standards and roadmaps; direct technology portfolio simplification, reuse and lifecycle management to reduce duplication and technical debt while improving agility, resilience and operational efficiency.

Core Enterprise Architecture

  • Connect business priorities and capability needs with enterprise technology direction, translating strategy into integrated roadmaps, architecture standards and reusable patterns that guide investment and delivery across business domains.
  • Establish practical architecture governance and transparent decision-making to balance business value, delivery speed, cost and risk; drive technology portfolio simplification, reuse and lifecycle management to reduce duplication and technical debt while improving agility, resilience and operational efficiency.

Strategic Partnership, Innovation and Assurance

  • Partner with portfolio, product, engineering, data, AI, security, privacy, quality, legal, procurement and business teams to embed architecture into planning and execution without creating unnecessary control or bottlenecks.
  • Exercise enterprise-wide influence across divisional and domain decisions while respecting local accountability and delivery context; align senior leaders and architecture stakeholders through clear decision rights, governance and matrix leadership rather than relying solely on direct authority.
  • Monitor external market and technology trends, including AI, data, cloud, integration and digital platforms, and translate relevant developments into enterprise options, guardrails and modernization priorities.
  • Ensure security, resilience, compliance, privacy, data management and other critical non-functional requirements are considered early in architecture and investment decisions.
  • Communicate an integrated enterprise architecture vision and strategy to executives and teams across Gilead; define outcome measures and hold the architecture organization and federated community accountable for adoption, risk reduction, reuse, portfolio simplification and business value.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business or a related discipline.
  • 14+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor's degree, or 12+ years with a master's degree or MBA, in enterprise architecture, technology strategy or related leadership roles within a large, complex and matrixed organization.
  • Proven experience defining enterprise architecture strategy, target states, roadmaps, standards and governance for secure, compliant, enterprise-scale environments.
  • Demonstrated direct people leadership of high-performing architecture teams, including senior architects or architecture leaders, with accountability for organization design, performance management, workforce and capacity planning, talent development and succession.
  • Demonstrated success as the primary owner and governance leader for an enterprise-wide architecture landscape, operating in a federated model and using indirect leadership to align senior business and technology stakeholders, resolve cross-domain decisions and lead transformation across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.
  • Broad knowledge of modern architecture and delivery practices across cloud, data, AI, integration, applications, platforms, cybersecurity, resilience, SDLC and DevOps, with the ability to connect business strategy and capabilities to investment priorities, technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes; strong executive communication, facilitation, visual storytelling and business acumen to translate complex technology issues into practical decisions that balance value, risk, cost, speed, reuse and sustainability.
  • Proven accountability for enterprise-wide, multi-year architecture strategy and governance, with decisions and recommendations that materially influence major technology investments, portfolio direction, risk posture and transformation outcomes across multiple business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or MBA in a relevant discipline.
  • TOGAF or comparable enterprise architecture certification; familiarity with Business Architecture Guild, SAFe, Agile, product management or related frameworks.
  • Enterprise architecture leadership experience in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience shaping enterprise data, AI and digital platform strategy, including responsible adoption of advanced analytics, generative AI and agentic capabilities.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture repositories and planning tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq or Alfabet, and with portfolio, service management, software asset management and analytics platforms.
  • Experience building and sustaining architecture communities of practice, reusable asset ecosystems and federated governance models.
  • Practical experience with technology portfolio rationalization, technical-debt management, lifecycle optimization, software asset management and benefits measurement.
  • Executive presence and demonstrated ability to build constructive, consultative relationships with senior business and technology leaders.

title: GRC Data Engineer
description:

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role Join our Risk & Internal Control department as a GRC Data Engineer, where our team protects and empowers the business by turning complex data into trusted insights. You will design scalable big data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), building reliable pipelines that power continuous control monitoring and unlock Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities across the company.

Guided by our values to Lead, Deliver, and Care, we take a customer-centric approach to everything we build—relying on strong teamwork to deliver impactful data products that raise the bar and help our stakeholders succeed.

Location: Amsterdam (Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home) Reporting to: Head of Internal Control

These are some of the key components to the position:

  • Aim high by designing and maintaining scalable ETL and ELT data pipelines using Airflow and dbt.
  • Build dimensional data models (such as star and snowflake schemas) to simplify complex data and optimize reporting.
  • Drive excellence by developing AI-ready pipelines and feature datasets that power machine learning and advanced analytics.
  • Transform and analyze large partner and sales datasets using SQL and Python to deliver clear, actionable insights.
  • Elevate data reliability by contributing to Data Quality (DQ) frameworks, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and proactive alerting systems.
  • Partner closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate goals into trusted data solutions.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Proven background in data engineering with a track record of delivering production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, dimensional data modeling, and Python for automating data workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with orchestration and transformation tools like Airflow and dbt, alongside Git and CI/CD practices.
  • Working knowledge of a major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Azure.
  • Curiosity for Large Language Model (LLM) developer tools and building data foundations for AI and Machine Learning (ML).
  • Ability to develop a strong understanding of our internal and external partners, communicating clearly to solve problems together.
  • A commitment to achieving goals and aiming higher to drive excellence in data quality and system reliability.
  • A mindset to act responsibly while making a lasting impact—a general understanding of risk reporting or control monitoring is a plus.

At JET, this is how we play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

title: Certified Recovery Specialist
description:
St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.

Hours: Full-Time

The CRS has experience with behavioral health services and is willing to use and share lived experiences and first-hand knowledge to hospital patients, their family members, and staff. The CRS functions as a substance use resource and liaison to Network Emergency Departments, medical inpatient units, and all staff to provide expertise around community resources, the recovery process, symptom management, and the persistence needed by patients/families to have a recovery oriented and satisfying life. The CRS works to identify engagement needs and helps to work with individuals through stages of change. The CRS helps the patient and family identify opportunities from a strength-based approach about enhancing life domain needs. The CRS works collaboratively with Network interdisciplinary teams to provide education on stigma, resources, and lived experiences.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Engage in relationship building and active listening with patients receiving treatment in emergency room, medical inpatient units or virtually who have a substance use disorder.
  • Utilize best practices such as motivational interviewing and stages of change to assist individuals in healthcare decision making related to substance use disorder recovery.
  • Provide supportive (peer-based) coaching and encouragement to patients contemplating or actively seeking help with substance use treatment and recovery. Ensuring that all interactions are strength-based, recovery oriented and understanding of multiple pathways and definitions of recovery.
  • Provide education to enable patients to identify their relapse symptoms or relapse triggers as well as their protective factors (to avoid relapse).
  • Engage and provide education to family members, other natural supports, and other professionals regarding substance use disorders and available programs/resources.
  • Assist in after-care planning for individuals discharging from medical setting and help ensure that behavioral health needs are included in care plan.
  • Engage in team-based care and work cooperatively with other medical professionals.
  • Engage and develop education sessions regarding recovery and stigma awareness to medical professionals, and other stakeholders.
  • Complete appropriate documentation, including to document each service-related contact in case note according to program standards.
  • Keeps current with professional literature and trends in recovery support. Attends continuing education trainings, workshops, seminars, or conferences in order to keep current with evidenced based standards of practice and maintain certification.
  • Maintains confidentiality of all materials handled within the Network/Entity as well as the proper release of information.
  • Complies with Network and departmental policies regarding issues of employee, patient and environmental safety and follows appropriate reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrates/models the Network’s Service Excellence Standards of Performance in interactions with all customers (internal and external).
  • Demonstrates financial responsibility and accountability through the effective and efficient use of resources in daily procedures, processes, and practices.
  • Complies with Network and departmental policies regarding attendance and dress code.
  • Other duties as assigned​

PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:

Sitting for up to 5 hours per day, 2 hours at a time. Standing for up to 1 hour per day, 1 hour at a time. Walking for up to 2 hours per day, 20 minutes at a time. Occasionally uses fingers to turn pages. Frequently uses hands to write, type, and hold charts. Rarely uses the hands or fingers for firm grasping or twisting/turning. Frequently uses upper extremities to lift and carry up to 10 pounds. Frequently stoops, occasionally squats, rarely reaches above shoulder level. Hearing as it relates to normal conversation in person or on telephone. Seeing as it relates to general vision, near vision, far vision, color vision, and peripheral vision.

EDUCATION:

Must be a Certified Recovery Specialist (CRS) or Certified Family Recovery Specialist (CFRS) preferred, or eligible to earn the CRS or CFRS certification, or similar certification.

TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:

Understanding of principals of addiction and recovery.

Language, Mathematical Reasoning ability needed.

Please complete your application using your full legal name and current home address. Be sure to include employment history for the past seven (7) years, including your present employer. Additionally, you are encouraged to upload a current resume, including all work history, education, and/or certifications and licenses, if applicable. It is highly recommended that you create a profile at the conclusion of submitting your first application. Thank you for your interest in St. Luke's!!

The Role and Impact

Intel is seeking a talented and motivated GPU Compiler Engineer to help advance the software technologies powering the next generation of Artificial Intelligence (AI), High-Performance Computing (HPC), and accelerated computing solutions.

In this role, you will design, develop, optimize, and maintain compiler technologies that enable high-performance execution on Intel GPU architectures. You will contribute to LLVM-based compiler development, performance optimization, code generation, and programming language support for cutting-edge heterogeneous computing platforms.

title: Global Shop Inspection Leader
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

About you and this role

We have an exciting opportunity for a Global Shop Inspection Leader to join OTEC and the Maintenance Technology Center and lead our global 3rd party shop inspection efforts. Reporting to the MTC Maintenance Capability Director, this role will own and drive continuous improvement within our global shop inspection work process. They will act as a first among peers and partner with the 3 regional shop inspection leads to execute the inspection work process and ensure all equipment is fabricated to Dow’s standards through robust 3rd party inspections. They will own quality and inspection related EMETLs and partner with cross functional SMEs to ensure they are efficient and aligned with industry standards. The role will provide direct subject matter expertise to project teams on appropriate inspection scope, design codes, and fabrication methods. They will partner with procurement to ensure current and future inspection contractors are meeting expectations and providing cost effective service to Dow.

The desired location of this role would be a Dow site in North America due to a high percentage of workload being in the region, but the role is open to other Dow locations globally.

Responsibilities

  • Designs, develops and leads implementation and continual improvement of the 3rd party shop inspection work process and related Quality Management System.
  • Partners with cross functional SMEs and stakeholders to lead and develop strategic quality work processes, to improve inspection related Most Effectively Technology (MET).
  • Defines and tracks measures of success and Key Performance Indicators to monitor the overall effectiveness of our shop inspection programs and 3rd party contractors.
  • Identifies gaps, leads development of and conducts training for and mentoring of maintenance and project professionals on the effective use of the quality management system and related work processes to meet business needs.
  • Provides expert coaching on fabrication methods, design codes, levels of inspection required, etc.
  • Ensures non-conformances are adequately communicated and addressed.
  • Leads root cause investigations related to shop inspection findings and work process gaps.
  • Conducts inspections of fabrication facilities as part of the QMR process.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree OR relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E5 or Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class or Sergeant ranking. In lieu of a degree or military equivalence, 12+ years of relevant working experience will be considered.
  • A minimum of 7 years of quality, inspection, manufacturing or related experience required.
  • Ability to read, write, and speak English fluently.
  • Must be willing and able to meet all applicable requirements related to business travel (e.g., as to immigration and visa rules, public-health mandates, airline rules, etc.) into and out of (and physical presence in) various countries world wide.
  • The ability to work legally in the country for which you are applying. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Metallurgy.
  • Extensive experience with metallic fabrication of PCE and piping to the applicable design Codes, Experience with rotating equipment is an asset.
  • Holds multiple of the following certifications or willing to acquire them on a short term: AWS-CWI, API-510, API-570, API-653 or ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level II.
  • Knowledgeable in EMETL inspection and engineering practices.
  • Knowledgeable of fabrication inspection at supplier shops.
  • Well-versed in ASME Codes and standards applicable to metallic PCE and piping fabrication and inspection.
  • Experienced in developing inspection related work processes.

Physical Demands

Willing and able to meet the physical demands of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation:

  • Lift, push, and pull up to 55 lbs.
  • Work at heights, climbs stairs and ladders.
  • Wear all required personal protective equipment, such as earplugs, goggles, and steel-toed shoes.
  • Work in an area of intense or continuous noise.
  • Work in an area with hazardous materials.
  • Perform frequent bending, reaching, and lifting.
  • Stand or walk for extended periods of time.
  • This role does involve elevated work greater than or equal to four feet above the ground.
  • Must be able to wear and use personal protective equipment (PPE), including harnesses with a total weight capacity of 300lbs. (This typically accommodates individuals who weigh 285 or less.)

Skills

  • Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA): Corrective and preventive action consists of improvements to an organization's processes taken to eliminate causes of non-conformities or other undesirable situations. It is usually a set of actions that laws or regulations require an organization to take in manufacturing, documentation, procedures, or systems to rectify and eliminate recurring non-conformance.
  • Customer-Oriented: Being customer-oriented means prioritizing customer needs and delivering value to retain them. Customer-oriented people focus on building long-lasting relationships by understanding and meeting customer expectations.
  • Quality Assurance (QA): Quality assurance is a way of preventing mistakes and defects in manufactured products and avoiding problems when delivering products or services to customers.
  • Quality Mindset: A quality mindset refers to an attitude and approach where individuals and organizations prioritize quality in all aspects of their work.
  • Quality Improvement: Quality improvement are methods to improve a production process by changing or getting rid of parts of the process that do not work well. In business, engineering, and manufacturing, quality has a pragmatic interpretation as the non-inferiority or superiority of something; it's also defined as being suitable for its intended while satisfying customer expectations.
  • Quality Auditing: A quality audit is a process that involves the systematic identification and examination of a production quality system.
  • Quality Management Systems (QMS): A quality management system is a collection of business processes focused on consistently meeting customer requirements and enhancing their satisfaction. It is expressed as the organizational goals and aspirations, policies, processes, documented information and resources needed to implement and maintain it.
  • Communication: Professional communication, encompasses written, oral, visual and digital communication within a workplace context.

Additional Notes

  • We do not offer relocation assistance for Dow jobs like this position. This includes reimbursement for travel expenses incurred to and from test sessions/interviews. If you apply for a position that is not within the area in which you reside, you will be responsible for all costs that you incur.
  • For U.S. Applicants: Possession of a TWIC card or eligibility to obtain a TWIC card may be required for this position based on final hiring location. For information on TWIC eligibility requirements, please see: (If unable to access link, copy and paste in your browser.)

Benefits – What Dow offers you

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

  • Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
  • Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
  • Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.
    • Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
  • Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
    • Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
  • Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
  • Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
  • Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
  • Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
  • Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
  • Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
  • Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
  • On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
  • Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

    • Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
    • Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

About Dow
Dow (NYSE: DOW) is one of the world’s leading materials science companies, serving customers in high-growth markets such as packaging, infrastructure, mobility and consumer applications. Our global breadth, asset integration and scale, focused innovation, leading business positions and commitment to sustainability enable us to achieve profitable growth and help deliver a sustainable future. We operate manufacturing sites in 30 countries and employ approximately 36,000 people. Dow delivered sales of approximately $43 billion in 2024. Responsibilities of the Hall Director include: supervise and train student staff (Community Advisors, Graduate Student Interns) to deliver an effective residence hall program in an area of approximately 200-400 students; implement strategies and initiatives that help all students build connections, get involved, and achieve success; serve as a conduct hearing officer; interact daily with students for many purposes including community development, conflict resolution, helping skills, resource connection, student issues and crisis, etc.; and involvement in department and University committees and department policy/procedure formation.


This position has been designated as weather and emergency essential. In the event of a university closure or emergency event, incumbent is required to report to work and respond as requested. Refer to Minnesota State Board Policy 4.4 Weather / Short Term Emergency Closings at:

  • Master’s Degree in Higher Education Leadership/Administration/Student Affairs or related field (conferred on an official transcript and received in Human Resources prior to start of employment).

OR

  • Prior to the date of appointment, this position requires a criminal background check conducted by the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension (BCA).

  • Knowledge of residence hall student issues.

  • Demonstrated initiative and experience in community development.

  • Demonstrated experience in effective conflict resolution.

About

The Hall Director is required to live in an assigned residence hall apartment, maintain regular office hours, and eat with students in campus dining facilities on a regular basis.


Hall Director work involves performing tasks on evenings, weekends, and holidays. Therefore, evening meetings and participation and attendance at programs/activities/events during evening and weekend hours is expected. The Hall Director is considered a weather essential employee.


The Hall Director participates in an on-duty rotation with other Hall Directors (for the entire residence hall system) where a phone is also carried when the Residential Life office is closed, during academic break periods, and during summer school. Being on-duty may require quick on-site response throughout the residence hall system.


Workloads are expected to be higher while classes are in session during both fall and spring semesters and during opening and closing time periods. Extended vacations may not be approved during peak academic year time periods.

The Senior Manager partners closely with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Engineering, Validation, Microbiology, Facilities, and other stakeholders to ensure effective cleaning and disinfection practices that support product quality, patient safety, and business objectives.

  • Proven leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Minimum education and experience required for the role:

title: Healthcare Business Data Analyst - PCHP
description:
PRIMARY PURPOSE

Parkland Community Health Plan's (PCHP's) Healthcare Business Data Analyst, reporting to the Health Services department, is responsible for the gathering of data from various sources to ensure improvement in the delivery of health services. Performs data analysis, verification, and mapping of financial and clinical healthcare data related to medical, pharmacy, eligibility, and other types of data files. Oversees data mining, development, and preparation of data to provide useful information for health services department.

MINIMUM SPECIFICATIONS

Education


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems or other related quantitative degree.

Experience


  • Three years of healthcare or business-related reporting, analytics, and data analyst work.
  • Two years of experience creating detailed reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Three years of experience with data collection and analysis working with large data sets is preferred.

Equivalent Education and/or Experience


  • May have an equivalent combination of education and experience to substitute for the education requirements.

Certification/Registration/Licensure


  • None.

Required Tests for Placement


  • None.

Skills or Special Abilities


  • Skilled in interpreting, analyzing, and providing recommendations regarding data accuracy and data collection needs and processes.
  • Ability to work effectively with key stakeholders on complex cross teams and work groups.
  • Able to change direction in response to changing work situations.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and an eye for details to assess and accommodate detailed project requirements.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Power Point, Excel, Access, and Word for data analysis and presentations.
  • Ability to analyze, explain and draw logical conclusion based on complex data from multiple content areas.
  • Extremely organized and able to prioritize tasks and work effectively on multiple assignments.
  • Proficient in meeting NCQA medical management standards is preferred.

Responsibilities


  • Responsible for the statistical analysis and production of reports, using data from a variety of sources, for use in management and/or clinical decisions. Applies appropriate statistical and validation tools to ensure data accuracy.
  • Reports and presents clinical insights from the analysis of data from healthcare claims looking for discrepancies and trends in the data.
  • Designs and creates clinical consulting reports with data presentations to internal and external customers as required.
  • Offers suggestions on ways to improve healthcare delivery, quality and cost effectiveness for the health plan populations.
  • Tracks on-going outcomes reports and manage priorities for upcoming reports.
  • Responsible for information gathering from various sources and translation of information to the IT Team.

Job Accountabilities


  • Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements, and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of PCHP.
  • Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field by attending seminars/workshops, reading professional journals, actively participating in professional organizations, and/or maintaining certification or licensure. Integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws and guidelines that impact the area. Develops effective internal controls designed to promote adherence with applicable laws, accreditation agency requirements, and customer requirements. Seeks advice and guidance as needed to ensure proper understanding.

title: Commercial Analytics Lead
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Position: Commercial Analytics Lead

Status: Full Time (Hybrid)

Salary Range: $160,000 - $190,000

About the Job

Why Join Howden US?

At Howden, we’re not just building a business- We’re rewriting the rules of what a global insurance broker can be. And now, it’s your turn to be part of something extraordinary. From three people and a dog to over 22,000 employees across 56 countries, we’ve grown into a $4bn revenue powerhouse with bold ambition: to become a $13bn business with 40,000 people by 2030.

We’re launching our US retail platform with the same entrepreneurial spirit that’s driven our success worldwide- and we’re looking for trailblazers to help shape the future.

Why Howden?

  • You’ll Own It
  • With 6,000 employee shareholders owning 34% of the company, our unique ownership model means you’re not just joining a team—you’re building a business you truly own.
  • You’ll Be Empowered
  • We’re a destination for talent where people are trusted to look after their clients and grow together. You’ll have the freedom to lead, backed by global scale and local expertise.
  • You’ll Be Part of Something Bigger
  • Our integrated platform spans broking, reinsurance, and MGA capabilities—giving you access to everything you need to deliver for clients and build something remarkable


We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will.

What is the role?

We are seeking a strategic and entrepreneurial Commercial Analytics Lead to own the roadmap and delivery of client-facing analytics products. As an early member of the Howden US Data team, you will have the opportunity to work with industry-leading broking, claims, and actuarial talent to shape Howden’s analytics strategy.


The ideal candidate will bring strong product management skills, substantial insurance knowledge, a passion for tinkering with AI, and broad technical fluency that enables effective work with engineers, data scientists, actuaries, model providers, and business leaders. You will manage product backlogs, define priorities, and work closely with engineering, business, and analytics teams to translate requirements into functional outcomes. You are entrepreneurial and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where you will chart your own path.

What will you be doing?

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify client risk modelling needs and define clear product outcomes, in collaboration with leaders in casualty, property, financial lines, employee benefits, personal lines, and claims.
  • Bring together internal and external data, 3rd party statistical models, and vibe-coded prototypes into a governed, scalable, and branded analytics platform; identify and evaluate new opportunities to leverage AI to enhance capabilities deliver analytics more efficiently.
  • Coordinate with Global and US teams to define today’s tools, data sources, third-party relationships, and costs associated with delivering analytics to clients, driving reuse of existing capabilities and aligning standards to avoid duplicative investment.
  • Build consensus around build versus buy strategy, external partnerships, and defining core analytics capabilities.
  • Coordinate with Global and US teams to reuse existing Howden capabilities, align standards, and avoid duplicative investment.
  • Define product requirements for client data intake, data quality, model execution, explainability, visualization, and a cohesive client experience.
  • Define and monitor measures of product success, including usage, delivery time, client and broker feedback, commercial impact, delivery efficiency, and cost savings.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Expert understanding of product management principles.
  • Strong understanding of commercial insurance brokerage and client risk analytics, including CAT modelling, casualty loss modelling, cyber threat analysis, and benchmarking.
  • Ability to translate complex analytical, actuarial, and risk-modelling methods into intuitive and repeatable products for brokers and clients.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business leaders and align cross-functional specialists around a shared vision.
  • Technical fluency in modern data platforms, APIs, analytics workflows, visualization, statistics, data science, and AI concepts.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams. Strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to develop business cases, evaluate trade-offs, and make evidence-based investment decisions.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort with ambiguity.

Qualifications

·

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Actuarial Science, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. ·
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial insurance analytics, risk consulting, actuarial analytics, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience taking data, analytics, or technology products from concept through launch, adoption, measurement, and ongoing improvement.
  • Broad experience working across business and technical teams, including engineers, data scientists, actuaries, risk specialists, brokers, and sales teams.
  • Demonstrated leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives; people leadership experience is preferred.

What do we offer in return? A career that you define.

Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges. And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.


Diversity and Inclusion

At Howden we value diversity - there is no one Howden ‘personality type’. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
  • We support each other, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
  • We are determined to make a positive difference, at work and beyond

We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect – regardless.


of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, or family circumstances.

Our sustainability promise

We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact on the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.


Compensation and Benefits

The expected base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts

  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave

Life and Disability insurance

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

title: Transformation Lead – Candidate & Customer Journey
description:
Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Transformation Lead bepaal je wat onze candidate en customer journeys moeten worden, en je zorgt ervoor dat het ook gebeurt. Je geeft vorm aan de visie en de target state van beide journeys: waar we digitaliseren, waar we automatiseren, waar AI het voetwerk overneemt en waar onze consulenten het verschil maken. Je vertaalt die visie naar een heldere roadmap en stuwt die vooruit over business, IT, data en ons kantorennetwerk heen.

Tegenover de C-suite en de aandeelhouder ben je een scherpe, onafhankelijke stem. Je challenget prioriteiten, rapporteert eerlijk over de voortgang en kaart knelpunten aan voor ze problemen worden. Voor de teams denk je mee en ruim je blokkades uit de weg.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

    • Je kan een visie vormgeven en concreet maken. Je denkt in end-to-end journeys en target states, niet in losse projecten.
    • Je begrijpt hoe digitalisering, automatisering en AI een businessmodel en de processen kunnen veranderen, en je ziet waar ze echte waarde creëren, zowel voor kandidaten en klanten als voor onze kantoren.
    • Je challenget met zelfvertrouwen, ook op Clevel. Je kiest de juiste prioriteiten en krijgt stakeholders mee.
    • Je voelt je thuis in het rapporteren aan een leadership team en een PE-aandeelhouder, waar tempo, focus en aantoonbare vooruitgang tellen.
    • Je denkt strategisch en werkt hands-on: analyses, workshops en stakeholdergesprekken doe je zelf.
    • Je bent analytisch en hypothesegedreven, en je stelt de vraag achter de vraag.
    • Je wordt gedreven door impact en blijft nagaan of de prioriteiten dat ook weerspiegelen.
    • Je wordt deel van de teams, maar je rapporteert neutraal, ook wanneer het nieuws minder goed is.
    • Je stimuleert het ondernemerschap van onze mensen en kanaliseert het richting samenwerking en vooraf afgesproken resultaten.
    • Programmadiscipline (planning, RAID, opvolging van acties en beslissingen) is je tweede natuur. Het kost je weinig tijd, zodat je energie gaat naar waar het verschil gemaakt wordt.
    • Je spreekt Nederlands en Engels op professioneel niveau. Frans is een pluspunt.

De ideale collega is...

    • Minstens 3 jaar ervaring in top-tier strategieconsultancy: McKinsey, BCG, Bain of een vergelijkbaar strategiebureau.
    • Ervaring met digitale transformatie, customer experience of het hertekenen van operating models, van visie en target state tot implementatie.
    • Een bewezen trackrecord in transformatieprogramma’s die meerdere teams en systemen overspannen, met governance op managementniveau.
    • Ervaring in een ondernemende omgeving (een scale-up, een founder-led of PE-backed bedrijf, of je eigen onderneming) is een grote troef.
    • Ervaring in HR-dienstverlening, uitzendarbeid of een operationeel netwerkmodel is een pluspunt, geen vereiste.

title: Senior Technical Sales Architect, AI Infrastructure
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Intel is looking for a senior technologist who pairs deep silicon and systems knowledge with sound business judgment to lead AI infrastructure sales cycles in Asia Pacific and Japan. You will partner with cloud service providers and soverign AI model builders to design, benchmark and scale Intel-based AI infrastructure, from memory subsystem to the rack to the power budget, including agentic AI platforms. You are the technical lead in the deal, accountable for the architecture, the evidence and the outcome.

What You'll Do

  • Technical discovery: Lead architecture workshops with CTOs, platform and AI engineering teams, mapping workloads, SLAs, power and facility limits to business outcomes.
  • Architecture and design: Architect end-to-end AI infrastructure on Intel Xeon (AMX), Intel accelerators and memory (DDR5, MRDIMM, HBM, CXL), including disaggregated compute, memory and storage, prefill/decode separation, kv offload and rack-scale networking.
  • Rack to power to sustainability: Size racks, cooling (air and liquid), PUE and performance per watt, and build the TCO and carbon case for power-constrained data centers.
  • Benchmarks and PoCs: Design and lead reproducible benchmarks and PoCs (LLM serving, RAG, agentic workloads) with agreed acceptance criteria, measuring tokens per second, time to first token, cost per task and performance per watt against competing platforms.
  • Agentic transformation: Define reference architectures maximizing Intel goodness for agent platforms: CPU orchestration, long-context memory, sandboxes, tool and data connectors (MCP), vector databases, observability, security and data residency.
  • Pursuit leadership: Partner with account managers on proposals, SoWs, RFP/RFI responses and executive briefings, in Korean and English.
  • Ecosystem: Work with OEMs , SIs, memory vendors and software partners to deliver validated, supportable solutions.
  • Roadmap feedback: Turn field evidence into requirements for Intel product management and engineering.

Qualifications:

You must meet the qualifications below to be considered. Experience may come from degree, research, or prior roles and internships.


  • Education: Bachelor's in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 8+ years in customer-facing solutions architecture, technical sales or presales for data center compute, memory or AI infrastructure.
  • Platform depth: Server architecture (CPU, memory hierarchy, PCIe, CXL, networking, storage) and how it drives AI performance.
  • AI software: PyTorch and an LLM serving framework such as vLLM; the performance profile of inference and training; RAG and agent frameworks.
  • Infrastructure: Data center networking (Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand), containers and Kubernetes, rack power and cooling fundamentals.
  • Benchmarking: Proven record of running reproducible benchmarks and PoCs and defending the results to customer engineers.
  • Supply chain and ODM: Working knowledge of ODM and OEM design and manufacturing models, OCP-style rack integration, and how to work with Taiwan-based partners across time zones.
  • Communication: Ability to turn multi-node cluster designs into business outcomes for executives; business fluency in Korean and English.

Preferred Qualifications


  • These are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are a plus when identifying top candidates.
  • Track record with CSPs. CoSPs and their procurement structures.
  • Hands-on with Intel Xeon (AMX), Gaudi or Intel GPUs, or competing GPU platforms; OpenVINO and oneAPI.
  • Existing relationships with ODMs and system makersand experience taking ODM designs to enterprise or hyperscale buyers; .
  • Depth in disaggregation: CXL pooling and tiering, composable infrastructure, OCP racks, liquid cooling.
  • Large-scale inference economics: cost per million tokens, tokens per second per watt, fleet capacity planning.
  • Agentic AI: LangGraph or Semantic Kernel, MCP, vector databases, agent evaluation; has advised an enterprise agentic program.
  • Data center sustainability metrics: PUE, carbon intensity, power capping.
  • Influence over senior engineering and product leaders without direct authority; MBA or equivalent.

title: Sr. Product Designer- Interaction Design
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


DESIGN@LILLY | INTERACTION DESIGN


Sr. Product Designer- Interaction Design | 3-5 years

Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes.


As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build.


Path/Level:

R3


ABOUT THE ROLE
As an interaction Designer at Lilly, You will spend most of your time shaping how experiences look and feel, to crafting the interactions, nailing the visual execution, and getting it across the finish line with engineering and product.— owning visual quality, contributing to the design system, and setting the aesthetic standard across your product area.


At Lilly, that means your work has real stakes: the people on the other end of your screens are patients, caregivers, and the scientists trying to help them.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we will expect from you:

  • Elevate and maintain design standards through direct contribution across a wide range of outputs and mediums, from digital products to patient-facing experiences.
  • Bring attention to detail and a passion for all aspects of design including typography, motion, copy, composition and art direction.
  • Understand component-based design systems and know when to follow existing patterns and when to break constraints.
  • Present and persuasively communicate design rationale at all levels, incorporate feedback constructively, and build trust with collaborators across the organization.
  • Demonstrate accountability, flexibility, and initiative, with the ability to prioritize and deliver results efficiently.
  • Embrace a learning and growth mindset, stay current on industry trends and tools, and contribute positively to a culture of critique, collaboration, and honest reflection at Design@Lilly.
  • Identify the real design opportunity, and build alignment before execution begins.
  • Begin informally mentoring junior designers through critique and shared working sessions.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of experience in Interaction or visual design for digital products and experiences.
  • An exceptional portfolio of design work spanning multiple projects and mediums, with a focus on interface or screen-based experiences.
  • A degree in Design (Digital Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with a high level of intellectual curiosity and a passion for innovation in digital health.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable for a broad range of collaborators.
  • A collaborative spirit and the ability to build strong working relationships and navigate conflict constructively with peers and partners.
  • Deep understanding of foundational design principles with excellent command of type, grid, composition, and color.
