The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

MuleSoft's Customer Support team is looking for talented individuals with a passion for researching complex technologies and a track record of high customer satisfaction to help our team drive customer success with MuleSoft products. We maintain an extremely high level of satisfaction across our customer base, and we take great pride in our operational efficiency and the strength of the solutions we provide to our customers.

As a member of the Support team, you will leverage advanced technical expertise to resolve complex platform-related issues affecting customers. As a Senior Technical Support Engineer expert, you will enable customer success by helping our customers to overcome crippling technical challenges. You will provide hands-on troubleshooting, feature explanation, and best practice guidance to the broader Technical Support team to assist customers during critical and time-sensitive situations while partnering with development teams.

You'll find yourself researching new technologies every day, including Web Services, HTTP, JMS, JEE application servers, and many types of Enterprise Software. This role will give you an opportunity to build expertise and fast-track your career toward customer-facing technical roles, and your successes will have an impact across the company.

Work Hours: The candidate primarily needs to work US East or US Central shift. However, we are a 24x7 Support Hub, the candidate hence needs to be ready to work any shift based on business requirements.

Note: this role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in-office a minimum of three (3) days per week.


Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Take ownership of customer issues through to resolution - including troubleshooting, internal communication, and providing meaningful feedback on a regular basis to assist with troubleshooting integrations involving third-party APIs and implementation of other products.
  • Liaise and work closely with the internal teams on escalated technical issues and product roadmap changes/new features.
  • Provide feature explanation and implementation best practices.
  • Create knowledge base materials dedicated to operational efficiency while empowering and enabling the developer community.
  • Respond promptly and effectively to technical support requests from clients regarding integration API-related issues.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, offering timely and accurate solutions to ensure minimal disruption to clients' operations.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers and operations, to resolve complex integration challenges.
  • Document and track support cases, solutions, and interactions in our support systems to maintain accurate records.
  • Escalate critical issues to development teams when necessary, ensuring timely resolution.



Minimum Requirements

  • Must be a US citizen on US soil and not a citizen of another country (dual citizen).
  • Must be able to obtain authorization to work on US government support cases
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of REST and SOAP web-based services, with a working knowledge of WSDL interpretation, generation, and consumption.
  • Experience troubleshooting Internet technologies: HTTP, firewalls, web servers, proxy servers, etc.
  • In-depth knowledge of database concepts and data management (RDBMS) and SQL.
  • Proven analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to effectively prioritize and escalate customer issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications

  • MuleSoft Certifications (MCD 1, MCD 2) are a plus
  • Knowledge and troubleshooting experience with at least one programming language, such as Java, .NET, or PHP, and analyzing thread dumps and heap dumps as an added advantage.
  • Use of AI Tools for troubleshooting, problem discovery, and automation
  • Must have experience in Java development and concepts, including debugging against Java APIs, providing technical solutions, examining thread dumps and threading issues, and hosting services using JEE and/or JSE framework
  • Experience with JEE Application Servers and Containers (administration, deployment, and/or development in Tomcat, JBoss, WebSphere, Spring, etc.)
  • Deep knowledge of Internet technologies and protocols such as HTTP and FTP
  • Experience with SOAP, REST, Webservices, Tomcat, XML, JMS, WS, and SOA/Integration technologies
  • Integration product support is preferred. Other integration vendors include IBM, BEA, Oracle, Tibco, etc. Knowledge of Open Source business and/or past contributions to open-source projects is also favorable.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: CCE of Albany County Youth & Families Team Leader – Voorheesville, NY
description:
The Team Leader provides leadership and oversight for CCE of Albany County’s youth and families programs, with a primary focus on guiding staff, planning and managing programs, and building strong community partnerships. The role also contributes to program delivery, evaluation, grant development, and securing resources to support innovative, relevant, and impactful opportunities for youth and families.

Working independently with limited supervision, the Team Leader helps shape program direction, influence organizational decisions, and strengthens community connections to advance the mission and impact of CCE of Albany County.

This is an on-site position based in Voorheesville, NY.

We firmly believe in work-life balance and provide generous paid time off. This position is full-time. Compensation is paid at the rate of $70,000 annually and includes 21 Vacation days, 14 Holidays, 3 Personal days and 12 Sick days annually. Mileage for work related travel is reimbursed. title: PR&D – Senior Scientific Systems & Integration Engineer, PR&D/CMC
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


PR&D – Senior Scientific Systems & Integration Engineer, PR&D/CMC

Product Research & Development (PR&D) · CTI-MD Tech@Lilly

Product Research & Development (PR&D) owns the CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) data that underpins every regulatory submission, batch investigation, and process decision across Lilly's development portfolio. That data is created and held in lab and plant systems: LIMS, ELN, chromatography and instrument software, lab-data platforms, MES, DMS, and related tools, operating under strict GxP, data integrity, and audit-readiness requirements. The Senior Scientific Systems & Integration Engineer, PR&D/CMC, implements, configures, and integrates those systems and owns the workflow automation that connects them across PR&D labs. The primary expertise for this role is PR&D and CMC process and tools knowledge, delivery in a GxP environment, and hands-on LIMS platform implementation and integration. The secondary expertise is agentic AI: building the MCP tools, agent hooks, and evaluation sets that let PR&D's agents act on these systems safely. The role is hands-on and implementation-heavy, and matures into a systems architect who owns the connected lab-to-plant landscape. This role ensures integrations, workflow configurations, and tool definitions are built once as PR&D-owned, reusable assets that every later lab domain and agent use case builds on.

Path/Level: R4/R5 (Senior Principal Engineer), individual contributor.

Key Responsibilities

  • LIMS Implementation & Configuration — implement and configure LIMS and scientific workflow platforms for PR&D and CMC use: sample lifecycle, test execution, specifications, review and release, investigations, and stability, to GxP standards.
  • Lab & Plant Integration Ownership — own integrations between lab systems (LIMS, ELN, chromatography data systems, instruments, instrument middleware, lab-data platforms) and plant-side systems (MES, historians, QMS, DMS), including interface design, error handling, and support.
  • Instrument & Lab-Data Platform Integration — build and maintain instrument connectivity and data flows into lab-data platforms such as TetraScience, including ingestion, data harmonization, and use of connectivity standards (for example Allotrope, SiLA, OPC UA) where applicable.
  • Scientific Workflow Automation — design and automate cross-system scientific workflows, replacing manual hand-offs and re-keying with governed, auditable flows.
  • PR&D/CMC Data Mapping — with the Systems Architect and knowledge graph engineers, map LIMS, ELN, and lab-data entities (samples, batches, specifications, process parameters, investigations) to the Semantic Layer, keeping source semantics intact.
  • Agentic Enablement — build MCP tools and workflow hooks so agents can read from and act on LIMS and lab systems within defined permissions, support agent-to-agent hand-offs with the knowledge agents, and assemble evaluation sets from real lab and CMC questions.
  • GxP Validation & Compliance — deliver to GAMP 5-aligned validation expectations; produce requirements traceability, test evidence, and change-control documentation; and ensure data integrity (ALCOA+), audit trails, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliance across implementations and integrations.
  • Cross-Lab Scope — deliver across PR&D labs, aligning configurations and integration patterns so the same capability does not get rebuilt per lab or system.
  • Vendor & Partner Delivery Governance — direct and technically review partner and vendor work on instrument integration and platform configuration, holding partners to PR&D-owned standards and designs.
  • Reusable Integration Patterns — establish reference integrations, workflow templates, and configuration standards that accelerate delivery for later lab and plant domains.
  • Stakeholder Partnership & Mentorship — work directly with scientists, QA, and lab and plant system owners to shape requirements and priorities; mentor engineers on LIMS, integration, and GxP delivery practice.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas

LIMS Implementation & Configuration · ELN Integration · Chromatography Data Systems & Instrument Integration · Instrument Middleware · Lab-Data Platforms (TetraScience or equivalent) · Connectivity Standards (Allotrope, SiLA 2, OPC UA, MQTT) · MES, Historian, QMS & DMS Integration · API & Integration Architecture (REST, middleware, event-driven) · Scientific Workflow Automation · PR&D/CMC Process Knowledge (batch records, process parameters, QC and stability data) · GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+ · Computer System Validation · Data Mapping to Ontologies & Semantic Layer · Agentic AI & MCP · Agent Evaluation Basics · Python · SQL · Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS) · Vendor & Delivery Governance · Stakeholder Management

Basic Qualifications

  • Proven track record implementing and integrating LIMS or equivalent scientific workflow platforms in a GxP-regulated environment, building and configuring them rather than overseeing a vendor.
  • Working knowledge of PR&D or CMC processes and the tools around them (LIMS, ELN, chromatography and instrument software, lab-data platforms, MES, DMS).
  • Hands-on experience integrating lab systems with each other and with plant-side systems through APIs, middleware, or lab-data platforms.
  • Experience delivering to GxP, data integrity, and computer system validation expectations.
  • Working agentic capability: tool calling, MCP or an equivalent interface, and human-in-the-loop design, with an eye on safe action against validated systems.
  • Python and SQL skills sufficient to build against LIMS and enterprise interfaces.
  • Experience partnering with scientists, QA, and system owners to shape technical priorities.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies

  • Direct experience with a TetraScience-type lab-data platform.
  • Experience with MES, DMS, or ELN integrations and document-to-schema conversion.
  • Familiarity with ontologies or knowledge graphs as a source of agent grounding.
  • Experience directing partner or vendor delivery on instrument integration.
  • Experience designing agent-to-agent communication or multi-agent patterns beyond single tool calls.
  • Comfortable presenting technical strategy and trade-offs to senior, non-technical stakeholders.
  • Background in pharma and GxP-regulated environments.

Required Leadership Capabilities

  • Goes deep technically on lab and plant systems while translating integration trade-offs into business-relevant narratives.
  • Owns and defends an integration and configuration roadmap in front of scientists and business audiences.
  • Provides day-to-day technical guidance and mentorship without requiring a formal people-manager structure.
  • Systems thinking that connects lab and plant system design to downstream agentic workflows and business outcomes.

title: Electrical Construction Senior Project Manager
description:
Whether you’re a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

Why Rosendin?


Committed. Connected. Engaged.

If you’re looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity and inspires everyone to do their best. Rosendin is the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractor in the United States employing upwards of 8,000 people. Established in 1919, we remain proud of our more than 100 years of building quality electrical and communications installations and value for our clients but, most importantly, for building people within our company and our communities. As an employee-owner you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.


YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:

Join our team as a Senior Project Manager where you will be responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome for several small to medium projects or one very large project. You will lead and manage a team of project managers, and assistant project managers to deliver exceptional results for our clients. The position proactively develops new business opportunities and relationships with current and potential customers.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Establish project objectives, policies, procedures and performance standards within boundaries of corporate policies. Put these in clear concise work statement for the field.
  • Effectively supervise a staff in the day to day administration of a job or supervise two or more Project Managers in their daily tasks.
  • Train and effectively supervise Project Managers in the company philosophy and systems
  • Negotiate and supervise the preparation of all change orders on the project
  • Maintain all logs required to track the progress of the project.
  • Train and effectively supervise a Project Assistant in the maintenance of project required tracking devices.
  • Maintain liaison with prime client and A/E to facilitate construction activities.
  • Monitor construction activities in conjunction with the onsite Foreman and Area Superintendent to ensure project is being built on schedule, and within budgets
  • Investigate any potentially serious situations and implement corrective measures within company guidelines, and under supervision
  • Represent company/project in meetings with client, subcontractors, etc.
  • Prepare monthly costing reports
  • Manage financial aspects of contracts (progress billing, rental equipment, income/expenses) to protect the company’s interest and simultaneously maintain good relationship with the client
  • The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the role within the business unit.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

  • Experience managing electrical construction projects – after all, that is what we do!
  • Project accountability and initiative for all aspects of the project and its success.
  • Ability to creatively solve problems. You’ve been in the trenches before. You know what it takes to get the job done and done right for your customer and the company.
  • A strong knowledge of electrical systems, construction, and how these systems work.
  • A fanatical determination about planning, innovating, and improving the processes we use every day.
  • Ability to think outside the box and lead the team in driving innovative construction techniques and prefabrication strategies.
  • Possess strong leadership skills, business acumen, and integrity.
  • A strong understanding of the financials of a project and how to forecast.
  • Ability to create and foster great relationships with the field and understand what it takes to get the best out of your people.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders to achieve mutual outcomes.
  • We are counting on you to bring and foster a collaborative spirit to our work process.

WHAT YOU BRING TO US:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or other related discipline preferred.
  • PE license a plus
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in project management, preferably in electrical construction. Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment and methods required.
  • Can be a combination of education, training and relevant experience
  • Proven experience mentoring and managing others.
  • Business development/heavy client interaction a plus.
  • Ability to understand and follow standard operating policies and procedures;
  • Ability to perform duties in a professional manner and appearance
  • Extensive knowledge of safety protocols and procedure
  • Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); Oracle and Accubid preferred
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary
  • Ability to work under time pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude
  • Effective oral and written communication skills as required for the position
  • Ability to be self-motivated, proactive and an effective team player
  • Ability to interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others

TRAVEL:

  • Up to 100%

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • General work environment – Due to the variety of work to be performed, the Sr. Project Manager may be working at a job site or in the office. This position is performed primarily on active construction sites. Activity includes sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.
  • Noise level is usually low to medium; can be loud on a job site.
  • Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.

title: Full stack Java Developer
description:
Developers hebben dit softwarebedrijf opgericht. Dat merk je meteen. Wie hier beslist over architectuur, schrijft zelf ook code. Het Java-team draait op Spring en heeft sterke tech leads die hun kennis echt doorgeven.

Je werkt niet alleen. Op klantprojecten zit je meestal in duo met een tech lead. Zo leer je sneller dan in je eentje.

Je ontwerpt en bouwt full stack applicaties in Java en Spring, van architectuur tot oplevering. Bij de klant denk je mee over technische keuzes. Je zegt het ook als iets beter kan. Projecten lopen meestal 2 à 3 jaar. Je krijgt dus de tijd om iets degelijks neer te zetten.

Een gemiddelde week ziet er zo uit:

  • 60% programmeren
  • 15% analyse
  • 15% onderzoek naar nieuwe technologie
  • 10% meetings

Af en toe doe je expertisewerk, zoals een code-audit of een training. Je deelt intern wat je leert. Je groeipad stippel je samen met het bedrijf uit.

  • Je hebt een aantal jaar ervaring als developer, liefst 5 jaar of meer.
  • Je bent sterk in Java en Spring en je werkt full stack.
  • Je werkt pragmatisch. Goede code vind je belangrijk, maar je bouwt geen kathedraal als een schuur volstaat.
  • Je staat open voor feedback en wilt blijven bijleren.
  • Je werkt graag bij verschillende klanten, telkens voor langere tijd.

Heb je 5 jaar ervaring en wil je groeien, maar vink je nog niet elk punt aan? Solliciteer toch.

MUFG, one of the world’s top five banks with a rich heritage spanning over 360 years and a global presence in 50 markets, is seeking a Director VAT Lead to join their Finance Division in London. This pivotal role offers you the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of VAT operations across EMEA, ensuring robust compliance and governance while providing value-adding support to high-profile business stakeholders. As part of MUFG’s vision to become the world’s most trusted financial group, you will be empowered to lead a dedicated team, drive continuous improvement, and foster strong relationships both internally and externally. With access to flexible working arrangements, generous pension contributions, and ongoing training opportunities, this position promises stability, growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact within an inclusive and supportive environment.

  • Join MUFG’s Finance Division in London as Director VAT Lead and play a key role in shaping VAT strategy for one of the world’s largest financial institutions.
  • Benefit from flexible working opportunities, generous pension contributions, and comprehensive training programmes designed to support your professional development.
  • Lead a collaborative team environment where your expertise in VAT compliance and advisory will directly influence business decisions and stakeholder relationships across EMEA.

What you'll do:

As Director VAT Lead at MUFG, you will be entrusted with steering the strategic direction of the VAT function across EMEA. Your day-to-day activities will involve setting priorities for resource allocation, developing robust governance frameworks, and optimising data models that underpin effective compliance. You will provide guidance and mentorship to your team members, encouraging collaboration and knowledge sharing. By working closely with internal stakeholders, you will drive enhancements in data quality and facilitate seamless transitions to new technology solutions for VAT return preparation. Additionally, you will lead technical responses related to e-invoicing requirements while balancing responsibilities between MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities EMEA plc. Success in this role hinges on your ability to build trust through dependable oversight, maintain rigorous compliance standards, and foster an inclusive team culture that values interpersonal connections.

  • Set strategic priorities for the VAT function including resourcing, governance framework, and data model to ensure alignment with organisational objectives.
  • Provide supportive leadership to VAT team members by nurturing their development and fostering a collaborative approach to problem-solving.
  • Ensure all VAT compliance obligations are managed within a strong governance and control environment, including assessment of Partial Exemption Special Method.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to enhance VAT data quality and oversee the transition to new VAT return preparation tools.
  • Offer value-adding VAT advisory support to business stakeholders by translating complex technical concepts into actionable insights.
  • Brief senior management on key VAT issues, ensuring they are well-informed about regulatory changes and operational impacts.
  • Manage relationships with HMRC and external advisors by maintaining open communication channels and addressing queries promptly.
  • Identify and respond proactively to relevant changes in VAT law or case law that may affect business operations.
  • Lead the technical response to E-invoicing requirements by coordinating cross-functional teams and implementing best practices.
  • Maintain entity-neutral responsibilities for both MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities EMEA plc, ensuring legal integrity and regulatory compliance.

What you bring:

To excel as Director VAT Lead at MUFG, your proven experience should encompass deep knowledge of UK/EU VAT legislation coupled with hands-on expertise in financial services sector compliance. Your ability to deliver clear advice on partial exemption methods will be invaluable when supporting business units through regulatory complexities. You should bring strong analytical capabilities that allow you to interpret intricate data flows while presenting actionable insights tailored for diverse audiences. Your communication skills, both written and verbal, will empower you to prepare compelling management materials that inform decision-makers at every level. Organisational acumen is crucial for managing competing priorities under tight deadlines; meanwhile, your stakeholder management abilities will foster trustful relationships throughout the company.

  • Expertise in UK and EU VAT legislation as well as relevant case law is essential for navigating complex regulatory environments.
  • Experience in VAT compliance and reporting within financial services is required for managing partial exemption methods effectively.
  • Proven track record of providing insightful VAT advice that supports business decision-making processes.
  • Familiarity with communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders enhances cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong analytical skills enable you to interpret data accurately and present findings in high-quality management materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are vital for preparing reports and engaging senior management confidently.
  • Organisational prowess allows you to juggle multiple priorities while meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Effective stakeholder management skills help you build trust across all levels of the organisation.

What sets this company apart:

MUFG stands out as a global leader not only because of its impressive scale, over 180,000 employees across 50 markets but also due to its unwavering commitment to trustworthiness, stability, and employee wellbeing. title: Silicon Metal R&D Metallurgist / Engineer
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

About this role


Dow has an exciting opportunity for a Silicon Metal R&D Metallurgist / Engineer located in Midland, MI or Carrollton, KY.


Position Summary

  • The role is responsible for leading research, technology development, and innovation initiatives that support the long-term growth, competitiveness, and sustainability of silicon metal manufacturing and utilization in downstream silicone monomer production. This role combines expertise in chemical engineering, metallurgy, thermodynamics, and high-temperature process technology to develop new knowledge, improve production technologies, enhance product performance, and identify future process opportunities.
  • The position serves as a critical technical bridge between R&D, manufacturing, commercial, and engineering organizations. While the primary focus is technology development and scientific advancement, the role also provides technical consultation and support for plant operations, process optimization, and Reliability and Continuous Improvement (R&CI) initiatives. The successful candidate will develop and maintain recognized Subject Matter Expert (SME) status in key areas of silicon metal production, carbothermic reduction chemistry, submerged arc furnace operations, raw materials, process modeling, and product applications.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead research programs focused on silicon metal production, process innovation, energy efficiency, decarbonization, and product quality enhancement.
  • Design, execute, and interpret laboratory, pilot-scale, and plant-scale experiments.
  • Develop fundamental knowledge in carbothermic reduction chemistry, reaction kinetics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and mass transfer.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for competitive advantage.
  • Develop deep technical expertise and become a recognized SME in critical silicon metal technologies.
  • Author technical reports, patents, white papers, and technology standards.
  • Provide technical consultation to manufacturing sites, supporting troubleshooting and process optimization.
  • Support R&CI initiatives through data analysis, root cause investigations, and technology-driven improvements.
  • Participate in plant trials and technology implementation projects.
  • Develop process simulations and predictive process tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degree (MS or PhD) preferred.
  • Must possess a TWIC card or be eligible to obtain a TWIC card. For information on TWIC eligibility requirements, please see: (If unable to access link, copy and paste in your browser.)
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in silicon metal production, extractive metallurgy, pyrometallurgy, chemical process technology, or related industries. 10 or more years preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical projects, research programs, or process development initiatives.
  • A minimum requirement for this U.S. based position is the ability to work legally in the United States. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process.

Technical Competencies


  • Silicon metal production and furnace technology
  • Extractive metallurgy and pyrometallurgy
  • Chemical reaction engineering
  • Thermodynamics and process kinetics
  • Raw material characterization and slag chemistry
  • Statistical analysis and experimental design
  • Process modeling and simulation
  • Technology commercialization and scale-up

Leadership Competencies


  • Scientific curiosity and passion for innovation.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to influence through technical credibility.
  • Effective collaboration across R&D, manufacturing, engineering, and commercial functions.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and SME development.
  • Ability to communicate to a diverse global team.

Success Measures


  • Development and implementation of new technologies.
  • Creation of proprietary knowledge, patents, and intellectual property.
  • Recognition as an SME in key technology areas.
  • Successful support of manufacturing optimization and R&CI initiatives.
  • Improvement in silicon recovery, energy efficiency, and product quality.

Your Skills

  • Metallurgy: The science and engineering of metals, including their physical and chemical behavior and the processes used to produce and improve metallic materials.
  • Chemical Engineering: The application of chemistry, physics, mathematics, and engineering principles to design, develop, and improve chemical and manufacturing processes.
  • Design of Experiments (DOE): A structured method for planning and conducting experiments to determine how process variables affect performance, quality, and outcomes.
  • Process Simulation: The use of mathematical models and simulation tools to analyze, predict, design, and optimize chemical and manufacturing processes.
  • Statistical Analysis: The collection, interpretation, and analysis of data to identify trends, relationships, and variability that support technical problem-solving and decision-making.

Note: This position does not offer relocation assistance.

Benefits – What Dow offers you

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

  • Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
  • Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
  • Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.
    • Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
  • Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
    • Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
  • Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
  • Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
  • Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
  • Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
  • Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

title: Engineer - Project Manager - GFD
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.



Job Description

The Global Facilities Delivery (GFD) Organization delivers new and renovated capital assets around the world. Our mission is accomplished through a highly leveraged organization of design, construction, and qualification contractors. Many of the assets delivered focus on medical innovation and delivering innovative solutions to patients. Some of the assets delivered will expand the supply of existing medicines or strengthen the supply chain.


Key Objectives/Deliverables:

  • Project Management: Lead teams to deliver large programs of at least $50M USD or more in capital assets and/or support a workstream or node of a larger program of $200M or more in capital assets. These teams will consist of both Lilly and Non-Lilly professionals to safely achieve project objectives from front-end planning (conceptual design) in a Brownfield or Greenfield site through operational qualification (cradle to grave). Project objectives are defined as delivering asset capability or capacity with safety, cost, schedule, and quality assurance.
  • Interface/Communication: Ability to work from a regional distance from corporate headquarters while developing and maintaining effective communication with GFD program leadership, the project team, governance teams, business partners, and other stakeholders. Facilitate issue resolution, anticipate scope changes, and implement safely with quality, speed, and value.
  • Compliance: Lead/influence with a disciplined, structured approach to project management based on compliance with Company Policies and Procedures.\
  • Safety/Environment: Develop and maintain safety and environmental execution plans for projects. Ensure compliance with safety and environmental policies, procedures, and work rules for project personnel, contractors, and subcontractors from conceptual design through operational verification.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science – Engineering field or related to project management
  • Minimum of 5+ years of previous experience in capital project delivery in industrial or manufacturing facilities.
  • Willingness to relocate and/or travel to locations outside of home state/country.
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Preferences:

  • Project Size: Previous experience on projects or multiple projects of >$10M.
  • Previous experience managing greenfield projects.
  • Pharma manufacturing experience.
  • Capital Project Management Experience in Pharma manufacturing facilities, such as: Bulk API, sterile products, secondary packaging, Devices and to a lesser extent lab projects.
  • Experience in the following areas: GMP manufacturing, LEAN, Automation, construction, construction quality, project controls, the engineering disciplines, safety, scheduling
  • The capacity to achieve results and influence through people is critical.
  • Demonstrated ability to work from long distances with little supervision.
  • Must exhibit a good sense of judgment in decision making, without the need for management approval while at the same time keeping management informed and engaged on critical issues.
  • Effective communication skills both written and verbal.
  • Ability to influence personnel and organizations without having direct administrative responsibility for them
  • Competency in a foreign language(s).
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent technical certification.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience in working and/or living outside the U.S.
  • Demonstrated willingness to embrace the concept of continuous improvement and be an agent for change.

Additional Information:

  • Travel is required and will vary by project.
  • Full relocation to one of the posting locations listed on this requisition is required for the duration of the project. Throughout the hiring process, you may share preferences and further detail about your mobility with the hiring team.
  • This is an onsite role; onsite presence is required (this is NOT a remote role).
  • Multiple job levels can be hired on this posting, and business title will vary based on job title (i.e. Engineer/Sr. Engineer/Principal Engineer/Sr Principal Engineer – Project Manager – GFD).

title: Senior Contracts Specialist
description:
The Opportunity

At APA, our purpose is to secure Australia’s energy future. We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it with our customers and communities as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.

We have an exciting opportunity available for a Senior Contracts Specialist to join us in our Contracts and Supplier Strategy team. This team leads the development and delivery of the contracting strategies that underpin the successful delivery of APA’s major infrastructure and growth projects.

Reporting to the Senior Commercial Manager and allocated to major projects in a matrix organisational structure, you will play a key role in leading the implementation of contracting strategies and ensuring the effective formation, negotiation, and administration of major project agreements that enable balanced, delivery-focused outcomes across APA’s project portfolio.

While Brisbane is the preferred location, we are also open to considering candidates based in Melbourne or Sydney.

About the Team

Contracts and Supplier Strategy builds strong internal and external relationships to devise sustainable contracting arrangements that enable APA to be the partner of choice in delivering infrastructure solutions for the energy transition.

We support the delivery of energy infrastructure projects across Australia by providing expert commercial and contract services across gas transmission and storage, gas powered generation, and power.

It is an exciting time to join the team as we provide a core capability in the delivery of APA’s portfolio growth and asset transformation. We need people who are courageous, nimble, and ready to make an impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation of downstream commercial and contracting strategies across major infrastructure projects, from early stage procurement through to contract close out, including tendering, contract formation, negotiation and execution.
  • Evaluate supply chain pricing, inclusions and exclusions, qualifications and contract departures, identifying potential commercial and delivery risks early.
  • Partner with Project Managers to administer project contracts, ensuring commercial intent, risk allocation, contractual rights and obligations are effectively managed throughout delivery.
  • Manage contract changes, payment claims and variations, including detailed cost analysis, risk mitigation and maintaining accurate contract records and correspondence.
  • Provide strategic commercial guidance to project teams and resolve contract claims through clear analysis, dialogue, correspondence and supporting evidence.
  • Support the development of team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of APA’s contracts management framework.

Your background

  • You bring strong experience and commercial acumen in contracts, commercial management or procurement within infrastructure and construction.
  • You have experience administering complex contracts in a real delivery context with a proven track record for successful project delivery.
  • You come with demonstrated experience in contract development including commercial/contracting strategy development and tendering.
  • Proven track record administering high-value, complex contracts with confidence and credibility.
  • Highly developed stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively across project teams.
  • Experience across various contract forms, (NEC4 experience beneficial), or in the construction of power generation assets, including renewables or GPG, will be highly regarded.

Working at APA

At APA, we’re committed to fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where you can achieve your best.

We offer targeted career development programs designed to accelerate your career, competitive remuneration, employee benefits, flexible working arrangements, and wellbeing initiatives are all part of what we’ll offer you. Our inclusive parental leave policy offers 18 weeks of leave, including superannuation, to support parents at work and in life.

We employ around 2,000 people across Australia and are committed to building a high-performing, customer-focused organisation where everyone feels safe, valued, and trusted to perform at their best.

We are APA

At APA, we’re taking on one of Australia’s greatest challenges:​ the energy transition.​ We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.​

​

We proudly own, operate and manage a diverse $20 billion portfolio of assets which deliver essential services to communities and customers across Australia. And we own more than 15,000 kilometres of gas pipelines which deliver energy to households and businesses across every corner of Australia.

As the partner of choice in delivering infrastructure solutions for the energy transition, we’re focused on bundled remote grid energy solutions, electricity and gas transmission, and future energy, including hydrogen and carbon capture and storage.

Our customer focused approach means we understand our customers and offer them reliable, innovative, and cost-effective energy solutions that support their decarbonisation ambitions.

We are committed to securing Australia’s energy future by delivering infrastructure solutions for Australia’s energy transition and supporting the decarbonisation ambitions of our customers and communities.

Join our team and be part of securing Australia’s energy future. We’d love to hear from you.

APA is an equal opportunity employer. The safety, health and wellbeing our people, community and environment a priority. We embrace diversity in our people to ensure our workforce is representative of the communities that we operate in.


Applicants must be eligible to work in Australia to be considered.

This vacancy works with critical APA data, systems or infrastructure and candidates are subject to background vetting (including Police checks) before & during employment.

title: Temporary Research Assistant (Part Time)
description:

Belknap Campus

Position Description:

The Temporary Research Assistant in the College of Education will support research, development, and professional development initiatives at the Kentucky Reading Research Center (KRRC), with an emphasis on emergent literacy and young children's reading and writing development. This position will assist with the development and testing of teacher observation systems, contribute to research publications, and support the identification and development of external funding opportunities. The Temporary Research Assistant will also collaborate with researchers, educators, and community partners to develop evidence-based professional development resources and instructional practices that promote early literacy development among preschool-aged children. The position requires strong research, analytical, organizational, and communication skills, as well as the ability to contribute to multiple research and programmatic activities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Research and Development of Teacher Observation Systems

  • Assist with testing and establishing the reliability of a storybook observation system.
  • Collaborate with research team members to develop and co-author one to two research publications related to teacher observation systems and emergent literacy.
  • Support the development and refinement of an observation system to assess teacher practices that promote young children's writing development.

2. Grant Development and Funding Support

  • Identify and research potential funding opportunities that align with the Center's research priorities and ongoing study designs.
  • Contribute to the development of grant proposals, including supporting documentation, research descriptions, and other required materials.
  • Assist with efforts to secure external funding to support continued research and program activities.

3. Professional Development and Instructional Support

  • Support the development of professional development opportunities for preschool teachers focused on evidence-based instructional practices.
  • Assist in developing resources and materials that promote young children's emergent reading and writing development.
  • Collaborate with researchers and education partners to translate research findings into practical strategies that support early literacy instruction.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Education, Early Childhood Education, Literacy, Educational Psychology, Research Methods, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting or conducting research related to emergent literacy, early childhood education, or early reading development.
  • Familiarity with foundational literacy skills, including phonological awareness, alphabet knowledge, print concepts, oral language, and phonics.
  • Experience administering, scoring, or interpreting early literacy assessments and screening instruments.
  • Experience collecting, managing, analyzing, and reporting quantitative and/or qualitative research data.
  • Familiarity with research methodologies, program evaluation, and evidence-based educational practices.
  • Experience working with preschool and elementary-aged children, educators, school districts, or early childhood education programs.
  • Familiarity with Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements, research ethics, informed consent, and research protocols.
  • Experience using statistical analysis software (e.g., SPSS, SAS, or R) or qualitative data analysis tools.
  • Experience preparing research reports, literature reviews, presentations, and other scholarly or technical documents.
  • Experience coordinating research activities, managing project timelines, and collaborating with multidisciplinary research teams.

Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with researchers, educators, and community partners.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary research teams and manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Research and analytical skills.
  • Knowledge of emergent literacy development.
  • Data management and analysis.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Collaboration and relationship building.
  • Organization and project coordination.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving.

Compensation will be commensurate to candidate experience.

A General Manager must be committed to inspiring our team, as well as helping our Customers succeed and growing our business with integrity. Position is exempt and requires a minimum of 50-55 hours per week (excluding meal break periods). The average schedule is 5-6 days a week, 11 hour shifts, including rotating nights and weekends, with an hour for lunch. Additional hours may be required based on staffing, store conditions, sales to target, and other business demands. General Managers are required to work a schedule based on the needs of the business.

Primary Responsibilities

Must have a valid driver's license

ASE certification preferred, but not required

The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. title: Devops Engineer
description:
About NCR Atleos

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

Role Summary

The DevOps Engineer designs, builds, automates, and operates secure deployment platforms for Azure and AKS-based workloads while applying an AI-first engineering mindset. This role combines hands-on DevOps engineering, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and DevSecOps with practical AI skills that improve delivery velocity, operational quality, reliability, and developer experience. The engineer is expected to build and improve AI-assisted engineering workflows, not only use AI tools casually.

Key Responsibilities

· Design and implement AKS-based deployment strategies using Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitHub Workflows, GitOps, and secure release practices.

· Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for Java and .NET applications with automated quality gates, artifact promotion, rollback, recovery, and release governance.

· Use Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and AI-assisted DevOps workflows to accelerate pipeline development, IaC authoring, troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and operational analysis.

· Create AI-enabled DevOps automations where appropriate, such as pipeline diagnostics, log summarization, runbook assistance, incident pattern analysis, configuration validation, or developer self-service accelerators.

· Automate deployment and management of Azure services including AKS, App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, monitoring components, identity integrations, and platform services.

· Implement GitOps workflows using Flux or ArgoCD to ensure declarative, auditable, repeatable, and scalable deployments.

· Apply DevSecOps and AppSecOps practices across pipelines, IaC, secrets, container images, policy validation, vulnerability management, and compliance evidence.

· Configure and operate observability solutions covering metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, SLOs, and actionable incident response workflows.

· Troubleshoot AKS clusters, pipeline failures, deployment issues, runtime incidents, networking dependencies, and distributed system performance issues using structured debugging and AI-assisted root cause analysis.

· Collaborate with development, architecture, security, operations, and platform teams to simplify deployment workflows, improve developer experience, increase automation, and reduce operational toil.

· Support ITSM processes and SOC audit requirements by improving evidence collection, runbook quality, change traceability, and operational controls.

· Train and enable team members on modern DevOps, AKS operations, GitOps, automation-first practices, and responsible use of Copilot/AI tools.

Required Skills and Qualifications

· 5+ years of DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or software engineering experience.

· Strong hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), container orchestration, Helm/Kustomize patterns, deployment strategies, and production operations.

· Expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform; ability to design reusable modules, review IaC quality, and automate environment provisioning.

· Proficiency with GitHub Actions, GitHub Workflows, CI/CD design, branching/release strategies, artifact promotion, rollback, and recovery patterns.

· Hands-on experience deploying Azure services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and supporting Azure platform components.

· Experience building and deploying Java and .NET applications in cloud-native environments.

· Practical experience with GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD.

· Solid understanding of DevSecOps, AppSecOps, secure deployment patterns, compliance controls, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation workflows.

· Experience implementing observability and monitoring for cloud-native platforms using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts.

· Strong troubleshooting skills for complex distributed systems and production environments.

· Strong communication and documentation skills with a bias toward automation, reliability, continuous improvement, and developer experience.

· Experience working in regulated enterprise environments with SOC, ITSM, change management, evidence collection, and audit controls.

AI Skills Expectations

· Can provide concrete examples of AI-enabled engineering workflows personally built or improved, such as automations, runbooks, pipeline helpers, incident analysis tools, code review assistants, test generation, or operational copilots.

· Uses GitHub Copilot/Microsoft Copilot effectively but can also explain how outputs are tested, reviewed, secured, and operationalized.

· Understands context engineering concepts such as RAG/retrieval, embeddings, vector stores, chunking, grounding, system prompts, and how these can support DevOps knowledge bases, runbooks, or incident workflows.

· Uses advanced prompting and structured-output techniques such as few-shot examples, JSON outputs, prompt chaining, guardrails, and evaluation against test cases.

· Understands AI agents and tool-use patterns, including agent loops, tool calling, MCP/A2A concepts, and how agents can safely interact with APIs, logs, ticketing systems, CI/CD systems, and operational tools.

· Can reason about model selection for DevOps use cases based on cost, latency, quality, privacy, context window, and reliability needs.

· Knows how to evaluate AI-enabled automation quality using test sets, ground truth examples, human review, hallucination controls, auditability, monitoring, and rollback/kill-switch approaches.

· Demonstrates judgment on when not to use an LLM, especially for deterministic deployment logic, high-risk production actions without approvals, secrets/private data, or low-latency tasks better solved with scripts/rules.

· Experience with Azure OpenAI or AI-enabled operational tooling.

· Experience building AIOps, self-healing, incident triage, runbook automation, platform self-service, or developer productivity solutions.

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

As a Product Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the testability and manufacturability of Intel's cutting-edge integrated circuits, ensuring smooth production ramp from feasibility through high-volume manufacturing. In this role, you will perform hands-on work evaluating designs, developing test methodologies, debugging issues, and optimizing processes to ensure product quality and cost efficiency. Your contributions will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver innovative and reliable products to market.

Business group
The Product Engineering Integration team within Intel Corporation focuses on enabling the seamless transition of new products from design to manufacturing. The group collaborates across design, manufacturing, and quality domains to ensure robust product development and high-volume manufacturing readiness. By driving engineering excellence, the team supports Intel's broader mission to create world-changing technology that improves the lives of every person on the planet.

Leads team efforts in unit cost reductions through test time reduction and content optimization and methodologies as well as other efforts to drive continuous improvement in support of operational excellences

Job Description

What is a General Manager?

A General Manager must be committed to inspiring our team, helping our Customers succeed and growing our business with integrity. Professional level sales and management position capable of supporting functions on both sides of the business. The role requires understanding of store systems, automotive systems, parts knowledge and has the ability to identify, troubleshoot and project assist for DIY. Responsible for developing and maintaining Professional Customer relationships and program growth. Is accountable for achieving financial metrics and maintaining service and appearance standards. Position is exempt and requires a minimum of 50-55 hours per week (excluding meal break periods). The average schedule is 5-6 days a week, 11 hour shifts, including rotating nights and weekends, with an hour for lunch. Additional hours may be required based on staffing, store conditions, sales to target, and other business demands. General Managers are required to work a schedule based on the needs of the business.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Achieve overall store sales goals and service objectives
  • Manage and grow Professional Customer relationships/sales, including building and holding team accountable to executing Customer action plans
  • Selection, hiring, development, performance mgmt., coaching, scheduling and engagement of store Team Members

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Friendly communication

  • Ability to become ASE P2 certified or ASE ready equivalent

  • Advanced parts lookup and sourcing
  • Ability to source from numerous places including special order, FDO, second source, etc.
  • Ability to execute and train all store operational processes and procedures, and testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY services
  • Ability to execute and train inventory systems and store equipment

  • Ability to recruit, select, hire and develop quality Team Members

The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

description:
About the team

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month.   • Strong backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).

Pluses

  • Ad-serving technologies: Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid.js, programmatic (AdX/Open Bidding), viewability (Active View/OMID), IVT/ad-quality, identity and consent (RampID, PPID, CMPs).

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js/TypeScript)
description: Build the software that manages thousands of time nodes in 5G networks.Mobile networks depend on precise timing. Net Insight’s Zyntai platform keeps those networks synchronized, and Zyntai Director is the software used to manage the time nodes. Today, the platform supports around 2,000 nodes generating roughly 500,000 metric data points per second.Net Insight is looking for a senior engineer to join the five-person team behind Zyntai Director. You’ll develop backend services in Node.js and TypeScript, work with Kubernetes and AWS, and help the team keep Director reliable as customer networks grow.The roleThe Director team is part of Net Insight’s Sync R&D organization, which has around 15 engineers. Your work will span feature development, system design and troubleshooting in production. Upcoming work includes adding IPv6 support. A customer-reported issue might take you into the metrics to understand why a service behaves differently in a live network.Your responsibilities will include:    Building and extending backend services and APIs in Node.js and TypeScript.    Designing services that can handle larger networks and higher volumes of incoming metrics.    Investigating performance bottlenecks and improving reliability.    Adding networking capabilities, including IPv6 support.    Tracking down production bugs, testing fixes and following up on customer-reported issues.    Working with product owners on the scope and technical design of upcoming features.    Supporting customer proofs of concept alongside Tech Sales.Tech stack and environment    Backend: Node.js and TypeScript for Zyntai Director’s services and APIs.    Containers and orchestration: Kubernetes.    Cloud: AWS.    Distributed systems: Services that manage time nodes across telecom networks.    Metrics and observability: High-volume metrics processing, performance analysis and production troubleshooting.    Networking: API design, IP networking and work on IPv6 support.Net Insight is also investing in AI-assisted development for its engineering teams and exploring how AI could support future product features.Technical ownership and ways of workingThere is no separate architecture department at Net Insight. The Director team makes its own design decisions. When you take on a feature, you’ll help decide how it should work, discuss the trade-offs with the product owner and stay involved through implementation and testing. If an issue shows up in a customer’s network, the same team investigates it.The team uses Scrum and Kanban, with daily stand-ups. The Sync group is small enough that engineers work directly with Product, Sales and Tech Sales. title: Platform I/O and Sensor Software Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Role Overview As Intel accelerates its company-wide focus to define and execute to our Physical AI strategy, team is seeking a Platform I/O and Sensor Software Engineer to lead the integration, driver enablement, and latency optimization for critical robotics sensors, including high-precision IMUs (Inertial Measurement Units), mmWave Radar, thermal/heat imaging sensors, and optical environmental sensors on Linux platforms. You will define sensor interface abstractions, ensure microsecond-level synchronization, and optimize data ingestion pipelines for robotic state estimation, SLAM, and safety mechanisms. Key Responsibilities, Not Limited To • Linux Sensor Driver Development: Architect and implement Linux kernel drivers using the IIO (Industrial I/O) subsystem and custom bus drivers (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN/CAN-FD, PCIe, Ethernet) for IMUs, mmWave Radar, and thermal sensors. • Middleware and ROS Integration: Develop high-throughput user-space sensor adaptors, and zero-copy data transport libraries to support localization, mapping (SLAM), and collision-avoidance workloads. • Ecosystem Enabling and Troubleshooting: Benchmark, validate, and troubleshoot sensor noise, drift, latency, and bus communication errors on customer carrier boards and Intel reference evaluation platforms.

Qualifications:

Qualifications: -Experience: Typically requires around 7 years of relevant industry experience in software engineering, while dynamic, high-potential junior/early-career software engineers with 2-3+ years of hands-on experience in embedded Linux are equally encouraged to apply (2-7+ years overall experience welcomed) -Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Automation, or related fields. Technical Proficiencies: • In-depth knowledge of the Linux kernel framework, input subsystem, and driver debugging techniques. • Hands-on mastery of communication protocols and physical buses: SPI, I2C, I3C, UART, CAN-bus / CAN-FD, and Ethernet. • Practical experience integrating high-frequency 6-DoF/9-DoF IMUs (Bosch, TDK/InvenSense, Analog Devices) and mmWave/imaging radar modules. • Strong understanding of sensor timing, jitter reduction, interrupt latency, and hardware sensor calibration routines. • Exposure to robotics software ecosystems (ROS 2 sensor message standards, DDS) is highly desirable. • Soft Skills and Language: Self-motivated, collaborative across cross-functional teams, with excellent written and verbal English communication skills

The GMS National Pricing & Rebate Administrator is responsible for the administration, accuracy, and ongoing maintenance of national supplier pricing, rebate programs, purchasing agreements, and related supplier financial programs across GMS Canada.

The role will work closely with Purchasing, Finance and GMS business units to ensure negotiated pricing and rebate programs are accurately entered, documented, communicated, implemented, tracked, and reconciled.

A key focus of the position will be protecting the value of GMS Canada's negotiated supplier programs by ensuring pricing changes are implemented accurately, rebate opportunities and plateaus are properly captured, and discrepancies are identified and resolved in a timely manner.


Key Responsibilities

National Pricing Administration

  • In collaboration with and supporting the GMS National Procurement Administration Manager, the administrator will maintain national supplier pricing agreements and pricing programs within the Business Central ERP.
  • Support the coordination and implementation of supplier price increases, decreases, and other cost changes across GMS Canada.
  • Validate supplier pricing against negotiated agreements, price lists, quotations, and purchasing programs.
  • Maintain accurate pricing documentation and effective dates.
  • Coordinate pricing updates with Purchasing and applicable GMS business units.
  • Identify pricing discrepancies and work with suppliers and internal teams to resolve issues.
  • Support Purchasing with pricing analysis and historical cost comparisons.
  • Assist with maintaining consistency of supplier pricing across GMS Canada locations where national agreements apply.

Supplier Rebate Administration

  • Supports the maintenance of detailed records of national supplier rebate programs, including rebate structures, thresholds, applicable products, and program periods.
  • Track purchasing activity against applicable rebate programs and established targets.
  • Coordinate rebate submissions and supporting documentation where required.
  • Work with Finance and suppliers to validate rebate calculations, credits, payments, and outstanding amounts.
  • Identify potential rebate discrepancies, missed opportunities, or incomplete supplier payments and coordinate resolution.
  • Maintain an organized schedule of supplier rebate programs and key requirements.
  • Support year-end and periodic reconciliation of supplier rebates and purchasing programs.

Supplier Program Management

  • Maintain a centralized record of national supplier agreements, pricing programs, rebate structures, and purchasing incentives.
  • Work closely with the Purchasing team to ensure negotiated supplier terms are accurately reflected in internal records and processes.
  • Support the implementation of new supplier programs and modifications to existing programs.
  • Communicate relevant pricing and program changes to appropriate business units and stakeholders.
  • Assist with gathering information required for supplier negotiations, program reviews, and annual planning.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare regular pricing and rebate reports for Purchasing leadership.
  • Coordinating with the GMS National Procurement Administration Manager, analyze supplier pricing, rebate performance, purchasing volumes, and program activity.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve purchasing costs and maximize available supplier rebates.
  • Develop and maintain reporting tools that provide visibility into national pricing and rebate programs.
  • Support supplier business reviews with accurate pricing, purchasing, and rebate information.
  • Assist Purchasing leadership with ad hoc pricing, supplier, and cost analysis.

Pricing & Rebate Compliance

  • Monitor adherence to negotiated national supplier pricing and rebate agreements.
  • Review supplier invoices, credits, and related information when required to investigate discrepancies.
  • Maintain supporting documentation for pricing and rebate programs.
  • Work with Finance and Purchasing to reconcile differences between expected and received supplier rebates or credits.
  • Support internal review and audit requirements related to purchasing agreements and rebate programs.
  • Maintain confidentiality and appropriate controls around supplier pricing, rebates, and commercial agreements.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as a support and central resource for questions regarding national supplier pricing and rebate programs.
  • Work closely with Purchasing, Finance, Operations, Accounts Payable, and business-unit teams.
  • Coordinate directly with the GMS National Procurement Administration Manager and suppliers to obtain pricing information, program documentation, rebate statements, and other required information.
  • Support Purchasing initiatives involving supplier consolidation, cost reduction, national programs, and purchasing-process improvements.
  • Participate in the development and improvement of standardized pricing and rebate processes across GMS Canada.

Key Performance Areas

Success in the role would be measured through areas such as:

  • Accuracy and timeliness of national supplier pricing
  • Accuracy of rebate calculations and reconciliations
  • Capture of eligible supplier rebates and incentives
  • Timely implementation of supplier price changes
  • Resolution of pricing and rebate discrepancies
  • Quality and accuracy of purchasing and rebate reporting
  • Completeness of supplier program documentation
  • Consistency of pricing administration across GMS Canada
  • Responsiveness to internal stakeholders and suppliers
  • Contribution to purchasing cost-control and cost-reduction initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in pricing administration, purchasing, procurement, finance, rebates, accounting, or a related analytical role.
  • Experience within building materials, construction products, wholesale distribution, or large-format/big-box retail would be considered a strong asset.
  • Previous experience administering supplier rebates, buying programs, purchasing incentives, or vendor pricing programs is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of pricing structures, supplier programs, rebates, credits, and purchasing agreements.
  • Strong numerical and analytical capabilities with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to work effectively with large datasets, pricing files, reconciliations, lookup functions, PivotTables, and reporting.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple supplier programs, deadlines, and pricing changes simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with suppliers, Purchasing, Finance, and business-unit leadership.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to research and resolve pricing and financial discrepancies.
  • Ability to handle confidential supplier pricing, rebate, and commercial information with appropriate discretion.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail: Maintains a high degree of accuracy when managing pricing, rebate calculations, and supplier information.
  • Analytical Capability: Effectively analyzes pricing, purchasing, and rebate information to identify discrepancies and opportunities.
  • Financial Acumen: Understands how supplier pricing, rebates, credits, and purchasing programs impact overall product cost and profitability.
  • Organization: Effectively coordinate multiple supplier programs, pricing changes, reporting requirements, and deadlines.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of pricing and rebate issues through investigation and resolution.
  • Communication: Clearly communicates pricing and program information across suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across Purchasing, Finance, Accounts Payable, and GMS business units.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to simplify, standardize, and strengthen pricing and rebate administration processes.

description:

What You Will Accomplish


Position Overview: The Group Room Coordinator Handles all aspects of group guest reservations in support of Event Services, and other Sales Teams. Ensures all reservations requirements are handled professionally, accurately and in a timely manner to gain high level of guest confidence and satisfaction; and maximize revenue, market share and profitability. Enters reservations into computer system and runs necessary reports.
