title: Operations Performance Engineer
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

About you and this role


Dow has an opening for an Operations Performance Engineer located in Elizabethtown, KY. In this role, you will serve as a vital resource for Operations by applying technical skills to optimize plant operations, resolve plant problems, and enable safe and efficient production of low cost, quality products. You will be required to have conceptual knowledge of theories, practices, and procedures within job discipline. You will perform routine assignments and solves standard problems using existing procedures. You will apply general knowledge of business developed through education or past experience.


Responsibilities

  • Works closely with the operations team leveraging their problem-solving skills and technical expertise.
  • Elevates and appropriately applies knowledge of the plant and technology referencing historical data and conferring with Technology Center or other subject matter experts (SMEs).
  • Ensures Most Effective Technology (MET) is understood and utilized and that process automation is used as a tool to optimize plant performance.
  • Utilizes defined MET and challenges/escalates MET application and assumptions when better solutions arise.
  • Partners with experts to perform advanced troubleshooting and improve and document operating discipline.
  • Diagnoses and documents root causes of asset utilization losses in the facility.
  • Understands why specific procedure steps and precautions are needed and keeps a strong field presence to reinforce the importance.
  • Conducts daily review of logbook and alarm history to better understand the plant operation and stay engaged with daily activities.
  • Maintains, owns, and reviews daily Key Process Indicators (KPI)/ trends to ensure optimum performance.
  • Responds urgently to plant issues and emergencies.
  • Acts as a unit technical expert during unplanned events and drives implementation of effective corrective and preventative actions.
  • Provides leadership, expertise, diagnosis, and optimization in plant Raw Material Efficiency, which may include yield or waste generation.
  • Ensures compliance with plant operating permits. Understands site integration and provides input to optimize the overall system.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of an Bachelor's degree in Engineering OR relevant military experience at or above a U.S. E5 ranking OR Canadian Petty Officer 2nd Class ranking is required.
  • A minimum requirement for this U.S. based position is the ability to work legally in the United States. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in manufacturing.

Your Skills


  • Manufacturing Processes: Deep understanding of how equipment, materials, and unit operations interact to produce products safely, efficiently, and at consistent quality.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Effectively partners with operations, maintenance, technology, and EH&S to solve problems and implement sustainable improvements. Builds trust and alignment across teams.
  • Production Engineering: Applies advanced technical expertise to optimize plant operations, resolve complex production issues, and support safe, reliable, and cost‑effective manufacturing.
  • Plant & Process Safety: Reinforces safe work practices and operating discipline through strong field presence and sound daily decision‑making, while ensuring process safety risks are identified, understood, and controlled through effective application of standards and management systems.
  • Process Improvements: Identifies performance gaps and leads data‑driven improvements that enhance efficiency, reliability, and cost while aligning with business priorities.
  • Lean Manufacturing: Applies lean principles to eliminate waste, improve flow, and increase productivity without compromising safety or quality.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipates issues by monitoring trends, alarms, and KPIs, and leads root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
  • Data Analysis: Uses process data and performance metrics to guide troubleshooting, operational decisions, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • High Reliability: Promotes consistent and predictable plant performance by reinforcing operating discipline, understanding failure modes, and addressing reliability risks early.

Physical Requirements

Willing and able to meet the physical demands of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Wear safety equipment, such as earplugs, gloves, safety-toe shoes, helmets and safety glasses.
  • Work in tight or closed-in spaces.
  • Stand or walk for extended periods of time.

Additional Notes


Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Benefits – What Dow offers you

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

  • Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
  • Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
  • Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

title: PUBLISHER
description:

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS - Agentic Experience
description:
About the team

The Agentic Experience team sits at the forefront of Zillow's transformation toward an agentic product experience. We are the stewards of the agentic UX framework, the foundation that allows Zillow's agentic AI capabilities to come to life across its surfaces, and we operate at the intersection of product and platform: shipping meaningful agentic experiences today while building the durable infrastructure that enables teams across Zillow to build more, faster, tomorrow.
We built and launched the user experience for Zillow AI Mode, now available to every signed-in Zillow user across web, iOS, and Android, and we own and evolve that core experience every day. We also stay at the forefront of agentic UX: exploring what comes after the conversational interface, including generative, context-adaptive interfaces that personalize to each person's goals and stage of their real estate journey, and bringing the most promising of those ideas into a product used by millions.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS, to help build and evolve Zillow AI Mode in the Zillow iOS app. You will be a core contributor to the mobile experience of AI Mode, a multimodal, context-aware agentic experience that is increasingly woven into the rest of the app. Beyond the conversational experience itself, you will help shape the interfaces by which other parts of the Zillow iOS app integrate with AI Mode, so they can hand context to the agent and surface its capabilities in place. And as the team pushes into generative UX, you will have the opportunity to contribute to how we bring frontier interaction patterns into a production app used by millions. This is a hands-on engineering role on a team that is central to Zillow's AI strategy. Much of what comes next is still being defined, and you will have a real voice in defining it.


You Will Get To

  • Build and ship the iOS experience for Zillow AI Mode (conversational, multimodal, and context-aware) in Swift and SwiftUI, with a high bar for craft, performance, and reliability in a consumer app at scale.
  • Design and evolve the integration interfaces that let other surfaces in the Zillow iOS app connect to AI Mode: passing context to the agent and bringing agentic capabilities into the flows where users already are.
  • Contribute to the team's generative UX frontier, helping prototype, evaluate, and productionize AI-composed, hyper-personalized interfaces on iOS.
  • Partner closely with your web and Android counterparts to keep the AI Mode experience consistent across platforms: aligning on experience decisions, evolving the shared schema and protocol, and learning from how each platform solves the same problems, all while building natively on iOS.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, applied scientists, and ML engineers to turn new agentic skills and model capabilities into shippable, measurable user experiences, and support rapid experimentation with real users.
  • Champion operational excellence for the iOS experience, from instrumentation and observability to testing strategy and safe, incremental rollout, so we can move fast without compromising quality or user trust.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400.00 - $262,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200.00 - $249,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • A builder at heart who takes pride in the craft of mobile engineering and has the judgment to balance speed with rigor.
  • A champion for user experience quality. You care how things look, feel, and perform, and you hold a high bar for what great mobile work is.
  • A collaborative engineer who works well across platforms and functions (product, design, AI/ML, and peer engineering teams) and drives outcomes through influence rather than authority.
  • A pragmatic technologist who is comfortable in ambiguity, breaks down complex problems, and surfaces risks and trade-offs early.
  • A clear communicator who documents designs and decisions well and can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.
  • A practitioner of AI-native development. You actively use AI coding tools and assistants in your own workflow and treat them as a genuine force multiplier throughout the software development lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, the majority of it building native iOS applications in Swift.
  • Deep proficiency in SwiftUI and UIKit, Swift concurrency, and modern iOS architecture patterns, with experience evolving a large, long-lived codebase.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping consumer-facing iOS products to a large user base, with an appreciation for performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience quality.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incremental rollout.

Desired Skills

  • Experience building AI-powered or agentic applications, including familiarity with LLMs, streaming responses, tool/function calling, and multimodal input/output (text, voice, images).
  • Experience with server-driven or dynamically composed UI, or other approaches to rendering generative, context-adaptive interfaces on mobile.
  • Experience on a cross-platform team, aligning experience decisions with web and Android counterparts and learning from how other platforms solve similar problems.
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping and iterative product development in a fast-moving, research-adjacent environment.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Spesialrådgiver IKT
description:
Vil du bruke din IKT-kompetanse til å støtte en av helsevesenets sentrale virksomheter og bidra til at laboratoriene får den IKT-støtten og de digitale tjenestene de trenger for å sikre god drift og videre utvikling?

Vi søker en spesialrådgiver IKT i 100 % fast stilling som vil ha en sentral rolle i oppfølging og koordinering av IKT-relaterte saker for laboratorieklinikken. Stillingen passer for deg som liker å ha oversikt, samarbeide på tvers av fagområder og være en viktig støttespiller for både ledelse og fagmiljøer. Du vil bidra til stabil drift, god samhandling og videreutvikling av klinikkens digitale tjenester.

Som en del av enhet KLM-IKT-Lab i klinikkstaben, Klinikk for laboratoriemedisin (KLM) får du en sentral rolle i et av Norges største og mest kompetente laboratoriemiljøer. KLM leverer laboratoriediagnostikk til pasienter ved Oslo universitetssykehus, andre sykehus og primærhelsetjenesten, og har en viktig funksjon i pasientbehandlingen. Hos oss får du arbeide tett med både laboratoriefaglige miljøer, ledelse og IKT-aktører, og bidra til å sikre stabile, effektive og fremtidsrettede digitale tjenester som understøtter klinikkens virksomhet.

KLM er inndelt i åtte avdelinger og dekker fagområdene farmakologi, immunologi og transfusjonsmedisin, medisinsk biokjemi, medisinsk genetikk, mikrobiologi, patologi, smittevern og rettsmedisinske fag.

Virker dette som en arbeidsplass og rolle som passer for deg? Da hører vi gjerne fra deg! Oppstart etter avtale.

Oslo universitetssykehus er en arbeidsplass med stort mangfold. Vi mener dette er avgjørende for å løse våre oppgaver på best mulig måte. Vi ønsker at dette mangfoldet skal gjenspeiles blant søkerne til våre stillinger, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig bakgrunn, til å søke!

Arbeidsoppgaver

IKT-landskapet i laboratorievirksomheten er i kontinuerlig endring. Med nye sykehusbygg, økt digitalisering og pågående modernisering av systemporteføljen står Klinikk for laboratoriemedisin foran spennende endringer. Som spesialrådgiver IKT vil du bidra til å sikre gode digitale tjenester for laboratoriene gjennom koordinering, oppfølging og samarbeid på tvers av fagmiljøer og teknologiske plattformer.

  • Bidra i koordinering og følge opp prioriterte IKT-relaterte saker, aktiviteter og leveranser for laboratorieklinikken.
  • Bidra til utvikling, prioritering og forvaltning av klinikkens IKT-løsninger og digitale tjenester innen laboratorieområdet.
  • Samarbeide med Sykehuspartner og andre aktører om bestillinger, endringsbehov, avklaringer og leveranser.
  • Representere klinikken i prosjekter og fora, og bidra til god samhandling mellom laboratoriefaglige miljøer, IKT-miljøer og andre samarbeidspartnere.
Kvalifikasjoner

For å trives med arbeidsoppgaver hos oss, ser vi etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå. Særlig relevant realkompetanse og arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • God kjennskap til medisinsk laboratorievirksomhet og laboratorienes arbeidsprosesser.
  • God digital kompetanse og erfaring fra arbeid med IKT, digitalisering og systemforvaltning i større relevante organisasjoner.
  • Kunnskap om laboratoriedatasystemer og andre sentrale IKT-løsninger for laboratorier.
  • God helhetsforståelse, samarbeidsevner og evne til å arbeide selvstendig.
  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk.

Det er en fordel om du har:

  • Erfaring fra medisinsk laboratorievirksomhet i spesialisthelsetjenesten.
  • Erfaring med forvaltning, utvikling eller innføring av laboratoriedatasystemer.
  • Erfaring med samhandling med IKT-tjenesteleverandører, gjerne Sykehuspartner.
  • Erfaring fra prosjekter eller utviklingsarbeid på tvers av organisasjoner og fagmiljøer.
  • Forståelse for integrasjoner og informasjonsflyt mellom laboratorie-, analyse- og kliniske IKT-systemer.

Vi ber om at relevant dokumentasjon legges ved søknaden, som sendes via webcruiter ved å klikke på linken "søk på stillingen".

Personlige egenskaper
  • Trives med å håndtere komplekse problemstillinger og evner å omsette behov og utfordringer til praktiske løsninger og fremdrift. Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
  • Bygge gode relasjoner og skaper tillit gjennom tydelig kommunikasjon, god samhandling og forståelse for ulike faglige perspektiver.
  • Har evne til å se helheten samtidig som du følger opp detaljer når det er nødvendig, og gjør gode prioriteringer i en travel arbeidshverdag.
  • Kan jobbe selvstendig og håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig.
  • Nysgjerrig på teknologi og utvikling, samtidig som du har forståelse for betydningen av stabile og velfungerende tjenester i en klinisk virksomhet.
  • Samarbeider godt på tvers av fagområder og bidrar positivt til et inkluderende og løsningsorientert arbeidsmiljø.
  • Utviklingsorientert og endringsvillig i en tid hvor OUS bygger nye sykehus.
Vi tilbyr

Oslo universitetssykehus har et viktig samfunnsoppdrag i det å tilby gode og likeverdige helsetjenester til befolkningen. Som medarbeider ved sykehuset vil du ha en rolle i å innfri dette. Du har betydning for pasientsikkerhet, trivsel på arbeidsplassen og utvikling av en trygg, åpen og inkluderende kultur. Vi er opptatt av at du skal trives og utvikle deg, vi kan tilby deg:

  • Du får en utfordrende, variert og spennende hverdag i en kompleks organisasjon som er i kontinuerlig utvikling.
  • Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø med høy kompetanse, og et utstrakt samarbeid med dedikerte kolleger som er ledende innenfor sine fagområder.
  • Du blir gitt gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Du får god opplæring og det vil være mulighet for interne kurs og årlige seminarer, samt faglig påfyll underveis.
  • Vi tar vare på våre nye medarbeidere og støtter deg gjennom oppstartsfasen med vårt sentrale nyansattprogram, les mer:
  • Vi har velferdstilbud for våre medarbeidere, f. eks. teaterbilletter, bedriftskor, bedriftsidrettslag m.m.
  • Vi kan tilby fleksibel arbeidstid og hjemmekontor etter avtale.

I Oslo universitetssykehus driver vi med avansert pasientbehandling, forskning, utprøvende behandling, undervisning og innovasjon på et høyt internasjonalt nivå. Vi er derfor hele Norges bakvakt! Vi vil gjerne ha deg med på laget. Høres dette ut som en stilling for deg? Vi gleder oss til å lese din søknad.

Vil du vite mer om oss? Les om arbeidsplassen vår her:

KontaktinformasjonKirstin Elisabeth Dahle, Avdelingsleder, +4799706318, kirdah@ous-hf.no ArbeidsstedForskningsveien 2A 0373 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5205468743 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 30.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen med pasienten utvikler vi morgendagens behandling Oslo universitetssykehus med våre 25 000 medarbeidere skal være en lærende og skapende organisasjon med evne til å tenke nytt. Vi skal ha en ledende rolle i utvikling av forskning og innovasjon, samt utvikling av morgendagens helsetjeneste, medisinsk behandling og presisjonsmedisin. Hos oss finner du noen av landets ledende eksperter innen sine fagfelt, og her blir du en del av Norges største helsefaglige arbeidsplass. Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av åpenhet og respekt er svært viktig for oss. Uansett hva du jobber med vil du få muligheten til å utvikle deg og benytte din kompetanse på et sted hvor det virkelig teller.

title: Assistant Merchant
description:
About us

Talbots is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of women's clothing, shoes and accessories. Established in 1947, we are known for modern classic style that's both timeless and timely, fine quality craftsmanship and gracious service. At Talbots relationships are the key to our business, we hire individuals who bring new ideas to the table, understand smart risk taking and can enhance an already thriving culture. With a commitment to offer modern classic style for every body type, through a full range of sizes, inclusive to every woman in your life.

About the role


In Merchandising, we are committed to your growth and development. If you are looking for an opportunity to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic environment and kick-off your Merchandising career, then keep reading! We are currently working in a hybrid & collaborative setting which consists of being onsite in our Hingham, MA Corporate Office as often as project and product calendar dictate. This position is responsible for actively assisting the Merchant with the strategy, development, and selection of merchandise while supporting the department through the entire product lifecycle. Assistant Merchants will be assigned to a specific category.

The impact you can have

  • Prepare weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting and assist Merchant in analyzing performance; initiate and perform additional ad hoc analytical assignments as requested.
  • Review and compile seasonal commits by style, color, and size partnering with Sourcing and Allocation partners.
  • Monitor and track purchase orders and inventory through receipt reconciliation process.
  • Order, track, and organize samples for every season; ensure all photo samples are accurate and follow proper protocol for incorrect samples.
  • Work cross functionally with other partners and teams to ensure accurate product representation for photo shoots and floor sets.
  • Provide data for copy cards for all items in catalog.
  • Review shot sheets for catalog, ensure all product is being shot and has appropriate selling space.
  • Prepare for and attend catalog, store set layout and web thumbnail reviews, to ensure accuracy, timeliness of delivery and placement.
  • Review and correct all catalog and web content for department as released, work with teams to ensure accurate product representation.
  • Maintain knowledge of retail industry trends, shop competition and visit Talbots stores frequently.
  • Consistently check department landing page on the web to ensure accurate product information, gallery ranking, and any helpful customer reviews. Partner with web merchandising team on any callouts.
  • Assist merchant in generating reports weekly to analyze sales and business trends.
  • Gather / recap history as a stepping off point for future buys.

You’ll bring to the role

  • 1 -2 years merchandising, retail sales, buying or internship experience preferred.
  • Broad-based business acumen with the potential to grow to the Merchant level and beyond!
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel skills to include VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and numerical formulation or and have aptitude to learn these technical applications quickly.
  • Innate sense of fashion and ability to analyze and translate trends
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, ability to multitask and work collaboratively.
  • Excellent attention to detail, understands importance of accuracy and thorough completion of tasks Ability to hit concurrent deadlines, manage and prioritize own workload

Benefits

  • You will be eligible to receive a merchandise discount at select KnitWell Group brands, subject to each brand’s discount policies.
  • Support for your individual development plus opportunities for career mobility within our family of brands.
  • A culture of giving back – local volunteer opportunities, annual donation and volunteer match to eligible nonprofit organizations, and philanthropic activities to support our communities.*
  • Medical, dental, vision insurance & 401(K).*
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Time off – paid time off & holidays.*
  • The target salary range for this role is: $50,000 - $55,000*

*Any job offer will consider factors such your qualifications, relevant experience, and skills. Eligibility of certain benefits and associate programs are subject to employment type and role.

On-site: This position works on-site at least 4 days per week consistent with the needs of the business at our Talbots office location in Hingham, MA.

Regular/Full time

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Responsibilities: • Actively participates on cross-functional project teams developing analytics enabled solutions • Owns and manages assigned tasks. • Works on problems of limited scope / complexity, following standard practices and procedures • Developing ability to generate relevant, actionable insights based on iterative data analysis, translate data-driven output into business language, and to make appropriate recommendations to respective business stakeholders • Provides analysis on datasets of moderate complexity • Communicates results of cases of limited complexity to more senior data scientists and business partners • Works closely with subject matter experts to understand data sources • Gains fundamental understanding of the business value chain and customer lifecycle for the projects they are supporting. • Curious and learns to ask the right kinds of questions of peers and customers to gain knowledge. • Builds stable working relationships with cross-functional peers, begins to establish a broader internal network. • Actively seeks out coaching and incorporates feedback into their work. • Owns their career development. • Takes advantage of available resources to advance their technical and business skills. • Understands how their assigned tasks fit into the broader initiative Limited ability to construct systematic process to implement analytics insights and solutions: 1) designing a process with multiple relevant parties with clear specifications of roles and responsibilities 2) identifying required tasks, system / data flow and contingency 3) specifying check-and-balance throughout the process 4) establishing rigorous tracking and closed-loop learning 5) implementing such process in a scalable way Requirements: • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Math, Computer Science, Engineering; or equivalent work experience • Basic Working knowledge of programming languages and concepts (e.g. SAS, SPSS, R, or Python) • Familiarity with basic statistical tests, distributions, maximum likelihood estimators, statistical modelling techniques (regression, cluster / factor / principle components, decision tree, survival analysis, etc.) • Basic understanding of different techniques and knowledge of machine learning algorithms. • Basic knowledge of AI toolkits. • Basic knowledge of data visualization tools such as Tableau, QlikView, open source data visualization libraries - ggplot and d3.js • Basic knowledge of common database querying languages such as SQL. • Capability of applying a systematic, structured approach to explore / navigate / mine massive amount of data, structured or un-structured, to uncover hidden patterns / insights. • Working knowledge of relational database models (e.g. data vaulting techniques, rules tables)•

title: Financial Clearance Specialist III - Pre Arrival - Full Time 8 Hour Days (Non-Exempt) (Non-Union)
location: Los Angeles, CA - Health Sciences Campus
description:
The Financial Clearance Specialist III is responsible for ensuring insurance eligibility, benefit verification, and the authorization processes are complete in the time allowed by the insurance companies to prevent denials or penalties. Documenting accurate insurance information and authorization details to optimize reimbursement from both the payer and patient. Maintain strong working knowledge of insurance plans, contract requirements, and resources to facilitate appropriate insurance verification and authorization. Must be able to run eligibility and secure full benefit coverage information (including COBRA when applicable) with insurance companies and employers, confirm all demographic information is correct, and ensure coordination of benefit (COB) and insurance plan codes are accurate. Verify insurance coverage immediately for inpatient and outpatient accounts that are same day and next day add-ons. Determine if pre-certification, pre-authorization or a referral is required for insurance companies and obtain if applicable. Communicate with providers and team regarding out-of-network issues, assess contracted and non-contracted payer issues, and document outcomes and next steps. Determine, communicate, and collect patient liability prior to service and attempt to collect prior balances. Conduct all transactions appropriately and consistently, and complete Medicare Secondary Questionnaire accurately with the patient or patient's representative. Maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations as it pertains to the insurance processes. Maintain professional development by attending workshops, in-services, and webinars to remain up-to-date on insurance rules and regulations in addition to changes within the industry. Responsible in submitting authorizations for surgery, GI , Imaging chemotherapy, Infusions, invasive and non-invasive procedures, transplants, and all other services as required.

Essential Duties

  • Responsible for obtaining insurance information/verification/authorization to ensure financial clearance of patient accounts. Updates both professional and / or hospital registration systems. Ensure all insurance plans are properly selected in all registration and scheduling information systems. Responsible for calling insurance or use Internet portals to obtain and document: a) Insurance eligibility and benefits, b) Financial responsibility, c) Authorization and / or Pre-Certification as required. (20%)
  • Responsible for understanding and articulating patient’s liability by performing mathematical calculations in understanding out of pocket, co-insurance and deductible calculations. Responsible for full calculations on all Surgery, GI, Chemo/Infusions, Imaging on non and invasive procedures by following the appropriate documentation standard guidelines. (20%)
  • Responsible for contacting Physician office when a patient’s services are denied, re-directed and or when a Peer to Peer is required. Communicate with physician offices regarding proposed admissions, special procedures, outpatient referrals and same day surgeries. (20%)
  • Responsible for submitting authorizations for Surgery, GI, Chemo/Infusions, Imaging on non and invasive procedures. Submits authorizations via the Valor software tool and or websites and follows the appropriate protocol when submitting authorizations. Responsible for clearing assigned worklists in any of the information systems (15%)
  • Responsible for completing Documentation of all authorization information is entered in all appropriate registration fields and follows the approved documentation standard guidelines. Submit pre-certification documentation to third party payers for authorization with correct CPT and ICD coding. Research payer medical policy requirements for treatment authorizations and understand process for submitting pre-certification requests. Follow up for routine requests from the message center are followed up on 3-5 business days consistently. Scan all authorizations into appropriate system under the respective patient accounts and document authorization outcomes in the registration system. (15%)
  • Perform all other duties as assigned. (10%)


Qualifications

  • Req High school or equivalent Or GED required.
  • Req 2 years Admitting/ insurance verification experience in a hospital, health plan or Physician office environment.
  • Req Broad experience in financial counseling and co-pay collections.
  • Req Ability to submit authorization and articulate full insurance benefits for Surgery, GI, Imaging, Chemo Therapy, Infusions, and invasive and non- invasive procedures is highly desirable.
  • Req The extended ability to perform mathematical calculations, extensive experience in hospital and medical business office setting.
  • Req Ability to interrupt patient’s insurance coverage, identify services that are not covered benefit and provide clear explanation to patients and providers.
  • Req Strong problem solving customer skills.
  • Req Knowledge of business office procedures.
  • Req Knowledge of medical terminology and coding.
  • Req Knowledge of grammar, spelling, and punctuation to type patient information.
  • Req Must be able to verify insurance and advanced knowledge of both CPT codes and medical terminology.
  • Req Must also be able to understand and interpret patient liability and benefits for HMOs and all payer types.
  • Req Ability to read, understand, and follow oral, and written instructions and establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, employees, and the public.
  • Req Excellent time management, organizational skills, research/analytical skills, negotiation, communication (written and verbal), and interpersonal skills.
  • Req Capable of reading the policy and procedure manual and understanding information pertaining to specific job duties and the general information for all hospital employees.
  • Req Fire Life Safety Training (LA City) If no card upon hire, one must be obtained within 30 days of hire and maintained by renewal before expiration date. (Required within LA City only)

Keck Hospital of USC, a 343-bed acute care hospital, provides exceptional and innovative care for complex medical and surgical conditions across a wide range of specialties. The hospital’s world-renowned physicians deliver compassionate, customized, patient-centered care and treat the most acutely ill patients with highly innovative techniques and treatment plans. As a leading academic medical center, hundreds of clinical trials are currently taking place at Keck Hospital and its affiliated research institutions, giving patients access to novel and promising therapies that are generally not available elsewhere. Every day at Keck Hospital, physicians, nurses and staff go beyond the science of exceptional medicine to bring patients breakthroughs in the art of caring. title: Group Coordinator
location: The Meritage Resort & Spa – Napa, CA
description:
Pacific Hospitality Group provides a unique value proposition to investors and team members through our owner/operator approach. We are a family focused company committed to long term holds that enable us to grow our business and our team members. Our vision is to enrich people’s lives by offering memorable experiences, giving back to our communities and honoring God in all that we do. We are focused on long-term value creation and sustainable growth.

Our Guiding Principles:

Integrity, Compliance, Value Creation, Principled Entrepreneurship, Customer Focus, Knowledge, Change, Humility, Respect, & Fulfillment

1. Group Reservations & Room Block Management

  • Create, manage, and maintain group reservations in the Property Management System (HMS).
  • Process rooming lists, individual reservations, modifications, cancellations, and name changes.
  • Monitor contracted room blocks, room types, and available inventory.
  • Create and maintain group booking links and coordinate inventory adjustments.
  • Ensure reservations reflect accurate arrival dates, departure dates, rates, room types, and special requests.
  • Review group cutoff dates and coordinate the release of unused inventory with the appropriate departments.

2. Group Pickup, Attrition & Reporting

  • Monitor daily and weekly group pickup against contracted room commitments.
  • Prepare and distribute accurate rooming lists and pickup reports.
  • Identify groups at risk of attrition and communicate potential exposure to Reservations Management and Sales.
  • Track group cancellations, no-shows, early departures, and room block changes.
  • Prepare pre-event, in-house, and post-event reports.
  • Assist with final group pickup reconciliation and reporting.

3. Group Billing & Financial Accuracy

  • Review and establish group billing instructions, including master account and individual payment arrangements.
  • Ensure proper routing of room charges, taxes, resort fees, gratuities, and incidentals.
  • Coordinate credit card authorization forms and deposits as needed.
  • Review master account activity and identify billing discrepancies.
  • Work with Accounting and Front Office to resolve group billing concerns.
  • Assist in reviewing no-show charges, cancellation penalties, and early departure fees in accordance with contractual terms and hotel policies.

4. Pre-Arrival & VIP Coordination

  • Review upcoming group arrivals to ensure reservations and billing arrangements are accurate.
  • Coordinate VIP room assignments, suite upgrades, special accommodations, and room-blocking requests.
  • Communicate group preferences and operational requirements to the Front Office and Rooms Control teams.
  • Prepare group arrival notes and ensure special instructions are properly documented.
  • Participate in pre-convention meetings as needed.

5. Client & Interdepartmental Communication

  • Serve as a primary reservations contact for group planners and internal Sales and Events teams.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to group reservation inquiries.
  • Provide regular rooming list updates, pickup reports, and reservation confirmations.
  • Communicate inventory restrictions, sold-out dates, and booking challenges.
  • Coordinate with Revenue Management regarding group inventory and room availability.
  • Support Front Office operations during group arrivals and departures.

6. Administrative & Operational Support

  • Maintain accurate group reservation records and documentation.
  • Follow established Reservations department procedures and service standards.
  • Assist with daily group reservation audits and quality-control checks.
  • Maintain confidentiality of guest information, payment details, and contractual agreements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve group reservation processes and operational efficiency.
  • Support the Reservations Manager with additional group-related projects and assignments.

title: Associate Director - Quality Assurance
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Patients are at the center of everything we do at Lilly. We are currently hiring a Associate Director -Associate Director - Quality Assurance


This role supports critical work that helps bring medicines and solutions to patients responsibly and efficiently. #WeAreLilly


This Manufacturing Quality Assurance role focuses on shaping and sustaining the QA function across manufacturing, guiding teams through coaching, performance development, and clear priorities. You’ll set direction, resource allocation, and workforce planning for QA activities, including hiring and onboarding to ensure capable, ready-to-run teams. Regular quality reviews and team connects drive alignment on performance, risks, and corrective actions, while early issue identification and escalation keep barriers from slowing progress. The role requires strong leadership, collaborative communication, and effective use of IT tools to enable consistent quality outcomes and continuous improvement across the manufacturing QA landscape.


Key Responsibilities


  • This position will be responsible to facilitate, lead, and ensure compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices and Corporate Quality policies of PR05 plant.
  • Serve as liaison between flow teams and Quality Management Department.
  • Responsible for Process Support, Intermediate Batch Disposition, Computer Systems Quality, Capital Projects, and responsible person at the site for all cGMP matters in the absence of the Sr. Director Quality.
  • Develop team capability through coaching, mentoring, performance development plans, and clear goals and priorities.
  • Set direction, build capability, and allocate resources for QA teams through workforce planning, hiring, and onboarding.
  • Facilitate regular quality review meetings and team connects to align on performance, risks, and corrective action plans.
  • Translate organizational quality objectives into executable plans and drive delivery via team leadership during organizational change.
  • Build collaborative relationships internally and externally with stakeholders including peers, reports, customers, partners, and regulators.
  • Manage financial planning including forecasting and budget ownership related to manufacturing quality assurance activities.
  • Oversee and direct manufacturing process quality control activities to ensure inspection readiness with compliance of cGMP and quality standards.
  • Conduct periodic internal audits and assessments of manufacturing quality systems to identify gaps and ensure continuous improvement.

Core Capabilities

  • Support and guide teams to achieve quality goals through coaching and clear performance plans.
  • Facilitate cross-team alignment and transparent information sharing to drive quality outcomes.
  • Utilize approved systems to monitor QA activities and ensure accurate data capture and reporting.
  • Architect on-the-job learning and formal training aligned with manufacturing QA priorities.
  • Coordinate QA projects, track milestones, and manage processes within defined resource constraints.
  • Familiarity with leading performance and quality initiatives to drive consistent results.
  • Experience with monitoring operations to identify gaps and implement improvements.
  • Exposure to aligning quality goals with broader business planning and resource needs.
  • Awareness of forecasting resource needs and coordinating teams to meet objectives.
  • Lead quality assurance team assign to support manufacturing.
  • Provide Quality direction for complex business and operational issues or technical challenges. Remove barriers as they arise.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Lilly global standards and regulatory guidelines.
  • Evaluate and approve change controls, risk assessments, excursions, and deviation investigations.
  • Host regulatory inspections/audits and coordinate inspection/audit responses and commitments.
  • Review/approve standard operating procedures, batch records, specifications, validation protocols/reports, as applicable.
  • Provide compliance guidance to Manufacturing, QC, FUME and other supporting business units.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional departments at Flow team level and provide support to process/continuous improvement projects and initiatives at the site
  • Identify and lead process improvement projects impacting multiple business areas.
  • Promote a positive Quality Culture and oversee on-the-floor Quality presence in the respective business area (e.g., manufacturing).
  • Mentor, coach, and manage staff performance and development.



Ability to:

Establish positive interpersonal relations and interact effectively with people. Work under minimum supervision. Work under time pressure. Work fast during short and long periods of time. Be flexible when priorities of work change. Lead a diverse team. Make decisions. Exercise good judgment in special situations. Anticipate the implications and consequences of situations and take appropriate action to prepare for possible contingencies. Use a logical, systematic approach to problem solving. Identify information needed to clarify a situation, seek that information from appropriate sources and use skillful questioning to draw out the information. Focus on a desired end result, set challenging objectives, pursue them tenaciously and meet or exceed those objectives. Influence others. Teach others.


Basic Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in the Chemistry, Chemical Engineer or Microbiology.
  • Requires a minimum of 10 years technical and/or Quality experience in a GMP regulated environment, Biopharmaceutical industry preferred. A minimum of 5 of these 10 years of experience must be in a leadership role in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) with written, verbal and oral communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Veeva and/or an equivalent quality management system.
  • Proficiency in applying U.S. FDA regulations and GMPs, statistical sampling systems and computerized systems in a pharmaceutical quality environment.
  • Experience participating in regulatory agency audits.

Additional Information:

  • Travel: Availability to travel within and outside of Puerto Rico when necessary.
  • Schedule: Availability to work irregular hours, night, weekends or holidays when necessary, in support of 24/7 operation.

title: Electrical Failure Analysis Engineer - Shift2 Nanoprobing
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The TD QnR Failure Analysis and Fault Isolation (FAFI) organization is seeking a highly motivated Electrical Failure Analysis Engineer to join the Nanoprobing Engineering (NPE) team on Shift 2. FAFI serves as the technical forensic organization responsible for identifying, isolating, and understanding electrical failures impacting next-generation semiconductor technologies and products. As a Nanoprobing Engineer, you will utilize advanced electrical characterization and nanoprobing techniques to investigate device, transistor, circuit, and product-level reliability and yield challenges across leading-edge CMOS technologies. This position provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of semiconductor device physics, circuit design, reliability engineering, and advanced failure analysis. Engineers in this role develop innovative debug methodologies and perform detailed electrical investigations to enable rapid root-cause determination and technology learning. Responsibilities Perform advanced nanoprobing investigations to identify and isolate electrical failure mechanisms in leading-edge semiconductor technologies. Execute cell-level, transistor-level, SRAM, logic, and analog circuit characterization activities using state-of-the-art nanoprobing platforms. Analyze electrical signatures to determine root causes associated with reliability, performance, yield, and functional failures. Develop and improve characterization methodologies for transistor and circuit-level validation. Utilize semiconductor parameter analyzers, waveform generators, oscilloscopes, and switching systems to perform precision electrical measurements. Correlate nanoprobing results with fault isolation, physical failure analysis, design, process, and reliability data. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Design, Process Integration, Device Engineering, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Failure Analysis organizations. Drive technical problem solving and debug efforts on complex issues involving advanced CMOS technologies. Document findings and communicate technical results through reports, presentations, and engineering reviews. Support development and deployment of next-generation electrical characterization and failure analysis capabilities.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications
Master's degree in: Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Engineering Physics Applied Physics Or a closely related technical discipline.

Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics.
Strong understanding of electronic circuits and circuit analysis.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following areas:
Nanoprobing or electrical failure analysis.
Semiconductor parameter analyzer operation.
Device characterization and transistor measurements.
CMOS process technology and semiconductor manufacturing.
Digital circuit design and debug.
SRAM, memory, or logic circuit characterization.
Reliability testing and root-cause analysis.
Fault isolation techniques.
Analog or mixed-signal characterization.
Python, MATLAB, or data analysis programming.
Linux/Unix environments.
Statistical data analysis and automation development.

Ideal Candidate
The successful candidate will be a hands-on experimental engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges. They will possess strong laboratory skills, a passion for semiconductor technology, and the ability to translate electrical observations into actionable failure analysis conclusions. The ideal applicant is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where every failure presents a unique technical investigation requiring creativity, persistence, and rigorous analytical thinking.

The Technical Scout, specializing in Electronic Warfare (EW), Radio Frequency (RF) Systems and Spectrum Analysis, will simplify pathways for innovative companies, and talent, to engage with the Department of War (DoW), driving faster commercialization, scalable production, and ensuring warfighter-relevant technologies reach the field at speed and scale. This position supports defense‑related projects funded by a U.S. Department of Defense grant. An offer of employment is contingent upon the selected candidate being eligible for and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance (Secret or higher) and any necessary export control licenses to perform the job functions.

  • Provide personalized 1-on-1 education, coaching, and guidance to founders, researchers, and corporate teams on product development with specialized emphasis on advanced manufacturing techniques, scalability, and production readiness.

At APA, our purpose is to secure Australia’s energy future. We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it with our customers and communities as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.

You’ll also spend time out in the field, with up to four months of fieldwork across the year, typically undertaken in one to one to two-week blocks.

Working with teams across the business, First Nations Peoples, specialist heritage consultants and regulators, this is an opportunity to play an important role in supporting the compliant delivery of APA activities while building heritage capability across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate heritage due diligence assessments and clearly communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.
  • Provide advice and support on heritage requirements, risks and appropriate management measures.
  • Engage with First Nations Peoples and regulators on heritage management, information and approvals.

Working at APA

​

We proudly own, operate and manage a diverse $20 billion portfolio of assets which deliver essential services to communities and customers across Australia. And we own more than 15,000 kilometres of gas pipelines which deliver energy to households and businesses across every corner of Australia.

As the partner of choice in delivering infrastructure solutions for the energy transition, we’re focused on bundled remote grid energy solutions, electricity and gas transmission, and future energy, including hydrogen and carbon capture and storage.

Our customer focused approach means we understand our customers and offer them reliable, innovative, and cost-effective energy solutions that support their decarbonisation ambitions.

We are committed to securing Australia’s energy future by delivering infrastructure solutions for Australia’s energy transition and supporting the decarbonisation ambitions of our customers and communities.

title: Clinical Documentation Specialist - Lead
description:
Clinical Documentation Specialist - Lead

Part time (0.8FTE)

Malvern


We’re building for the better!

By 2036, more than 150,000 patients will look to us for healthcare every year.


At Cabrini Health we champion community, compassion and career fulfilment. Our teams are united by the shared purpose of making a meaningful contribution to exceptional, patient-centred care in well- resourced, world class facilities that inspire you to perform at your best and continuously grow professionally.


Turn your clinical expertise into influence, education and better outcomes for every patient.


Bring your clinical expertise to a role that improves the way care is understood, communicated and delivered across Cabrini.

We are seeking an experienced medical or surgical Registered Nurse to join our Clinical Documentation Improvement team as the Lead Clinical Documentation Specialist. This is a unique opportunity to move your clinical knowledge beyond the bedside and influence patient safety, quality of care, clinician communication and the accurate reflection of patient complexity across the organisation.


Working closely with nurses, medical staff and multidisciplinary teams, you will review clinical documentation, identify opportunities for improvement and support clinicians to ensure the patient record tells the full clinical story. You will combine strong clinical judgement with education, relationship-building and practical problem-solving to embed high-quality documentation into everyday practice.


This role is ideally suited to an experienced acute-care nurse who enjoys clinical thinking, working collaboratively and supporting others to learn. You will have the opportunity to apply your understanding of disease processes, co-morbidities and complications in a new and highly influential way, while helping improve both patient outcomes and organisational performance.


You will bring:

  • Current AHPRA registration and substantial medical or surgical nursing experience in a medium to large health service
  • Broad clinical knowledge, including anatomy, physiology and disease processes
  • A genuine interest in education, quality improvement and accurate clinical communication
  • Confidence engaging constructively with clinicians across a range of specialties
  • Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills, with excellent attention to detail
  • Experience in casemix, discharge planning, coding, funding or clinical documentation improvement is desirable, but not essential

What we offer:

  • Salary packaging: up to $15,900 tax-free each year, plus $2650 meal & entertainment card benefits
  • Convenience: Vibrant Malvern location, close to local shops, cafes and public transport
  • Travel Perks: Myki Commuter discounted fares
  • A commitment to health and wellbeing initiatives including discounted access to a wide range of gyms, pools, and fitness facilities through Fitness Passport
  • Access to a range of retail offers, discounted hospital services and savings on eligible private health fund services

At Cabrini, you will be supported to develop expertise in clinical documentation improvement while contributing to a service that puts people, safety and quality at the centre of every decision.


Step into a role where your clinical voice shapes practice, builds capability and makes every patient story count.


To view the full position description click here


Enquiries should be directed to Megan Mills Group Director Nursing , Allied Health & Clinical Education on 03 9508 1381


Apply early! This role may close sooner than the listed closing date if we find the right candidate – so don’t wait to get your application in.


Does this sound like your new role? Bring your skills and enthusiasm to Cabrini Health and help optimise the patient experience and health outcomes for our community.

Cabrini Health acknowledges the importance of creating a work environment that is welcoming, safe, equitable and inclusive for people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is core to our mission.

As part of our commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples.

Working for Cabrini

Cabrini Health is a Catholic, private, for-purpose health service located in Melbourne’s southeast. Inspired by the mission and ethic of care of the Cabrini Sisters, providing quality, compassionate care to our community for more than 75 years.

There is something special about Cabrini Health. Our highly skilled staff and specialists incorporate clinical research, innovative models of care and state-of-the-art technology to deliver the best possible care and outcomes for our patients. We demonstrate our mission to serve our community through outreach programs that support asylum seekers, provide healthcare in rural communities and in underdeveloped countries.

Our size, reputation and growth strategy ensure genuine opportunities for our people to learn, grow and realise potential.

Our values: Compassion - Integrity - Courage - Respect

MANDATORY FOR ALL NEW STAFF TO CABRINI

Employment with Cabrini Health will be based on satisfactory background checks such as professional references, National Police Check, vaccinations for annual Influenza plus a Working with Children Check (WWCC) may also be requested. Vaccination for COVID-19 is highly recommended.

title: Process Integration Development Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Join Intel and Build a Better Tomorrow

At Intel, we are driving the next generation of semiconductor technology that powers the world's most advanced computing platforms. As part of the Manufacturing Development and Customer Engineering (MDCE) and Logic Technology Development (LTD) organizations, you will contribute to process technology innovations that enable Intel's future product roadmap and foundry growth strategy.This is an opportunity to work alongside world-class scientists and engineers to develop breakthrough semiconductor manufacturing processes and bring leading-edge technologies from development into high-volume manufacturing.

What You'll Do

As a Process Integration Development Engineer, you will lead and execute scientific research that enables the development, integration, and manufacturing of advanced semiconductor technologies. You will work across multiple process modules to optimize device performance, yield, reliability, and manufacturability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead scientific research supporting the development of innovative semiconductor device architectures and advanced process technologies.
  • Design, execute, and analyze experiments to establish robust process integration solutions that meet device and technology requirements.
  • Apply statistical methodologies and data-driven approaches to solve complex process integration challenges.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across process engineering, device engineering, yield analysis, characterization, and manufacturing organizations.
  • Develop and implement process integration strategies that drive technology readiness and manufacturing success.
  • Identify root causes of process and device performance issues and develop corrective actions.
  • Contribute to intellectual property development through invention disclosures, patents, and technical publications.
  • Integrate multiple semiconductor process steps into a cohesive manufacturing flow for advanced logic technologies.
  • Support technology transfer and manufacturing ramp activities using Intel's Copy Exactly methodology.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on yield enhancement, process capability, reliability, and cycle-time reduction.

What We Are Looking For

The Ideal Candidate Demonstrates:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Scientific curiosity and a passion for innovation.
  • Ability to interpret complex datasets and derive actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and technical presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Project leadership skills and a track record of delivering results.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative mindset with a commitment to operational excellence.

Qualifications:

The minimum qualifications listed below would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experience and / or schoolwork/classes/research. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
  • 2+ years of semiconductor industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Semiconductor processing.
    • Semiconductor fabrication.
    • Nanotechnology
  • Experience with the following:
    • Design of Experiments (DOE).
    • Statistical Process Control (SPC).
    • Computational data analysis and data-driven decision making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in semiconductor process development, device fabrication, or nanotechnology.
  • Experience with electrical characterization of transistors or other semiconductor devices.
  • Experience leading technical projects and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of advanced process integration methodologies for logic technology development.
  • Experience utilizing statistical analysis tools such as JMP, Python, R, MATLAB, or similar computational platforms.
  • Prior contributions to patents, technical publications, or intellectual property development.

Why Intel?

At Intel, your work will help create groundbreaking technologies that improve the lives of billions of people worldwide. We provide opportunities to innovate, grow your career, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

title: Principal, Mobile Product Designer
description:
Manulife is a leading international financial services group serving over 33 million customers across the globe. We are hard at work to transform our organization into a digital, customer-centric market leader, evolving our customer interactions into innovative, elegant, and highly functional digital experiences delivering high value.

The barrier to the financial services industry can be complex but it doesn’t have to be; our mission is to simplify financial services by making decisions easier and lives better.


Our Product Design team is looking for a Principal, Mobile Product Designer.


You’ll help drive mobile transformation, turning customer needs and business goals into intuitive, data-led experiences that drive growth and value.


You’ll collaborate with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Accessibility, and other partners to solve complex challenges and carry ideas from early discovery through delivery and iteration.


You’ll bring a curious, questioning mind, strong product thinking, and an exceptional creative eye. As part of a collaborative and inclusive team, you’ll help transform financial services in ways that simplify complexity and improve the lives of Canadians.


Position Responsibilities:

  • Shaping native mobile experiences across iOS and Android, with the judgment to determine when experiences should align with responsive web and when native capabilities call for a different approach.
  • Partnering with Product, Engineering, Research and other disciplines to frame complex problems and turn customer needs and business goals into desirable, viable and feasible solutions.
  • Helping advance our customer-led vision and Product Design practice, bringing strong product thinking and design craft to transformation work.
  • Using research, customer insights and product data to inform decisions, challenge assumptions and measure outcomes.
  • Leading design from discovery through delivery and iteration, facilitating collaboration and clearly articulating the thinking behind decisions.
  • Contributing to the evolution of Manulife’s mobile design system and raising the bar for quality, consistency and accessibility.
  • Exploring and applying AI tools to accelerate workflows, prototyping and learning without compromising design judgment.

How you’ll show up

  • A team player: Collaborative, transparent and low ego. You make the people and work around you better
  • Committed to quality: Set a high bar for design craft and experiences that deliver real value
  • Confident: Bring strong, informed opinions while staying open to challenge and evidence
  • Evidence-led + customer-focused: Use research, customer insights and product data to connect customer needs with business outcomes
  • Deeply empathetic: Advocate for customers while balancing business goals and technical realities
  • A realistic visionary: Think big while balancing ambition, constraints and what it takes to ship
  • An owner of your craft: Care deeply about product problems, design quality and the details that make experiences great
  • A strong communicator: Make complex ideas clear and bring others along.
  • AI curious: Understand AI’s opportunities and limitations and apply it where it makes the work better

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years acting as a product designer with a strong focus on native mobile experience across iOS and Android and mastery of Figma.
  • A strong portfolio showing how you frame complex problems, explore ideas, apply product thinking and exceptional design craft, collaborate, and measure the impact of shipped work.
  • Strong end-to-end product design skills, from discovery and user validation through prototyping, high-fidelity design, delivery and iteration.
  • Experience working with mobile design systems, accessibility and native platform patterns, with an understanding of how experiences connect across mobile and web.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design and other disciplines to solve complex problems and bring ideas to life.
  • Experience with AI-assisted tools and workflows, including tools like Figma Make and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate exploration and prototyping without compromising design judgment.
  • Experience working in iterative product teams and using customer insights and product data to improve experiences after launch. Financial services experience is an asset.
  • Strong understanding of native iOS and Android capabilities, including accessibility features and SDKs, and the judgment to know when to leverage platform conventions and where to design beyond them.

When you join our team:

  • As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
  • We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
  • We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

title: SVP Business Strategy and Enterprise Initiatives
description:
Osaic Careers


Executive Strategy Opportunity in Financial Services

Head of Business Strategy and Enterprise Initiatives

Location(s):

*** Preferred *** Scottsdale: 18700 N Hayden Rd, Suite 255, Scottsdale, AZ 85255

Atlanta: 2300 Windy Ridge Pkwy SE, Suite750, Atlanta, GA 30339

La Vista:12325 Port Grace Blvd, La Vista, NE 68128

Oakdale: 7755 3rd St. N, Oakdale, MN 55128

St. Petersburg: 877 Executive Center Dr. W, Suite 300, St. Petersburg, FL 33702

Osaic is not considering remote candidates at this time.

Osaic has returned to the office on a hybrid schedule requiring a minimum of 4 days weekly in the office. Applicants should be located at one of our hubs listed above and must be willing to work this schedule.

Role Type:

Full-time, Exempt

Salary: The base salary range starts $250,000 - $275,000 per year + annual performance-based bonus

Actual compensation offered will be determined individually, based on several job-related factors, including location, skills, licensure, experience, and education.

Our competitive compensation is just one component of Osaic’s total compensation package. Additional benefits include health, vision, dental insurance, 401k, paid time away, volunteer days and much more. To view more details of what you can look forward to, visit our careers page: .

Summary:

Osaic is seeking a Head of Business Strategy and Enterprise Initiatives to serve as a strategic partner to the CEO/President and Executive Committee. This Senior Vice President will help Osaic anticipate market, competitive, and industry developments that could create new opportunities or put the company’s five-year strategy at risk, bringing an objective, enterprise-wide perspective to the company’s most important strategic questions.

Operating as a central integrator, the SVP connects strategy, analysis, executive decision-making, and implementation. The role leads enterprise strategic planning, business research and insights, a portfolio of high-value enterprise initiatives, and Executive Committee and Board planning, translating the five-year strategy into annual priorities, enterprise KPIs, and measurable outcomes. While business and functional leaders remain accountable for execution, this leader ensures enterprise initiatives have clear plans, owners, resources, milestones, KPIs, governance, and transparent reporting.

Education Requirements:

Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Strategy, or a related field preferred, bachelor’s degree from accredited university field required.

Responsibilities:

· Enterprise Strategic Planning: Lead the planning process and cadence across business units and functions, connecting business plans, budgets, investments, and enterprise KPIs to the five-year strategy. Surface gaps, dependencies, and trade-offs for executive decision, and periodically reassess the assumptions underlying the strategy.

· Research, Foresight, and Insights: Build an enterprise research and competitive intelligence capability spanning wealth management, financial advisor channels, RIA models, products, platforms, technology, and asset management. Develop clear points of view on market developments and their implications for Osaic.

· Strategic Questions and Business Cases: Frame Osaic’s most important strategic questions and define the work plans to answer them through internal analysis, external research, scenario modeling, market assessments, consultant engagements, RFPs, and pilots.

· Enterprise Initiatives and Implementation: Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives sponsored by the CEO/President and Executive Committee. Translate decisions into charters, roadmaps, milestones, and KPIs; mobilize cross-functional teams and external partners; and manage initiatives through implementation and handoff to accountable operating owners.

· KPIs and Performance Reporting: Partner with Finance and accountable leaders to define enterprise KPIs, maintain an integrated view of performance, distinguish activity from actual value delivered, and identify where decisions or interventions are required.

· Governance and Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the link between Executive Committee decisions and Operating Committee implementation. Clarify decision rights, ownership, and escalation paths across Finance, Technology, Operations, Product, Human Resources, Marketing, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and the advisor businesses.

· Executive Committee and Board Support: Oversee the Executive Committee’s strategic planning and decision-making cadence. Lead Board planning, including the annual Board and committee calendar, agendas, and the quality of Board materials and executive reporting.

· M&A and Strategic Opportunities: Support the evaluation of M&A, partnerships, and new business models through market analysis, business cases, and scenario analysis, and establish governance for major integrations and value realization.

Basic Requirements:

  • 12+ years of progressive senior experience in enterprise strategy, strategic planning, enterprise transformation, corporate development, business operations, executive governance, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated success shaping and implementing enterprise strategy within a complex organization, including translating multi-year strategies into annual priorities, enterprise KPIs, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Proven ability to frame and answer ambiguous strategic questions using structured analysis, external research, financial and business analysis, and executive judgment.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional enterprise initiatives from concept through implementation, working through business and functional owners rather than direct operating control.
  • Significant experience leading internal teams and external consultants, advisors, and vendors, including designing RFPs, market assessments, business cases, and partner evaluations.
  • Considerable experience in wealth management, financial services, banking, asset management, or another highly regulated industry, with a strong understanding of advisor channels, RIA models, advisor economics, and technology, competitive, and regulatory trends.
  • Experience supporting CEOs, Presidents, Executive Committees, and Boards of Directors.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with M&A, partnerships, diligence, integration planning, or post-transaction value realization is strongly preferred; experience in a private-equity-backed or similarly performance-oriented environment is preferred.
  • Experience in enterprise strategy and transformation; corporate strategy; business operations and enterprise execution; corporate development and integration; business intelligence and competitive research; CEO or enterprise Chief of Staff; strategic program or portfolio leadership; Partner- or Principal-level management consulting; or senior wealth management or financial-services leadership with substantial strategy and enterprise-implementation responsibility.

Key Competencies

  • Think and operate at an enterprise level, optimizing Osaic's long-term success rather than a single business, function, or initiative.
  • Bring strategic foresight and pattern recognition, and develop a clear point of view with decisive recommendations.
  • Influence senior leaders without relying on formal authority and challenge assumptions constructively.
  • Balance strategic thinking with disciplined program management, creating pace, clarity, accountability, and measurable progress.
  • Communicate complex issues simply for executive and Board audiences, with exceptional judgment, discretion, integrity, and executive presence.

title: Customer Experience Manager: Training
description:
Job Description:

TTI Consumer Power Tools, Inc., has an opening in its Anderson, SC office for a Customer Experience (CX) Manager: Training that oversees the training needs with the Customer Experience operations across multiple regions and business units, ensuring consistent service delivery and continuous improvement across the U.S., Mexico, LATAM, and offshore BPO teams, and others.
