title: Director-Third Party Risk Assessment
description:
About Our Company


We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world.

Job Description

Lead the Third-Party Risk Assessment team responsible for the Enterprise Vendor Risk Assessment Process. Provide thought leadership and oversight for the continuous improvement of the processes (ongoing reviews, reporting and exception escalation) enabling adoption and compliance throughout the enterprise. Report third party risks for updates to Chief Risk Officer for updates to appropriate Risk Committees. Serves as subject matter expert on Third Party Risk Assessment (TPRA) processes and supports lines of business and Risk Domain Partners.

Job Description:


  • Leads the implementation of strategic change within the Third-Party Risk Assessment team.
  • Assists the Sr. Director and VP in setting the TPRA change agenda.
  • Develop reporting and metrics which enable the effective management of team core processes and business units in identifying and managing Third Party Risk.
  • Partners with Operational Risk, Enterprise Procurement, Risk Domains and Business Owners to consistently enhance the Company’s visibility into Third Party Risk through shared processes, reporting and communications.
  • Leads the India Third Party Risk Assessment team in executing the Enterprise Framework per the Enterprise TPRM Policy and SLAs.
  • Employs appropriate re-engineering to streamline processes and enhance line of business experience and process planning.
  • Leads the implementation and maintenance of supporting systems and ensures safe handling of third-party data.
  • Improves and manages process, controls, training and feedback to create a high-performing team.
  • With the VP of Operational Risk Management Centers of Excellence and TPRM, support on updates to the Enterprise Third Party Risk Management Policy, updating procedure manuals and systems documentation.
  • Create training and presentations when needed and lead employee and business partner training as required to implement change and drive integration of the framework.
  • Lead and facilitate third party incident triage calls.
  • Make recommendations to CRO and Risk Committees for necessary changes to support regulatory guidance.
  • Govern and manage the third party financial health and Sanctions programs.
  • Solid understanding of regulatory requirements for managing third party risk.
  • Prior experience in implementing a third-party risk management program
  • Strong process design experience
  • Strong conceptual thinking skills and ability to organize and understand data
  • Demonstrated global people leadership experience, either through direct leadership or coaching/mentoring roles.

title: Principal Quality Systems Specialist
description:
The Principal Quality Systems Specialist is responsible for providing quality oversight and expertise of the pharmaceutical quality systems for the Cell and Gene Therapy team based in San Diego, CA. You will also provide quality leadership of the development, implementation, and on-going management of the quality management system and programs including risk management, change management, planned and unplanned events, training, documentation and records management, and data integrity. Lastly, you will support and/or lead relevant strategic initiatives, as applicable.

The Opportunity

  • Coordinate work across systems, functions, and sites to harmonize workflow, clearly identify responsibilities, and optimize cross functional team member participation
  • Lead development, review, and revision of SOPs and procedural documents
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to determine training needs and update curricula
  • Monitor implementation of systems and assist in execution, performance and effectiveness ensuring compliance to procedures and regulations and identifying areas for improvement
  • Create routine and ad hoc Quality Management Review metrics for all Quality Systems
  • Provide project and validation oversight related to Quality Systems applications
  • Additional responsibilities include supporting internal and external audits, deviation/CAPA management, complaints investigations, all while promoting a culture of compliance throughout the organization through continuous improvement initiatives
  • Continue to improve Roche’s overall Quality Management System (QMS) and quality manual, policies, and procedures while keeping them current with emerging and changing regulations, guidance documents, and current industry best practices and expectations.
  • Provide timely support for Health Authority interactions and author/review responses to relevant Health Authority information requests
  • Perform tasks in a manner consistent with safety policies, quality systems, and cGTP/GMP and Health Authority requirements and guidances

title: Customer service medewerker
description:
Zo ziet je job er uit

Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?

Je dag begint met een overtuigende goeiemorgen en een eerste energieshot: een lekkere kop thee of Nespresso koffie. Je start je computer op, meldt je aan en bekijkt de eerste binnengekomen vragen en bestellingen via e-mail. Of via telefoon. Of via … Je screent elke mail, bestelling of (prijs)aanvraag en analyseert ook complexere vragen. Wanneer je het antwoord weet of een bestelling hebt kunnen inboeken, roep je net geen eureka. Je doet het nodige voor de klant en antwoordt hem zo duidelijk mogelijk. Klant tevreden, jij ook tevreden!

Tussen de telefoons en mails door roep je nog een paar keer goeiemorgen: je collega-chauffeurs zijn heel vroeg gestart en komen tussendoor nog even binnenspringen. En je groet ook andere collega’s, want hun werkdag start vandaag iets later. Maar morgen is het jouw beurt om een uurtje langer te snoozen. ’s Middags neem je een break en neem je de tijd om er even uit te zijn, bij te praten met je collega’s en je weekendplannen te bespreken. Je ontdekt de pas geleverde fruitmand en met een lekker stuk vitamine C in de hand start je je namiddag om nog meer Happy Customers te maken.

Jij wordt warm van:

  • het helpen enontzorgen van (potentiële) klanten: je werkt met en vóór mensen die op je rekenen om hun (telefonische) mazoutbestellingen op te nemen, in te plannen en op te volgen en natuurlijk ook hun vragen te beantwoorden.
  • het uitvoeren van het complete verkoops- en leveringstraject voor je klant: van de prijsopgave over de bestelling tot het concreet inplannen van de mazoutlevering, in samenwerking met je collega’s van dispatch.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Jij bent de verschilmaker omdat:

  • je met je klantvriendelijke, sterk empathische en commerciële, oplossingsgerichte charmes elke klant er altijd warm kan laten bijzitten.
  • je meerdere ballen tegelijkertijd in de lucht kan houden zonder in te boeten op flexibiliteit, stressbestendigheid en accuraatheid. Je maakt er een punt van om gegevens nauwkeurig te verwerken, gebruik makend van toepassingen zoals MS-Office.
  • je je Nederlandstalige of Franstalige klant weet warm te houden via een fijne conversatie, die eenvoudig en makkelijk te begrijpen is dankzij je vlotte en verzorgde communicatie skills aan telefoon of schriftelijk.
  • je beschikt over hoge wattages aan respect, tact en diplomatie. Zo sta je open om feedback te krijgen, maar ook om te geven. Want zo helpen wij elkaar groeien!

De ideale collega is...

  • iemand die zich thuis voelt in een familiale KMO
  • graag kwalitatief werkt, in plaats van kwantitatief

title: Senior CRA II
description:
Senior CRA II

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP):Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records
    Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines
    Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and action items to resolution.
  • Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in and may lead global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • May provide direct supervision, training and/or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. Performs training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned. May be mentored and assigned lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL) or operational line manager. This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings.
  • For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA II will use the business card title of Sr.Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:
    Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs
    Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    As required, collaborate and build relationship with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff
    The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff
    Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager
    Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.
    Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements
    Develop study and country level informed consent forms
    Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared
    Participate in bid defense meetings
    Provide input into Requests for Proposals (RFPs), scope and budgeting. Develop site management strategy.
    Participate in Case Report Form design and edit check development.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Moderate level of critical thinking skills expected.
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Get to know Syneos Health


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. title: Sr. Product Designer- Experience Design
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


ESIGN@LILLY | EXPERIENCE DESIGN

Sr. Product Designer - Experience Design | 3-5 years

Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes.


As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build.


Path/Level:

R3

ABOUT THE ROLE
As an Experience Designer at Lilly, you will spend most of your time in the problem space — defining flows, validating ideas with users, and shaping how experiences work before they are built. At Lilly, that means your work has real stakes: the people on the other end of your screens are patients, caregivers, and the scientists trying to help them.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we will expect from you:

  • Elevate and maintain design standards through direct contribution across a wide range of outputs and mediums, from digital products to patient-facing experiences.
  • Understand component-based design systems and know when to follow existing patterns and when to break constraints.
  • Present and persuasively communicate design rationale at all levels, incorporate feedback constructively, and build trust with collaborators across the organization.
  • Demonstrate accountability, flexibility, and initiative, with the ability to prioritize and deliver results efficiently.
  • Embrace a learning and growth mindset, stay current on industry trends and tools, and contribute positively to a culture of critique, collaboration, and honest reflection at Design@Lilly.
  • Produce polished, independent work across UX from research synthesis through delivery.
  • Reframe ambiguous briefs, identify the real design opportunity, and build alignment before execution begins.
  • Begin informally mentoring junior designers through critique and shared working sessions.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of experience in UX for digital products and experiences.
  • A collaborative spirit and the ability to build strong working relationships and navigate conflict constructively with peers and partners.
  • A degree in Design (Digital Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
  • An exceptional portfolio of design work spanning multiple projects and mediums, with a focus on interface or screen-based experiences.
  • Demonstrable experience identifying and addressing user pain points, synthesizing research, and advocating for user-centered design.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable for a broad range of collaborators.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with a high level of intellectual curiosity and a passion for innovation in digital health.

title: Analyst/ Associate, Internal Control
description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG is seeking a dedicated Internal Control Professional to join their Planning Department, Internal Control and Administration team for GCIB in Singapore. This role offers you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in ensuring robust governance and effective control activities across the division. You will be at the heart of maintaining high standards of compliance, supporting business continuity, and safeguarding information security within one of the world’s leading financial institutions. MUFG values your commitment to accuracy, your collaborative spirit, and your ability to connect with stakeholders across departments. The organisation is renowned for its supportive leadership, inclusive culture, and ongoing training opportunities that empower you to grow professionally while contributing meaningfully to the team’s success.

  • Join a globally respected financial institution where your attention to detail and commitment to quality will directly impact divisional governance and operational excellence.
  • Work closely with diverse teams and stakeholders, fostering strong inter-personal connections and sharing knowledge to ensure seamless implementation of internal controls.
  • Benefit from MUFG’s commitment to professional development, working opportunities, and a supportive team environment that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.

What you'll do:

As an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you will take on a multifaceted role spanning internal controls, governance, operational resilience and management support. Working closely with various departments, you will help ensure that GCIB maintains effective controls, appropriate governance standards and accurate control-related records.


Your responsibilities will include coordinating GCIB self-inspections, managing SOX reporting processes, tracking remediation actions and following up on findings through to closure. You will also coordinate business continuity management activities, including disaster recovery exercises, and maintain critical records such as call trees and next-of-kin information.


In addition to overseeing and driving greater consistency in SOPs and governance documentation on SharePoint, you will support non-system information security controls to help ensure appropriate standards for information handling are maintained. You will also monitor incidents and support timely escalation and reporting where required.


Your responsibilities will extend to vault governance, including record reconciliation and periodic access reviews, as well as the maintenance of authorities-related documentation, including Letters of Delegation of Authority, Deeds of Substitution and authorised signature lists.


You will also provide ad-hoc administrative and management support to help ensure the smooth running of the department. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, sound control awareness and the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders, while remaining flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities.

· Perform and coordinate GCIB self-inspection processes, SOX reporting and spreadsheet controls, including the management of findings, supporting evidence, remediation tracking and follow-up actions.

· Oversee and drive greater consistency in standard operating procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices and internal guidelines, and maintain related governance documentation on GCIB SharePoint.

· Perform and coordinate business continuity management activities, including business impact analysis, call tree and next-of-kin record maintenance, disaster recovery exercises and other related activities.

· Serve as PIC for incident monitoring and reporting, ensuring timely escalation, communication and accurate documentation of events affecting divisional operations.

title: Product Software Engineer
description:
About Role:

Under general supervision, designs, develops, tests, debugs and deploys routine to moderately complex customer-intent software solutions, along with supporting software tools and utilities required for the operation, maintenance, and control of the software system. Makes routine to moderately complex modifications to existing software to fit specialized needs and configurations and maintains program libraries and technical documentation. Assists in planning, scheduling and implementation and initiates corrective action(s) to stay on schedule.


Essential Duties and responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain modern SaaS web applications using TypeScript, React, Node.js and AngularJS
  • Implement user stories and fix defects in line with team coding standards and the approved architectural patterns
  • Contribute to the migration of legacy AngularJS components to React under the guidance of senior engineers
  • Write unit tests for own code and maintain the team's agreed coverage levels
  • Apply security best practices for web applications, including authentication and authorization mechanisms
  • Build responsive, accessible and cross-browser compatible user interfaces and help optimize UI performance
  • Use Kibana for log analysis and monitoring, and support the investigation of production issues
  • Participate in Agile development, estimation and sprint planning, and take part in peer code reviews
  • Contribute to technical discussions, continually learn about new technologies and suggest ideas to improve the product

Job Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in the software industry
  • Experience working in Agile teams using React, Node.js, TypeScript and various datastores (e.g., Redis)
  • Good UI skills, a solid understanding of frontend frameworks, and exposure to modern cloud-based applications
  • Key Skills:
  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS/SASS, JavaScript (ES2020+), TypeScript, React, AngularJS (1.x), state management (e.g., Redux, nanostores)
  • Backend & API Integration: Node.js, Express, building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Testing: Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, Mocha, Sinon
  • Build & Tooling: Rush/pnpm monorepo, Webpack, Vite, Git (Bitbucket/GitHub), Jira
  • Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker (containers for local development), Jenkins CI/CD pipelines
  • Security & Observability: OWASP Top 10 awareness, secure coding, ELK/Kibana, SonarQube
  • Mandatory Skills:
  • Strong experience in TypeScript, React and Node.js
  • Working knowledge of AngularJS (1.x)
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Knowledge of security best practices (e.g., authentication, authorization, secure coding)
  • Experience in unit testing (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library)
  • Competencies/Soft skills:
  • Critical thinker who enjoys engineering challenges
  • Proficiency in English, both verbal and written
  • Experience working in an international environment with different cultures
  • Proactive and comfortable reaching out to other teams for help and suggestions
  • Able to clearly present problems and propose well-reasoned solutions
  • Eager to learn and open to feedback from senior engineers
  • Supplemental skills (nice to have):
  • Design for accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
  • AI-assisted development (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to enhance productivity
  • Experience with design systems and shared component libraries
  • Legal, regulatory or publishing domain experience

Travel requirements

title: Research Assistant - Digital Health, AI, and Health Economics
description:

We are seeking a Research Assistant in the School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences to support projects led by Associate Professor Centaine Snoswell, applying specialist expertise in data analysis, health technology and health economics to contribute to meaningful research outcomes.


Key responsibilities will include:


  • Contribute subject matter expertise to projects on topics within digital health, generative artificial intelligence in healthcare, and health economic evaluation.
  • Undertake advanced research activities using appropriate scientific and research methods, applying specialist technical knowledge and skills to support high-quality outcomes using quantitative and qualitative analytical techniques.
  • Maintain accurate research records, technical documentation and effective data management practices, while supporting strong research housekeeping and a proactive safety culture.
  • Support the development of junior research staff and students, and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing research environment.

This is a part-time (20% FTE), fixed-term position for 12 months at HEW Level 5 based at our Dutton Park campus.

  • Completion of a relevant degree in health with subsequent post-graduate or PhD-level experience in coordinating research activities. Applicant may be a PhD candidate.
  • Experience coordinating research activities in digital health, generative artificial intelligence, and health economics.
  • Experience presenting work in diverse formats, including various media types (radio, or online articles), book chapters, and journal articles.
  • Demonstrated research knowledge and skills across specialist and general research techniques, including quantitative and qualitative analysis, data management and manuscript preparation.
  • Well-developed problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to plan ahead, prioritise competing tasks and meet deadlines.

title: General Manager II - Store 6400 - Dublin, GA
description:
Job Description

What is a General Manager?

A General Manager must be committed to inspiring our team, helping our Customers succeed and growing our business with integrity. Professional level sales and management position capable of supporting functions on both sides of the business. The role requires understanding of store systems, automotive systems, parts knowledge and has the ability to identify, troubleshoot and project assist for DIY. Responsible for developing and maintaining Professional Customer relationships and program growth. Is accountable for achieving financial metrics and maintaining service and appearance standards. Position is exempt and requires a minimum of 50-55 hours per week (excluding meal break periods). The average schedule is 5-6 days a week, 11 hour shifts, including rotating nights and weekends, with an hour for lunch. Additional hours may be required based on staffing, store conditions, sales to target, and other business demands. General Managers are required to work a schedule based on the needs of the business.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Achieve overall store sales goals and service objectives
  • Manage and grow Professional Customer relationships/sales, including building and holding team accountable to executing Customer action plans
  • Selection, hiring, development, performance mgmt., coaching, scheduling and engagement of store Team Members
  • Ensure execution of all inventory and operational standards
  • Coach all Team Members to deliver on Customer expectations (DIY and Professional)
  • Manager on duty responsibilities (touch base/coaching, floor/phone mgmt., task assignment and completion, safety, open/close duties)
  • Ability to lead change management
  • Embrace diversity and foster a respectful environment for both Customers and Team Members

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Provide DIY service including battery installation, testing, wiper install, etc.
  • Assist District/Region in other functions upon request

Success Factors

  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Ability to become ASE P2 certified or ASE ready equivalent
  • Ability to execute and train project and product quality recommendations
  • Advanced parts lookup and sourcing
  • Ability to source from numerous places including special order, FDO, second source, etc.
  • Ability to execute and train all store operational processes and procedures, and testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY services
  • Ability to execute and train inventory systems and store equipment
  • Ability to execute and train POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Ability to review and analyze P&L statement
  • Ability to recruit, select, hire and develop quality Team Members
  • Ability to build and grow relationships with Professional Customers

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a General Manager

  • Working knowledge of automotive systems preferred
  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with Customers, peers and upper management
  • Use Microsoft software effectively (Word, Excel required; PowerPoint preferred)
  • Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, percentages, sales increases, and gross profit percent
  • Ability to review and analyze business reports, such as profit and loss statement (P&L)
  • Hold others accountable, inspect work quality and give feedback in a way that is inspiring
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings and weekends as needed
  • Prior Experience that Sets a General Manager up for Success
  • 2-3 years of experience managing a team of 10 - 20 Team Members in a fast-paced and highly dynamic retail environment
  • Successful experience managing profitability; proven financial and business acumen

Education

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED), Bachelor’s degree in business or a related area preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • ASE certification preferred, but not required

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Position is eligible for sales commission based on individual or store performance.

title: Portfolio Strategy & Transformation Lead
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Portfolio Strategy & Transformation Lead (100%) to join our Global Portfolio Management team within the Flow division in Switzerland. In this high-impact role, you will help transform portfolio management into a strategic business capability across the Water & Industrial Business Unit (WIBU), enabling data-driven decision-making, profitable growth, and long-term portfolio optimization.

You will establish portfolio governance, performance transparency, product hierarchy ownership, lifecycle management practices, and strategic portfolio steering processes. Working across functions and senior stakeholder groups, you will play a key role in shaping the future direction of our portfolio and driving business transformation.



Your main tasks and responsibilities:


  • Own and evolve the Product Hierarchy framework by driving the WIBU Product Hierarchy program, ensuring clear ownership, consistent product classification, improved master data quality, and successful milestone delivery.

  • Drive strategic portfolio steering by developing and facilitating portfolio review processes that support investment decisions, lifecycle management, portfolio optimization, resource allocation, and growth initiatives.
  • Generate market, competitive, and portfolio intelligence by consolidating insights on market trends, customer needs, competitive developments, portfolio gaps, and emerging business opportunities in collaboration with segment, product management, and development teams.
  • Lead portfolio transformation initiatives related to portfolio governance, lifecycle excellence, digitalization, product master data, performance and pricing management, and process harmonization across the organization.
  • Act as a trusted partner to senior leaders, enabling fact-based portfolio decisions and fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.



To succeed in this role, you will need:


  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; an MBA is a strong plus.
  • 5-8 years of experience in portfolio management, strategy, business transformation, product management, or a related function within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex market, portfolio, and business data into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience driving cross-functional transformation initiatives involving product management, commercial functions, operations, R&D, and senior leadership.
  • Strong change management and project management skills with a track record of driving business improvement and transformation.
  • Digital mindset with experience using analytics and reporting tools to drive performance management and business insights.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Position Description:

The Office of Research and Innovation (Sponsored Programs Administration) at the University of Louisville is seeking an Associate Director to oversee the sponsored programs compliance program to facilitate compliance with federal and state regulations, Sponsor and University requirements, and University policies and procedures. Compliance areas that fall under the responsibility of this position include oversight of effort certification, sponsored programs cost allowability, review of additional pay requests, review of departmental agreement requests, management of the annual single audit process, and oversight of federal training grant and fellowship programs. Provide strategic and operational leadership to OSPA Compliance personnel, overseeing all day-to-day operations and ensuring accountability for compliance outcomes. This position will serve as a main point of contact to answer questions and offer authoritative guidance and training to university personnel engaged in Effort Reporting. The position requires a deep understanding of federal regulations surrounding sponsored programs as well as state and university policy and administrative procedure. The position will serve as a primary contact within the Office of Sponsored Programs Administration (OSPA) for audit and compliance tracking and reporting.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the compliance program over sponsored program activities (grants and contracts). The following compliance activities are included in the program; oversight of effort certification for biweekly workers and semi-annual certification for salaried employees, control over cost allowability, management of audits and desk reviews (e.g., annual single audit), and the management of training grants and fellowships. The program will engage with other compliance areas routinely.
  • Supervise and oversee OSPA Compliance personnel involved in the university's sponsored programs compliance program and effort certification program.
  • Oversee and serve as point of contact for the University’s effort certification in Workday for biweekly workers and salaried employees. This includes offering training and guidance materials and videos, facilitating the certification and re-certification process, ensuring that 100% of effort reports are certified/re-certified so that payroll data match the certified reports, and coordinating related system updates as necessary.
  • Review and approve all additional pay requests (summer salary and/or work overload) on sponsored programs. Review and approve all Departmental Agreements (DA) requests on sponsored programs.
  • Maintain the University Direct Cost Policy including the direct cost allowability matrix, update spend restrictions according to revisions of the uniform guidance, determine the appropriate spend restrictions on all sponsored programs, and maintain object classes and spend categories in Workday, and create/update and deliver training materials to the research community.
  • Conduct internal operational reviews and spot-checks for identified sponsored programs. Facilitate the correction of identified deficiencies.
  • Develop training materials and deliver/facilitate educational sessions to OSPA and the research community on Effort Reporting and other aspects of sponsored programs compliance.
  • Maintain an advanced knowledge and understanding of Uniform Guidance and federal cost principles and guidelines established by the Office of Management and Budget and advise research leadership on fiscal compliance related issues. Identify emerging trends that may affect the conduct of sponsored projects at the university.
  • Advise and assist in the development and/or revision of university policies and procedures related to sponsored programs compliance objectives.
  • Develop procedures for and oversee the final closeout of awards in Workday, ensuring all reports and deliverables are met and saved in the system of records.
  • Provide operational support for internal and external audits related to sponsored programs. Lead Sponsored Programs response to the single audit annually and when research objectives are under detailed review.
  • Monitor work plans/audit plans for federal agencies and perform institutional health assessments in areas that are under review by these agencies.

title: Vizir søker: Erfaren kandidat innen Microsoft Dynamics 365
description:
Vizir søker: Har du flere års erfaring innen Microsoft Dynamics 365 ?

Da håper vi at du kontakter Vizir for en spennende mulighet.

For en attraktiv kunde i sterk vekst søker vi etter en konsulenter, som ønsker å være en del av et sterkt fagmiljø.

Er du en prosjektleder/arkitekt som ser helheten og brenner for å skape forretningsverdi?

Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring, innen Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, og som også har god oversikt over Power Platform, øvrige apper og Azure. Du ønsker en rolle der du får bruke både strategisk blikk og teknologiforståelse til å skape verdi for kundene våre.

Hos oss får du jobbe tett med kunden -- fra tidlig dialog og løsningsdesign til ferdig leveranse og kontinuerlig forbedring -- med fokus på å bygge løsninger som faktisk gjør en forskjell i virksomheten.

  • 5 og 10 års erfaring med Dynamics 365 Finance og Supply Chain Management.

  • Har erfaring med løsningsdesign og arkitektur på tvers av systemlandskap

  • Har fokus på leveransemetodikk og brenner for standardiserte og strukturerte prosesser

  • Har deltatt i presales og trives med dialogen i tidlig fase

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Er analytisk, forretningsorientert og god til å kommunisere

  • Er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi og motiveres av å lære og dele kunnskap

  • Jobber strukturert, forstår kundens behov og tenker langsiktig.

  • Du trives med å presentere løsninger og samarbeider godt i team.

Hos vår kunde får du:

  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag med hybridmodell og mulighet for hjemmekontor.

  • Tilhørighet til et sterkt fagmiljø med fokus på kunnskapsdeling og utvikling.

  • Prosjekter hos mellomstore og store virksomheter, ofte med kompleksitet og påvirkningskraft.

Vår kunde er i vekst og ser etter flere dyktige folk som vil være med og løfte både kundene og hverandre. Du vil få tilhørighet til ett av våre kontorer i Norge, og vi ser gjerne at du er innom kontoret én til to ganger i uken.

Syntes du at noen av de ovenfor beskrevne områdene er interessante vil vår kunde kunne tilby konkurransedyktige betingelser et godt miljø og gode fremtidige karrièremuligheter med meget kompetent kolleger. Noe reising må påregnes.

title: Camera and  Vision Software Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Role Overview As Intel accelerates its company-wide focus to define and execute to our Physical AI strategy, team is hiring a Camera and Vision Software Engineer focused on Linux-based direct camera enablement across GMSL (Gigabit Multimedia Serial Link), MIPI CSI-2, and industrial high-speed USB vision interfaces. You will work at the intersection of camera sensor hardware, serializer/deserializer (SerDes) silicon, Linux V4L2/Media Controller subsystems, and hardware-accelerated image signal processing (ISP) pipelines to provide robust perception solutions for next-generation robotics. Key Responsibilities, not limited to • Camera Driver Enablement and Optimization: Design, implement, and optimize Linux kernel camera drivers (V4L2, Media Controller framework) for MIPI CSI-2 direct cameras, GMSL/FPD-Link SerDes systems, and UVC/industrial USB3 cameras. • Multi-Camera Synchronization and SerDes Bring-Up: Architect and validate multi-camera hardware triggering, frame synchronization, timestamping, and low-latency serialization pipelines across complex robotic vision sensor arrays. • Pixel Pipeline and ISP Optimization: Enable RAW, YUV, and RGB direct ingest paths; collaborate with internal architecture and third-party ISP partners to tune auto-exposure (AE), auto-white-balance (AWB), high-dynamic-range (HDR), and color correction matrices (CCM) under challenging lighting conditions. • Customer Landing and Production Support: Work with robotics customer engineering teams to isolate camera drops, frame jitter, and signal integrity issues; develop reference camera drivers, board support package (BSP) overlays, and technical application notes

Qualifications:

Qualifications: -Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Imaging Science, or equivalent -Experience: Typically requires around 7 years of relevant industry experience in software engineering, while dynamic, high-potential junior/early-career software engineers with 2-3+ years of hands-on experience in embedded Linux are equally encouraged to apply (2-7+ years overall experience welcomed). Technical Proficiencies: • Expert knowledge of the Linux V4L2 framework, Media Controller, sub-device drivers, and DMA-BUF memory management. • Deep experience with camera interfaces: MIPI CSI-2, D-PHY/C-PHY, and automotive/robotics SerDes architectures (e.g., Maxim GMSL2/GMSL3, TI FPD-Link). • Hands-on experience bringing up YUV/RGB sensors (Sony, Omnivision, Onsemi etc.) and configuring deserializer hubs. • Familiarity with hardware video capture and camera calibration. • Experience with ROS 2 camera nodes and Intel OpenVINO / media acceleration stacks is a strong plus. • Soft Skills and Language: Analytical mindset, customer-enabling orientation, and proficiency in professional English

title: Manager, Lab Animal Operations
description:
Job Purpose:

The Manager, Operations is accountable for the overall operational performance and success of the operational areas of responsibility. This hands-on role will have a highly visible and dynamic leadership presence at the facility, supporting the implementation of company strategies and ensuring regulatory and operational compliance. This role demands a strong emphasis on safety, quality, productivity and operational efficiency, maintenance, and cost control/reduction.

*This position is on-site.

*Travel is required - ~25%

This position encompasses both day-to-day operational management and strategic planning and direction. Fundamental to the role are 1) adherence to management best practices and a clear understanding of the technical expertise and scientific requirements and capabilities across the site to fuel a solution-oriented culture; and 2) strong relationship-building skills in order to effectively manage and motivate a diverse range of people to deliver a high level of customer service.

The Manager, Operations will protect the Company’s brand by ensuring the areas of operational responsibility represents acceptable aesthetic, scientific and technical standards to deliver competently to our customers at all times. The role will actively support the continued growth of the business, attending customer visits, regulatory visits and ensuring measures are in place to comply and actions are delivered wherever necessary. Ensuring KPI metrics are met within the Lines of business on site and connecting different departments to ensure seamless delivery of projects on time.

The job description includes but is not limited to the outline described below.

Accountabilities in Operational Areas of Responsibility:

Financial responsibility

  • Having a good financial understanding of the profit and loss for the operational areas of responsibility is imperative.
  • Revenue recognition and cost control is a key accountability.

Visible leadership

  • Interacting with departments, quality assurance, safety and support staff site on general matters.
  • Hold regular meetings with staff and establish a two-way (upward and downward) communication.
  • Ensure cascading of important information
  • Attend opening and closing meetings with all customers and regulatory officials.

Compliance

  • Ensure all regulatory compliance is adhered to and that the duties and actions to maintain compliance are met in operational areas of responsibility.
  • Drive the quality metrics to ensure expected standards are met.
  • Tour Ready and 5S is implemented and regular inspections are held
  • Ensure familiarity and compliance with relevant Health and Safety regulations
  • Ensuring high quality animal care and compliance with the relevant animal care regulations

Operational delivery

  • Operate units at a high standard of regulatory compliance and accreditation including but not limited to (AAALAC, USDA, Client Audits, Internal Audits, Business Continuity, Animal Welfare Regulations and Business Integrity).
  • Assist other units through direct participation in marketing and sales efforts and in necessary regulatory roles.
  • Manage appropriate staffing levels and ongoing technician training.
  • Assist with budget forecast by projecting revenue returns and expense levels.
  • Achieve revenue, cost and profit goals by monitoring performance.
  • Respond directly to client feedback.
  • Meet productivity goals.
  • Achieve Key Business Indicators
  • Recommend new facility and program designs for operational areas.
  • Establish production/sales models and resource commitments.
  • Monitor the quality system and set standards for quality program participation and compliance.
  • Management of team, regular and thorough performance evaluations, ensuring development opportunities and tailored learning plans are in place.
  • Working with HR team to implement policies and procedures to resolve pertinent site related issues around workforce planning recruitment, performance management and disciplinary matters associated with assigned operational units.
  • All responsibilities and duties as assigned to operational business units.

Customer relations

  • Focus on achieving customer satisfaction and loyalty through quality and agreed expectations.
  • Interact with major account holders ensuring that the operational strategy is aligned with existing and emerging market needs and customer expectations.
  • Together with operational leaders, develop an awareness of customer feedback and sentiment (Voice of the Customer), identify root cause and create and monitor action plans to address

Quality, Health and Safety

  • Adopt the Company’s Quality Policy in the work delivered.
  • Take accountability for the Quality metrics and delivery of improvements.
  • Ensure the culture is in line with our Vision, Mission and Values
  • Effectively communicate issues relating to safety, operations and quality along with achievements and actions required to senior management.
  • Support the establishment of disaster recovery plans and establish contingency planning as required to mitigate actual or perceived risks to the business
  • Promote and support self-reporting

Business continuity and risk

  • Adopt and implement our Business continuity policy throughout the site
  • Ensure procedures are tested at least annually
  • Be visible and available in times of need
  • It is expected that any risk should be notified to line manager

KPI’s:

  • Contribution to Company-wide metrics
  • Operational Metrics
  • Voice of the customer
  • Quality Metrics
  • Employee related Metrics
  • Profit and Loss

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred in Life Science, Animal Science or Management, or equivalent experience in managerial roles.
  • Must have 8 - 10 years of management experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in the biomedical industry.
  • Experience working with animals.
  • Animal Production experience preferred.
  • Previous experience with process improvement methodologies.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage site operations with P&L responsibility and people management.
  • Possess strong analytical and conflict resolution skills, to help build and lead a successful team that aims at achieving business objectives.
  • Must have proven verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must have the ability to prioritize and multi-task.

Preferred Qualifications/Skills/Abilities:

  • Advanced study in engineering or business

*This position could be offered at different levels for candidates who qualify with a combination of advanced levels of education and/or years of experience. The salary range will adjust along with the level of the role to match the person’s relevant experience and/or education level.


At Inotiv, our work helps advance the development of new medicines and therapies that can improve people's lives. title: Memory IP Architect
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact

As a Memory IP Architect, you will lead the definition and development of advanced digital IP architectures that power Intel's next-generation semiconductor solutions. You will be responsible for creating scalable, configurable, and high-performance IP designs while driving innovations in functionality, power efficiency, performance, and silicon area optimization. Working closely with architecture, design, verification, and SoC teams, you will influence critical technology decisions and help shape the future of Intel's portfolio.

About the Team

The Intel Foundry FUSE Design Team develops advanced digital IP solutions that enable seamless integration across a broad range of products and platforms. Our team focuses on creating highly configurable and reusable IP architectures that accelerate innovation, improve product scalability, and deliver industry-leading performance. As part of Intel Foundry, you will contribute to technologies that power the next generation of computing and semiconductor solutions worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, develop, and drive digital IP architecture specifications with a focus on modularity, configurability, performance, power efficiency, and area optimization.
  • Lead architecture exploration activities, evaluating trade-offs and proposing innovative solutions for next-generation IP designs.
  • Develop microarchitecture concepts and architectural features, including modeling and simulation to evaluate performance, power, and area metrics.
  • Analyze validation and test data, leveraging statistical methods to identify optimization opportunities and improve IP quality.
  • Partner with design, verification, validation, and product engineering teams to ensure successful architecture implementation and execution.
  • Evaluate design alternatives and validate IP configurations, connectivity, interoperability, and overall system performance.
  • Collaborate with SoC architects and integration teams to support IP selection, integration, performance tuning, and system-level validation.
  • Drive technical innovation by identifying emerging technologies, methodologies, and architectural approaches that enhance Intel's IP portfolio.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong technical leadership with the ability to influence cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across architecture, design, verification, and product organizations.
  • Proven problem-solving capabilities and a passion for developing innovative technical solutions.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing complex technical challenges and competing priorities.
  • A growth mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and technology advancement.

Qualifications:

The Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Minimum qualifications listed below would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experience and / or schoolwork/classes/research. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM field with 6+ years of relevant experience; -OR-
  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM field with 4+ years of relevant experience; -OR-
  • PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM field with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of Digital IP architecture definition, microarchitecture development, or architectural modeling.
  • 2+ years of Hardware design and implementation using SystemVerilog, RTL design methodologies, synthesis flows, or UPF-based low-power design techniques.
  • Experience in Performance, Power, and Area (PPA) analysis and optimization.
  • Experience with PCI Express (PCIe) architecture, protocols, or subsystem integration.
  • Experience in Computer architecture, SoC architecture, or security architecture concepts.
  • Experience with Pre-silicon and post-silicon validation, debug, or characterization methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience architecting and developing high-speed interface IPs, including PCIe, CXL, or related protocols.
  • Experience with advanced semiconductor process technologies and low-power architecture techniques.
  • Experience with complex SoC or IP development programs from concept through production.

Why Intel

Join Intel Foundry and help architect the foundational technologies that enable tomorrow's computing innovations. Your expertise will directly influence the creation of high-performance, power-efficient digital IP solutions that power the next generation of industry-leading products.

title: Programme Manager
description:
Job Description

Programme Manager – Composite Technology Facility

Full-time

Bristol/Hybrid (3 days a week)

Management Level C

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to lead the Programme Management team in the Composite Technology Facility. In this role, you will be accountable for providing project leadership for delivery and growth of Rolls-Royce composite strategy. The role will be accountable for delivery of key work packages which includes new capabilities, technologies and products. Here in the CTF we are developing the latest Composite manufacturing technologies to deliver solutions for the Ultrafan Fan System Program and also structures for the GCAP program. This includes the hardware to support bot engine and rig testing for both the civil and defence programs.

Reporting in the Engineering Technology & Safety (ET&S) organisation, you will be a key member of the Manufacturing Engineering & Materials (ME&M) leadership team. You will be developing integrated plans, managing extensive budgets, whilst ensuring deliverables meet quality and cost through entire project life cycle.

What you will be doing:

In this exciting role, you will be you will be leading a team to plan, schedule and execute a variety of Rolls-Royce composite engineering projects. You will also:

  • Be held accountable for the successful delivery to cost, specification and time for a defined package of work.
  • Accountable for and maintain the budgets required for the facility and programs of work.
  • Propose programme governance and manage senior stakeholder expectations in the business.
  • Establish, develop and maintain the documentation necessary to deliver our projects.
  • Oversee the development, administration and maintenance of the project plans in Primavera P6 and integration with the programme master schedule.
  • Capture, monitor, and report on the full project lifecycle.
  • Manage effective customer relationships and build effective contacts in the supply chain to support industrialisation strategies.
  • Make tactical and strategic programme management decisions.
  • Develop and implement Programme Management best practice in line with company management processes, including continuous improvement techniques to ensure business efficiencies and lean practices.
  • Manage the budget and risk profiles for the project scope, including integration with customer programmes.
  • Create a high performing and engaged team, setting mindset and culture expectations through modelling Rolls-Royce Behaviours and Values

Position qualifications:

Being a part of Rolls-Royce you’ll know we embrace agility, are bold, pursue collaboration and seek simplicity in everything we do. These principles form our values and behaviours and are an essential component of our assessment process and are fundamental qualities that we seek for all roles. To fulfil the role of Programme Manager at the Composite Technology Facility, you will need demonstrate the following:

  • Proven track record of leadership and delivery in fast paced product development context including experience in complex hardware and infrastructure projects.
  • Experience of managing or coordinating projects or programmes in unfamiliar contexts or subjects.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong personal philosophy for what makes great teams – happy to challenge and be challenged.
  • Original and creative problem solving abilities with passion for learning and for supporting the learning of others.
  • Resilience – a self-starter, able to deal with ambiguity and seeks positive action in the face of adversity.
  • Strong IT skills with a good understating of SAP, Primavera P6, MS Excel and other reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with managing schedules, budgets and risk management processes.

Regional Benefits:

  • Work in a safety-first environment were doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
  • Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
  • Develop your career as a mid-career professional blending technical expertise with strong personal qualities.
  • Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.
  • Collaborate and build relationships in a team-focused environment while also working independently.
  • Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
  • Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.

To work for the Rolls-Royce Defence business, an individual has to hold a Security Check clearance. Rolls-Royce will support the application for Security Clearance if you do not currently already have this in place. Due to the nature of work the business conducts and the protection of certain assets we can only progress applications from individuals who are a UK national or, in MOD and Government body approved cases, a dual national.

Please be aware that the priority will be given to employees identified as being at high risk.

The professional level and the salary of the position will be dependent on the skills and experience of the successful candidate.

It is advised that you inform your current manager of your application for this role.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

Job Description:

College of Human Sciences and Education

Social Research and Evaluation Center

GULF Program Director


The GULF Project Director is responsible for ensuring the program is implemented with fidelity to the approved scope of work, complies with all applicable federal and state grant regulations, and achieves the program's academic, graduation, postsecondary enrollment, and family-engagement goals. The Director supervises key program staff, manages the program's overall performance and continuous improvement process in partnership with internal and external evaluators and LSU. The Director will provide overall strategic leadership and long-range vision for the seven-year GULF grant, ensuring all activities align with GEAR UP program requirements and the approved grant scope of work. They will ensure programmatic and fiscal compliance with federal regulations (e.g., EDGAR, GEPA, FERPA) and state and university grant-administration policies, and supervise and evaluate the performance of the Assistant Director. They will serve as the primary liaison to the U.S. Department of Education program officer, LDOE, LSU leadership, partner school districts. The Director will oversee the GULF program budget and approve major expenditures in coordination with the Finance Specialist and university sponsored-programs offices.


35% Strategic & Grant Leadership

• Set and communicate the strategic vision for GULF across all partner districts and subrecipients.

• Oversee implementation of the seven-year scope of work and ensure fidelity to GEAR UP program requirements.

• Monitor compliance with federal (EDGAR, GEPA, FERPA) and state/university grant regulations.


20% Personnel Management

• Supervise and evaluate the Assistant Director

• Provide direction and professional development opportunities for all GULF staff, including GULF Liaisons.

• Foster a collaborative, high-performing program culture across a geographically dispersed team.


20% Partner & Stakeholder Relations

• Serve as primary liaison to the U.S. Department of Education, LDOE, LSU administration, and the all partner school districts.

• Manage relationships with subrecipient organizations providing mentoring/tutoring, external evaluation, and STEM programming.

• Convene local and state Advisory Councils and incorporate stakeholder feedback into program adjustments.


15% Resource & Budget Oversight

• Approve program expenditures and review budget-to-actual reports with the Finance Specialist.

• Ensure fiscal decisions comply with federal grant-management and university procurement requirements.


10% Program Evaluation & Reporting

• Prepare and submit the Annual Performance Report (APR) and, in the final year, the Final Performance Report (FPR).

• Use evaluation findings to drive continuous program improvement.

Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications:

Master's in Education or related field with 5 years of teaching experience; • Minimum two (2) years of leadership experience in higher education or a K-12 setting.

Some experience in coordinating partners to support education programs,

Some experience in postsecondary education readiness programs or postsecondary admissions,


Required Competencies

Knowledge of higher education infrastructure policies, Title IV regulations, and federal/state compliance requirements.

Excellent written and oral communication skills


Preferred Qualifications: PhD in Education or related field with 7+ years of teaching experience; • 5+years of leadership experience in higher education or a K-12 setting; • 3+ years of experience administering federal or state grant programs


LSU values skills, experience, and expertise. Candidates who have relevant experience in key job responsibilities are encouraged to apply— a degree is not required as long as the candidate meets the required years of experience specified in the job description.


Additional Requirements

This position is considered operational essential and may be asked to work during an official closure but is otherwise not required to report to the physical campus during a closure and whose absence does not present a risk to the safety, resources, and well-being of the campus per FASOP HR-01.


This position and/or position's responsibilities require work directly with minors. Fingerprinting and a National Sex Offender Registry check are required per FASOP HR-04.


This position regularly engages in financial matters including handling credit cards, cash, grant funds, or other university funds, and must undergo a credit check per FASOP HR-04.

title: Production Engineering Lead
description:
Job Title:

Production Engineering Lead

Location:

OH - Columbus

What you'll do:

As a Principal Engineer II you'll provide your expert-level knowledge as the established authority in your domain as well as extensive knowledge across multiple domains to ensure solutions are safe, secure, compliant and reliable. You'll lead large and complex design efforts supporting critical projects and solutions while engaging with project and business sponsors defining requirements and objectives of targeted solutions. As a Principal Engineer II, you'll also engage in the facilitation of dialogue and large team activities, while ensuring collaboration to include teams outside of your domain. You'll develop effective presentations and narratives for business stakeholders and IT audiences.
  • Build the solution design of efforts that can be handed off to lower level engineers for execution assuring reuse of platforms where possible.
  • Review technical plans developed by lower level engineers and analysts to assure quality designs which can support the volumetrics of our business partners objectives.
  • Build comprehensive measurement dashboards that give performance insight into key applications of the bank which can feed operational results of our business partners while enforcing IT standards, and may modify or build procedures that support areas of operations across IT.
  • Work independently or partner with architecture team counterparts to lay out the final documentation required for proper, ongoing reference of the given solution to include physical and logical layouts with cross reference to use case models.

What you'll need:

  • 10+ years of related experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in related field required; Masters or MBA in related field preferred.
  • Previous leadership experience preferred.
  • Advanced knowledge of general Financial Services or Banking is preferred.
  • Advanced to expert knowledge of applicable regulatory and legal compliance obligations, rules and regulations, industry standards and practices.
  • Advanced to expert experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously with an established expertise in one or more key domains of the bank (Deposits, Loans, Operations or Reporting)with the ability to walk through top level process design. Capable of working with regulatory partners like the CFPB, OCC and FRB through audits and collaboration efforts as situations arise.
  • Advanced to expert familiarity with the capability model across IT and the applications and infrastructures available for engagement in solutioning across the bank to develop results that leverage existing capabilities in addition to implementing new solutions when required. Experience in the design, enhancement and compliance to all governance frameworks across the IT organization to ensure proper compliance to published procedures and standards.
  • Expert speaking and writing communication skills.
  • May require up to 25% travel.

Benefits you’ll love:
We offer all the important things you'd want — like competitive salaries, an ownership stake in the company, medical and dental insurance, time off, a great 401k matching program, tuition assistance program, an employee volunteer program, and a wellness program. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bolster your business knowledge, learning the ins and outs of how successful companies operate and manage their finances, giving you invaluable hands-on experience to help grow your career!

About the company:

Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Western Alliance Bancorporation. Serving clients nationwide, Western Alliance Bank includes six legacy bank brands — Alliance Association Bank, Alliance Bank of Arizona, Bank of Nevada, Bridge Bank, First Independent Bank and Torrey Pines Bank — that remain part of the company’s heritage, as well as AmeriHome Mortgage, a Western Alliance Bank Company.
