title: Sr. Business Systems Analyst
description:
To apply to a Varex Imaging position, please create an account and sign-in.

CURRENT VAREX IMAGING EMPLOYEES: Please apply by logging into your internal Workday Account.

Summary

Analyzes complex business problems to be solved with automated systems. Provides technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements. Configures system settings and options; plans and executes unit, integration and acceptance testing; and creates specifications for systems to meet business requirements. Designs details of automated systems. May provide consultation to users in the area of automated systems. May lead cross-functional linked teams to address business or systems issues. May be internal or external, client-focused, working in conjunction with Professional Services and outsourcing functions. May include company-wide, web-enabled solutions.

Job Description

Role Definition

This position is responsible for supporting enterprise-wide SAP Finance and Controlling applications, development, configuration, and project management activities. The successful candidate will provide functional leadership for delivering on SAP projects & support including strategic and transformational initiatives for multiple business units globally.


OTHER FUNCTIONS

  • Work closely with Global Finance leadership to fulfill defined business goals. Provide project management and solution expertise in the areas of Accounting, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, reporting with an extensive knowledge on the integration aspects of different business processes and the required SAP configuration supporting cross functional support and project implementations.
  • Work closely with business and IT technical teams to provide application support and continuous improvements for the applications that are already in production and used extensively for day-to-day operations. Primary focus will be on the following processes and applications: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Tax, Treasury, Financial Reporting, FP&A and Month End close activities.
  • Partner with business groups and Varex SAP applications team to deliver SAP projects across multiple business units. The person will be involved in leading business sessions to define high level business goals & vision, extract business requirements, software selection, guide application development, define performance indicators, and architect the solution on various SAP platforms.
  • Lead teams of third-party technology professionals including functional consultants and developers focused on architecture, design, and implementation. Remain knowledgeable with current and future technologies. Provide and implement recommendations as needed to meet SAP applications & IT objectives.

Education and Experience

  • B.S. degree in IT, IS or related field of study
  • 10+ years of industry/ IT experience and 8+ years of relevant SAP FICO Experience.
  • 2+ years of project management experience leading small to medium scale enterprise projects that require fundamental change in business practice and automation delivering significant value to business partners. The successful candidate should understand or have direct experience in or support of procurement, manufacturing, and quality processes within business functions.
  • The candidate should have successfully participated in at least 2 full life cycle end-to-end business transformation projects implementing SAP Finance modules.
  • The candidate must have hands on design, configuration, and customization in FI, CO modules along with exposure to integration with MM, PP, SD, BPC.
  • Prior consulting experience, preferably in a Big 4 environment with exposure to clients/customers in US and Europe desirable.
  • Experience conducting requirements analysis, meeting with business owners, and performing current state system analysis.
  • Experience in S4 HANA and ABAP Development is a plus.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND CERTIFICATIONS

Required Certifications and Training

  • Obtains and completes LMS training plan specific to assigned responsibility.

Experience Level with Business Tools

  • Proficient in utilizing business tools such as: E-mail, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with SAP or equivalent ERP product and productivity software desired.

LEVEL DESCRIPTION

Knowledge

  • Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.

Job Complexity

  • Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises independent judgment and discretion in solving complex business problems.

Interaction

  • Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.

Supervision

  • Determines methods and procedures reviewed by others on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Team Lead).

Ability to Travel

  • Travel may be required.

title: IT Manager (M/F/D) | Matosinhos
description:
A Talenter está a recrutar para um grupo empresarial do setor dos transportes e logística, atualmente a atravessar um processo de modernização e transformação digital, com o objetivo de reforçar a sua eficiência operacional e posicionamento no mercado.

Neste contexto, procuramos um/a IT Project Manager, que terá a responsabilidade de liderar iniciativas tecnológicas estratégicas, assegurando o desenvolvimento, implementação e evolução de projetos de IT, com impacto direto no negócio.

Esta função combina gestão de projetos, coordenação de equipas e alinhamento estratégico com o negócio.

* Fluência em português e inglês.

title: Senior Policy Director
company: American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network
description:
The American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network (ACS CAN) is the nation's leading cancer advocacy organization. Together with our charitable partner, the American Cancer Society, we work in Congress, state legislatures and local jurisdictions to support evidence-based policy and legislative solutions designed to eliminate cancer as a major health problem.

The Senior Policy Director for the Policy Team will direct strategy for and manage team members executing a wide portfolio of complex policy issues that guide and support ACS CAN’s advocacy agenda at the state, federal and local levels. As a deputy to the Vice President, Public Policy Advocacy, the position requires senior level policy and/or legislative expertise in key issue areas. In addition to directing strategy for and managing team members executing a wide range of policy issues, this position will have primary responsibility for a specific access to care policy portfolio including employer-sponsored coverage, Affordable Care Act coverage, and the uninsured. This position works collaboratively across ACS and ACS CAN to develop and communicate clear public policy positions and guidance.

Ideal candidate needs to reside in the Washington, DC area.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Policy Team, directing strategy and execution for a wide range of complex policy issues to support advancement and protection of a priority agenda; (25%)
  • Oversee a portfolio of ACS CAN’s priority policy issues, provide thought leadership to identify emerging issues that will impact the organization’s advocacy positions, and lead development of policy recommendations; (40%)
  • Develop special reports and undertake major projects that are used to educate and persuade policymakers on key health issues; (15%)
  • Develop strategic partnerships and work collaboratively with external organizations and partners to advance ACS CAN’s policy advocacy; (10%)
  • Analyze state and federal legislative proposals and federal regulations related to employer-sponsored coverage, Affordable Care Act coverage, and the uninsured, develop written responses and make recommendation to state and federal colleagues; (10%)

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: ​Bachelor's Degree​
  • Preferred Degree: ​Master's Degree, PhD​ or Juris Doctorate
  • Years of experience: 15+ years experience, applied policy and/or legislative experience at the state or federal level highly desired.
  • Nonprofit advocacy organization of benefit; demonstrated public policy experience and analysis, and knowledge of legislative and regulatory processes at the local, state and federal levels of government.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • 5+ years of team management experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills and interpersonal communications skills
  • Experience with collaborative, complex organizations
  • Expertise in public policy analysis and support of local, state and federal legislative issues
  • Ability to work in a highly charged and competitive political environment
  • Must be able to manage nationwide efforts involving multiple priorities, be comfortable with deadlines, and maintain a flexible, pragmatic approach to work requirements
  • Able to foster professional, interdependent relationships with other staff to achieve mutually satisfactory approaches and products
  • Experience with designing/formatting presentations
  • Demonstrated knowledge of areas of portfolio responsibility

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Some travel may be involved


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • N/A

The starting rate is $170,000-$190,000. The final candidate's relevant experience/skills will be considered before an offer is extended. Actual starting pay will vary based on non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.

ACS CAN provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. Further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. We are a proud equal opportunity employer.

title: Portfolio Analyst
description:
Bij Intrum groei je door het verschil te maken. Die groei maak je in een internationale omgeving en uitdagende, ondersteunende cultuur met oog voor ieders inspanning en appreciatie voor elke bijdrage.

Portfolio Analyst

Ben jij een analytische denker met een passie voor data, strategie en optimalisatie? Wil je werken in een internationale omgeving waar technologie, data en artificiële intelligentie een belangrijke rol spelen? Dan is deze functie bij Intrum iets voor jou.

Bij Intrum krijg je de kans om data om te zetten in inzichten die bijdragen aan betere beslissingen, sterkere klantrelaties en optimale resultaten.

Jouw uitdaging

Als Portfolio Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het analyseren, optimaliseren en strategisch adviseren rond toegewezen opdrachtgevers, sectoren en portefeuilles.

Je bent de schakel tussen data, business en operationele teams. Je ontwikkelt analyses, modellen en strategieën die bijdragen aan betere prestaties en vertaalt complexe data naar concrete aanbevelingen.

Vanuit jouw expertise adviseer je zowel interne stakeholders als opdrachtgevers over optimalisatiekansen, verbeterinitiatieven en de verdere ontwikkeling van strategieën.

Wat ga je doen?

Analyseren en optimaliseren van portefeuilles

  • Uitvoeren van diepgaande analyses op de prestaties van verschillende servicing- en investmentportefeuilles.
  • Analyseren van trends, afwijkingen en optimalisatiemogelijkheden.
  • Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van incassomodellen en strategieën op basis van data-inzichten.
  • Toepassen van scoring en segmentatie om resultaten verder te verbeteren.
  • Monitoren van prestaties en vertalen van inzichten naar concrete acties.

Rapportering en dashboards

  • Ontwikkelen van heldere en visueel aantrekkelijke rapportages en dashboards.
  • Opvolgen van belangrijke KPI’s en performance-indicatoren.
  • Presenteren van analyses en inzichten aan interne stakeholders en management.
  • Ondersteunen van datagedreven besluitvorming binnen de organisatie.

Ondersteunen van accountmanagement en klanten

  • Voorzien van accountmanagementteams van relevante data-inzichten.
  • Ondersteunen bij het strategisch beheren van klantrelaties en portefeuilles.
  • Proactief identificeren van kansen en risico’s op basis van data.
  • Fungeren als inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor interne teams en opdrachtgevers.

Continue verbetering en innovatie

  • Identificeren van verbeterpunten binnen processen en dienstverlening.
  • Opzetten en begeleiden van A/B-testen om hypotheses te toetsen.
  • Analyseren van resultaten en vertalen naar aanbevelingen.
  • Meewerken aan innovatieve toepassingen van data en technologie.

Rendabiliteit en performance

  • Bewaken van prijszetting, marges en winstgevendheid.
  • Samenwerken met Finance en Sales om een optimale balans te realiseren tussen klantwaarde en bedrijfsresultaat.
  • Bijdragen aan de verdere optimalisatie van dienstverlening en resultaten.

Jouw profiel

Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in Economie, Bedrijfskunde, Toegepaste Economische Wetenschappen, Statistiek of een gelijkwaardige richting.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een uitgesproken cijfermatig inzicht.
  • Een kritische en resultaatgerichte mindset.
  • Het vermogen om complexe data te vertalen naar duidelijke inzichten en aanbevelingen.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Een vlotte beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Ervaring met tools zoals Excel, Power BI en SQL is een plus.

Wat maakt jou geschikt?

Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en combineert een passie voor data met een goed businessinzicht.

Je:

  • denkt kritisch mee over processen en verbeteringen;
  • communiceert helder met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders;
  • kan analyses overtuigend presenteren;
  • werkt proactief en neemt verantwoordelijkheid;
  • bent klantgericht en resultaatgedreven;
  • handelt volgens het First-Time-Right principe en leeft de kernwaarden van Intrum na.

title: Supporttekniker till utbildningsförvaltningen
description: BeskrivningVill du vara den som gör skillnad för människor, varje dag?Digital Support är en del av avdelningen Digitalisering och innovation på utbildningsförvaltningen. Vi arbetar nära skolor och utbildningsverksamheter för att göra elevernas och skolpersonalens digitala vardag enklare.För oss handlar riktigt bra IT-support om mer än att lösa tekniska problem. Det handlar om att skapa förtroende, förstå människors behov och ta ansvar för hela upplevelsen, från första kontakten tills användaren fått den hjälp som behövs.Vi söker dig som är social, nyfiken och har en naturlig känsla för service. Du tycker om att möta människor, lyssna och förstå deras situation. Du tar egna initiativ, håller användaren informerad och ser möjligheter att göra saker bättre, både för den du hjälper just nu och för nästa person som behöver stöd.Hos oss blir du en del av ett team där vi hjälps åt, delar kunskap och utvecklar våra arbetssätt för att ge elever och personal bästa möjliga stöd.ArbetsuppgifterSom supporttekniker arbetar du nära verksamheten och möter elever, lärare och annan skolpersonal. Arbetet kombinerar teknisk problemlösning med personlig service, både i våra IT-mottagningar och ute på skolorna.I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår bland annat att:    ge professionell och pedagogisk IT-support till elever och personal.    felsöka och hantera datorer, Chromebooks, Mac och annan IT-utrustning.    installera, konfigurera och lämna ut datorer och digital utrustning.    arbeta med konto- och behörighetshantering.    registrera, hantera och följa upp ärenden i ärendehanteringssystem.    ge stöd vid digitala prov, introduktion av nya användare och införande av digitala tjänster.    identifiera återkommande problem och bidra till förbättringar som underlättar för verksamheten.Vi vill att du ser längre än det enskilda ärendet. Du är serviceinriktad och lyhörd och kan förklara teknik på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du anpassar ditt bemötande efter användarens behov.Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, driver ärenden framåt och kan prioritera när det är mycket att göra. Du samarbetar gärna, delar kunskap och vet när du behöver ta hjälp av andra.Du är nyfiken och initiativrik, uppmärksammar återkommande behov och föreslår förbättringar. För oss är ett gott bemötande, ansvarstagande och förståelse för skolans verksamhet lika viktigt som teknisk kompetens.ÖvrigtUrval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden.Till din intervju behöver du ha med dig pass/nationellt id och eventuellt bevis på uppehållstillstånd om du har ett medborgarskap utanför EU/EES. title: Heritage Specialist (West)
description:
The Opportunity

At APA, our purpose is to secure Australia’s energy future. We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it with our customers and communities as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.

Reporting to the Heritage Lead, we have two opportunities available for Heritage Specialists to join our team, with one position based in Perth.

In these roles, you’ll support the effective management of heritage across our operational assets. You’ll work across heritage due diligence, advice, stakeholder engagement, surveys, regulatory liaison and data management, helping ensure heritage requirements, risks and management measures are clearly understood, documented and effectively managed.

You’ll also spend time out in the field, with up to four months of fieldwork across the year, typically undertaken in one to one to two-week blocks.

Working with teams across the business, First Nations Peoples, specialist heritage consultants and regulators, this is an opportunity to play an important role in supporting the compliant delivery of APA activities while building heritage capability across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate heritage due diligence assessments and clearly communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.
  • Provide advice and support on heritage requirements, risks and appropriate management measures.
  • Engage with First Nations Peoples and regulators on heritage management, information and approvals.
  • Design, coordinate and implement heritage surveys, including report writing and making recommendations.
  • Engaging and managing specialist consultants.
  • Prepare heritage data for GIS, support heritage agreements and provide heritage-related training and coaching across APA.

Your Background

  • You bring experience providing heritage advice and supporting the management of heritage requirements and risks.
  • You have experience engaging with First Nations Peoples on activities and associated heritage management requirements.
  • You have experience in obtaining appropriate heritage approvals.
  • You can undertake and coordinate heritage surveys and work effectively with specialist heritage consultants.
  • You understand the importance of accurate heritage records, data and regulatory information to support compliant delivery.
  • You are comfortable working with a range of internal and external stakeholders and sharing heritage knowledge through advice, training and coaching.
  • Relevant qualifications and experience, or demonstrated extensive practical experience in heritage management including technical report writing.

Working at APA

At APA, we’re committed to fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where you can achieve your best.

We offer targeted career development programs designed to accelerate your career, competitive remuneration, employee benefits, flexible working arrangements, and wellbeing initiatives are all part of what we’ll offer you. Our inclusive parental leave policy offers 18 weeks of leave, including superannuation, to support parents at work and in life.

We employ around 2,000 people across Australia and are committed to building a high-performing, customer-focused organisation where everyone feels safe, valued, and trusted to perform at their best.

We are APA

At APA, we’re taking on one of Australia’s greatest challenges:​ the energy transition.​ We’re not doing it alone. We’re doing it as Australia’s energy infrastructure partner, a role our unique experience and expertise positions us to play.​

​

We proudly own, operate and manage a diverse $20 billion portfolio of assets which deliver essential services to communities and customers across Australia. And we own more than 15,000 kilometres of gas pipelines which deliver energy to households and businesses across every corner of Australia.

As the partner of choice in delivering infrastructure solutions for the energy transition, we’re focused on bundled remote grid energy solutions, electricity and gas transmission, and future energy, including hydrogen and carbon capture and storage.

Our customer focused approach means we understand our customers and offer them reliable, innovative, and cost-effective energy solutions that support their decarbonisation ambitions.

We are committed to securing Australia’s energy future by delivering infrastructure solutions for Australia’s energy transition and supporting the decarbonisation ambitions of our customers and communities.

Join our team and be part of securing Australia’s energy future. We’d love to hear from you.

APA is an equal opportunity employer. The safety, health and wellbeing our people, community and environment a priority. We embrace diversity in our people to ensure our workforce is representative of the communities that we operate in.


Applicants must be eligible to work in Australia to be considered.

This vacancy works with critical APA data, systems or infrastructure and candidates are subject to background vetting (including Police checks) before & during employment.

Role closes on Tuesday, 1 December 2026. Role Reference Number: JR5207

APA Group will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies.

We will contact successful candidates after the closing date.

description:

title: Lead Application & Product Architect
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Lead Application & Product Architect / Software Engineer to lead enterprise application architecture and delivery across .NET, Microsoft Azure, and Angular. The successful candidate will have a proven record of governing and delivering secure, scalable, resilient, maintainable, observable, and testable applications while remaining close enough to implementation to validate decisions through working software.

This role translates business capabilities and ambiguous requirements into explicit technical requirements, architecture decisions, engineering guardrails, and executable specifications. The architect will guide teams from design through production, balancing business value, delivery speed, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead architecture and hands-on engineering for .NET/Azure/Angular solutions; turn business needs into technical requirements, non-functional requirements, solution designs, ADRs, and actionable delivery guidance.

• Select and govern fit-for-purpose approaches, including modular monoliths, microservices, Domain-Driven Design, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, SOLID and Dependency Inversion, ports/adapters, REST APIs, messaging, and event-driven integration.

• Maintain architectural integrity through design, architecture, and code reviews; prototyping; debugging; refactoring; performance analysis; production troubleshooting; and direct collaboration with engineering teams.

• Design security, identity, authorization, secrets, resiliency, observability, automated testing, deployment, and operational support into solutions from the beginning rather than treating them as later-stage controls.

• Guide Azure service selection and cloud patterns by evaluating scalability, availability, latency, data consistency, operational complexity, security, vendor constraints, and total cost.

• Manage technical debt and modernization using incremental, risk-based approaches; create reusable standards, reference architectures, diagrams, patterns, and guardrails across teams.

• Mentor engineers and technical leads, communicate trade-offs to technical and business audiences, and partner with Product, Security, DevOps, Operations, and other stakeholders.

• Evaluate AI-assisted engineering practices where they measurably improve delivery or product capability while preserving human accountability for architecture, security, correctness, and production quality.

Specification-Driven Development & AI-Assisted Engineering

The ideal candidate has experience integrating architecture processes with Specification-Driven Development (SDD) or can quickly adopt it. They should be able to encode business rules, architectural constraints, APIs, security, observability, resiliency, testing, and acceptance criteria into clear, reusable specifications that guide both human and AI-assisted implementation.

• Establish architecture and engineering constraints before implementation; use ADRs, interface contracts, examples, and quality attributes in a durable development context.

• Review generated and manually developed code against architectural intent, specifications, secure coding expectations, test strategy, and operational requirements.

• Use tools such as GitHub Copilot responsibly while maintaining traceability, review discipline, and ownership of the delivered solution.

Required Experience & Capabilities

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a Lead Engineer, Principal Engineer, Application/Product Architect, Solution Architect, or comparable technical leadership role.

• Deep hands-on expertise in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, dependency injection, background services, asynchronous programming, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, NuGet, and modern .NET testing practices.

• Strong Angular and TypeScript experience, including components, routing, RxJS, state management, API integration, frontend security, performance, accessibility, unit testing, and end-to-end testing.

• Proven ability to translate business needs into technical and non-functional requirements, select and defend architecture patterns, and guide implementation through production.

• Strong knowledge of application security, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, authentication and authorization, secure API design, secrets and certificate management, dependency risk, and secure coding.

• Experience with relational data modeling, persistence patterns, database and application performance, distributed systems trade-offs, automated CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and production diagnostics.

Microsoft Technology & Azure Solutioning Experience

Candidates must be comfortable designing, selecting, integrating, and troubleshooting solutions using a practical mix of technologies including but not limited to the following

• Application and compute: .NET / ASP.NET Core, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure Functions, Linux hosting, Azure API Management, and Azure Front Door or Application Gateway.

• Data and caching: SQL Server, Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance, Entity Framework Core, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage (Blob, Queue, Table, Files), Azure Cache for Redis, and data migration or synchronization patterns.

• Integration and eventing: Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Logic Apps, Durable Functions, REST/JSON APIs, webhooks, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, and event-driven workflows.

• Identity and security: Microsoft Entra ID, External ID/B2C patterns, Managed Identities, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, Azure Key Vault, VNets, NSGs, certificates, RBAC.

• Observability and operations: APM, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, structured logging, dashboards, alerts, health checks, SLO-oriented monitoring, and incident diagnostics.

• Delivery and platform engineering: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Azure Container Registry, Bicep/Terraform, blue-green/canary strategies, feature flags, automated quality/security gates, and environment configuration.

• Angular ecosystem: Angular CLI, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx or comparable state management, component libraries, Backend for Frontend, and secure integration with .NET APIs.

Candidate Profile & Interview Expectations

This is not a diagram-only architect or a senior developer who applies patterns by habit. The successful candidate can explain why an approach fits the business problem, establish constraints and specifications, work directly with engineers, and validate that implementation and operations reflect the intended architecture.

Interviews will combine architecture/design exercises with hands-on .NET engineering. Candidates may be asked to translate a business scenario into technical and non-functional requirements; compare modular monolith, microservice, synchronous, and event-driven options; design for security, resiliency, observability, scalability, and testing; review or refactor C# code; diagnose performance or production issues; and show how architecture standards can be incorporated into an SDD workflow.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and bonus package.

• Opportunity to shape the architecture and technical direction of strategic products.

• Exposure to modern AI, cloud, and enterprise-scale engineering challenges.

• A collaborative culture that values ownership, mentorship, innovation, and technical excellence.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$107,500.00 - $188,400.00 USD

This role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

title: Manufacturing Training Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact
In this role, you will own the strategy, design, and delivery of technical training programs for manufacturing and process engineering teams. You will partner with factory leaders, engineers, and subject matter experts to identify skill gaps, build curriculum, and measure how training improves readiness, productivity, and quality. Your work will help ensure our workforce is prepared for new technologies, new products, and high-volume production.

About the Team
The Foundry Technical Training group builds and sustains a highly skilled manufacturing workforce for our factories. Focused on NPI and HVM needs, the team delivers tailored technical training solutions that support Intel's broader manufacturing goals. You will join a collaborative group that values continuous learning, data-driven improvement, and close partnership with the factories we support.

Key Responsibilities
• Define the technical training strategy and roadmap for manufacturing and process engineering, aligned with New Product Introduction (NPI) and High-Volume Manufacturing (HVM) priorities.
• Assess training needs through partnership with engineers, managers, and subject matter experts, and translate them into curriculum and learning plans.
• Design, develop, and continuously improve technical training content, including instructor-led, hands-on, and e-learning formats.
• Establish processes and standards for training delivery, documentation, and record keeping, and ensure compliance with training requirements.
• Define success metrics, evaluate training effectiveness, and report results and recommendations to stakeholders.
• Lead and mentor trainers, technicians, and subject matter experts who contribute to training delivery.
• Manage training projects, schedules, and resources, balancing competing priorities across multiple factories or teams.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's Or Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical field, with 5+ years of experience in technical training, manufacturing operations, or Equipment/process engineering. Equivalent experience may be considered.
• Experience designing and delivering technical training for equipment, processes, or manufacturing operations.
• Experience developing technical training materials, such as manuals, procedures, schematics, and equipment specifications.
• Experience defining and tracking training metrics and using data to improve program outcomes.
• Demonstrated ability to manage projects and influence stakeholders across engineering and manufacturing teams.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in semiconductor or other high-volume manufacturing environments.
• Experience leading or mentoring trainers or technical contributors.
• Strong communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills.
Join us to shape how Intel's factory workforce learns and grows while advancing your career in technical training. Apply now to lead programs that drive innovation and employee development.

title: AI RnD Engineer, XeSS and Neural Graphics (f/m/d)
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Drive the development of AI models for Intel XeSS and related AI-based graphics technologies for Client Graphics, with direct impact across XeSS Super Resolution, XeSS Frame Generation, neural rendering, and next-generation AI rendering capabilities. You will contribute to technical direction and drive execution across research, SW, HW architecture, validation, and ecosystem teams to bring new technologies from concept to product.

This is an end-to-end technical role spanning model design, datasets, training, visual quality, performance optimization, and product integration. You will help shape how modern AI model architectures are adapted for the quality, performance, and latency constraints of real-time graphics.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive the development of AI models for XeSS and next-generation neural rendering capabilities, from early exploration through product delivery.
  • Design, train, and evaluate AI models for super resolution, frame generation, neural rendering, and related real-time graphics workloads.
  • Develop training methods, loss functions, and evaluation approaches that improve visual quality, temporal stability, robustness, and model efficiency.
  • Define dataset requirements and work with data and infrastructure teams to improve training coverage, reference quality, and data pipelines.
  • Analyze visual quality and model failure cases, and drive improvements across models, training data, model inputs, and product integration.
  • Optimize AI models for real-time execution on Intel GPUs, balancing visual quality, latency, memory and compute costs.
  • Collaborate with SW, HW architecture, validation, and ecosystem teams to integrate, validate, and deliver product-ready technologies.
  • Evaluate emerging AI architectures and techniques, and help define the technical direction for future XeSS and AI graphics capabilities.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience developing AI/ML technologies for graphics, imaging, video, or related areas, including experience delivering production-quality solutions.
  • Strong expertise in AI/ML for real-time graphics, imaging, or video, such as super resolution, frame generation, denoising, reconstruction, optical flow, or related AI rendering workloads.
  • Experience developing AI technologies from research through productization, with experience across model architecture, datasets, training, evaluation, optimization, and deployment.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architecture, performance, memory systems, latency, and hardware-aware optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate across cross-functional teams spanning research, SW, and HW.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing AI upscaling, frame generation, neural rendering, or adjacent AI-based graphics technologies.
  • Good understanding of modern neural network architectures, such as convolutional networks, Vision Transformers, diffusion models, and related architectures.
  • Experience with high-performance GPU compute, inference kernels, or production AI deployment.
  • Experience with dataset capture, processing, and training infrastructure for graphics AI models.
  • Experience productizing AI technologies through SDKs, APIs, or cross-platform SW.
  • Experience with C++ and real-time graphics APIs or shader programming, such as Direct3D, Vulkan, HLSL, or GLSL.
  • Experience influencing future GPU or AI accelerator features based on AI workload analysis.

In this community rooted in love and dignity, curiosity thrives, leading to endless opportunities for growth and advancement.

Inspired by the soul of the West—the spirit that our region embodies—we emerge as a force for positive change, harnessing our collective power to build a Human Scale University that reflects our values and brings to life our shared vision of the world we aspire to create.

Colorado Mesa University Core Values
Love - Extending oneself for nurturing the growth of self and others
Dignity - Respecting the intrinsic value of each person and believing that others act from a foundation of goodwill
Courage - Taking risks in the pursuit of new possibilities
Humility - Suspending one’s ego and pride to recognize that no idea is perfect and being open to the input of others
Resiliency - Investing in the future by adapting to changes, overcoming challenges and pursuing Opportunity
Curiosity - Cultivating awe and exploring the unknown
Power - The strength to act collaboratively with individual agency to achieve our goals

SECTION II – THE SEAT

At CMU, we look at every position as a seat. Every seat is vital and the individual in the seat contributes significantly to our mission of providing an affordable and accessible education and forming meaningful and mutually enriching partnerships that support the well-being and vibrancy of our community. As a human centric organization, a priority is to ensure we have the “right seats” in our organization, and that the expectations, ownership and accountabilities are defined and communicated clearly for the success of the individuals holding the seats.

This seat is the University’s primary technical resource for the Student Information System (SIS), student-system integrations, and student data architecture and management. The current environment is Banner running on Oracle; the durable responsibility is to maintain reliable student systems and data regardless of whether the future platform is Ellucian Student, Workday Student, or another approved solution.

The current Banner and ancillary student environments are hosted by Ellucian. Ellucian performs operating-system, database-engine, and application-layer patch installation for hosted services. This seat owns CMU’s application-owner responsibilities: release-note and advisory review, institutional impact assessment, identification of affected integrations and business processes, coordination of technical regression testing and functional user acceptance testing, post-release validation, defect tracking, and escalation to Ellucian.

The seat owns day-to-day Banner technical operations, student-system database and application development, SIS integrations and outbound data feeds, and student data conversion and migration. It designs, develops, and maintains source data structures, database objects, data models, source-to-target mappings, integration specifications, and reconciliation processes that support operational student systems and downstream institutional data platforms.

This seat works closely with the Data Engineer to maintain consistent student data from the SIS through EAB Edify and downstream institutional data products. The SIS seat owns source-system meaning, structures, security, APIs, extracts, and mappings; the Data Engineer owns Edify ingestion, transformation, cross-source modeling, quality controls, lineage, and delivery. Both seats jointly resolve data-quality and mapping issues across the handoff.

The seat leads technical participation in SIS updates, releases, testing, modernization, and implementation planning, including conversion analysis, historical-data decisions, interface mapping, reconciliation, cutover validation, and post-implementation data quality. Current technologies include Banner, Oracle SQL/PLSQL, Linux, Python, and Ellucian Ethos; future technologies may include PostgreSQL-based Ellucian Student services or Workday Student data access and WQL.

This seat has no supervisory responsibilities. It coordinates technical activities with Ellucian, Oracle, EAB, Workday, implementation partners, consultants, and third-party service providers. The Director of Enterprise Applications retains final responsibility for contracts, procurement, licensing, vendor selection, and strategic vendor management.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment, without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. Employment is contingent upon maintaining valid work authorization for the expected duration of the position.

OVERVIEW AND ROLE SCOPE OF TEAM AND/OR TASKS

Student Information System Platform Ownership

Own and maintain the technical operation, development, configuration, integrations, security dependencies, releases, and lifecycle of the University’s SIS, currently Banner.


Student Data Architecture and Management

Design and maintain student-system data structures, logical and physical data models, database objects, source-to-target mappings, data definitions, history requirements, and reconciliation controls from the SIS through Edify and downstream data products.


SIS Integration and Automation Development

Develop and support integrations using APIs, Ellucian Ethos, SQL/PLSQL, Linux scripting, Python, scheduled processes, secure file exchange, JSON, XML, and related technologies.


Data Lake Source and Quality Partnership

Partner with the Data Engineer to build and maintain SIS-to-Edify feeds, trace data-quality issues to their source, implement approved corrections, and ensure student data is represented consistently across operational and analytical platforms.


SIS Updates, Releases, Testing, and Modernization

Lead CMU technical participation for Ellucian-hosted updates and releases by reviewing release notes and advisories, assessing impacts to Banner modules, integrations, reports, data, and business processes, coordinating technical regression testing and functional user acceptance testing, validating production after Ellucian implementation, tracking defects, and escalating issues. Also lead modernization, conversion, migration, cutover, reconciliation, and stabilization for future SIS platforms.


Technical Vendor Coordination and Functional Partnership

Coordinate technical work with vendors and partners and translate requirements from Enrollment Services, Academic Affairs, Student Services, Financial Aid, Institutional Research, Finance, Human Resources, and Information Technology into durable technical solutions. For Banner Financial Aid, lead technical release-note review, impact assessment, test planning, technical defect analysis, and Ellucian escalation while Financial Aid owns regulatory interpretation, functional test execution, expected business results, and readiness approval.


Cross-Training, Documentation, and Operational Continuity

Maintain accurate technical and operational documentation for assigned applications, integrations, configurations, procedures, and support responsibilities to support operational continuity, cross-training, and backup coverage.


ACCOUNTABILITY TO RESULTS

The individual in this seat is accountable for delivering the following outcomes. Targets may be refined by the Director of Enterprise Applications as baselines and institutional priorities are established:

  • SIS updates, releases, testing, modernization, conversion, and migration milestones are completed according to approved priorities and committed timelines.
  • Critical SIS operations, integrations, scheduled processes, and data feeds meet established service expectations and are monitored, supportable, and recoverable.
  • Student data delivered from the SIS to Edify is complete, timely, traceable, and reconciled to agreed source-system controls.
  • Ellucian-hosted SIS updates and releases have documented release-note review, impact assessment, assigned technical and functional test coverage, post-release validation, defect tracking, and vendor escalation with minimal disruption to University operations.
  • Modernization milestones, data-conversion deliverables, and integration designs are completed according to approved project priorities and timelines.
  • Priority SIS, integration, and student-data incidents receive timely technical response, documented resolution, and appropriate escalation.
  • Owned systems, integrations, database objects, mappings, and procedures have current documentation and effective contributor coverage.

Additional metrics and results may be assigned as needed by our business.


CORE PROCESSES

Ensuring that core processes are known, documented, and operate effectively across departments brings clarity and efficiency to our business. This seat owns or contributes to the following processes:


Owned:

  • Maintain SIS (Banner)
  • SIS Database, Application, and Source Data Model Development (Current: Banner/Oracle)
  • SIS Integration and Data Lake Source Feed Development (Linux, Python, Ellucian Ethos)
  • SIS Updates, Releases, Testing, and Modernization (Banner)
  • SIS Data Conversion and Migration (Banner)

Contributor:

  • Enterprise Applications Portfolio Strategy
  • Enterprise Application Vendor Management
  • Documentation Standards and Operational Continuity
  • Enterprise Applications Data Governance and Stewardship Support
  • Institutional Data Platform Administration and Technical Data Management (Current: EAB Edify)
  • Data Integration and ETL/ELT Pipeline Development (Current: EAB Edify)
  • Data Products and Extracts for Reporting and Analytics (Current: EAB Edify)
  • Document Management Platform Administration, Access, and Retention (Xtender)
  • Document Workflows and Integrations (Xtender)
  • Document Management Updates, Releases, Testing, Modernization, and Migration (Xtender)
  • SIS Add-On Applications Administration and Support (Degree Works)
  • Forms Management and Workflow Processing (SoftDocs)

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

DISCLAIMER - This position description is only a summary of the typical functions of this seat, and not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and areas of accountability.

SECTION III – OUR DESIRES FOR RIGHT FIT

For the success of our mission and our teams, we desire to have individuals who are a “Right Fit” in our seats. We define “Right Fit” as those who embrace our culture, demonstrate our values, understand the seat and what is required. We seek individuals who want this seat, desire to be a part of a bigger vision and have the capacity to be a successful member of our CMU team.


CAPACITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Advanced working knowledge of student information systems, student-system data architecture, integration patterns, database development, and downstream data-management practices.
  • Capacity to understand student-system business processes and translate functional requirements into reliable application, database, integration, and data-management solutions.
  • Advanced capacity with Banner technical architecture and Oracle SQL/PLSQL, including tables, views, indexes, packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and scheduled processes.
  • Capacity to design data models, source-to-target mappings, canonical definitions, conversion rules, reconciliation controls, and lineage across SIS and data-lake environments.
  • Capacity to develop and support integrations using Linux, Python, Ellucian Ethos, REST/SOAP services, JSON, XML, secure files, and related technologies.
  • Capacity to work effectively across Banner/Oracle today and transition to future student platforms without tying durable responsibilities to a single database technology.
  • Ability to partner closely with the Data Engineer, Institutional Research, functional data owners, and designated data stewards to resolve source, mapping, quality, and lineage issues.
  • Ability to lead institutional release readiness for hosted enterprise applications, including release-note review, impact assessment, test planning, technical regression testing, functional UAT coordination, post-release validation, defect escalation, conversion, migration, and cutover activities.
  • Commitment to cross-training, shared support, and reduction of single-person dependencies within a small Enterprise Applications team.

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE FOR RIGHT FIT

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field from a regionally accredited four-year college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree on a year-for-year basis.
  • Minimum four (4) years of experience supporting and developing solutions within Banner SIS or a comparable higher-education student information system.
  • Minimum four (4) years of experience developing and supporting student-system integrations, batch processes, APIs, or related data exchanges.
  • Minimum four (4) years of experience developing and supporting relational database solutions, including advanced SQL and stored-programming capabilities. Current Oracle SQL/PLSQL experience is strongly relevant; the durable requirement is database-agnostic student-data engineering and management.
  • Experience with Linux scripting, Python, REST APIs, JSON, XML, and enterprise integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience developing data models, source-to-target mappings, data conversion rules, reconciliation processes, and technical documentation.
  • Experience supporting higher-education student business processes and working directly with functional stakeholders to gather requirements, review vendor release impacts, coordinate testing, and validate solutions.
  • Preferred: experience with Ellucian Ethos, EAB Edify, PostgreSQL, Workday Student, WQL, Ellucian Student, SIS modernization, data conversion, data governance/stewardship support, Git or source control, and cross-platform integration architecture.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical documentation, professional materials, vendor documentation, procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation, reports, requirements, test plans, support procedures, and presentations.
  • Ability to explain complex technical information to functional users, technical staff, leaders, vendors, and implementation partners.

REASONING ABILITY

Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills are necessary. The individual must be able to diagnose complex application, integration, data, and process issues; evaluate alternatives; identify dependencies and risks; and apply sound judgment where procedures or solutions are not fully standardized.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this seat. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this seat, the individual is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, talk, hear, and use a computer. The individual must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

This is a predominantly in-person, on-campus seat. The individual typically performs duties in an office setting and works extensively with computers, enterprise applications, and campus stakeholders. The noise level is generally moderate, with periodic interruptions. Occasional work outside regular hours may be required for upgrades, releases, production issues, testing, or implementation activities.

HOW TO APPLY: Applicants will be asked to complete an online application by creating a profile and then providing personal and demographic information. In addition, please be prepared to upload a:

  • Cover letter

  • Resume

  • Copy of transcripts for all degrees completed (if your transcripts include a social security number or birthdate, please redact that information before uploading the document. Official transcripts will be required upon hire)

Colorado Mesa University is particularly interested in candidates who have experience working with students from diverse backgrounds and who have a demonstrated commitment to improving the levels of access and success for underrepresented students within higher education.

Colorado Mesa University is committed to providing a safe and productive learning and living community. To achieve that goal, we conduct background investigations for all final applicants being considered for employment. Background investigations include reference checks, a criminal history record check, and when appropriate, a financial and/or motor vehicle history. Women and minorities are encouraged to apply. To request an accommodation, please contact the CMU Human Resources Office by phone or email. title: Staff Hardware Systems Engineer (Embedded)
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient Embedded Systems Engineer to serve as a technical leader for our complex instrumentation systems. You will own embedded hardware architecture decisions, lead cross-functional engineering teams through hands-on expertise, and drive critical design decisions that impact product performance. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge instrumentation technology while providing technical leadership in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with demonstrated leadership coordinating and aligning large cross-disciplinary teams
  • Extensive experience with embedded hardware debugging and analysis tools
  • Good understanding of PCA design, signal integrity, and system integration principles
  • Proven track record with Design Verification Testing (DVT) processes and V&V documentation
  • Strong root cause analysis capabilities for complex technical issues
  • Experience leading technical teams through expertise rather than process management
  • Systems thinking approach with understanding of interdependencies across subsystems
  • Hands-on troubleshooting experience with embedded system design and integration
  • Experience translating complex system requirements into actionable hardware specifications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences • Ability to make critical decisions and own technical outcomes in fast-paced environments
  • Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional engineering teams
  • Self-motivated problem solver who thrives on complex technical challenges

#LI-ONSITE

title: Trade & Working Capital Solutions Executive Director
description:
Trade & Working Capital Solutions Executive DirectorCountry: Spain

IT STARTS HERE


Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.


This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) is Santander's global division that supports some of the world's most complex and sophisticated corporate and institutional clients, offering customized services and value-added wholesale products to best meet their needs.


THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE


Banco Santander, S.A. is looking for an Executive Director based in Madrid.


As Trade & Working Capital Solutions Executive Director, you will work closely with the Global Head of Origination to define, execute, and monitor Santander’s Trade and Working Capital origination strategy and core growth initiatives linked to Investment Banking transactions.


This is a highly visible and cross-functional leadership role that combines strategic planning, business development, transaction execution, project management and stakeholder engagement. You will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, coordinating strategic initiatives across geographies and products, and helping position Trade & Working Capital solutions as a core component of Santander’s Investment Banking offering.

The role requires the ability to operate effectively across multiple senior stakeholder groups, including Coverage, Investment Banking, Risk, Product, Country Management and Executive Management teams. The successful candidate will be expected to influence decision-making, build strong internal networks, mobilize resources across the organization and drive execution in complex environments.


In parallel, you will originate, structure and execute Trade & Working Capital solutions associated with strategic corporate transactions, including M&A, Leveraged Finance, Project Finance, and other structured financing situations.


A strong understanding of corporate finance and capital structures, combined with strategic thinking, commercial acumen and leadership capabilities, is essential.


We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


  • Contribute to the execution of Santander’s global Trade & Working Capital origination strategy, identifying growth opportunities and advancing key business development, transformation and commercial initiatives across the franchise.
  • Lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives, coordinating stakeholders across geographies, products and functions to ensure effective execution and delivery of strategic objectives.
  • Develop strategic analyses and materials to support sales efforts, strategic business development decisions, governance forums and senior management discussions.
  • Originate, structure and execute Trade & Working Capital solutions in connection with M&A, Leveraged Finance, Project Finance and other strategic transactions, providing advice on optimal working capital solutions within the broader financing and capital structure framework of clients.
  • Build trusted relationships across Coverage, Investment Banking, Risk and Product teams, influencing stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mobilizing resources to deliver commercial and strategic outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING


Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Professional Experience


  • 8+ years of experience (Required)
  • Trade & Working Capital Solutions, Private Debt, Structured Finance, M&A or Relationship Management in the Corporate & Investment Banking of a bank with an international background (Preferred)
  • Consulting or legal background will also be considered
  • Experience in top-tier financial institutions, advisory firms, consulting firms or alternative investment platforms is highly valued (Preferred)
  • Demonstrated experience operating in complex international organizations and managing senior stakeholder relationships (Required)

Education


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or Law (Required)
  • MBA or CFA will be valued

Languages


  • English – Fluent / Bilingual (Required)
  • Spanish – Fluent (Required)

Hard Skills


  • Strong understanding of Trade & Working Capital products and their interaction with broader capital structures.
  • Solid knowledge of Corporate & Investment Banking products (Project Finance, Leveraged Finance, M&A, etc.).
  • Advanced project management and execution skills, with experience leading complex strategic programs.
  • Excellent PowerPoint and executive communication skills, including preparation of materials for senior management and governance forums.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast-paced.
  • Strong understanding of AI tools.

Soft Skills

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate long-term vision into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills, with the ability to create networks across functions, geographies and seniority levels.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration capabilities, able to mobilize teams, align diverse stakeholders and drive results in complex environments.
  • Entrepreneurial and execution-oriented mindset, with a high degree of autonomy, ownership and focus on business development and value creation.
  • Strong judgment, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, balance risk and commercial objectives, and support effective decision-making.
  • Strong team leadership skills, with the ability to develop talent, foster collaboration and drive high performance across teams.

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT


Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.


  • We’re enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
  • Flexibility that works. Enjoy a hybrid working models—some days remote, some days onsite with your team—along with flexible hours.
  • Learning for life. Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com)
  • Competitive rewards. Receive a highly competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, motivating you to keep growing with us.
  • Financial advantages. Benefit from preferential banking terms, special interest rates on loans, life insurance, and more.
  • Your health is our priority. Through BeHealthy, our global wellness programme, we promote Holistic wellbeing.
  • We know family is everything. That’s why we offer childcare support and family-friendly programmes tailored to each life stage.
  • Always by your side. Get access to Santander Contigo, our program for employees and their families offering legal, emotional, and administrative advisory services.
  • Extra benefits. Gym/WellHub membership, medical centers in some of our facilities, meal subsidy, parking, shuttle service from various points in Madrid, as well as exclusive discounts and offers for Santander employees. And that’s only the beginning—we’ll tell you more when you join!

We’re here to keep you motivated, help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE


Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.

WHAT TO DO NEXT


If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP IN YOUR JOURNEY?

title: Landscape Enhancement Designer and Estimator
description:
Work With The Best

We are building the premier outdoor living company in the country by creating a “family of family companies” across the nation. Now you can build your landscaping career with the best, working in one of our many company locations nationwide. Learn from the top experts in the field and work on some of the country’s largest and most complex landscape projects. Take advantage of opportunities to share and exchange best practices across our network. The opportunities are endless.

Position Summary: Berghoff Design Group is looking to add an experienced Landscape Enhancement Designer and Estimator to our growing Maintenance team. The Landscape Designer & Estimator plays a pivotal role in the design and development of custom residential landscapes. This individual is responsible for conceptualizing and rendering innovative designs, preparing detailed proposals and takeoffs, and collaborating with clients and internal teams to ensure each project is both beautiful and feasible. The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, and experienced in high-end residential landscape design.


Key Responsibilities

Design & Visualization

● Create custom landscape designs tailored to client preferences, site conditions, and budget.

● Develop conceptual and detailed design plans using CAD and 3D rendering software.

● Present design concepts to clients with clarity and professionalism.

● Stay current with design trends, materials, and horticultural best practices.

Estimating & Proposal Development

● Generate accurate takeoffs and cost estimates for design projects.

● Prepare comprehensive design proposals, including scope of work, materials, and pricing.

● Collaborate with production and procurement teams to ensure feasibility and alignment with company standards.

● Revise estimates and designs based on client feedback and site conditions.

Client & Team Collaboration

● Participate in client meetings, site visits, and design presentations.

● Work closely with project managers, sales teams, and installation crews to ensure design intent is maintained throughout execution.

● Communicate effectively with clients to understand their vision and guide them through the design process.


Qualifications

● Bachelor’s degree in Landscape Architecture, Horticulture, or related field.

● 3+ years of experience in residential landscape design and estimating.

● Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion, or similar.

● Prior CRM experience, preferably Aspire

● Strong understanding of design development, graphic presentations, and construction document preparation of landscape plans including hardscape, planting, lighting, irrigation, and details.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

● Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

● Experience working with high-end clientele and delivering luxury-level service.

The Perks

  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • FSA/HSA
  • PerkSpot
  • Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance
  • Paid time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement (after one year of service)

description:
Job Description

Technology Engineer – Camp Hill, PA
This is an exempt level position.

Position Summary:
The Technology Engineer will apply engineering principles and best practices at the facility with tasks ranging from process design, troubleshooting & optimization to implementation of best practices to the evaluation/implementation of new technologies. The primary purpose of the position is to enable facility success by ensuring that plant process systems are designed, built, operated, and maintained at optimal levels.

Essential Job Functions:
  • Display a dedication to lead, develop and support safety and promote a safety culture. Promote continuous process safety improvement.
  • Benchmark the location versus internal and external best available technologies and drive improvements.
  • Manage and prioritize the Wave portfolio in cooperation with the Plant Manager or and/or the Milling Technology CoE, where applicable.
  • Develop and maintain a 5-year project portfolio to include capital budgeting, execution and to strike a balance between NDE and productivity/growth.
  • Manage projects end to end from initiation to execution, overseeing scope development, budgeting, planning, engineering, procurement, execution, commissioning, and closeout to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with the appropriate COE’s to ensure alignment of technology.
  • Explore, propose and/or champion new process technologies, equipment design improvements and equipment suppliers.
  • Work within the Global Milling Technology Team to standardize operations, share standard methodologies and implement new technologies.
  • Assist plant operations in solving applicable technical problems.
  • Support the facility in setting up goals.
  • Work closely with company subject matter experts on the implementation of innovative approaches to plant operation and maintenance.
  • Act as a resource for plant process engineers through coaching, mentoring, and conducting training sessions.
Required Skills:
  • Dedication to working safely and to the awareness for the safety of others.
  • Strong knowledge of a variety of process unit operations. Some examples include grain handling, wheat cleaning & milling, product conveyance, dust control systems, packaging and/or bulk vessel loading, automation systems, and warehousing.
  • Experience with optimization/analytical processes and tools.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for working with plant colleagues, management team, and Milling Technology CoE.

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience with plant process systems at a production facility.
  • Desired Experience: Operations supervision and/or Process/Project Engineer.

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Oracle Financials)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect (Oracle Fusion Financials) to lead the architecture and design of enterprise financial systems supporting financial accounting, reporting, and revenue processes.

This role is responsible for defining and governing the solution architecture across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials, ensuring the platform is scalable, compliant, and aligned with the long-term enterprise ERP strategy. The architect will play a key role in Oracle Fusion implementations, platform modernization, and the evolution of the organization's financial systems landscape.

The position works closely with Finance leadership, product teams, engineering, and external partners to translate business requirements into robust system architecture that supports financial operations, regulatory compliance, and reporting integrity.

About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments

  • 10+ years of experience working with enterprise ERP platforms supporting financial processes.
  • 7+ years of strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Subledger Accounting, and Revenue Management/Revenue Recognition.
  • 7+ years of proven experience in Oracle Fusion solution architecture, configuration, integration design, and implementation.
  • 7+ years of strong understanding of financial accounting processes, financial reporting, and enterprise financial controls.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance Systems, or a related field.

It would be great if you also had…

  • Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Financials, including integration, modernization, or migration to Oracle Fusion.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes and their integration with Oracle Fusion Financials.
  • Hands-on Oracle Fusion development and technical experience, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher, OTBI, FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs, and Fusion extensions.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing complex financial system architectures in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15).
  • Experience designing enterprise integrations and end-to-end financial data flows across multiple upstream and downstream systems.
  • Experience supporting large-scale Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations, migrations, or transformations.
  • Background working with global financial operations, multiple legal entities, and diverse regulatory environments.
  • Familiarity with financial reporting platforms, data platforms, and enterprise integration technologies.
  • Experience modernizing legacy ERP environments, simplifying application landscapes, and reducing technical debt.
  • Experience participating in vendor evaluations, solution assessments, and technology selections.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and enterprise architecture best practices.
  • Master's degree in a related field (optional but beneficial).

What will you be doing in this role?

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials.
  • Lead architecture and solution design activities for Oracle Fusion implementations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
  • Define scalable architecture patterns, system integrations, and financial data flows supporting enterprise financial operations.
  • Establish and enforce architecture standards, design governance, and technical controls across Oracle Fusion Financials.
  • Ensure system designs support financial controls, audit requirements, regulatory compliance, and reporting integrity.
  • Define integration patterns between Oracle Fusion and billing, procurement, banking, tax, and financial reporting platforms, ensuring end-to-end data quality.
  • Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, and implementation teams to translate business requirements into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Evaluate solution design options, including standard Oracle Fusion functionality, configurations, extensions, and integrations, while minimizing unnecessary customization.
  • Contribute to the long-term ERP strategy, including legacy ERP modernization and migration to Oracle Fusion.
  • Provide architecture oversight for implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and cross-functional projects.
  • Review technical designs and work closely with development teams and implementation partners to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex Oracle Fusion Financials and integration challenges.

About the Team

This role sits at the intersection of Finance and Enterprise Technology, supporting high-visibility, high-impact financial systems used for operational accounting, revenue management, and financial reporting.

You will collaborate with Finance leadership, product teams, engineering, and external partners to ensure the Oracle Fusion ERP ecosystem is stable, compliant, scalable, and aligned with the organization's long-term transformation strategy.

The team operates in a highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with internal stakeholders across Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, FP&A, and Enterprise Architecture, as well as strategic implementation partners.

Hours of Work

  • Full-time, permanent position primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to collaborate across global time zones as needed.
  • Hybrid position working 2–3 days per week on-site.
  • Must live within a commutable distance of our Philadelphia, Kansas City, or Ann Arbor offices.
