description:
Customer Experience Consultant | S1 | Retail Banking | East Northern Ireland | NewtownardsCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE


Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.


This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.


THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE


Santander is looking for a Customer Experience Consultant based out of Newtownards Branch, working 35 hours per week, on a rota’d basis Monday to Saturday, between 8am & 6pm.


For our customers, you’ll be more than just the friendly face and voice of Santander. You’ll be a listener and problem solver. Whether you’re helping someone with a simple cash transaction, aiding them with technology in the banking hall, transacting with them over the phone or protecting your customers against fraud and scams, you’ll never know what the next challenge will be.


What’s not in doubt is that you’ll have plenty of support. Life in a branch can be busy, varied and challenging, so we’re a close-knit team.

You’ll be totally flexible in your approach and comfortable in undertaking a broad range of activities. This means not limiting your time and focus on one particular element of your role. You’ll thrive on the variety this gives you and take satisfaction for operating in a multi-skilled environment. You’re the eyes and ears of our business after all.


We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


  • Listening to, understanding and anticipating customers financial needs
  • Presenting options and solutions across a range of products and services with a primary focus on digital first
  • Answering customer calls into our contact centre
  • Developing meaningful relationships with customers, and working with colleagues to look after their day-to-day and long-term needs
  • Helping us be a bank that’s simple for colleagues and customers to deal with

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT


At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

  • The starting salary is £25,158.00 together with a £500 flexible benefit allowance and the opportunity to earn a discretionary performance-related bonus of 8% of salary
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 26 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.
  • Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates. Including: medical insurance, dental insurance, and health assessments
  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.
  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.
  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans.
  • As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services
  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE


At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen Branch location.

Right to work in the UK


  • All candidates must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander.

WHAT TO DO NEXT


If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.


If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk

title: Sr CRA
description:
Sr CRA

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates, and may, with supervision, lead, global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • May provide training or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. May perform training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned.
  • May be mentored and assigned clinical operations lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL), or operational line manager. For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA I will use the business card title of Sr. Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close out
    Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs
    Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    As required, collaborate and build relationships with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff
    Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager
    Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations
    Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements
    Develop country level informed consent forms
    Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared
    Participate in bid defense meetings

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Basic level of critical thinking skills expected.
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Get to know Syneos Health


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: 2nd Shift Biobank Technician I
description:
Azenta Inc.

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity

Job Title

2nd Shift Biobank Technician I

Job Description

Company Overview


At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer-focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

Azenta Life Sciences is a global leader in the life sciences space with headquarters in Burlington, MA, and offices and operations worldwide. We are a market leader in automated bio sample management solutions and genomic services across areas such as drug development, clinical and advanced cell therapies for the industry's top pharmaceutical, biotech, academic and healthcare institutions globally. We provide unparalleled capabilities with our lab analysis, sample management and storage services, informatics software, and consumables, with the largest installed base managing over 1 billion samples globally.

How You’ll Add Value

The Biobank Technician I is responsible for registering, labeling, retrieving, and discarding irreplaceable biological and production materials (research samples, products, etc.) as assigned, while maintaining appropriate temperatures. The incumbent is accountable for performing all assigned tasks with full attention and accuracy to maintain the integrity of the material and the storage processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform all functions methodically and in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Adhere to FDA Good Practices (GMP, GTP, GLP, GDP), International Organization of Standards (ISO), College of American Pathologists (CAP) standards and other regulatory requirements as outlined in SOPs.
  • Handle materials in a manner that maintains required temperatures (+30oC to -196oC) per the project definition and SOPs.
  • Follow all safety requirements for working with infectious and noninfectious biological materials, radioactive materials, chemical compounds, and drug products.
  • Utilize the Company Inventory Management System for all sample handling tasks and ensure chain of custody and audit trails for all activities are proactively maintained.
  • Register samples into the inventory management system. This includes:
  • Scanning of sample barcodes.
  • Quality checking information on the material being registered against project and shipment manifest specifications.
  • Overlay or place a new label onto materials as required per the project specification.
  • Store materials at required temperatures in designated storage units for the specified category of the material.
  • Retrieve and package materials requested for lab services, outbound shipments, and discards. Perform quality control checks.
  • Perform discard quality checks
  • Investigate and document issues encountered in registration or retrieval of materials using common and company specific systems.
  • Generate location management reports.
  • Assist with upkeep of the facility.

What You Will Bring

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Two years’ experience demonstrating teamwork, self-motivation, detail orientation, and professionalism
  • Life Sciences experience preferred
  • GMP/GTP/CLIA Experience, preferred
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to read/understand/interpret basic correspondence, instructions, rules, procedures in English language
  • Ability to make decisions and judgements based on reasoning
  • Ability to perform tasks with care, is thorough and checks work for accuracy and completeness
  • Strong attention to detail for repetitive tasks
  • Ability to use Microsoft Excel, performing basic and intermediate functions

Physical Requirements

  • Reaching/lifting/bending.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds
  • Extended periods of standing or sitting
  • Right- and left-hand finger dexterity
  • Ability to discern colors or use of color correction glasses
  • Ability to work with refrigerants (e.g., dry ice and LNs) using proper PPE

Your Working Conditions:

  • Employee will be working in an area with potentially infectious materials
  • Employee will be responsible for maintaining a clean work environment and enforce and follow Universal Precautions for bloodborne pathogens when working in an area considered to be potentially contaminated
  • The position requires flexibility to report to either the Indianapolis or Plainfield facility based on business needs

Join us and help enable life‑changing discoveries by keeping critical life science systems running reliably—every day.

title: Technical IT Consultant: Data & Integratie
description:
Technical IT Consultant: Data & Integratie

Hasselt · Hybride werken · Master met IT-achtergrond · Schoolverlaters welkom

Analyseer complexe bedrijfsprocessen. Ontwikkel de logica die ze aanstuurt. Bouw expertise op bij grote organisaties.

Jobomschrijving

Als Technical IT Consultant werk je aan implementatieprojecten voor grote, bekende nationale en internationale bedrijven. Je combineert programmeren met analyse en vertaalt business requirements naar datamodellen, workflows en integraties tussen bedrijfssystemen.

Een sterke start voor een ambitieuze master die technische diepgang wil combineren met bedrijfsinzicht. Opleiding, certificeringen en begeleiding door een senior consultant helpen je om die expertise op te bouwen.

Jouw rol: van analyse tot implementatie

Samen met analisten en ervaren consultants implementeer je oplossingen voor Master Data Management (MDM). Daarmee beheren bedrijven hun belangrijkste gegevens en bepalen ze hoe die worden gecontroleerd, goedgekeurd en uitgewisseld tussen toepassingen zoals ERP en e-commerce.

Binnen een gespecialiseerd softwareplatform gaan programmeren en configureren hand in hand. Concreet werk je aan:

  • Technische analyse: requirements vertalen naar logische stappen, voorwaarden en uitzonderingen.
  • Development: businesslogica ontwikkelen in JavaScript voor datavalidatie en procesautomatisering.
  • Datamodellering en workflows: gegevensstructuren, relaties en goedkeuringsprocessen configureren.
  • Integratie: gegevensuitwisseling met andere bedrijfsapplicaties mee realiseren.
  • Kwaliteit: oplossingen testen, technische problemen analyseren en verbeteringen implementeren.

Grote projecten, een gespecialiseerd team

Onze opdrachtgever is een gespecialiseerd IT-consultancybedrijf binnen een grote, financieel sterke technologiegroep. Dat combineert persoonlijke samenwerking met de kennisdeling, opleidingsmogelijkheden en stabiliteit van een grotere organisatie.

Projecten brengen je in contact met processen binnen aankoop, productbeheer, logistiek, verkoop en e-commerce. Samen met een vast projectteam van analisten en technische collega's werk je meerdere maanden aan een klantomgeving. Zo leer je de samenhang tussen afdelingen en systemen begrijpen en zie je jouw oplossingen in gebruik.

Gericht investeren in jouw expertise

Ervaring met MDM of het platform is vooraf niet nodig.

Tijdens de eerste anderhalve maand combineer je online platformopleidingen en certificeringen met praktische toepassing. Een senior consultant begeleidt je, bespreekt technische keuzes en geeft feedback op je werk.

Afgebakende opdrachten vormen het vertrekpunt. Daarna volgen complexere workflows en integraties, meer zelfstandigheid en geleidelijk meer klantencontact. Zo groei je naar het zelf toelichten van oplossingen en deelnemen aan workshops en klantgesprekken.

Jouw achtergrond

Een master met een stevige IT-component vormt de basis. Denk aan informatica, computerwetenschappen, een ingenieursrichting met IT-focus, handelsingenieur in de beleidsinformatica of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Een programmeerbasis, bijvoorbeeld in Java, vanuit je opleiding, stage, eindwerk, eigen projecten of eerste job. Binnen deze functie werk je onder meer met JavaScript.
  • Analytisch inzicht: complexe vragen structureren, verbanden leggen en rekening houden met uitzonderingen.
  • Een communicatieve houding: gerichte vragen stellen, ideeën bespreken en je redenering helder uitleggen.
  • Een vlotte kennis van Nederlands en Engels.

Kennis van SQL, API's, XML of JSON is meegenomen. Schoolverlaters en kandidaten met een eerste werkervaring zijn welkom.

description:
The Confidential Advocacy, Resources and Education – Support Center (CARE-SC) Advocate will provide supportive services to USC students who have been impacted by sexual violence. The Advocate will accompany sexual assault survivors to SART centers for rape exams, arrange transportation to and from SART Centers, and provide linkage to aftercare services on campus, including but not limited to student health care services, counseling, advocacy, Title IX, and academic accommodations. They will be available 24/7 to respond to requests from DPS, USC After-Hours Call Center (Protocol) or students who request services due to a sexual assault either on or off-campus. Advocate will be required to complete a TB test, and fingerprinting. The position is housed in the Confidential Advocacy, Resources and Education – Support Center (CARE-SC) in USC Student Health. The position reports to the Advocate Supervisor and Director of CARE-SC.


Departmental Specific Summary


Essential Duties

  • Responds to the victim and stays with the USC student from entry to the emergency room, law enforcement and forensic interview, nurse exam and through recovery. Be present with the victim at the SART hospital before, during and after the medical forensic examination and police report. Provides professional knowledge of evidenced based concepts, principles, procedures and practices for victims of sexual violence. Provide advocacy services and support to survivors of relationship violence, stalking, and sexual assault or abuse. Work with first responders to sexual assault (emergency room, police, etc.) in ensuring that victims receive respectful and appropriate services and information.
  • Work directly with victims of sexual assault in providing support, the full realm of advocacy, referrals. Assists in filing (if applicable) complaints to the designated office and the Title IX Coordinator; provides victims/survivors with Victims Bill of Rights and assists (if applicable) in applying for Victim Witness Assistance Program services. Act as liaison for victims of sexual assault with other agencies and with tribal, state, and federal criminal justice agencies and keep victims updated on the status of their cases and any criminal proceedings. Lends support by attending and accompanying the student(s) at the criminal trial or Title IX hearings. Provides emotional support, resources and referrals. Ensures that the victim’s rights are not violated. Coordinates and monitors program personnel and participant registration and attendance, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring accurate data gathering and input; participates in participant follow-up activities and project evaluation reports.
  • Provide linkage for USC students back to student health/medical services on campus. Enhance and build resources to meet the specific needs of sexual assault victims. Make appropriate referrals to community resources to victims Provide crisis intervention, care, support and advocacy to those who report incidents of sexual assault or interpersonal violence. Develop rapport and maintain regular contact with students to assess their need for supportive services and/or make modifications to reporting options, safety planning and service referrals. Assist with safety planning and provide guidance. Document and maintain confidential client files on all services provided Practice and ensure confidentiality and safety at all times.
  • Participates and attends required meetings, conferences and trainings locally and at remote locations which are appropriately related to the program. Maintains and demonstrates an awareness and understanding of advances and changes in the fields related to Title IX. Performs advanced-level document production including complex formatting of documents, creating charts and spreadsheets and establishes and maintains databases.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Req Associate’s Degree Degree in human services or related field.
  • Req 1 year 1-2 years working in human services or social services.
  • Req Knowledge of counseling or case management skills.
  • Req Ability to establish and maintain effective and supportive relationships with victims of violence.
  • Req Crisis intervention skills.
  • Req Knowledge of resources for survivors of violence.
  • Req Knowledge and practice of trauma-informed care approaches.
  • Req Must have the ability to manage time effectively and complete multiple tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Req Maintain personnel and client confidentiality.
  • Req Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Req Ability to work effectively across different groups with cultural sensitivity
  • Req Strong collaboration and relationship management skills
  • Req Strong project and time management skills
  • Req Knowledge of crisis counseling and case management skills
  • Req Knowledge of resources for survivors of power and gender-based harm
  • Req Excellent listening skills
  • Req Knowledge and practice of trauma-informed care approaches
  • Req Ability to establish and maintain effective and supportive relationships

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pref Bachelor’s Degree Degree in human services or related field.
  • Pref 6 - 12 months Experience as an advocate with interpersonal violence, sexual or domestic violence agency.

description:

Je komt terecht in een hecht en Agile engineering team van ongeveer 10 professionals die samen grenzen verleggen in de sector.

title: Senior Executive Talent Consultant
description:
The Senior Associate, Executive Talent Acquisition is a core member of the Executive Search team, supporting senior and executive-level search mandates through market intelligence, talent mapping, and executive reporting. The role turns complex market and talent data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders, and helps run a disciplined, well-governed executive search function. It is ideal for an analytical, polished professional who thrives in a fast-paced, highly confidential environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Research & Talent Mapping: Conduct in-depth market scans across financial services and adjacent industries to identify target executive candidate pools and inform search strategy for priority mandates.
  • Senior Leadership Insights: Prepare and present data-driven market scans and talent insights to VP+ stakeholders, translating complex talent data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Executive Reporting & Data Storytelling: Lead weekly and quarterly executive reporting on search activity, market intelligence, and hiring trends; continuously improve and automate reporting workflows to increase speed and accuracy.
  • Budget Management & Vendor Relations: Oversee invoice processing and financial tracking for the Executive Search budget in line with enterprise accounting guidelines; act as the primary liaison for external retained search firms.
  • Search Support & Confidentiality: Support end-to-end executive search execution and maintain strict confidentiality and data integrity across all mandates and candidate information.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience in talent acquisition, executive search, research, or a related analytical role; financial services exposure is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct market research and build talent maps.
  • Strong data analysis and storytelling skills, with experience presenting to senior audiences.
  • Proven track record of process improvement and reporting automation.

Job Description

Reporting to the Pre-award & Clinical Operations Manager, the Research Quality Assurance Coordinator is responsible and accountable for the coordination, facilitation, guidance and evaluation of activities aimed at establishing and maintaining quality assurance and regulatory compliance in the conduct of clinical research at the Research Institute based at the St. Joseph’s Health System. Emphasis is placed on providing support to Research Institute researchers conducting investigator-initiated and regulated research and acting as a liaison for research staff in the conduct of investigator-initiated and sponsor-initiated clinical research. The coordinator is expected to independently liaise with the research community (including physicians, investigators, researchers, research coordinators, and research assistants conducting research at the Research Institute), Hamilton Integrated Research Ethics Board (HiREB), Clinical Trials Ontario (CTO), St. Joseph’s Health System (SJHS) divisions and organizations and specifically St. Joseph’s Healthcare Hamilton (SJHH) departments linked to research, clinical trial sponsors, regulatory bodies, and other external groups and research networks.


Responsibilities:


  • Support Research Institute operational and financial objectives through accurate administrative work.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with all Research Institute, SJHS, SJHH, and OH&S policies.
  • Provide professional and responsive service to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Liaise with Research Institute research personnel, external partners, and vendors to ensure the conduct of research is in line with policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Maintain complete and accurate administrative and research related records.
  • Review of monthly HiREB reports, assessing for institutional compliance as well as resource requirements.
  • Review CTO application submissions for institutional compliance, resource requirements and institutional approval as required.
  • Supports the implementation of a new institution-wide review and approval process for all research studies conducted at the Research Institute. This includes conducting assessments of research documentation in accordance with existing regulations and guidelines and ensuring that institutional resources are engaged appropriately.
  • Report to the leadership team on quality assurance and compliance findings resulting from the assessments.
  • Conduct risk analysis on all study proposals and ethics applications and coordinating review from other departments within the Research Institute, SJHH or SJHS as required (e.g. privacy, cyber security, AI oversight committee).
  • Liaise with researchers and research staff for quality-related education and direction.
  • Staying up to date with national and international regulatory requirements.
  • Provide monitoring services to investigator-initiated research studies at the Research Institute.
  • Work with external sponsors to facilitate and/or establish quality requirements for research studies
  • Draft training materials with related guides documents
  • Maintain systems to monitor and record regulatory training and related records for all affiliated researchers, staff, learners, and visitors as applicable.
  • Provide planned and ad hoc training sessions for affiliated researchers, staff, learners, and visitors regarding clinical research compliance, regulations, institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Facilitate the affiliation process, reviewing all applications for completeness and accuracy and then approving for contract initiation.
  • Participates in the development of internal research quality systems for clinical research conducted at the Research Institute (e.g., vendor qualification for equipment calibration, deviations from protocol, etc.).
  • Conduct periodic reviews of established institutional quality systems to ensure functionality and effectiveness, and work with SJHH units/departments to improve systems where deficiencies are identified
  • Supports the Manager in the conduct of Audits.
  • Design, implement, and maintain tracking systems for all clinical trial inspections and audits conducted across the Research Institute.
  • Develop and maintain templates, tools, guidance documents, and other resources to guide Research Institute researchers and their staff in the conduct of clinical research to facilitate regulatory compliance.
  • Provide training and support the implementation of quality systems by affiliated researchers and their staff.
  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of a centralized review process for all applications and ongoing communications/submissions to regulatory authorities (e.g., Health Canada, FDA, etc.) for investigator initiated regulated research.
  • Verify the accuracy and completeness of the applications prior to authorizing institutional signature.
  • Track all pending, active and completed investigator-initiated applications to regulatory authorities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Experience in a quality management capacity and/or SOP development is preferred.
  • Experience with Research Ethics Boards and Health Canada is required.
  • Experience in monitoring, auditing or inspection activities an asset.
  • Proven knowledge of clinical research conduct.
  • Demonstrated proficient knowledge of TCPS, GCP, FDA and Health Canada rules and regulations governing research.
  • Demonstrated ability to implement a multi-faceted research quality initiative within a complex environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to respond to multiple research support service requests/demands in a friendly, efficient, expert manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to take a diplomatic and constructive approach to working with people and in a team environment. • Possesses a high level of professional integrity.
  • Demonstrated excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment and discretion, recognizing potential areas of sensitivity and handling appropriately.
  • Critical assessment and objective evaluation skills.
  • Attention to detail and highly developed organizational, prioritization and planning skills.
  • Ability to take direction as well as work independently.
  • Strong electronic data management skills and advanced skills in Microsoft Office programs.
  • Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. title: Trade & Distribution Director
description:
Trade & Distribution Director


ABOUT ASTRAZENECA


AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.


Join a high-performing team, empowered to cut through the noise and drive real change. Our agility and pace, coupled with scientific focus, powers us to spot opportunities in the market that keep us moving forward and into new spaces.



SITE DESCRIPTION


AstraZeneca is experiencing a significant transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, driven by a commitment to advancing healthcare, innovation, and sustainable growth. Building on our global legacy, AZ KSA is rapidly evolving its operations to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to the ambitious goals outlined in the Saudi Vision 2030. We are investing in talent, digital solutions, and new ways of working; all designed to enhance our impact on patient outcomes and reinforce our leadership in therapeutic areas. This dynamic environment calls for visionary, agile professionals who thrive in change and are motivated to help shape the future of healthcare in KSA.


ROLE SUMMARY


The Trade & Distribution Director will lead AstraZeneca KSA’s trade and distribution strategy, ensuring efficient, compliant and commercially sustainable availability of AstraZeneca medicines across the Kingdom.


The role will provide strategic leadership across pharmaceutical distribution, wholesalers, key trade partners, supply and demand coordination, commercial agreements, inventory management and channel performance.


Working closely with Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Market Access, Procurement, Regulatory Affairs, Legal and Compliance, the role will ensure a robust route-to-market model that supports business growth while maintaining strong governance and product availability.


The position will also play a critical role in managing strategic relationships with distributors and other external partners in the Saudi market.


What you’ll do


Trade & Distribution Strategy


  • Develop and execute the KSA Trade & Distribution strategy in line with AstraZeneca's commercial priorities and long-term business objectives.

  • Define and continuously optimize the route-to-market and distribution model across relevant public and private healthcare channels.

  • Evaluate market evolution, channel dynamics and distribution trends to identify opportunities and potential business risks.

  • Ensure the distribution model supports appropriate and timely access to AstraZeneca medicines across Saudi Arabia.

  • Translate commercial strategy into clear trade, channel and distribution priorities.

Distributor & Strategic Partner Management


  • Lead the strategic management of pharmaceutical distributors, wholesalers and other trade partners.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLAs and governance mechanisms to monitor distributor performance.

  • Lead business reviews with strategic partners and ensure appropriate performance against agreed commercial and operational objectives.

  • Lead or support negotiations related to distribution agreements, commercial terms and service levels in collaboration with relevant internal functions.

  • Identify and address performance gaps and implement corrective action plans where required.

  • Build long-term, value-based partnerships while protecting AstraZeneca's commercial interests.

Commercial & Financial Management


  • Own the commercial performance of the trade and distribution operation, including relevant budgets, costs and financial KPIs.

  • Partner with Finance to monitor gross-to-net, distribution costs, inventory, receivables and other relevant financial indicators.

  • Support commercial planning, forecasting and budget cycles.

  • Identify opportunities to improve distribution efficiency and optimize cost-to-serve.

  • Provide senior management with clear insights into trade performance, opportunities and risks.

Inventory & Product Availability


  • Partner closely with Supply Chain and Commercial teams to ensure appropriate inventory levels across the distribution network.

  • Monitor stock levels, inventory coverage, expiry exposure, supply constraints and potential stock-out risks.

  • Establish appropriate inventory controls and governance with distributors.

  • Support demand planning and forecasting by providing channel and market insights.

  • Lead cross-functional resolution of significant distribution or product availability issues.

Data, Analytics & Performance Management


  • Establish trade and distribution dashboards covering key business and operational KPIs.

  • Monitor sell-in, sell-out, stock-on-hand, inventory days, service levels and distribution performance.

  • Improve distributor data quality, transparency and reporting.

  • Use market and channel data to identify risks, opportunities and changes in customer purchasing behavior.

  • Provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership based on trade performance.

Compliance & Governance


  • Ensure Trade & Distribution activities comply with AstraZeneca policies, Code of Ethics, applicable local legislation and regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain strong governance around distributor contracts, commercial arrangements and business interactions.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Regulatory and Finance on trade-related risk management.

  • Ensure appropriate governance of pharmaceutical storage and distribution activities through approved partners.

  • Proactively identify compliance, operational and financial risks and ensure effective mitigation plans are established.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Provide leadership and strategic direction to the Trade & Distribution function.

  • Build strong collaboration across Commercial, Market Access, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and Regulatory Affairs.

  • Develop team capabilities and create a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Represent Trade & Distribution in relevant senior leadership and cross-functional forums.

  • Act as the internal subject-matter expert for trade, distribution and route-to-market topics.

Essential for the role


AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.


Essential Capabilities:


  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Pharmacy, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of significant experience within the pharmaceutical, healthcare or FMCG industry, with strong exposure to trade, distribution, commercial operations, supply chain or related functions.
  • Strong knowledge of the Saudi pharmaceutical market and distribution landscape.
  • Proven experience managing distributors, wholesalers or strategic commercial partners.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen.
  • Experience managing contracts, commercial agreements and complex negotiations.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with experience using data to drive commercial decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrix organization.
  • Strong senior stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.
  • Strong leadership, communication and negotiation skills.
  • Fluency in English; Arabic would be advantageous.

Desirable Capabilities:


  • MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.

  • Previous leadership experience within Trade, Distribution, Commercial Excellence, Market Access or Supply Chain in the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Strong understanding of the Saudi healthcare ecosystem across government, institutional and private channels.

  • Experience managing complex distributor relationships and route-to-market transformations.

  • Experience with digital trade analytics and distributor performance management.

  • Experience working within a multinational pharmaceutical organization.

  • Good understanding of Saudi pharmaceutical distribution and regulatory requirements.


Why AstraZeneca?


At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. title: Vice President, Project Manager - Compliance and Financial Crime
description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG, one of the world’s top five banks with over 360 years of heritage and a global presence spanning 50 markets, is seeking a Vice President, Project Manager to join their Compliance and Financial Crime Portfolio Change function in London. This role offers you the opportunity to be part of a renowned institution committed to becoming the world’s most trusted financial group. You will play a pivotal part in delivering complex change projects that support both MUFG Bank and Securities EMEA plc, working within a highly supportive team environment where your expertise in compliance and financial crime will be valued. With access to high-profile clients, cutting-edge technology, and strategic transformation programmes, you’ll enjoy a workplace that prioritises stability, collaboration, and professional growth. Flexible working opportunities and generous training resources are available to help you thrive in your career.

* Join a globally respected bank with a rich history and strong commitment to trust, stability, and sustainable business practices.

* Work closely with senior stakeholders across diverse teams to deliver impactful compliance and financial crime initiatives that shape the future of banking.

* Benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing training opportunities, and supportive leadership dedicated to your personal and professional development.

What you'll do:

As Vice President, Project Manager – Compliance and Financial Crime at MUFG in London, you will be entrusted with leading complex change projects that drive strategic transformation across the organisation. Your day-to-day activities will involve collaborating with senior stakeholders from both MUFG Bank London branch and Securities EMEA plc to ensure seamless delivery of compliance-related initiatives. You will facilitate meetings with subject matter experts (SMEs) and account executives (AEs), run steering committees and working groups, manage RAID logs, business justification documents, status reporting activities, and translate technical analysis into actionable insights for non-experts. Success in this role requires you to maintain structured project plans that adapt to changing needs while keeping all parties informed about risks, dependencies, budgets, and progress. By fostering an inclusive environment where consensus is achieved through gentle yet assertive communication, you will help MUFG realise its vision of being the world’s most trusted financial group.

* Take overall responsibility for delivering complex change projects from initial design through build, deployment, and handover to business units within the Compliance and Financial Crime portfolio.

* Manage the full project lifecycle by adhering to standard governance frameworks and best practices from project initiation to closure, ensuring all milestones are met efficiently.

* Work collaboratively with relevant business units and key stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of projects that align with organisational objectives.

* Create and maintain comprehensive project plans, revising them as necessary to accommodate evolving requirements and priorities.

* Facilitate steering committees and cross-functional working groups, ensuring accountability for actions against planned timelines while fostering consensus among participants.

* Act as a trusted partner to functional stakeholders and the Planning department by providing timely updates on issues, risks, dependencies, and progress towards agreed outcomes.

* Ensure transparency in risk management by identifying, escalating, and resolving risks or issues in alignment with business owners’ needs.

* Produce detailed management information reports regarding project health, delivery progress, budget status, and resource allocation.

* Work closely with technology teams and business product owners to design fit-for-purpose solutions that meet compliance and financial crime requirements.

* Identify resource demands for each initiative and assign responsibilities appropriately while managing project costs against budget constraints.

What you bring:

Your proven experience as a Vice President Project Manager – Compliance and Financial Crime will be instrumental in driving successful outcomes at MUFG. You bring deep knowledge of investment banking operations coupled with hands-on expertise in compliance (data quality, data governance, regulatory reporting/monitoring) or financial crime (AML/KYC/Sanctions screening). Your interpersonal skills allow you to work effectively with senior stakeholders across international teams while maintaining a structured approach under pressure. You are adept at managing large workloads against tight deadlines without compromising accuracy or transparency. Your advanced numerical abilities support robust budgeting processes while your proficiency in project management tools ensures seamless tracking of deliverables. By demonstrating empathy during conflict management situations and nurturing collaborative relationships between departments, you contribute positively towards achieving organisational goals. Your educational background further enhances your credibility when engaging with consultants or SMEs during fact-finding sessions.

* Extensive experience leading full lifecycle complex projects within investment banking environments is essential for quick understanding of content and anticipating risks or issues.

* Minimum five years’ proven track record delivering projects for financial institutions within timeframes and budget constraints demonstrates your dependability.

* Strong governance approach ensures adherence to best practice standards throughout project delivery.

* Effective communication skills enable you to build relationships across diverse skillsets internationally while maintaining transparency.

* Advanced proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project or Planview supports efficient planning and tracking of deliverables.

* Proven ability to manage budgets responsibly while producing accurate status updates on project finances.

* Demonstrable experience managing multiple senior-level stakeholders fosters collaborative outcomes across departments.

* Direct experience identifying project outputs and tracking business benefits ensures tangible results are achieved.

* Degree-level education is required; programme/project management or financial markets accreditation is beneficial for further credibility.

* Excellent attention to detail combined with advanced Microsoft Office skills (PowerPoint, Visio, Excel & Word) enables precise documentation.

What sets this company apart:

MUFG stands out as one of the world’s leading financial institutions thanks to its unwavering commitment to trustworthiness, stability, and sustainable growth. With more than 180,000 employees operating in 50 markets worldwide—including commercial banking, trust banking, securities services, asset management—MUFG offers unparalleled opportunities for professional advancement within a supportive network. The IT Planning division provides oversight for strategic delivery portfolios across EMEA entities while championing simplification initiatives aligned with business targets. Employees benefit from flexible working arrangements designed around their needs alongside generous training resources that foster continuous learning. MUFG’s inclusive culture values collaboration above all else; every team member is encouraged to share ideas openly so that together they can achieve meaningful outcomes for clients globally. As part of this prestigious organisation headquartered at Ropemaker Place in London’s financial district, you’ll enjoy access to high-profile projects that make a real difference—supported by knowledgeable colleagues who are committed to helping you succeed every step of the way.

What's next:

If you’re ready to take your career forward by joining one of the world’s most respected banks in a pivotal project management role focused on compliance and financial crime transformation—apply now!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements.

MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy and maternity, race, gender reassignment, religion or belief and marriage or civil partnership.

We make our recruitment decisions in a non-discriminatory manner in accordance with our commitment to identifying the right skills for the right role and our obligations under the law.

title: Solution Consultant (Oslo)
description:
What if your next tech role didn't make you choose between people and technology? At ConnectMyApps, Solutions Consultants work with both. We build integrations for client across Europe that make their business applications work together, across HR, finance, ERP, CRM and more. We're growing our Customer Solutions team and are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join us in Oslo.

What you'll do

You'll work across the whole customer journey, from first conversations and onboarding to solution design, implementation, testing and ongoing support. That includes:

→ Working out what the customer is trying to achieve, even before the requirements are technical

→ Exploring what customer and third-party systems can (and can't) do, and how their APIs let them talk to each other

→ Turning business needs into clear technical specifications

→ Using AI to help turn those specifications into reliable integrations, then reviewing, validating and refining

→ Leading test sessions with customers and stakeholders

→ Working closely with customers, partners and our team to make it all work in the real world

This isn't a traditional developer role. We want someone who thinks first and builds second: someone who can look at a problem, understand what's going on, ask the right questions, find a solution and explain it clearly to everyone involved. You don't need to be an experienced coder, but you should be curious about how technology works and willing to find your way around solution components and code.

What we're looking for

Someone who moves comfortably between people, business and technology. You:

→ Communicate and present well, and are comfortable in front of customers

→ Can turn business conversations into technical requirements, and explain technical ideas in plain language

→ Understand APIs and how systems work together

→ Think logically and enjoy solving problems

→ Pick up unfamiliar systems quickly

→ Have used or experimented with AI agents for coding and/or document generation

→ Enjoy variety: different systems, industries and problems

→ Are comfortable with fast pace and having to switch context between projects

→ Are a real team player

New graduates are welcome. We care more about potential, curiosity and mindset than years of experience.

Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language is a must. Other languages are a bonus.

Why ConnectMyApps?

A part of The Amesto Group, ConnectMyApps was founded in 2014 with the purpose of simplifying integration and setting business free from manual data entry. We're a small team that changes the way companies work. Here you'll work directly with customers and see the impact of what you build.

Many of the tools and improvements we use today came from the team's own ideas. So, when you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it, and we want you to explore it. You won't just follow an established process. You'll help shape what our way of working looks like.

We foster a strong team spirit. We have regular team events, spend time together outside work and, importantly, enjoy each other's company. You won't be one small piece of a big puzzle. You might actually leave a mark.

Benefits

We offer competitive salary, pension, health insurance, career development, travel and hotel discounts, Ruter discounts, mobile phone packages, discounted lunch at an excellent canteen, and discounts at selected Oslo shops and services.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway

  • Position type: On-site

  • Level: Junior level

  • Requirements: Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language required

  • Education: University degree or similar

  • Work permit: Must have full residency/work permit for Norway.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

An Amesto Group company, ConnectMyApps was founded in 2014 with the purpose of simplifying integration and setting business free from manual data entry and inconsistent records.

Our team is a dedicated, committed, curious, knowledgeable, and unstoppable team of integration experts, who provide our customers with valuable advice, ensuring a seamless integration experience.

title: Vil du jobbe med drift og overvåking av meldingstjenesten?
description:
Cyberforsvaret er Forsvarets fremste ressurs i utviklingen mot et nettverksbasert forsvar. Cyberforsvarets CIS Regiment (CCR) er Cyberforsvarets største avdeling, og samler en rekke svært varierte kompetansemiljøer som avhenger av god samhandling. Avdelingen skal sørge for fungerende kommunikasjons- og virksomhetsprosesser i fred, krise, konflikt og krig.

For ytterligere informasjon om Cyberforsvaret (CYFOR) og Forsvaret generelt, se www.forsvaret.no.

Ved Cyberforsvarets CIS Regiment, CIS bataljon Sør, Sambandsavdeling Viken, Gruppe Sikkerhet & Krypto, er det ledig fast stilling som sambandsleder - førstekonsulent. Arbeidssted er Oslo.

Sambandsavdeling Viken er ansvarlig for drift og vedlikehold av applikasjoner, plattformer, telekommunikasjon, nettverk og kryptosystemer for Forsvaret i Oslo, Kolsås og på Rygge. Avdelingen er ansvarlig for sikkerhetsarbeid og kryptosystemer i avdelingen.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Drift, overvåking og behandling av meldingstjenesten i Forsvaret og andre systemer som benyttes ved Sambandssenter Oslo
  • Utføre filoverføringer mellom forskjellige plattformer
  • Veilede brukere av meldingstjenesten
  • Bistå på andre tjenestefelt innen operativt samband som for eksempel kryptotjenesten
  • Støtte og bidra til øvrig tjenesteproduksjon i avdelingen
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Minimum fullført videregående utdanning
  • Annen utdanning og/eller lang relevant arbeidserfaring /tjenesteerfaring kan etter vurdering kompensere for eventuell manglende formell utdanning
  • Må kunne sikkerhetsklareres for Strengt Hemmelig og Cosmic Top Secret før tiltredelse (for mer informasjon om sikkerhetsklarering se se )
  • Må kunne gjennomføre og bestå krypto kvalifiseringskurs grad 1 innen 6 måneder etter tiltredelse
  • God norsk muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne. Søknaden skrives på norsk
  • Førerkort klasse B

Ønskelige kvaliﬁkasjoner

  • Fagbrev innen relevant fagområde, eksempelvis IKT / sikkerhetsfag
  • Sambandserfaring fra Forsvaret
  • Gjennomført førstegangstjeneste
  • Minimum ett års relevant arbeidserfaring, for eksempel innen arkiv, sentralbord, resepsjon etc.
  • Gode og grunnleggende kunnskaper om kontorstøttesystemer (Excel, Word, Powerpoint, Outlook eller tilsvarende)
  • Kjennskap til Forsvarets meldingshåndteringssystem XO-mail
  • Kryptokvalifiseringskurs grad 1
  • Gjennomført førstegangstjeneste
  • God kjennskap til Forsvaret og Forsvarets sikkerhetsrutiner
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på engelsk

Attester og vitnemål må legges ved søknaden. Høyere utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning (tidligere godkjenninger av NOKUT aksepteres også). Godkjenning må dokumenteres.

Personlige egenskaper
  • Positiv, omgjengelig og fleksibel
  • Serviceinnstilt
  • Gode samarbeidsevner
  • Strukturert og evne til å jobbe selvstendig
  • Må trives i et til tider hektisk miljø
  • God helhetsforståelse
  • Serviceinnstilt og Innstilt på nye utfordringer
Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende jobb med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Tilhørighet til et godt fag- og utviklingsmiljø med god kompetanse
  • Kurs og opplæring etter behov
  • Mulighet for inntil to timer trening i arbeidstiden
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Forsvaret har gode velferdsordninger samt egen bedriftshelsetjeneste
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode låne-, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger ()

Du vi få lønn som førstekonsulent stillingskode 1408, kr 500 000 - 650 000 brutto per år, avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. Av lønnen trekkes 2 % lovbestemt innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.

KontaktinformasjonHelland, Marius Sandvik, Gruppesjef sikkerhet & krypto, 994 79 073 Norbeck, Bernt Kristian, Avdelingssjef, 91881821 Arbeidssted 0150 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Forsvaret Referansenr.: 5184084118 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 07.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

En jobb i Forsvaret er noe mer enn en jobb. Forsvarets viktigste oppgave er å skape sikkerhet for Norge og trygghet for befolkningen. Uansett hvilken stilling du har, er du med på å ivareta landets og fellesskapets interesser. For å verne om alt vi har og alt vi er, må vi selv leve ut de verdiene vi er satt til å forsvare. Vi ønsker derfor ansatte som bidrar til en god kultur ved å vise respekt og ta ansvar for hverandre, og ha mot til å handle riktig og våge å si ifra.

Som en del av Cyberforsvaret er du med på å drifte, sikre og forsvare Forsvarets datasystemer, nettverk og høyteknologiske plattformer mot angrep i og fra cyberdomenet.

I Forsvaret er det ønskelig at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, kulturell bakgrunn, hull i CV-en eller funksjonsevne. Vi vil sørge for tilrettelegging på arbeidsplassen hvis det er behov for dette. Noen av Forsvarets stillinger kan ha egne helsekrav og krav til fysisk skikkethet.

I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25 andre ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Det er egne regler for militære stillinger.

Forsvaret benytter elektronisk søknadsbehandling. Attester og vitnemål må legges ved søknaden. Høyere utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være offentlig godkjent av NOKUT eller Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse. Godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Det blir gjennomført bakgrunnsjekk når sikkerhetsklareringen gjennomføres.

title: Test Manager-Device SW
description:
ZEISS in India

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics.

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

Further information at ZEISS India.

Job Description – Test Manager (Device Software)

Domain: Medical Devices / Ophthalmic Equipment

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced QA Engineering Manager to lead and own end-to-end software verification and validation activities for a medical device product.

The role involves managing the complete QA engineering function, including device software testing, test laboratory and infrastructure, test automation, quality documentation, QMS compliance, resource planning and team development.

The candidate will provide technical and people leadership, ensuring high-quality product delivery in compliance with applicable medical device standards and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. QA Strategy & End-to-End Ownership

  • Own the overall test strategy, planning, estimation and execution of all device software testing activities.
  • Drive functional, integration, system, regression and non-functional testing.
  • Ensure testing quality, coverage, timelines, risk management and release readiness.

2. Device Software Testing & Infrastructure

  • Lead verification and validation activities of device software.
  • Establish and manage device testing laboratories, test benches, hardware interfaces, test environments and infrastructure.
  • Ensure effective testing of software-hardware integration and system-level functionalities.
  • Continuously improve test architecture, testability and testing methodologies.

3. Test Automation & Engineering Excellence

  • Define and drive the test automation strategy and roadmap.
  • Establish reusable automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines wherever applicable.
  • Explore AI/GenAI-based testing solutions to improve engineering efficiency and test coverage.

4. Quality Documentation & QMS

  • Own QA documentation, including test plans, test specifications, test protocols, reports and traceability matrices.
  • Ensure compliance with medical device QMS and software lifecycle requirements.
  • Work with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure audit and regulatory readiness.
  • Drive risk-based testing and verification of risk control measures.

5. People & Resource Management

  • Build and lead a strong QA engineering team through recruitment, hiring and onboarding.
  • Mentor test engineers and technical leads, drive competency development and succession planning.
  • Manage resource allocation, team performance and overall delivery.

6. Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with software development, systems engineering, product management, quality and regulatory teams.
  • Coordinate with international teams, suppliers and external testing partners.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, quality metrics and delivery status.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.
  • 8–12 years of experience in software testing and verification & validation, preferably in medical devices or complex embedded systems.
  • 3–5 years of experience leading and managing QA/V&V engineering teams.
  • Strong experience in device software testing, system integration and hardware-software interaction.
  • Experience in test laboratory and infrastructure setup and management.
  • Good understanding of ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 and medical device regulatory requirements (FDA/CE).
  • Experience in test automation, test strategy, risk-based testing and quality documentation.
  • Proven experience in hiring, mentoring and developing engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ophthalmic medical devices or surgical equipment.
  • Experience in embedded software and hardware-software integration testing.
  • ISTQB Advanced Level certification.
  • Experience with Agile, V-model and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled testing solutions.

Key Leadership Competencies

  • Strong technical and engineering leadership.
  • End-to-end ownership and accountability.
  • Effective people management and team development.
  • Strategic planning and execution excellence.
  • Strong quality mindset and regulatory awareness.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.
  • 8–12 years of experience in software testing and verification & validation, preferably in medical devices or complex embedded systems.
  • 3–5 years of experience leading and managing QA/V&V engineering teams.
  • Strong experience in device software testing, system integration and hardware-software interaction.
  • Experience in test laboratory and infrastructure setup and management.
  • Good understanding of ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 and medical device regulatory requirements (FDA/CE).
  • Experience in test automation, test strategy, risk-based testing and quality documentation.
  • Proven experience in hiring, mentoring and developing engineering teams.

description:
Welcome to Halperns Steak & Seafood! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. Here's a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you...

Meat Trimmer

Orlando, FL


Welcome to Halperns’! The dedicated employees who work at Halperns' are passionately committed to this business and the customers they serve. Being part of Halperns' means being part of something important, something unique, and something special. This commitment is made clear by the superior meat and seafood specialty products we distribute.


There's a seat at our table for you...


Hourly Pay Range: $20 + Based on Experience

Work Schedule: 10am until finish - weekends during busy season


What we offer:

  • Medical, Prescription Drug, EFAP Benefits after 30 days of employment
  • Dental, vision and other voluntary plans
  • Pre-Tax Saving Accounts
  • Profit Sharing
  • Family culture and career advancement

Position Summary:

Responsible for portion and merchandising all boneless meat products.


Essential Functions:

  • Works with supervisors and production managers to schedule production.
  • Cleans, trims, slices, and portions subprimals of beef, pork, lamb and veal for future processing.
  • Inspects meat products for defects, bruises or blemishes.
  • Accurately reads and comprehends all customer specific special instructions.
  • Perform Quality Control checks and communicates with supervisors and manager any defects.
  • Separates meats and byproducts into specified containers and seal containers.
  • Uses knives, cleavers or other equipment to perform meat cutting and trimming.
  • Weighs meats and tag containers for weight and contents.
  • Follows company’s detailed product specifications.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

  • Must have working knowledge of production equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to portion all boneless cuts of meat in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Ability to reduce processing costs but cutting and sizing portions accurately with good yields as well as meeting customer specs.
  • Ability to problem solve in terms of trimming and product substitutions.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressure, challenging environment
  • Must be a team player and possess a positive attitude.
  • Ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally, in English.
  • Must demonstrate the ability to understand the Meat Buyer’s Guide specifications as they relate to the company’s internal product specifications.
  • Follows company’s Quality Control procedures.​

You are required to provide your most recent employment experience for your application to be considered complete.
